ARC-003.subject: E3.trajectory_commitment
ARC-003.title: E3 selects and commits trajectories.
ARC-003.what_would_answer:
ARC-003 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "E3 SELECTS" and "E3 COMMITS" are separate assertions
with OPPOSITE readiness. Digested 2026-07-21 by splitting on testability.

LEG A -- SELECTION (testable now, COMMITMENT-FREE).
ANSWER "E3 selects" if the E3 score gradient over the candidate set is non-flat
and predicts the taken candidate above chance, AND lesioning the E3 contribution
to the score collapses selection toward the candidate-generation prior.
ANSWER "E3 is a pass-through, not a selector" (FAIL) if candidate choice is
statistically indistinguishable from the proposer's prior. MECH-060/061/062 and
the tri-loop gating claims would then lose their premise.
NON-DEGENERACY: the candidate pool must be DIVERGENT (cand_world_pairwise_dist
above floor -- the GAP-A guard). Scoring a pool of near-identical candidates
tests nothing and would manufacture either verdict. Measured at the scoring
level; requires NO sustained execution.

LEG B -- COMMITMENT (BLOCKED; not queueable as of 2026-07-21).
ANSWER "E3 commits" if a selected trajectory persists across >= N steps under a
perturbation that would flip an uncommitted selector, with a measurable
release/switch cost (hysteresis).
This leg requires SUSTAINED MULTI-STEP ACTION COMMITMENT, and the basal-ganglia /
action-commitment layer is under active construction (ARC-107 BG-selector
constitution; MECH-448 demotion lever provisional; MECH-449 substrate_conditional;
commit/release-duration falsifiers 460j/485i/654h pending). A behavioural FAIL run
now would RE-DERIVE THE F-DOMINANCE CONVERSION CEILING ("a navigable landscape
does not convert to committed action because the selector drowns it"), NOT
adjudicate ARC-003 -- a confound, not a verdict.
RELEASE CONDITION: ARC-107 BG-selector constitution landed AND the
commit/release-duration levers (460j / 485i / 654h) returned.

ARC-005.subject: control_plane.precision_routing
ARC-005.title: Control plane routes precision and modes.
ARC-005.what_would_answer:
The falsifiable content is NOT "a control plane exists" (that is a design fact --
we built one). It is that the control plane ROUTES: has causal authority over
precision and mode that is DISSOCIABLE FROM CONTENT. If precision and mode are
readouts of what the agent happens to be processing, the plane is epiphenomenal
and all 88 dependents inherit a false premise.
Testable in V3 as a DOUBLE DISSOCIATION over the implemented channel set
(5-HT rigidity, phasic-surprise-burst gain, SalienceCoordinator mode prior,
pcc_stability mu): a 2x2 of {channels varied, content fixed} x {content varied,
channels fixed}, measuring (i) the E3 precision readout and (ii) mode-occupancy
distribution.
ANSWER "routes" (PASS) if channel intervention shifts precision and mode occupancy
monotonically with channel setting, AND the channel effect on mode occupancy
exceeds the content effect by >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed DELTA and by an absolute
floor of >= 0.15 occupancy-fraction, AND identical channel settings reproduce the
same regime across differing content.
ANSWER "readout, not router" (FAIL) if mode occupancy and precision are predicted
as well or better from content features than from channel settings. ARC-005 then
demotes and its dependents need re-derivation from whatever does the routing.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): in the
baseline arm at least two modes must be occupied >= 5% of steps, and the precision
readout must carry non-zero cross-seed variance (not floor-pinned). A single-mode-
collapsed agent makes both arms trivially identical and the comparison vacuous.
SCOPE: tests routing authority over the CURRENTLY-IMPLEMENTED channels. A PASS
does not vindicate every channel posited in MECH-002/MECH-004; it establishes the
plane is causal rather than decorative.

ARC-007.subject: hippocampus.path_memory
ARC-007.title: Hippocampal systems store and replay paths through residue-field terrain.
ARC-007.what_would_answer:
ARC-007 is CONJUNCTIVE and only one leg has ever been tested.
LEG 1 -- "hippocampal systems store and replay paths" -- is already carried
behaviourally by EXQ-114 (harm_rate 0.006 intact vs 0.765 ablated, 99.2%
reduction, 2/2 seeds). That is what the exp_conf 0.55 rests on.
LEG 2 -- "THROUGH RESIDUE-FIELD TERRAIN" -- is untested. Nothing in the evidence
trail distinguishes paths through a residue field from paths through an ordinary
spatial/latent map that residue merely co-varies with. Leg 2 is the whole
REE-specific content: without it ARC-007 reduces to "a hippocampus helps
navigation" -- true, generic, and not load-bearing for the 76 dependents that
assume residue-shaped terrain.
Answered by a RESIDUE-SCRAMBLE DISSOCIATION with the hippocampal path machinery
left fully intact: A0 intact / A1 hippocampus-ablated (the EXQ-114 reference arm,
establishing the base effect is live) / A2 residue field PERMUTED (residue values
shuffled across cells -- preserves the field's marginal distribution and the
spatial map, destroys the residue<->location correspondence) / A3 residue field
frozen at initialisation. Primary DV BEHAVIOURAL (harm_rate, path efficiency).
NOT hippo_quality_gap -- that probe is sign-inverted (EXQ-397/397c reclassified
non_contributory 2026-04-22) and must not be a verdict source until redesigned.
ANSWER "leg 2 holds" (PASS) if A2 and A3 degrade toward A1, recovering >= 50% of
the A0->A1 harm gap, with an effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta. The stored
paths depend on residue structure specifically.
ANSWER "terrain claim false, leg 1 survives" (FAIL) if A2/A3 are statistically
indistinguishable from intact A0. Path memory works, but not through residue
terrain. ARC-007 must then be SPLIT: the path-memory leg promotes on EXQ-114, the
residue-terrain leg demotes, and dependents assuming residue-shaped terrain
(MECH-073 value-shaped geometry, the replay cluster) need re-derivation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict):
(a) the residue field must carry live non-flat structure in A0 -- non-zero
cross-cell variance, not uniform-pinned; permuting a flat field is a no-op and
would manufacture a false FAIL; (b) the A0->A1 harm gap must reproduce EXQ-114's
magnitude, else there is no base effect to attribute; (c) the permutation must
verifiably change the field state, not merely be requested.
This also makes the 4-PASS/4-FAIL evidence split legible: a FAIL here EXPLAINS the
divergence rather than adding to it -- the passes tested leg 1, leg 2 was never
under test.

ARC-016.subject: cognitive_modes.control_plane_regimes
ARC-016.title: Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.
ARC-016.what_would_answer:
ARC-016 is UNLIKE the other load-bearing ARC claims: its core circuit is ALREADY
VALIDATED and it does not need a new discovery experiment. Digested 2026-07-21.
VALIDATED: E3-derived variance -> relative commit threshold -> BetaGate ->
action_selection, by EXQ-018b (PASS 5/5; commit_threshold = 2 x
training_baseline_variance; stable env commit_rate 0.90 / precision 718, perturbed
0.50 / 426 -- a 40% precision drop producing a proportional 40-point commit-rate
drop) and EXQ-060 (PASS 4/5; committed_step_count 5980,
hold_rate_during_committed 0.936).
ARC-016 would be OVERTURNED by the commit threshold ceasing to track E3-derived
variance -- commit_rate failing to move with a manipulated precision level while
the BetaGate remains wired. That would mean modes are NOT control-plane regimes
over shared predictive machinery but independent modules.

THE 15 FAILs DO NOT REFUTE THE CIRCUIT -- each is already diagnosed (see
heterogeneity_note): the V2 precision_regime_probe imposed precision externally
rather than deriving it from E3 and had no end-to-end commitment wiring; V3
EXQ-018's absolute threshold 0.40 was 100x the operating variance range (fixed by
going relative); EXQ-396a x3 and EXQ-396b are non_contributory on a train/eval
variance gap (train ~0.000032-0.000064 vs eval ~0.001, so the threshold never
engages in eval); EXQ-454 is non_contributory because the V_s monostrategy lock
dominates threshold-adaptation behaviour; V3-EXQ-642's autopsy records a
measurement / test-design gap, explicitly NOT a substrate_ceiling.
NOTE FOR GOVERNANCE (flag, not a digestion action): exp_conf 0.53 is therefore an
AGGREGATION ARTEFACT -- a claim whose FAILs are almost all already stamped
non_contributory still scores as if half-refuted. Re-scoring needs a governance eye
rather than a digestion edit, because stripping non-contributory FAILs can expose
that the REMAINING supports are thinner than the headline number suggested.

THE ONE GENUINELY OPEN ITEM is calibration, not mechanism -- named by this claim's
own notes as "pending recalibration with eval-derived threshold". ANSWERED by
re-running the EXQ-396 design with an EVAL-DERIVED (or online-adapted) baseline
variance in place of 2 x training_baseline_variance.
ANSWER "calibration artefact; validation stands" (PASS) if with an eval-derived
threshold the commitment threshold engages during eval and commit_rate tracks
manipulated precision monotonically.
ANSWER "genuine evidence against the circuit" (FAIL) if even a correctly-calibrated
eval-time threshold leaves commit_rate not tracking precision. That would be the
FIRST real evidence against ARC-016, and the 15 prior FAILs would need re-reading
as right for the wrong reasons.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (this is exactly what killed EXQ-396a/b -- trap it):
the commit threshold must ACTUALLY ENGAGE in eval -- commit_rate strictly between
floor and ceiling, not pinned at 0.0 or 1.0, and eval-time variance within the
threshold's dynamic range. A threshold that never fires makes all arms identical ->
substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict.
SCOPE GUARD: the run must be STRUCTURAL ONLY. Do NOT attach a behavioural harm DV --
that re-imports the V_s monostrategy-lock confound that voided EXQ-454, and the
behavioural consequence layer is ARC-029, not ARC-016 (split 2026-03-22).

ARC-018.subject: hippocampus.rollout_viability_mapping
ARC-018.title: Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.
ARC-018.what_would_answer:
ARC-018 is CONJUNCTIVE, and its PASS/FAIL split is NOT noise -- the evidence
separates cleanly by leg. Digested 2026-07-21.
LEG A "post-commitment viability mapping": EXQ-042 PASS (terrain_prior learns E3
preferences, hippo_quality_gap 0.393, terrain_loss -> 0), EXQ-053 PASS (terrain-
guided navigation 50x less harm than random, 5/5 criteria), EXQ-120 PASS
(discriminative pair). Three consistent PASSes.
LEG B "explicit rollouts": EXQ-172 FAIL (harm_advantage_mean -0.190), EXQ-196 FAIL
(harm_advantage_mean 0.0 across all 3 seeds). Two FAILs.
Every PASS is leg A; every FAIL is leg B. Carrying this as one conjunction at
exp_conf 0.547 averages a well-supported leg with an unsupported one and hides
both facts.
BUT LEG B IS UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED -- both FAILs are confounded, differently:
EXQ-172 ran at e2_world_r2 = 0.203 and the note itself concludes "rollout planning
counterproductive at current fidelity ... ARC-018 may be E2-quality-gated" -- a
negative advantage from a poor forward model indicts E2, not the rollout
architecture. EXQ-196 ran at good fidelity (e2_world_r2 0.766, residue populated)
and returned EXACTLY 0.0 on all three seeds -- an exact-zero-everywhere result is a
DEGENERACY SIGNATURE (the rollout output never reached the DV), which is why
governance classified it non_contributory and deferred the verdict.

LEG A would be OVERTURNED by: terrain-guided navigation losing its advantage over
random when the terrain prior is ablated WHILE hippo_quality_gap and terrain_loss
remain healthy -- i.e. the map is learned but inert.

LEG B is ANSWERED by a ROLLOUT-DEPTH ABLATION AT VERIFIED E2 FIDELITY: arms at
rollout depth 0 (no rollout) / shallow / full, run only after E2 fidelity clears a
measured floor. Primary DV harm_advantage_mean.
ANSWER "rollouts confer planning advantage" (PASS) if harm_advantage_mean scales
monotonically with rollout depth, effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta, on
>= 2/3 seeds. ARC-018 then holds conjunctively.
ANSWER "rollout leg demotes" (FAIL) if there is no advantage at ANY depth despite
verified-live rollouts and adequate E2. ARC-018 reduces to its mapping leg, and
MECH-092 plus the replay-consolidation dependents need re-derivation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (each drawn from a specific prior failure; any breach
-> substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict):
(a) e2_world_r2 >= 0.6 measured IN-RUN -- below this the EXQ-172 confound recurs;
(b) rollout-derived scores must carry non-zero cross-candidate variance -- the
rollout must actually discriminate between candidates;
(c) harm_advantage_mean EXACTLY 0.0 across all seeds is the EXQ-196 signature of an
unwired DV -- trap it explicitly and self-route substrate_not_ready. NEVER record
that pattern as a FAIL.

ARC-034.subject: ethics.test_scope_nth_order
