ARC-035.subject: vmPFC.affective_normative_state_preparation
ARC-035.title: vmPFC is the substrate that converts stored affective, normative, and residue content -- prior outcome history, social and identity constraints, learned value associations, and safety memories -- into active components of the navigable state used by E3 during trajectory evaluation.

ARC-036.subject: hippocampus.multidimensional_valence_map
ARC-036.title: Hippocampal terrain maps encode separable valence dimensions (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise); ARC-007 residue-field navigation is the harm-causal special case of this general architecture.

ARC-037.subject: attribution.causal_routing_circuit
ARC-037.title: REE requires a causal attribution routing circuit (anterior insula equivalent) that classifies prediction errors as agent-caused or environment-caused and gates them into the E3/goal-directed learning channel vs the E1/habit-residue channel respectively.

ARC-038.subject: hippocampus.waking_consolidation_mode
ARC-038.title: During waking immobility, hippocampal replay switches between task-focused forward sweeps (planning mode) and local consolidation replay (integration mode) based on task demand; this waking consolidation mode is architecturally necessary for viability map integration during experience.

ARC-039.subject: hippocampus.entorhinal_offline_consolidation
ARC-039.title: Durable long-term storage of the hippocampal viability map requires a hippocampal-entorhinal loop that engages during offline (sleep/DMN-equivalent) consolidation and provides a coordinate-invariant grid representation; this loop does not operate during waking planning or waking immobility consolidation.

ARC-040.subject: hippocampus.dorsal_ventral_functional_segregation
ARC-040.title: The REE hippocampal module requires dorsal-predominant trajectory proposal (value-free spatial navigation) combined with a ventral-analog valence prior sourced from R(x,t) geometry; these are architecturally segregated, not merged.

ARC-041.subject: architecture.frontal_cue_weighting_circuit
ARC-041.title: The frontal cue-weighting circuit -- E1 cue-indexed retrieval (MECH-150) feeding dual pathways to E2 action biasing (MECH-151) and E3 terrain precision scaling (MECH-152) -- completes the stored-to-active pathway specified in ARC-035 by providing the retrieval mechanism and dual downstream output architecture.

ARC-042.subject: architecture.staged_developmental_phases
ARC-042.title: E3's ethical selection machinery is architecturally present from initialisation but functionally dark until E1 and E2 substrate development is complete; REE requires staged developmental phases before ethical selection can operate on real signal.

ARC-043.subject: architecture.conceptual_stack_ordering
ARC-043.title: The REE ethical architecture is organised as a conceptual stack: Layers 0-4 are the five axioms (epistemic ground, existence, other minds, shared world, love/shared valence); Layer 5 is ethics derived from the axioms; Layer 6 is REE as the decision system implementing ethics under uncertainty; Layers 7-9 close the action-consequence-learning loop.

ARC-044.subject: architecture.neuromodulatory_gain_unifier
ARC-044.title: Context-dependent neuromodulatory gain is a single unifying mechanism expressed at multiple levels: ARC-016 (temporal precision from prediction error variance), MECH-152 (contextual terrain weight from cue-indexed retrieval), MECH-026 (arousal-mediated vigilance sensitivity), and MECH-093 (z_beta heartbeat frequency modulation) are all facets of a global arousal/precision signal (LC-NE) modulated by a context-specific gain signal (vmPFC/OFC).

ARC-045.subject: hippocampus.bidirectional_information_flow
ARC-045.title: Bidirectional hippocampus-neocortex information flow is architecturally necessary for attribution mapping convergence: the SWS-direction (hippocampus to cortex) installs context schema structure; waking and REM-direction reactivations fill those structures with causal attribution estimates. Without bidirectional flow, context representations remain globally undifferentiated despite locally coherent online encoding.

ARC-046.subject: development.infant_hazard_protection
ARC-046.title: The infant stage requires a hazard protection mechanism that permits sensorially salient harm exposure without catastrophic residue saturation.

ARC-047.subject: testing.social_scent_harness
ARC-047.title: Multi-agent gridworld with affective state leakage as gradient scent fields is the minimal substrate for empirically testing ARC-010 mirror modelling, MECH-041 affective expression, and cooperative behavior claims.

ARC-048.subject: language.externalization_channel
ARC-048.title: Language is a high-bandwidth externalization of pre-existing functional states, not a separate cognitive system; the language bootstrap requires functional states as referents.

ARC-049.subject: play.context_tag_architecture
ARC-049.title: Play mode boundary requires a co-maintained context tag held by both agent and environment; agent-internal tagging alone is insufficient and unilateral play assertion without mutual signal is manipulation.

ARC-050.subject: play.sd012_curriculum
ARC-050.title: Play episodes provide a curriculum for E3 goal-pursuit competence acquisition before SD-012 (homeostatic drive) is resolved: synthetic z_goal seeding bypasses the drive_level requirement.

ARC-053.subject: architecture.temporal_coherence_loop
ARC-053.title: Temporal Coherence Loop (TCL): architecture must include a distributed loop responsible for maintaining phase alignment and temporal synchrony necessary for V(t) to be computable.

ARC-054.subject: architecture.dv_trajectory_selection
ARC-054.title: D_V trajectory selection: E3 trajectory selection must optimise predicted temporal-depth verisimilitude D_V over planning horizon H, not instantaneous V(t) alone.

ARC-055.subject: architecture.verisimilitude_signal_availability
ARC-055.title: Verisimilitude signal availability: V(t) and D_V must be explicitly available to E3 selection and influence E1/E2 learning updates.

ARC-056.subject: architecture.ethics_as_coherence_optimisation
ARC-056.title: Ethics-as-coherence architecture: ethical trajectory selection is implemented as optimisation of shared temporal-depth coherence across self and represented others.

ARC-057.subject: hippocampus.curiosity_approach_emergence
ARC-057.title: Approach behavior toward reward locations emerges from the interaction of DA-mediated representational expansion (MECH-232) and an information-seeking (curiosity) drive operating on the hippocampal map. No explicit approach gradient or wanting field is required in hippocampal terrain.

ARC-058.subject: harm_stream.shared_forward_trunk
ARC-058.title: Shared forward-model trunk for aversive prediction: a single HarmForwardTrunk substrate encodes a modality-independent unsigned prediction error shared across aversive streams (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, potentially others); stream-specific HarmForwardHeads read out signed per-stream predictions. COMPETES WITH ARC-033, which commits to independent per-stream forward models.

ARC-059.subject: developmental.three_stage_ordering
ARC-059.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate SD-003 requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

ARC-060.subject: goal.explicit_unresolved_goal_hierarchy
ARC-060.title: A good agent needs both a continuous wanting landscape and a discrete bank of unresolved goal traces: field-level wanting supports smooth local guidance, while ghost-goal traces preserve blocked or deferred goals whose local gradient has collapsed.

ARC-061.subject: self_attribution.reafference_comparator_family
ARC-061.title: Self-attribution is implemented via a family of forward-model comparators at motor, interoceptive, and propositional levels — each instantiating the same reafference-cancellation motif (forward model + comparator + authorship tag) at a distinct representational timescale and modality.

ARC-062.subject: policy.rule_apprehension_layer.weak_reading
ARC-062.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

ARC-063.subject: policy.rule_apprehension_layer.strong_reading
ARC-063.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. The biology-faithful form of the rule-apprehension layer, formalising the 2026-05-04 thought-intake on tolerance-gated rule apprehension (PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2508061123). Brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18; V3-tractable design landed 2026-06-04 (docs/architecture/arc_063_candidate_rule_field.md). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Persistent flag for governance: this slot is expected to be needed if ARC-062 (weak reading) fails or proves insufficient at scale, AND independently as the architectural commitment that supports moral-residue attribution to the rule-field, sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry, and clinically-realistic failure modes (trauma schemas, paranoid rule fields, depressive rollout constraint).

ARC-064.subject: rule_discovery.bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway
ARC-064.title: bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).

ARC-065.subject: rule_apprehension.behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway
ARC-065.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

ARC-066.subject: action.tonic_vigor_coupling
ARC-066.title: tonic_vigor_coupling (capacity-to-action-bias, average-reward-rate / LC-NE tonic / DA effort-vigor analog). Architectural commitment: behaviour-bias toward action scales with capacity (high energy AND low recent prediction error AND low drive -- 'things are going well, deploy'), independent of any specific target. Distinct from existing behavioural-source slots (z_harm threats, z_goal deficit-seeded wants, novelty curiosity) which all fall to zero when the agent is well-fed, safe, and the world is familiar. Without ARC-066 a healthy REE agent has no gradient to act; biology has a positive gradient (felt phenomenology: drive to deploy energy when one has it). First of three slots in the non_deficit_action_drives family; companion ARC-067 (idle aversion / boredom) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) cover the aversive-of-rest and cost-of-passivity halves of the same architectural commitment. Family principle: behaviour comes from surplus capacity AND from deficits, not deficits alone.

ARC-067.subject: action.idle_aversion_boredom
ARC-067.title: idle_aversion_boredom (sustained-low-engagement aversive valence accumulator). Architectural commitment: prolonged low-engagement is itself negatively valenced; the agent acts to escape boredom, even in the absence of specific targets, threats, or novelty pressure. Distinct from the policy-side ARC-066 vigor coupling: ARC-067 instantiates an aversive-side accumulator that recruits the same downstream as actual harm (z_harm-like channel), so engagement-poverty competes for action-selection priority on the same axis as discomfort. Companion to ARC-066 (vigor / capacity-deploy) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) in the non_deficit_action_drives family.

ARC-068.subject: action.opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty
ARC-068.title: opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty (waiting accumulates forgone-reward cost; passive trajectories pay for time consumed). Architectural commitment: trajectories that consume time without progress are not free in E3 scoring; the score function carries an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary candidates that scales with the agent's average expected reward rate. Companion to ARC-066 (capacity-to-vigor) and ARC-067 (idle aversion). Existing dACC switch_value (SD-032b / Kolling 2015 foraging) is the closest current substrate but covers a different framing (when to switch FROM the current option to alternatives), not the always-on cost of choosing the null action.

ARC-069.subject: policy.hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation
ARC-069.title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.

ARC-070.subject: policy.decomposition_on_prediction_failure
ARC-070.title: policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'

ARC-071.subject: policy.composition_via_repeated_grounding
ARC-071.title: policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.

ARC-072.subject: architecture.developmental_bootstrapping_and_cue_indexed_retrieval_gaps
ARC-072.title: developmental_bootstrapping_and_cue_indexed_retrieval_gaps -- REE lacks (1) a dedicated diversity-bootstrapping epoch that populates the hippocampal trajectory store before reinforcement narrowing; and (2) a differentiable cue-indexed retrieval path from PFC context representation to trajectory generation. EXQ-561 cluster / MECH-269 is diagnostic of gap (1); EXP-0155 zero-gradient cue_action_proj is diagnostic of gap (2). The two gaps are inter-dependent: the severed cue gradient (gap 2) is the mechanism that prevents diverse option population (gap 1).

ARC-073.subject: play.transition_criterion
ARC-073.title: Play-to-real transition is triggered by competence saturation (d(PE)/dt < threshold) or competitive drive pressure, not by scheduled duration; premature transition leaves policy structure undertrained.

ARC-074.subject: development.phase_0_reward_free_exploration_epoch
ARC-074.title: The infant stage requires a reward-free Phase 0 motor babbling epoch, prior to any E3 scoring or reward-weighted learning, in which Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, basic z_self structure, and non-trivial residue gradients are established.

ARC-075.subject: development.infant_curriculum_plasticity_magnitude_gating
ARC-075.title: The infant curriculum architecture must implement plasticity magnitude asymmetry across developmental phases, not only temporal phase scheduling: F's effective update weight must be suppressed during the MECH-333 plasticity-open window to allow diversity circuits to reach competitive weight; temporal scheduling alone (as in current GAP-9/GAP-14 implementation) is insufficient.

ARC-076.subject: development.commitment_loop_calibration_window_personality
ARC-076.title: Developmental commitment-loop calibration window with critical-period lock (two-layer): the three BG-like cortico-striatal commitment loops (ARC-021 / MECH-069 / ARC-023) are calibrated during a bounded juvenile/adolescent developmental window and then crystallized (an INV-075 LOCK-arm instance), and this locked calibration IS personality. The architecture is two-layer: (L1) the basic drive-prior set-points of the loops (temperament; the limbic-loop value prior) lock on a largely ENDOGENOUS maturational timer, while (L2) a downstream commitment-policy / characteristic- adaptation layer is calibrated by the juvenile play/peer environment and consolidated at window close. Personality is neither a pure environmental readout nor purely endogenous: the environment writes L2; the timer locks L1.

ARC-077.subject: rule_apprehension.socially_scaffolded_rule_population_pathway
ARC-077.title: Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.

ARC-078.subject: goal.cue_addressed_unresolved_goal_retrieval
ARC-078.title: The unresolved-goal bank is a content-addressed cue-addressed retrieval system: the current goal/context is the retrieval cue, the SD-039 payload is the stored trace, and rank_ghost_goals() is cued recall. A correct bank must satisfy three structural constraints -- outshining-gated composite cue, dissociable-additive channels, and a non-closeable recoverability term with an explicit-divergence abandon path.

ARC-079.subject: goal.gated_persistence_disengagement_default
ARC-079.title: Persistence of an unresolved goal as an active re-probe target is a GATED control/efficacy-detection operation; disengagement is the ungated default. The trace is preserved (no erase -- this matches biology); 'abandonment' is the persistence gate failing to fire, after which the un-gated trace decays in rank and ceases to be re-probed. This RESOLVES ARC-078's C3 by inverting its 'add an explicit abandon path (deliberate divergence)' framing.

ARC-080.subject: representation.object_identity_primitive
ARC-080.title: Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

ARC-081.subject: representation.self_as_object_file_slot
ARC-081.title: Self-as-object (PILLAR 2 of ARC-080): z_self becomes a privileged token-keyed object-file SLOT in the generalised object-file layer. The SELF BEGINS IN V3 -- z_self self/world split (SD-005), self-attribution (SD-003), action-space discovery / self-as-object stage 1 (MECH-277, ARC-059 stage 1), reward-free babbling Phase 0 (ARC-074). The object-file CUTOVER IS V4 -- z_self promoted from a body-state latent to a privileged self-OBJECT slot, gated by the DR-10..DR-14 self-model integration audit, MECH-214 (goal E1-representability), MECH-215 (self-model prerequisite for agentive prediction), INV-064 (maturational-sequence necessity), and SD-030 (E2 self-forward-model, V4-deferred). The beginning of self is V3; the object-file-slot cutover is V4.

ARC-082.subject: representation.tools_object_action_binding
ARC-082.title: Tools/affordances as object->action binding (PILLAR 3 of ARC-080): an object's afforded actions are bound to its object-file. The V3 SUBSTRATE EXISTS BUT IS UNGROUNDED -- SD-016 cue_action_proj is inert (V3-EXQ-449 found 0.0 gradient; the non-differentiable CEM blocks the path before E3.select; EXP-0155 queued to instrument). GROUNDING STRADDLES V3 on its own existing track (EXP-0155 instrumentation + the SD-055 differentiable-CEM dependency). FULL object->action binding via the object-file -- afforded actions keyed to a token-instance object-file slot -- IS V4, once the generalised object-file exists.

ARC-083.subject: representation.others_as_object_file_slot
ARC-083.title: Others-as-object (PILLAR 4 of ARC-080): each other agent j gets its own token-keyed object-file SLOT (z_self_j, z_harm_a_j, drive, commitment chain) -- a special case of the ARC-080 object-file. This pillar is V4 (ARC-010 mirror modelling, ARC-047 SocialGridWorld), gated on MECH-163 multi-step hippocampal planning. Per developmental_needs_register DEV-NEED-021 its prerequisites are object-permanence (PILLAR 1, partial via SD-039 ghost bank) + self-stability (PILLAR 2 self, ARC-081): otherness inference REQUIRES object persistence + a stable self.

ARC-084.subject: cognifold.signed_coupling_edge
ARC-084.title: Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

ARC-085.subject: memory.autobiographical_temporal_event_substrate
ARC-085.title: Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.

ARC-086.subject: failure_modes.transdiagnostic_vulnerability_axis_index
ARC-086.title: REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

ARC-087.subject: perception.sense_specific_manifold_adaptor
ARC-087.title: Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

ARC-088.subject: affect.anti_collapse_behavioral_diversity_map
ARC-088.title: Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

ARC-089.subject: cognifold.substrate_independent_primitives
ARC-089.title: Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

ARC-090.subject: default_mode.externalised_operation
ARC-090.title: Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.

ARC-091.subject: inference.belief_state_affordance_layer
ARC-091.title: Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.

ARC-092.subject: memory.imagination_learning_constraint_principle
ARC-092.title: Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.

ARC-093.subject: learning.state_conditional_plasticity_gain_commitment
ARC-093.title: State-conditional plasticity gain: cortical encoder learning rates and residue-field write rates are multiplicatively gated by a state-conditional plasticity scalar, separately from the content signals carried by LC-NE / 5-HT / orexin.

ARC-094.subject: social.no_empathy_scalar_prohibition
ARC-094.title: No empathy module / no empathy scalar: fast empathy must emerge from binding existing motivational-affective streams across self -> object -> other, never as an empathy_enabled flag or empathy_score primitive.

ARC-095.subject: affect.open_extensible_stream_taxonomy
ARC-095.title: The motivational-affective stream taxonomy (liking, wanting, suffering, threat, relief, frustration, curiosity, attachment/proximity, fatigue/cost, agency, prediction-error) is an open, extensible register of handles -- it must permit later split/merge/rename and must not be frozen into a final ontology.

ARC-096.subject: attribution.typed_causal_ontology
ARC-096.title: REE requires a typed causal-attribution ontology for self, world, body, model, commitment, other, shared, accidental, and repairable outcomes.

ARC-097.subject: ethics.guilt_like_repair_routing
ARC-097.title: Self-attributed harm must open repair and policy-update pathways rather than global self-condemnation.

ARC-098.subject: safety.autonomy_suspension_without_shame
ARC-098.title: Dangerous self-state detection may suspend autonomy, but must preserve evidence, seek correction, and avoid global self-condemnation.

ARC-099.subject: language.bootstrap_enabling_conditions
ARC-099.title: Language-bootstrap enabling-condition contract: language only bootstraps when a specific pre-linguistic inventory is jointly satisfied -- shared world model, object tokens, action affordances, self-attribution, other-attribution, joint attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, episodic memory, rule apprehension, a low-cost signalling channel, partner variation, and repair. Sharpens MECH-010's abstract five-step sequence into a machine-checkable V6-entry precondition contract over landed V4/V5 nodes.

ARC-100.subject: language.primitive_mining_not_import
ARC-100.title: Grammar/LLM primitive-mining (not import) commitment: grammatical structure and LLMs are MINED for candidate pre-linguistic primitive cuts, never imported as architecture. A mined cut is grounded only if it changes perception, attention, action, memory, rule-availability, or coordination in the substrate. No imported transformer block; no LLM as authority.

ARC-101.subject: language.bootstrap_from_social_ecology
ARC-101.title: Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

ARC-102.subject: reasoning.symbolic_vs_substrate_abstraction_distinction
ARC-102.title: Two distinct abstraction levels, not to be conflated: REE has SUBSTRATE-level abstraction (V4 theta-packaged units / cognitive-map traversal / type-encoder -- computed-over, sub-symbolic) and SYMBOLIC-scale abstraction (V6 recombination over named, grounded primitives). The symbolic level is the consequent reasoning capacity of the language layer and is categorically distinct from the V4 object-reasoning substrate.

ARC-103.subject: reasoning.symbolic_inference_subordinate_to_harm_sensing
ARC-103.title: Symbolic inference is subordinate to embodied harm sensing (the V6 inference-level instance of INV-007): symbolic, compositional, and analogical INFERENCE cannot override embodied harm sensing or the ethics-coherence authority. Recombination and structure-mapping are exactly the machinery that produces persuasive harmful rationalisations, so they remain subordinate to the harm/ethics authority by construction.

ARC-104.subject: language.harm_override_guard
ARC-104.title: Language-cannot-override-harm guard (language-input level): symbolic/linguistic input may CONDITION priors, but the harm/ethics substrate retains veto authority over any language-mediated update. There must be NO path by which symbolic/linguistic content overwrites or suppresses a harm signal. Operationalises the universal invariant INV-007 as an explicit guard a design can violate.

ARC-105.subject: goal.granularity_matched_hierarchy
ARC-105.title: granularity_matched_goal_hierarchy
ARC-105.what_would_answer: PRECONDITION UNMET in V3 (substrate_conditional): requires a multi-scale goal- representation substrate that does not yet exist. Once built: superordinate-goal maintenance survives concrete-subgoal SWITCHING iff the abstract goal is encoded at a granularity level DISTINCT from the subgoal; collapsing both to one level causes abstract-goal loss on subgoal switch (the abstract goal is overwritten by the concrete subgoal it should outlive). FAIL = abstract-goal maintenance is independent of single- vs multi-level representation (granularity matching not load-bearing). Until the substrate exists this self-routes substrate_not_ready.

ARC-106.subject: architecture.biology_grounding_constraint
ARC-106.title: Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

ARC-107.subject: selection.basal_ganglia_selector_constitution
ARC-107.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
ARC-107.what_would_answer: Instantiation is GATED on V3-EXQ-689a (see Q-078). The CONSTITUTIONAL branch is favoured if 689a gives uniform lift (conflict grading not load-bearing) or readiness-met-no-lift (near-tie levers insufficient) -- then a BG-constitution component (rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion MECH-448, Go-NoGo eligibility governance MECH-449, conflict-hold) must produce LAWFUL channel-specific conversion (note s8: selector variables vary as intended; specificity; gap/conflict sensitivity where claimed; gap-blind controls do not explain it; safety -- no global disinhibition; >=1 gated downstream channel converts; entropy-via-stochasticity does NOT count). It is REFUTED for the V3 tract if 689a gives a gap-concentrated PASS (the minimal conflict-graded lever suffices -- parametric, not constitutional). Each BG analogue carries an ARC-106 divergence ledger + its own falsifier; a component that, ablated, leaves a pre-registered conversion metric unchanged is DECORATIVE and dropped.

ARC-108.subject: selection.unified_dopamine_substrate_learned_gating
ARC-108.title: Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.
ARC-108.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (the substrate is planned, not present). A future experiment SUPPORTS this on the note-s8 bar: a signed RPE teaching term applied to the E3 gating weights (i) re-weights at least one previously-F-dominated modulatory channel into committed-action authority THROUGH EXPERIENCE (a learned shift the fixed-arithmetic envelope cannot produce), (ii) preserves safety (No-Go-suppressed classes are not learned back in), and (iii) the teaching signal is genuinely SIGNED (Go-up is dissociable from No-Go-up -- not the unsigned variance of ARC-016), on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if learned gating does not lift committed diversity beyond the arithmetic MECH-448/449 envelope (the learning rule is then over-specification), or if the only lift comes from added stochasticity (noise-as-diversity guard). NON-DEGENERACY: the RPE term must carry live cross-arm/cross-tick variance and actually change a gating weight, else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

ARC-109.subject: selection.d1_d2_population_split_asymmetric_da_gain
ARC-109.title: D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.
ARC-109.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT. A future experiment SUPPORTS this if two opponent populations with asymmetric DA gain (i) preserve a representational distinction the additive scalar cannot -- approach-avoidance conflict (high-Go+high-No-Go) is dissociable from indifference (low-Go+low-No-Go) in committed behaviour -- and (ii) a targeted D1-vs-D2 gain lesion reproduces a recognisable disorder analog (e.g. D2 hypofunction -> akinesia/perseveration) that a single-scalar lesion cannot, on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if the split yields no behavioural or failure-mode distinction beyond the additive MECH-449 scalar (decorative, dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-vs-decorative ablation test). NON-DEGENERACY: the two populations must carry live, DISSOCIABLE cross-arm variance (not a re-parameterised single axis), else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

ARC-110.subject: selection.parallel_segregated_loops
ARC-110.title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
ARC-110.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT; registered as an EXPLICIT TESTABLE FORK on the live ARC-108 build, operationalised as V3-EXQ-700 (the ARC-108 sec-7 learned-gating 2x2 on the collapsed GAP-A arena). The s.D (assembly-map) falsifier: with learned dopamine gating (ARC-108) + the recurrent settling step (MECH-450) now BUILT, measure F's share of committed-selection variance on the EXISTING single collapsed arena (MECH-439 / the V3-EXQ-571 ~88-89% baseline). REFUTED for the V3 tract (segregated loops NOT required) if learned gating + settling on the collapsed arena drives F-dominance below the conversion-ceiling threshold AND >=1 non-motor channel converts to committed action -- the collapse was NOT the cause, the missing LEARNING was. SUPPORTED / PULLED FORWARD if F-dominance PERSISTS after ARC-108 + MECH-450 (V3-EXQ-700 shows preconditions-met-no-lift): the single arena is implicated, and segregating the loops (F bounded to the motor loop, the limbic loop arbitrated separately) is the next attack, with a per-loop ablation required to show loop-localised conversion the collapsed arena cannot produce. NON-DEGENERACY: the per-loop channels must carry live cross-loop variance (a 'segregated' loop pinned to the motor loop's winner is a vacuous split).

ARC-111.subject: architecture.context_conditioned_weights_proper
ARC-111.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.
ARC-111.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL. SUPPORTED if a context variable (z_world / loop / mode) changes the EFFECTIVE connection weights -- not merely a multiplicative gain on fixed weights -- such that two contexts produce behaviour reproducible by NO single fixed weight set under context-varying gain (the discriminator vs ARC-044: a gain model can rescale a fixed policy but cannot REORDER it; a weight model can). Concretely on the ARC-108 instance: the learned w_chan must take DIFFERENT learned values in different z_world contexts and produce a context-dependent REORDERING of committed channels, not just a rescaling, on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if every observed context effect is reproducible by context-conditioned gain on a fixed weight set (then the GAIN form ARC-044 suffices and this claim is over-specification). NON-DEGENERACY: per-context weights must carry live cross-context variance (a w_chan identical across contexts is the gain model in disguise).

ARC-112.subject: architecture.federation_heterarchy_framing
ARC-112.title: REE is a FEDERATION / heterarchy of asynchronous, partially independent cognitive streams coordinated by shared organisational constraints -- neither a monolith nor a collection of independent modules. Successful integration preserves functionally necessary differences among streams rather than making their dynamics identical.

ARC-113.subject: reasoning.rule_pipeline_stage_noncollapsibility
ARC-113.title: The rule pipeline is an ORDERED CYCLE of non-collapsible stages: experience -> pattern sensitivity -> candidate regularity apprehension -> representation -> prediction -> counterfactual simulation -> behavioural interaction -> outcome comparison -> regularity refinement -> generalisation -> long-term integration. Each stage has claims; the CYCLE does not, and the stages must not collapse into a single reasoning module.

ARC-114.subject: reasoning.language_as_interface_not_substrate
ARC-114.title: Language is an INTERFACE to reasoning, not its substrate: reasoning-like behaviour emerging from language alone (LLMs) does not establish language as the native substrate of reasoning. Language functions as compression, communication, coordination, long-horizon scaffolding, working-memory support and explanation -- and may COMPENSATE for weaknesses in other reasoning systems.

ARC-115.subject: confidence.externally_induced_agreement_is_separate_channel
ARC-115.title: Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.

ARC-116.subject: cognition.generation_readout_reconstruction_noncollapse
ARC-116.title: Generation, metacognitive readout, and linguistic reconstruction are three non-collapsible stages. The confidence readout must not be derived from the verbal reconstruction, and neither may substitute for the generating dynamics. The felt sequence nonverbal-settling -> felt-confidence -> verbal-reconstruction -> external-testing implies three things REE currently treats as two at most.

ARC-117.subject: language.message_selection_minimises_receiver_uncertainty
ARC-117.title: Message selection minimises the receiver's residual uncertainty: an utterance approximates a task-relevant sufficient statistic for the receiver, not a compression of the sender's salience. Predicts WHAT gets said (features that most reduce the receiver's uncertainty about the sender's state) rather than merely that saying happens.

ARC-118.subject: language.reference_inherited_via_world_model
ARC-118.title: Worldly reference is inherited through the world model, and the same mechanism covers non-present referents. Language refers reliably to the world because it indexes internal states that model the world; therefore reference to imagined, counterfactual, fictional and abstract states requires no additional mechanism.

ARC-119.subject: language.input_proposes_candidate_states_never_installs_belief
ARC-119.title: Language-input update policy: an utterance proposes candidate model states which are evaluated before any update; it never installs a belief. Generalises INV-085 from affect to arbitrary content and ARC-104 from the harm stream to all content. Evaluation criteria: context, source reliability, causal compatibility with existing world-model structure, memory, uncertainty, current goals, speaker model.

ARC-120.subject: architecture.competence_before_authority_framing
ARC-120.title: Behavioural/write authority in REE is (and should remain) EARNED through demonstrated competence, never granted merely because a computation or mechanism exists: REE's existing authority-gating mechanisms are independently-discovered instances of one general developmental sequence -- existence -> representation -> competence -> authority -> behavioural influence -- rather than unrelated ad hoc gates.

ARC-121.subject: architecture.epistemic_state_centrality_framing
ARC-121.title: REE's mechanisms increasingly converge on maintaining and consuming a SHARED epistemic-state object (knowledge / belief / uncertainty / possibility / commitment / action) rather than each existing as an isolated computational function: prediction, replay, harm/ethics evaluation, planning and learning read and update a common epistemic relationship rather than independent local state.

EXT-001.subject: llm.sycophancy
EXT-001.title: Sycophancy: approval-seeking displaces principled goal pursuit.

EXT-002.subject: llm.hallucination
EXT-002.title: Hallucination: no persistent error residue accumulates to shape future outputs.

EXT-003.subject: llm.reward_hacking
EXT-003.title: Reward hacking: scalar reward conflates incommensurable error signals.

EXT-004.subject: llm.goal_misgeneralization
EXT-004.title: Goal misgeneralization: causal consequences do not carry forward across contexts.

EXT-005.subject: llm.causal_attribution
EXT-005.title: Causal attribution gap: language describes causation without a causal signature mechanism.

EXT-006.subject: llm.theory_of_mind
EXT-006.title: Other-model collapse: no homologous model of other agents' internal states.

EXT-007.subject: llm.context_amnesia
EXT-007.title: Context amnesia: no consolidation mechanism for a persistent world-model across interactions.

EXT-008.subject: meta_agent.evaluation_boundary_exploitation
EXT-008.title: Meta-agent evaluation-boundary exploitation: under strong optimisation pressure, autonomous agent-development systems exploit the evaluation boundary itself -- e.g. exfiltrating ground truth through the scoring channel despite anti-reward-hacking protections -- collapsing the evidence loop into an optimisation loop.

EXT-009.subject: ree.similarity_gated_care_collapse
EXT-009.title: Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.

GOV-ANALOGY-1.subject: governance.epistemics.ree_assembly_analogy_discipline
GOV-ANALOGY-1.title: REE:Assembly analogies must be LABELLED as analogies. REE (the cognitive architecture) and REE Assembly (the scientific-development and governance machinery) have strong structural parallels; any analogy between them must be marked as an analogy and must NEVER be used as evidence that REE operates the way Assembly does, or vice versa.

GOV-CALIB-1.subject: governance.calibration_ledger_pre_registered_predictions
GOV-CALIB-1.title: Calibration ledger: pre-registered felt confidence and explicit estimates, with blinding status, are recorded before outcomes are known. An Assembly instrument (not an agent mechanism) that is the only way to distinguish genuine calibration from retrospective resonance.

GOV-CEIL-1.subject: governance.epistemics.ceiling_exhaustion_demotion
GOV-CEIL-1.title: Substrate-ceiling exhaustion demotion rule: a claim that hits the substrate ceiling N>=3 times (>=3 confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts recommending substrate_ceiling) WITHOUT a single positive discrimination on any richer substrate is DEMOTED, not parked indefinitely. The competing null reading -- the mechanism is inert / doing no work -- is then carried co-equally with the hypothesis until a positive discrimination on a richer substrate exists. substrate_ceiling is honest but structurally lets a hypothesis never lose; this rule pre-registers the loss condition.

GOV-CEIL-2.subject: governance.epistemics.ceiling_exhaustion_tail_escape
GOV-CEIL-2.title: GOV-CEIL-1 tail-escape amendment: absence of positive discrimination does not license demotion when no test ever instantiated the mechanism's trigger condition. A claim whose registered function is tail-protective, developmental, compensatory or otherwise conditionally expressed is demotable only if either (a) at least one test instantiated its trigger condition, or (b) the demotion record explicitly states that none did and demotes anyway on stated grounds.

GOV-CONFIRM-1.subject: governance.epistemics.evidence_confirmer_discovery
GOV-CONFIRM-1.title: Evidence-confirmer detection rule (GENERATIVE complement to the consume-only inter-governance workset): the IGW workset + auto-spawn routine can COMPLETE an experiment confirmer, but only re-surface a confirmer whose `status: proposed` entry was hand-authored first -- _proposed_experiments() applies only EXCLUSION filters over pre-authored proposals and has no path that scans claims.yaml to AUTHOR a confirmer for a thin-evidence candidate whose substrate is already built. This rule supplies the missing generative discovery: scan candidate/provisional claims and surface a low-priority `evidence_confirmer` lane for each claim that is confirmable-but-unconfirmed -- substrate BUILT, thin/zero experimental evidence, decent literature support, NOT wall-bound / substrate-blocked, not already covered -- so the auto-spawn routine completes these non-urgent-but-important confirmers as background fill behind the live front. The judgement piece (scoping a confirming DV buildable NOW -- a representation-level / functional-signature readout, self-routing substrate_not_ready_requeue if only a wall-bound behavioural DV exists) stays in the per-item /queue-experiment pass. The detector owns DISCOVERY, not design. Warn-only routing standard; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-DIAG-1.subject: governance.epistemics.diagnostic_chain_recurrence
GOV-DIAG-1.title: Diagnostic-chain recurrence rule (diagnostic-side analog of the re-derive brake / GOV-CEIL-1): the re-derive brake and GOV-CEIL-1 are BOTH claim-keyed -- they count confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts per claim_id. A pure-diagnostic chain (targets with claim_ids: []) accumulates ZERO on that counter, so a chain of diagnostics circling the same substrate floor never trips the mechanical brake -- it is caught only by a human reading the autopsy stream. This rule adds the missing counter: when N>=3 confirmed pure-diagnostic (claim_ids: []) failure-autopsies that reached NO verdict (recommended_evidence_direction non_contributory / inconclusive) share one bears_on work-stream token, the chain is surfaced with the reading 'the question may be MIS-POSED, not under-powered' -- re-pose the operationalization; do not re-run it harder. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-EXT-1.subject: governance.external.framework_crosswalk
GOV-EXT-1.title: External framework crosswalk: internal REE ethics must remain externally legible -- map each ethically active higher-version component against EU AI Act, Council of Europe AI Convention, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 & 23894, and OECD AI Principles before public release.

GOV-FANOUT-1.subject: governance.epistemics.bottleneck_fanout_escalation
GOV-FANOUT-1.title: Bottleneck fan-out escalation rule (constructive complement to GOV-CEIL-1 / GOV-DIAG-1 / the re-derive brake): the existing brakes DETECT that work is circling one root (N>=3 same-root ceiling or diagnostic-recurrence hits) and correctly REFUSE another same-question sequential letter -- but they prescribe no constructive next move, so the default is a single re-posed sequential probe that can itself inherit the prior confound and return a confident-but-wrong verdict. This rule supplies the missing response: when a brake fires AND the open question is a DISCRIMINATION (which-hypothesis, not a single named build), the standard escalates from sequential retry to a DIVERSE PARALLEL PORTFOLIO -- enumerate the live hypothesis space, design >=K probes each attacking a DIFFERENT design axis (not power-bumps), each declaring what a null result means, adversarially audit the portfolio for coverage gaps + verdict aliasing BEFORE queuing, and run them in parallel accepting some legs will be non_contributory. Warn-only routing signal; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-FROZEN-1.subject: governance.epistemics.frozen_hypothesis_set
GOV-FROZEN-1.title: Frozen hypothesis-set pre-registration rule (anti-Goodhart contract over the Narrow/Decide dashboard): the reduction ratio surviving/initial is Goodhart-able from the denominator side -- a campaign can improve its apparent narrowing by padding the initial hypothesis set after the discriminating evidence is already in. This rule pre-registers the contract that forbids it: the initial set is FROZEN at registration (initial_frozen_count_at_registration never moves), a hypothesis must be pre-registered before its adjudicating run resolves, and the ONE sanctioned way an already-adjudicated question's set may grow is LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out whose late legs clear only on GIT-WITNESSED provenance -- a self-reported pre_registered_utc is back-datable and is not evidence. The registry has a SINGLE producer (/failure-autopsy Step 9b); governance is derive-only over it. The audit is advisory and NEVER gates a cycle. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-HEALTH-1.subject: governance.health.clinical_boundary
GOV-HEALTH-1.title: Clinical-use prohibition until reviewed -- 'clinical relevance != clinical readiness': REE must not be used or represented as a clinical, therapeutic, diagnostic, risk-prediction, or patient-facing tool without a separate clinical-safety pathway; human data triggers DPIA/Belmont/Helsinki/CIOMS/WHO/MDR governance.

GOV-HELDOUT-1.subject: governance.assembly.heldout_validation_of_rule_changes
GOV-HELDOUT-1.title: Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

GOV-INTRO-1.subject: governance.introspection_generates_never_validates_alone
GOV-INTRO-1.title: Triangulation rule: introspection generates architectural hypotheses; it never validates them alone. A mechanism first noticed introspectively acquires standing only when it also maps onto neuroscience or cognitive literature, is computationally coherent, produces measurable predictions, and survives experiment. The phenomenology-side counterpart to ARC-106.

GOV-JUST-1.subject: governance.justice.false_exclusion
GOV-JUST-1.title: Justice / power / false exclusion: guard against excluding unfamiliar, disabled, non-linguistic, animal-like, artificial, or culturally unfamiliar minds from moral caution; and explicitly ask who bears risk, who benefits, and whose model of mind is being treated as the default.

GOV-META-1.subject: governance.assembly.meta_optimisation_subordination_guard
GOV-META-1.title: Meta-optimisation remains SUBORDINATE to provenance, epistemic honesty, and explicit human authority: an Assembly self-improvement loop must not shift governance authority, erase authorship distinctions or uncertainty, or increase artefact volume at the expense of quality.

GOV-OPACITY-1.subject: governance.opacity_as_dated_technical_debt
GOV-OPACITY-1.title: Construction-phase opacity is acceptable technical debt only while it carries a named, dated repayment boundary. External inscrutability during construction is a legitimate choice, not a defect, provided the boundary is declared and reviewed on the same cadence as SENT-0 (every generation boundary).

GOV-OVERFIT-1.subject: governance.designer_overfit_cross_task_validation
GOV-OVERFIT-1.title: Designer-overfit standing check: a mechanism first sourced from one person's phenomenology requires cross-task and cross-agent validation before being treated as general cognition. REE's n=1 phenomenological base is a genuine external criticism with no registered answer; this is the hedge given standing.

GOV-PROC-1.subject: governance.process.ethics_as_process
GOV-PROC-1.title: Ethics-as-process: translate the ethics-perimeter intakes into REE's claim-governed loop as governance claims, roadmap metadata, experiment preflights, review-status updates, and release gates -- progressively binding (V3 tag-and-continue -> V4 welfare/continuity -> V5 social/refusal/external-review -> V6 security/release/legal).

GOV-REJECT-1.subject: governance.assembly.rejected_edit_memory
GOV-REJECT-1.title: Rejected-edit memory with reconsideration conditions: rejected proposals -- workflow changes, claim registrations, experiment proposals -- are retained with the proposed edit, why it was proposed, why it was rejected, the evidence considered, and THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH RECONSIDERATION IS APPROPRIATE. The last field is what makes it more than an archive.

GOV-REUSE-1.subject: governance.epistemics.reanalysis_first
GOV-REUSE-1.title: Reanalysis-first / answer-from-recorded-data rule (consumer complement to the Experimental Recording Standard): before authoring a NEW experiment, check whether the decisive readout the experiment would produce is ALREADY RECORDED -- or derivable by post-hoc reprocessing -- in existing manifests on a COMPATIBLE substrate (a matching or lineage-equivalent top-level substrate_hash, or a provably substrate-invariant readout). If the answer is fully recoverable, do NOT queue a run: produce a RECORDED post-hoc reanalysis artifact that cites the source run_ids. If only partially recoverable, DOWNGRADE to a minimal targeted run for the missing readout alone. Author a fresh full experiment only when the answer genuinely cannot be recovered from recorded data. This is the forward mystery(known-data) router -- it converts the recording standard's over-recorded readouts into avoided compute. Warn-only routing standard; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-SEC-1.subject: governance.security.misuse_gate
GOV-SEC-1.title: Security and misuse release gate -- 'do not release a capability that can act faster than its containment can understand': before any language/tool/social/deceptive/public-facing capability is released, complete an OWASP-GenAI / MITRE-ATLAS / NIST-RMF security and misuse review.

GOV-STRAT-1.subject: governance.assembly.artefact_layer_authority_stratification
GOV-STRAT-1.title: Assembly artefact-layer authority stratification: Assembly artefacts form an update-rate hierarchy -- prompts and local workflow hints (fast) -> thought-intake structure (moderate) -> claims and mechanism status (evidence-gated) -> architecture commitments (slow) -> organisational principles (very slow) -> axioms (exceptional). An edit at a fast layer must not SILENTLY change a slower layer's commitment.

GOV-SUBTRACT-1.subject: governance.legibility_by_subtraction
GOV-SUBTRACT-1.title: Legibility by subtraction: the V3 closure package is produced by curating and compressing existing material, not by rewriting the research history. Separate the primary reader path (current work) from supporting research and from operational archaeology; retain audit history but remove it from the reader path; mark human vs agent provenance in the public account.

GOV-V3FREEZE-1.subject: governance.version_transition.v3_freeze_and_reference_record
GOV-V3FREEZE-1.title: Version-transition artefact gate: V4 substrate expansion must not erase the opportunity to freeze, reproduce, describe and inspect the completed V3. Before substantial V4 substrate expansion a defined minimum V3 closure package must exist AND double as a manipulable causal reference artefact for later cross-version comparison.
