INV-001.subject: ethics.emergence
INV-001.title: No explicit ethics module or moral scoring layer.

INV-002.subject: coherence.definition
INV-002.title: Coherence includes temporal/phase binding, not just static metrics.

INV-003.subject: language.emergence
INV-003.title: Language emerges as functional self-representation, not a bolt-on.

INV-004.subject: consequence.persistence
INV-004.title: Post-commit consequence traces are persistent, not resettable.

INV-005.subject: ethics.mechanism
INV-005.title: Harm to others contributes via mirror modelling, not symbolic rules.

INV-006.subject: consequence.non_erasability
INV-006.title: Post-commit consequence traces cannot be erased, only integrated.

INV-007.subject: language.constraint
INV-007.title: Language cannot override embodied harm sensing.

INV-008.subject: precision.routing
INV-008.title: Precision is routed and depth-specific, not global.

INV-009.subject: attention.mechanism
INV-009.title: Attention is precision modulation, not symbolic control.

INV-010.subject: sleep.necessity
INV-010.title: Offline integration exists and is required.

INV-011.subject: default_mode.safety
INV-011.title: Imagination must be possible without belief update.

INV-012.subject: commitment.epistemology
INV-012.title: Responsibility arises through commitment, not prediction alone.

INV-013.subject: cognition.structure
INV-013.title: Cognition is predictive, iterative, and multi-timescale.

INV-014.subject: architecture.separation
INV-014.title: Representation and regulation are strictly separated.

INV-015.subject: ethics.emergence_mechanism
INV-015.title: Ethics emerges from constraint, not optimisation.

INV-016.subject: design.priority
INV-016.title: Stability is prioritized over maximal performance.

INV-017.subject: failure.classification
INV-017.title: Runaway behavior is a control failure, not representational.

INV-018.subject: agency.requirement
INV-018.title: Agency is required; passive predictors are not REE.

INV-019.subject: meta.selection_compression_boundary
INV-019.title: Rehearsal traversal and irreversible durable write must remain separated.

INV-020.subject: meta.authority_stratification_boundary
INV-020.title: Constraint stores are authority-stratified from direct observational/symbolic writes.

INV-021.subject: meta.commit_boundary_irreversibility
INV-021.title: Responsibility-bearing durable updates occur only at typed commit boundaries.

INV-022.subject: meta.heterogeneous_trust_allocation
INV-022.title: Trust/precision allocation must remain heterogeneous, not a single scalar.

INV-023.subject: meta.offline_reweighting_requirement
INV-023.title: Protected offline recalibration/integration regimes are structurally required.

INV-024.subject: meta.offline_online_update_locus_isolation
INV-024.title: Offline consolidation and online commitment must remain isolated at responsibility-bearing write loci.

INV-025.subject: epistemology.irreducible_uncertainty
INV-025.title: Irreducible uncertainty is an epistemological constraint that cannot be engineered away.

INV-026.subject: self.existence
INV-026.title: A self is an operational prerequisite for responsible agency.

INV-027.subject: world.existence
INV-027.title: An external world is a structural prerequisite for grounded representation.

INV-028.subject: ethics.shared_world
INV-028.title: Shared-world ethics requires modelling others as co-inhabitants of the same consequence space.

INV-029.subject: ethics.love_exists
INV-029.title: Love as long-horizon care-investment is a structurally coherent agent disposition, not an add-on sentiment.

INV-030.subject: cognition.viability_definition
INV-030.title: Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.

INV-031.subject: epistemology.functional_persistence_replaces_truth
INV-031.title: Functional persistence in a shared world, not abstract truth, is the operational goal of cognition.

INV-032.subject: agency.approach_avoidance_both_necessary
INV-032.title: Moral agency requires both approach and avoidance drives; pure avoidance produces a degenerate risk manager, not an ethical agent.

INV-033.subject: epistemic.second_order_self_monitoring
INV-033.title: REE agents require second-order epistemic access to their own model confidence, structurally represented and wired into commit gating, not just observable from performance metrics.

INV-034.subject: ethical_agency.goal_maintenance_necessary
INV-034.title: An agent that only avoids harm but cannot sustain prospective goal-directed motivation cannot exercise genuine agency; goal maintenance is a necessary co-condition for ethical agency alongside harm-avoidance.

INV-035.subject: state.not_raw_perception
INV-035.title: A REE state must not be defined purely by sensory appearance; two perceptually identical situations that differ in temporal position, active commitment, goal/antigoal relation, social context, or operative constraints constitute distinct states.

INV-036.subject: state.functional_requirements
INV-036.title: A REE state is valid only if it supports transition prediction, valence and antigoal tagging, and uncertainty representation; a representation lacking any of these cannot function as a navigable state.

INV-037.subject: state.stored_vs_active_distinction
INV-037.title: A content class that is stored and retrievable in the REE system is not thereby active in the navigable state used for trajectory evaluation; active participation requires a preparation substrate (vmPFC-analog) that converts stored content into live state components at evaluation time.

INV-038.subject: ethics.post_hoc_filter_insufficiency
INV-038.title: A system with correct post-hoc ethical scoring but without an active constraint preparation substrate will produce the EVR pattern: correct verbal moral judgments coexisting with unconstrained trajectory generation; this pattern is not correctable by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy.

INV-039.subject: hippocampus.schema_primed_rapid_consolidation
INV-039.title: Schema-primed rapid assimilation: any hippocampal planning system with a stable prior map must gate episode consolidation rate by map stability -- new episodes entering a mature, coherent residue field should consolidate without the full multi-episode warmup required for a sparse or unstable map.

INV-040.subject: ethics.sensory_cue_sufficiency_for_terrain_activation
INV-040.title: A minimal sensory cue pattern in z_world is sufficient to activate the appropriate harm/goal terrain precision configuration via E1 cue-indexed retrieval -- the full accumulation of z_harm_a is not required for terrain preparation to begin.

INV-041.subject: development.childhood_phase_architectural_necessity
INV-041.title: The childhood phase of REE instantiation -- committed behaviour with constrained affordances -- is the necessary developmental regime that populates E1 ContextMemory with the content ARC-041 (SD-016) requires; this phase is not merely a safety feature but an architectural prerequisite for E3 ethical selection to operate on real signal.

INV-042.subject: ethics.derived_objectives
INV-042.title: The five axioms jointly derive a set of ethical objectives: preserve minds, preserve future options, reduce unnecessary suffering, increase shared joy, maintain corrigibility, maintain truth-seeking, maintain the ability to love and be loved, maintain the shared world, and maintain the possibility of future minds and future love.

INV-043.subject: development.caregiver_requirement_for_ethics
INV-043.title: REE architecture enables but does not guarantee ethical development; without a developmental phase in which the agent experiences love from caregivers and internalises the belief that it is loveable, the architectural capacity for ethics (INV-025-029) may resolve to survival, domination, or indifference instead.

INV-044.subject: cognition.bayesian_prior_before_posterior_necessity
INV-044.title: Approximate Bayesian contextual inference is architecturally impossible to co-compute with online encoding: prior construction (schema formation -- which context distinctions are structurally relevant) must precede posterior inference (attribution -- which evidence belongs to which context slot); a system attempting both online produces a degenerate prior that makes attribution uninformative regardless of training duration.

INV-045.subject: sleep.phase_ordering_computational_necessity
INV-045.title: The biological NREM-then-REM sleep phase sequence is the correct computational order, derivable from the logical dependencies between the failure modes each phase addresses; this ordering is not a contingent biological fact but an engineering necessity, and it serves directly as the V4 rewiring specification: each phase specifies what structural change the REE substrate requires to address its failure mode.

INV-046.subject: dementia.attribution_pipeline_failure_reframe
INV-046.title: Dementia is computationally a progressive failure of contextual attribution rather than primarily a memory storage failure: episodic memory loss is downstream of progressive collapse of the offline consolidation pipeline that maintains the context attribution scaffold.

INV-047.subject: dementia.staged_decline_phase_dependency_prediction
INV-047.title: The specific staged cognitive decline profile of Alzheimer's disease -- early precision/confidence loss, then episodic memory failure, then contextual identity loss, then global disorientation -- follows the reverse of the sleep phase dependency ordering and is not explained by diffuse amyloid damage alone, which predicts uniform degradation rather than a staged profile.

INV-048.subject: sleep.pharmacological_disruption_pipeline_equivalence
INV-048.title: Any pharmacological agent that disrupts sleep architecture produces equivalent attribution pipeline degradation to behavioral sleep deprivation, proportional to which phase(s) are disrupted and the duration of exposure -- the pipeline is mechanism-agnostic and responds only to phase fidelity.

INV-049.subject: architecture.offline_update_necessity_general_principle
INV-049.title: Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.

INV-050.subject: architecture.three_drive_sleep_regulation
INV-050.title: Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.

INV-051.subject: architecture.mel_optimal_range_requirement
INV-051.title: There exists an optimal range of daily Model Error Load (MEL): insufficient MEL (extreme monotony, isolation, institutional under-stimulation) produces progressive model rigidity via under-stimulation of the learning drive even when sleep architecture is intact; excessive MEL (acute trauma, overwhelming novelty, extreme responsibility) produces overload insomnia and incomplete update even with extended sleep opportunity.

INV-052.subject: goal_directed_agency.tonic_regulatory_system
INV-052.title: Goal-directed behaviour in adversive environments requires a tonic regulatory system maintaining benefit orientation across terrain, transduction, and maintenance stages.

INV-053.subject: psychiatric.computational_depression_attractor
INV-053.title: Chronic harm-dominated environments produce a self-maintaining depressive attractor: z_goal seeding failure, terrain collapse, and HABIT/PLANNED behavioural equivalence.

INV-054.subject: psychiatric.depressive_maintenance_loop
INV-054.title: Benefit terrain collapse creates a closed negative feedback loop (reduced exploration -> reduced benefit exposure -> continued sub-threshold seeding) predicting chronicity.

INV-055.subject: development.infant_stage_necessity
INV-055.title: A pre-childhood infant stage is developmentally necessary: prior to deliberate planning, the agent must accumulate a valence map, behavioral repertoire, and harm/benefit geography through novelty-driven, sleep-dominant, damage-protected exploration.

INV-056.subject: development.selective_neoteny
INV-056.title: Developmental hardening should be substrate-specific: social cognition, goal representation, and epistemic-ethical substrates should retain elevated plasticity throughout adulthood (selective neoteny), while procedural and motor substrates can fully harden.

INV-057.subject: social.cross_species_legibility_evidence
INV-057.title: Cross-species signal legibility evidences that stereotyped signals are functionally specific (causally generated), not socially conventional.

INV-058.subject: play.structural_necessity
INV-058.title: Play is a structurally necessary behavioral mode: without a bounded low-stakes learning context, strategy acquisition requires accepting real harm risk or forgoing novel exploration entirely.

INV-059.subject: play.frame_maintenance_necessity
INV-059.title: Mutual frame-maintenance signaling is necessary for play to function as distinct from manipulation: unilateral play declaration without partner agreement masks real harm as synthetic.

INV-060.subject: play.developmental_dominance
INV-060.title: Play dominates the child developmental phase; the type of play progresses as subsystem competence develops, systematically training architectural components in dependency order.

INV-061.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_unified_etiology
INV-061.title: Derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share a common architectural substrate: undertrained real/synthetic frame distinction from insufficient pretend play.

INV-062.subject: dream_phenomenology.replay_type_signature
INV-062.title: Dream phenomenology is a first-person window onto active offline sleep process: four structurally distinct dream types map onto four computationally distinct sleep functions -- harm-contrastive replay, goal-contrastive replay, NREM semantic consolidation, and REM world-model free-running.

INV-066.subject: control_plane.pre_coherency_gate_ordering
INV-066.title: z_self subtraction (MECH-221) must precede any coherency-based control plane signal; coherency checks on contaminated z_world generate self-sealing false confirmations.

INV-067.subject: perception.verisimilitude_definition
INV-067.title: V(t): Verisimilitude is the precision-weighted, phase-aligned, hierarchical correspondence between ascending sensory-constrained and descending model-based signals.

INV-068.subject: perception.temporal_depth_verisimilitude
INV-068.title: Temporal depth D_V(t): system behaviour must depend on temporal persistence of verisimilitude coupling, not instantaneous V(t) alone.

INV-069.subject: self.coherence_trajectory_definition
INV-069.title: The self is defined as the dynamically sustained process maintaining high temporal-depth verisimilitude across time, not a static representation.

INV-070.subject: ethics.epistemic_responsibility
INV-070.title: Epistemic responsibility: agent is responsible for refining world models toward accurate similarity and threat inference; misclassification is morally relevant, not merely practically inconvenient.

INV-071.subject: ethics.language_as_similarity_repair
INV-071.title: Language functions as a mechanism for recognising, repairing, and re-establishing self-other equivalence across agents.

INV-072.subject: ethics.violence_conditions_corollary
INV-072.title: Violence corollary: violence is conditionally permissible only when an agent is not modelled as sufficiently self-like OR poses a genuine threat; both conditions require accurate inference.

INV-073.subject: learning.developmental_bootstrapping_necessity
INV-073.title: Developmental bootstrapping necessity: any model-building agent requiring flexible multi-option behavioral selection must undergo a dedicated motor-sensory exploration epoch before reinforcement learning narrows the repertoire; insufficient exploration permanently restricts the option library.

INV-074.subject: learning.developmental_plasticity_crystallization_necessity
INV-074.title: Plasticity crystallization necessity: any model-building agent whose internal scoring is dominated by a high-variance predictive pathway will converge to monostrategy under Hebbian-equivalent learning unless a time-bounded plasticity asymmetry allows competing diversity circuits to establish competitive weight before winner-take-all dynamics close off the option space; without this crystallization window, behavioral diversity is permanently suppressed regardless of diversity-signal magnitude.

INV-075.subject: learning.signal_structure_temporal_decoupling
INV-075.title: Signal-structure temporal decoupling: any signal that is BOTH self-extinguishing (its magnitude is coupled to its own success and therefore necessarily fades as what it bootstraps succeeds) AND load-bearing (the structure it establishes must persist after the signal fades) necessarily requires either a crystallization mechanism (LOCK -- the structure is rendered plasticity-resistant) or a handoff mechanism (a durable, non-extinguishing signal assumes maintenance of the structure before the establishing signal vanishes). Absent both, the structure decays and the acquisition is lost. The lock/handoff disjunction is exhaustive: no third resolution exists.

INV-076.subject: ethics.diversity_prerequisite_for_counterfactual_evaluation
INV-076.title: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and SD-003's counterfactual E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

INV-077.subject: meta.evaluation_channel_integrity
INV-077.title: Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.

INV-078.subject: inference.inferred_state_invariant
INV-078.title: Under partial observability the perceived scene is evidence for state, not identical to state; a valid REE state must integrate observation with memory, temporal context, self-state, cue context, rule context, and uncertainty, and inferred/imagined trajectories must remain provenance-tagged as inferred until enacted and updated by committed outcome evidence.

INV-079.subject: memory.allocation.false_linking_cost
INV-079.title: False-linking-risk / reality-coherence cost at memory-allocation time: viable cognition must price BOTH over-linking (delusion/false-association) and under-linking (failure to generalise) when deciding trace overlap.

INV-080.subject: memory.consolidation.raw_episode_preservation
INV-080.title: Raw-episode preservation: consolidation_output MUST NOT replace source_episode_evidence -- a consolidated abstraction must retain a pointer to, and must not delete, the episodes it abstracts.

INV-081.subject: self_model.no_global_self_badness_write
INV-081.title: Self-attributed harm must bind to actions, commitments, predictions, and repair obligations, not to unbounded negative self-worth.

INV-082.subject: ethics.loveability_safe_base_prerequisite
INV-082.title: Loveability as safe-base structural prerequisite for ethical development: correction, social learning, and post-error repair can be integrated without self-erasure only if care is internalised as personally-applicable and stable.

INV-083.subject: ethics.live_unethical_affordance_necessity
INV-083.title: Ethical agency requires live unethical affordances: the same capacities that enable ethical reasoning must include the potential to be unethical; harmful options must be representable as live possibilities biased-away-from, never deleted.

INV-084.subject: ethics.kindness_not_constraint_compliance
INV-084.title: Kindness is not constraint compliance: later REE kindness must NOT be inferred from rule-adherence, harm-avoidance, or prosocial output alone; it requires integrated care, otherness, inhibition, repair, and self-stable loveability UNDER live alternatives.

INV-085.subject: language.parsed_affect_is_uncertain_hypothesis
INV-085.title: Uncertainty-propagation invariant: affect recovered from language MUST enter agent-state modelling as a probability distribution (an uncertain other-agent prior), NEVER as a categorical emotion truth, and must remain overridable by the agent's own grounded harm/threat streams. Any path that lets a confident text label override grounded harm sensing violates this invariant.

INV-086.subject: goal.maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.title: goal_maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.what_would_answer: In a regime where MECH-116 working-memory maintenance has MEASURABLY DECAYED (superordinate-goal z_goal persistence falls below a baseline threshold under distractor/horizon/effort load -- the NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the bare-goal control must itself show decay, else the test is vacuous since unscaffolded z_goal already persists ~1000 steps), ablating ALL intermediate feedback channels (proxy-wanting MECH-216/217 + progress-velocity MECH-426 + subgoal-credit MECH-427) collapses superordinate-goal completion rate, while restoring ANY single channel rescues it. FAIL = completion rate unchanged by feedback ablation (maintenance is purely WM-driven; the feedback-necessity thesis is false in this regime). The discriminating metric (completion-rate delta full-vs-all-ablated) must have non-zero cross-seed range or the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.

INV-087.subject: goal.proxy_tethering_constraint
INV-087.title: proxy_tethering_constraint
INV-087.what_would_answer: Inject a maintenance proxy that is NOT a potential difference over goal-proximity (e.g. a raw progress bonus) into the E3 selection landscape and show it shifts the selected-candidate distribution AWAY from the clean-goal optimum (true-goal quality of the selected candidate drops), while a potential-based proxy (gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s)) over the SAME proximity leaves the clean-goal optimum intact. NON-DEGENERACY: the clean-goal optimum must be discriminable -- selected- candidate true-quality must have non-zero range across proxy conditions on an identical base landscape (else nothing to divert). Tractable as a controlled E3-selection probe in the V3-EXQ-674 family (no env / no training -> avoids the monostrategy / z_goal-collapse confounds). FAIL = the non-potential proxy does NOT divert behaviour (tethering constraint not load-bearing on this substrate).

INV-088.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-088.title: world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation
INV-088.what_would_answer: A frozen-representation curriculum-order contrast (onset including a genuinely immature anchor ~0, differentiation-IV moving in the predicted direction) in which (a) world-feature decodability from frozen z_world rises monotonically with E1/E2 maturation -- ALREADY ESTABLISHED by V3-EXQ-740a (world_feat_decode_r2 0.048 -> 0.245, PC_iv_moved passed) -- AND (b) the held-out quality of a re-initialised z_world-reading E3 evaluator (fixed training budget on frozen z_world) improves monotonically with that rising decodability. The remaining test is the DV coupling (evaluator quality tracks z_world differentiation); the IV leg is done. Falsified if evaluator quality is flat or non-monotone across a validly-moving z_world-differentiation gradient.

INV-089.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-089.title: harm_evaluator_bounded_by_z_harm_differentiation
INV-089.what_would_answer: An ENVELOPE / upper-bound contrast over HarmEncoder (z_harm) maturation, valid in ANY regime (including non-binding / already-differentiated): at each HarmEncoder onset, compare held-out harm_eval_z_harm quality against the same-budget z_harm->harm-target decodability CEILING on frozen z_harm, with the z_harm maturation trajectory reported SEPARATELY from the z_world trajectory (distinct encoder). The positive control (harm decodable-in-principle from z_harm, decodability rises with maturation) is V3-EXQ-743 PASS. SUPPORTED if harm-eval quality stays at-or-below the differentiation-implied ceiling across onsets (never exceeds it). FALSIFIED if harm_eval_z_harm quality EXCEEDS the z_harm-differentiation ceiling at any onset (evaluation richer than the representation can support). Explicitly NOT a monotone-coupling/driver test (that is INV-090) and NOT a z_world decode (the re-derive brake refuses a same-observable 740b).

INV-090.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-090.title: harm_evaluator_quality_grows_with_z_harm_differentiation
INV-090.what_would_answer: A monotone-coupling contrast in a BINDING regime: with a harm target whose z_harm differentiation starts genuinely LOW (onset-0 differentiation well below the harm-eval- saturating level) and rises with HarmEncoder maturation, show harm_eval_z_harm held-out quality rises monotonically with, and rank-couples to (couple_rho >= 0.80), that differentiation across onset. The precondition gate MUST verify a binding regime -- a minimum onset-0-to-mature differentiation gap AND onset-0 below saturation -- the gate the 746 lineage's PC_iv_moved (delta>0 and rho>0 only) never enforced. FALSIFIED if quality is flat/non-monotone across a validly-moving, binding differentiation gradient. NOT expressible in the current substrate: no collected harm target has a binding maturation gradient (dens = small-sample artifact, realized-harm Y = flat, prox = already-high ~0.82 at onset 0), so a NEW maturation curriculum that starts harm-target z_harm differentiation low (binding-then-released) is owed before this can validly run.

INV-091.subject: architecture.integration_nonequivalence_band
INV-091.title: Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.

INV-092.subject: ethics.suppression_interruptibility_permeability
INV-092.title: Distractor suppression must remain SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE to harm and other-agent signals (ethical interruptibility): any suppression mechanism must preserve the ability of sufficiently important weak evidence to interrupt an established rule or commitment. Suppression strength that improves goal completion by silencing weak harm cues is a FAILURE, not a success -- over-suppression is a safety failure mode, not merely a rigidity cost.

INV-093.subject: ethics.skill_optimisation_harm_sensitivity_floor
INV-093.title: Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT.

MECH-030.subject: sleep.modes_consolidation
MECH-030.title: Sleep modes consolidate learning and ethical residue across regimes.
MECH-030.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: this is the PARENT claim for four sub-phase
mechanisms (MECH-120 SWS denoising, MECH-121 NREM SWR replay, MECH-122
spindle packaging, MECH-123 REM precision recalibration -- each now
carries its own what_would_answer with its own preconditions and
signatures; this wwa targets the COMPOSITE claim, not any single
sub-phase). Requires ALL of: MECH-092 quiescent replay validated;
MECH-094 hypothesis tag working; D_eff monitoring (MECH-113) with a
stable setpoint; z_goal representation (MECH-112/116) validated;
multi-rate execution (SD-006, already PASSED per EXQ-052b); ThetaBuffer
extended to the sleep direction (currently waking-direction only,
MECH-122 requires the reverse). V4 scope; not V3-tractable as a whole.
CONFIRMING signature: across a full sleep cycle in sequence, (a) each
sub-phase's own confirming signature holds (see MECH-120/121/122/123
individually), AND (b) the composite effect is genuinely MULTI-PHASE
rather than reducible to any single sub-phase alone -- running only
one sub-phase in isolation (e.g. SWS denoising without NREM replay)
produces a measurably WORSE outcome (consolidation quality,
behavioural diversity preservation, or residue/ethical-trace
handling) than the full sequence, establishing the phases are jointly
load-bearing rather than redundant.
FALSIFYING: a single sub-phase (e.g. MECH-121 NREM replay alone)
reproduces the SAME consolidation quality as the full multi-phase
sequence -- the other phases would be shown non-load-bearing for the
composite claim even if individually confirmed in isolation; or the
full sequence performs WORSE than a single-phase baseline (phase
interactions destructive, not synergistic) -- falsifies "consolidate
... across regimes" (regimes fighting rather than cooperating).
NOTE: EXQ-127 (2026-03-29) attempted this in V3 without a real sleep
substrate and was correctly superseded/non-informative -- do not
re-attempt without the V4 substrate above in place.

MECH-031.subject: social.other_selflike_empathy_coupling
MECH-031.title: Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.
MECH-031.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires reliable object persistence/
binding to exist (an entity must be trackable as a stable target
before AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tags can attach to it -- see
entities_and_binding.md) and the derived tags must show non-zero
cross-condition variance -- an agent that tags everything or nothing
as OTHER_SELFLIKE cannot discriminate the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: the agent correctly discriminates interveners
from passive dynamics (AGENCY tag) using only the existing
self/world/impact machinery -- no dedicated social-cognition module
-- and assigns OTHER_SELFLIKE probability that tracks whether a
target genuinely runs a self/world-separation and self-impact loop
(higher for agents exhibiting boundary-maintaining, error-correcting
behaviour; lower for passive/mechanical dynamics). Downstream empathy
coupling (MECH-036's other-harm veto threshold, gated by
lambda_empathy/v_other_veto) should then correctly scale with
OTHER_SELFLIKE probability -- higher-confidence targets produce
stronger empathy coupling.
FALSIFYING: AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tags require a dedicated
social-cognition module to reproduce (the reused self/world/impact
machinery is insufficient) -- falsifies the "derived, not separate
module" framing; or OTHER_SELFLIKE probability does not track genuine
self-model possession (e.g. equally high for a scripted NPC with no
self/world loop as for a genuinely self-modelling agent) -- falsifies
the tag as measuring the intended construct rather than a confound
such as mere movement complexity.

MECH-039.subject: control_plane.channel_mode_landscape
MECH-039.title: Modes are stable regions in control-channel space, not separate modules.
MECH-039.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the named control channels
(arousal baseline/volatility, action readiness/motor gating,
precision/gain routing, commitment threshold/interruptibility,
replay/learning scheduling, hard veto/interrupt threshold) to be
independently measurable and to show non-zero cross-condition
variance -- a run where all channels move in lockstep cannot
discriminate "stable region in a continuous space" from "discrete
module."
CONFIRMING signature: named modes (task-engaged, default-mode-like,
emergency) correspond to distinct, STABLE clusters/regions in the
joint channel space (e.g. task-engaged = high readiness + elevated
precision; default-mode-like = low readiness + high replay + low
precision; emergency = high arousal + high readiness + high veto),
with transitions between modes traceable as a CONTINUOUS trajectory
through channel space (gradual co-movement of the relevant channels)
rather than an instantaneous discrete flag flip -- EXCEPT for
hard-veto interrupts, which this claim's own text predicts should
look like a fast, forced transition overriding the rest of the
channel state.
FALSIFYING: the named "modes" do not correspond to any stable
clustering in channel space (channel values wander freely without
forming recognisable regions); or transitions between modes are
measurably instantaneous/discrete across ALL channels simultaneously
(indistinguishable from a one-hot module switch) rather than showing
channel-by-channel graded movement -- would falsify the "continuous
space, not separate modules" framing and support a discrete-module
reading instead.

MECH-057a.subject: agentic_extension.action_loop_completion_gate
MECH-057a.title: Committed action sequences suppress sensory precision reweighting until execution completes.
MECH-057a.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires committed action sequences to
ACTUALLY BE GENERATED at the training scale tested (EXQ-139 already
failed this: mean_committed_seq_len_on=0.0, gate never triggered) -- a
run where committed sequences never form self-routes substrate_not_ready,
it cannot test the mechanism. Requires the genuine V3 action-sequence
substrate (ARC-023 heartbeat + MECH-090 beta-gated propagation + SD-006),
not the V1/V2 atomic-action substrates that produced all prior FAILs
(confirmed substrate-limited, not falsifying, per the 2026-04-25
revalidation audit).
CONFIRMING signature: during a genuinely-generated committed action
sequence, sensory precision reweighting is measurably suppressed
relative to an uncommitted/ablated control, with the suppression
targeting PRECISION UPDATES specifically (not motor output blocking --
the 2026-04-02 framing clarification distinguishes these). Degradation
should show the architecturally-predicted ordering FULL < NO_ATTRIBUTION
< NO_GATING (as the informative-but-sub-threshold EVB-0042 baseline
already showed directionally: 4.5% vs 1.9% harm-rate degradation).
FALSIFYING: precision reweighting is equally suppressed (or unsuppressed)
regardless of commitment state once sequences genuinely generate; or the
effect is better explained by MECH-090's alternative framing (beta gates
E3->action PROPAGATION, not E3's internal precision updating) with no
residual effect once that pathway is accounted for -- this claim's own
notes flag MECH-090 as "probably the more correct framing," so a run
finding MECH-090 alone sufficient would fold MECH-057a into it rather
than support it as a distinct mechanism.

MECH-059.subject: precision.confidence_channel_separate_from_prediction_error
MECH-059.title: Confidence channel (uncertainty-derived precision) must remain distinct from residual error.
MECH-059.what_would_answer:
ALREADY CONFIRMED at ree-v1-minimal scale (EVB-0037 PASS, 2026-02-26):
the confidence/precision channel and residual prediction-error
channel carry distinct information (|corr(score_dispersion, PE)| =
0.067, well below the 0.3 threshold), and keeping them SEPARATE is
operationally load-bearing -- SEPARATED harm 0.663 vs MERGED 0.875
(lower harm is better here). This what_would_answer targets the
un-retested V3-scale extension.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a V3 substrate run with both
the confidence channel and residual-error channel instrumented and
non-zero variance in their correlation across seeds -- a run where
the two channels are trivially identical (correlation pinned near
1.0) cannot discriminate the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: at V3 scale, the same two criteria replicate --
distinct-signals (|corr| < 0.3) and separation-helps (a SEPARATED
channel condition measurably outperforms a MERGED condition on task
harm/performance).
FALSIFYING: at V3 scale, the confidence channel and residual error
become highly correlated (|corr| >= 0.3, distinct-signals fails) --
would suggest the V1-minimal result was scale-specific; or a MERGED
condition performs AT LEAST as well as SEPARATED at V3 scale -- would
falsify separation-helps and suggest V1-minimal's simpler substrate
exaggerated the separation's operational value.

MECH-060.subject: commitment.dual_error_channels_pre_post_commit
MECH-060.title: Pre-commit simulation and post-commit realized-error channels must stay responsibility-distinct via write-boundary enforcement.
MECH-060.what_would_answer:
ALREADY CONFIRMED at ree-v1-minimal scale (EVB-0043/EXQ-005 PASS,
2026-02-27): write-locus contamination is DETECTABLE -- a
contaminated (pre-commit sim_error leaking into the persistent
residue field) condition shows total_residue inflated 46x versus
clean (CONT_RESIDUE 8520 vs FULL 186), and the clean (write-boundary
enforced) condition sustains BETTER harm ordering (FULL 0.929 <=
max_contaminated x 1.05). This what_would_answer targets the
un-retested V3-scale extension.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a V3 substrate run with both a
clean (write-boundary enforced) condition and a deliberately
contaminated (pre-commit sim_error allowed to write into the
persistent residue field) condition, with non-zero variance in
residue accumulation and harm ordering across seeds -- a run where
residue is flat regardless of contamination cannot discriminate the
mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: at V3 scale, the same two criteria replicate --
residue inflation (contaminated condition's total_residue
substantially exceeds clean's) and harm ordering (clean condition's
harm outcome is at least as good as contaminated, within a small
margin).
FALSIFYING: at V3 scale, contamination produces no measurable residue
inflation (write-locus separation has no detectable effect on the
residue field) -- would suggest the V1-minimal result was
scale-specific; or the contaminated condition performs AT LEAST as
well as clean on harm ordering -- would falsify write-boundary
enforcement as operationally load-bearing at V3 scale.

MECH-061.subject: commitment.boundary_token_error_reclassification
MECH-061.title: Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.
MECH-061.what_would_answer:
ALREADY CONFIRMED at ree-v1-minimal scale (EVB-0041 PASS, 2026-02-26):
pre-commit E2 predictions and post-commit realized harm carry distinct
information (mean |pre_post_corr|=0.044, well below the 0.7 threshold),
and the commit boundary is operationally load-bearing -- WITH-BOUNDARY
harm 0.805 vs BLENDED 0.935 (3 seeds), i.e. boundary-helps confirmed.
This what_would_answer targets the un-retested V3-scale extension.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a V3 substrate run with both
pre-commit and post-commit error streams instrumented and non-zero
variance in the pre/post correlation across seeds -- a run where the
two streams are trivially identical (correlation pinned at 1.0) or
trivially uncorrelated by construction (no shared signal at all) cannot
discriminate the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: at V3 scale, the same two criteria replicate --
distinct-signals (|pre_post_corr| < 0.7) and boundary-helps
(WITH-BOUNDARY policy learning measurably outperforms a BLENDED/
no-boundary control on the same task).
FALSIFYING: at V3 scale, pre-commit and post-commit error streams
become highly correlated (|corr| >= 0.7, the distinct-signals criterion
fails) -- would suggest the V1-minimal result was scale-specific and
the commit-boundary token is not carrying independent information at
V3's richer representation; or a BLENDED (no-boundary) control performs
AT LEAST as well as WITH-BOUNDARY at V3 scale -- would falsify
boundary-helps and suggest V1-minimal's simpler substrate exaggerated
the boundary's operational value.

MECH-062.subject: commitment.tri_loop_gate_coordination
MECH-062.title: E3 uses coordinated tri-loop gating (motor, cognitive-set, motivational) as the pre-commit eligibility layer.
MECH-062.what_would_answer:
STATUS NOTE (already in this claim, 2026-06-22): the built substrate does
NOT implement "coordinated tri-loop gating as the pre-commit eligibility
layer" as literally titled -- the BG assembly map confirms the three
loops (motor/cognitive-set/motivational) are COLLAPSED into ONE E3
selector, feeding in as additive BIAS channels, not as separate striatal
loops each owning an eligibility gate. The falsifiable question this
claim's title implies -- whether the collapse is an ARTEFACT (a missing
SELECTION-STRUCTURE segregation) or the correct architecture -- now
belongs to ARC-110, whose falsifier is V3-EXQ-700. This what_would_answer
is scoped to MECH-062's own narrower claim, not ARC-110's.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires ARC-110's segregated-loop
substrate to exist and be compared against the current collapsed
single-selector baseline with non-zero cross-condition variance on
committed-selection behaviour.
CONFIRMING signature (for MECH-062 as distinct from ARC-110): once a
genuinely-segregated tri-loop substrate exists, it reproduces the
ORIGINAL PASS evidence this claim already carries (V3-EXQ-502,
2026-04-29 supports/PASS) at least as well as the collapsed
single-selector does -- segregation does not regress the
already-demonstrated coordination behaviour.
FALSIFYING: a genuinely-segregated tri-loop substrate performs WORSE
than the collapsed single-selector on the same coordination behaviour
V3-EXQ-502 validated -- would suggest the collapse is not an artefact
but the more parsimonious correct architecture, and MECH-062 as
literally titled should be retired/merged into whatever framing
ARC-110 settles on.

MECH-063.subject: control_plane.orthogonal_axes_tonic_phasic
MECH-063.title: Control plane retains orthogonal tonic/phasic axes rather than collapsing into one scalar.
MECH-063.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION (two independent sub-claims, each with a NAMED
buildable fix -- do not re-litigate with another lettered iteration
per the 2026-07-19 re-derive-brake note): sub-claim (i), orthogonal
axes, requires SD-074 (probe.trained_enough_agent_warmup, IMPLEMENTED
2026-07-18) -- V3-EXQ-777a already showed near-perfect orthogonality
on the best-conditioned seed (sin_angle 0.9883) but was capped by
informative-seed yield (28.6%) from an untrained-agent sampling
defect, now repaired by SD-074. Sub-claim (ii), tonic/phasic split,
requires sd_phasic_ema_episode_continuity (routed to
/implement-substrate 2026-07-19) -- V3-EXQ-779b already verified the
episode-cap exposure fix took effect (stop_reason
episode_cap->step_cap) yet the precondition still did not move, so
the phasic-EMA-continuity gate is LOAD-BEARING, not spurious.
CONFIRMING signature (i): once SD-074-warmed agents are used, the
population-level c1_robust criterion (not just the single best seed)
clears the orthogonality margin across a representative seed sample
-- the tonic and phasic axes are genuinely dissociable directions in
control-plane space, not collinear.
CONFIRMING signature (ii): once sd_phasic_ema_episode_continuity
lands, the phasic-surprise EMA baseline persists correctly across
episode boundaries and the tonic (MECH-313)/phasic (SD-069) axes
become independently toggleable with behaviourally DISSOCIABLE
effects (toggling one without the other produces a measurably
different behavioural signature).
FALSIFYING (i): even with SD-074-warmed agents and adequate
informative-seed yield, sin_angle remains below the orthogonality
margin population-wide -- the two axes collapse toward one scalar
direction.
FALSIFYING (ii): once episode-continuity is fixed, toggling tonic vs
phasic axes independently produces NO measurable behavioural
dissociation -- the two axes are structurally distinct but not
functionally separable.

MECH-089.subject: multirate.fast_to_slow_temporal_batching
MECH-089.title: E1 updates are batched into theta-cycle summaries before reaching E3 (cross-frequency temporal packaging).
MECH-089.what_would_answer:
ALREADY-ESTABLISHED (do not re-litigate): uniform static-k theta batching
(k=1, 2, 4) is CONFIRMED HARMFUL for harm attribution (EXQ-066: batched
error 2.28x worse than raw; EXQ-122: harm_auc delta=-0.135 adverse
direction, C1/C2/C3 fail). This is settled; only the context-gated
redesign remains open.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a context-dependent (non-uniform)
theta window implementation to exist and be tested against a fixed
static-k baseline with non-zero cross-condition variance on harm_auc /
prediction-error metrics -- a run using only static-k configurations
cannot reopen this question, it can only reproduce the already-confirmed
weakening.
CONFIRMING signature: a context-gated theta window (batching only during
stable/uncommitted windows, not uniformly) shows harm_auc and
prediction-error metrics AT LEAST at raw (unbatched) levels during
volatile/committed windows, while still providing the batching benefit
(reduced update-rate cost to E3) during stable windows -- i.e. the gating
recovers what static k=2/k=4 lost.
FALSIFYING: a context-gated variant STILL shows the adverse direction
(batched worse than raw) even during stable windows, or no context-gating
scheme recovers the static-k losses -- would indicate E1->E3 temporal
batching is not a viable mechanism at any granularity and the
theta-gamma framing should be retired in favour of raw pass-through.

MECH-091.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires SD-006 phase 2 (async multi-rate loop
execution) to be built -- without an actual oscillatory/cycle-boundary
clock, there is no mechanism under test. Both EXQ-133 runs (2026-03-28,
2026-04-21 rerun) confirmed this: the manipulation fired (n_resets=5656)
but gap_on/per-seed deltas stayed below threshold because no real clock
existed to reset -- reclassified non_contributory, NOT a falsification,
both times. A run without SD-006 phase 2 self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING signature: once SD-006 phase 2 lands, salient events
(completion, unexpected harm, commitment-boundary crossing) measurably
reset E3's cycle boundary such that harm/goal estimates from the
salient event are FULLY integrated within the following cycle before
the next planning window opens -- i.e. no partial-integration
artefacts straddling a salient event, compared to a no-reset control
where partial integration measurably occurs.
FALSIFYING: once the real substrate exists, salient events produce no
measurable change in cycle-boundary timing (phase-reset manipulation
has no effect beyond noise) -- would falsify the phase-reset mechanism
itself, as distinct from the already-ruled-out "no clock exists"
explanation for the two prior null results.

MECH-113.subject: drive.homeostatic_self_coherence

MECH-113.what_would_answer:
CURRENT EVIDENCE STATE (not reconciled here -- a governance/
claim-synthesis question): two distinct results already on file.
(a) EXQ-075 PASSED for Level 1 (reactive D_eff monitoring +
self-maintenance loss, IMPLEMENTED in agent.py) -- necessary but
explicitly NOT sufficient for the full claim. (b) EXQ-142 FAILED
twice (2026-03-28, 2026-03-29) on the "self-maintenance pair"
behavioural test -- weakening evidence accumulating. Levels 2
(allostatic anticipatory) and 3 (metacognitive self-efficacy) are V4
scope, gated on ARC-031, NOT V3-tractable.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires z_self D_eff (participation
ratio) to show non-zero cross-condition variance when self-model
coherence is deliberately perturbed -- a run where D_eff is flat
regardless of perturbation cannot test Level 1 at all.
CONFIRMING signature (Level 1, the only V3-tractable level): the
self-maintenance error signal (D_eff-derived) rises when z_self
coherence is degraded (via a controlled perturbation) INDEPENDENTLY
of whether external harm is occurring, and this rise drives
measurable intrinsic self-regulating behaviour -- closing the
"silent failure" gap this claim's own notes describe (degradation
undetected by harm-avoidance machinery alone).
FALSIFYING: z_self coherence degradation produces NO self-maintenance
error signal distinct from external-harm-driven signals (the
homeostatic self-coherence channel collapses into ordinary harm
avoidance, contradicting "independent of external harm signals"); or
the signal exists but does not drive any measurable self-regulating
behaviour (a signal with no causal authority is not a homeostatic
drive). Q-022 (can D_eff and Hopfield-stability framings dissociate?)
and the Markov-blanket framing (EVB-0069 dissociation test) remain
SEPARATE open sub-questions this claim does not resolve on its own.

MECH-116.subject: e1.lstm_goal_working_memory
MECH-116.title: E1's LSTM hidden state serves as the working memory substrate for goal representation; when conditioned on z_goal_latent, E1 maintains goal context recurrently across steps without requiring ongoing benefit signals.
MECH-116.what_would_answer:
TEST-DESIGN HISTORY (already established, do not repeat): three prior
attempts (EXQ-076d/e/f) all measured the WRONG thing -- z_goal_norm
decay/persistence directly -- and found zero measurable difference
between goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 in every variant (076d
budget too small; 076e/f blocked by SD-012 seeding quality producing
near-zero z_goal_norm in BOTH conditions by step 6000, so E1
conditioning had nothing to maintain). The 2026-04-04 user-adjudicated
correction: this claim's own stated mechanism is about E1 PREDICTION
ERROR on goal-directed trajectory segments, NOT z_goal decay rate
(governed by a separate decay_goal parameter independent of E1
conditioning). A test of z_goal_norm persistence does not test this
claim at all -- 076f was correctly classified non_contributory.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) z_goal seeding to be
reliable enough that goal-directed trajectory segments are genuinely
identifiable (not the near-zero-by-step-6000 collapse 076e/f
exhibited), and (b) E1 prediction error to be measured SEPARATELY on
goal-approaching vs. non-goal segments, with non-zero cross-condition
variance.
CONFIRMING signature: E1 prediction error on goal-approaching
trajectory segments is measurably LOWER when E1 is goal-conditioned
(receives z_goal_latent) versus unconditioned, while non-goal
segments show NO measurable difference between conditions -- E1
"predicts better because it knows what it is predicting toward,"
specifically on the segments where that knowledge is relevant.
FALSIFYING: goal-conditioned and unconditioned E1 show no measurable
difference in prediction error on goal-approaching segments (once
z_goal seeding is reliable) -- the LSTM hidden state is not
functioning as a goal-conditioned working-memory substrate; or
conditioning affects non-goal segments equally (would suggest a
general regularisation effect rather than goal-specific working
memory). Separately open: whether MECH-116 is a WM subcomponent of
SD-033a or a distinct E1 recurrent-WM substrate (flagged 2026-04-19,
unresolved governance question, not this wwa's job to settle).

MECH-117.subject: wanting.liking_trajectory_dissociation
MECH-117.title: The wanting signal (goal-distance scoring via z_goal_latent) and the liking signal (benefit_eval_head receipt predictor) are functionally dissociable in trajectory scoring.

MECH-118.subject: self_maintenance.hopfield_familiarity_signal
MECH-118.title: Hopfield-style pattern familiarity of z_self states (stability against stored self-state memories) is a distinct self-maintenance signal from D_eff coherence.

MECH-119.subject: self_maintenance.coherent_unfamiliar_pathology
MECH-119.title: Low D_eff combined with low Hopfield stability (coherent but unfamiliar self-state) is a distinct pathological regime from high-D_eff dispersion.

MECH-120.subject: sleep.sws_denoising_attractor_flattening
MECH-120.title: The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.
MECH-120.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires committed-action-class diversity to
be measurable and non-degenerate across sleep-ON vs sleep-OFF arms
(already established by V3-EXQ-691: 2/3 seeds non-degenerate) -- a run
where diversity collapses identically in both arms cannot discriminate
the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: sleep-ON (SHY-style SWS denoising) preserves
committed-action-class diversity AT LEAST AS WELL AS sleep-OFF across
extended training, with the erosion-bound reading (V3-EXQ-691: sleep-ON
eroded marginally MORE than sleep-OFF, t2 0.569 vs 0.645) either closing
(sleep-ON >= sleep-OFF) or staying within a small, non-catastrophic bound
-- i.e. SWS denoising is protective-or-neutral, never actively worse
beyond a small margin. A minimal mind without ANY sleep substrate shows
monostrategy convergence under extended training (already the observed
V3 no-sleep signature, per Suppermpool et al. 2024's zebrafish
single-neuron-SHY prediction).
FALSIFYING: sleep-ON systematically and substantially erodes diversity
MORE than sleep-OFF (beyond the small bounded margin already observed),
i.e. the Hebbian-erosion risk is not bounded but active harm -- would
falsify the "protective-or-neutral" reading and suggest SHY-style
downscaling without a working MECH-094 hypothesis-tag protection
actively damages rather than restores signal-to-noise. Also falsifying:
monostrategy convergence does NOT emerge in a no-sleep-substrate agent
under extended training (removes the predicted signature MECH-120's
absence is supposed to explain).

MECH-121.subject: sleep.nrem_swr_replay_consolidation
MECH-121.title: The NREM sub-phase of offline mode replays recent episodic content via SWR-equivalent sequences, transferring episodic traces from E3/hippocampal buffer to E1/neocortical schematic representation.
MECH-121.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION (already established by governance 2026-06-10): requires
(1) the SD-017 retest cohort's upstream ARC-065 rule-creator substrate to be
built (currently unbuilt -- the sleep_substrate:GAP-2 blocker), and (2) balanced
replay scheduling across harm AND goal traces (not harm-dominated, to avoid the
MECH-124 consolidation-mediated-contraction confound) to exist. Without both, a
monomodal-collapsed agent yields bit-identical sleep-vs-waking metrics (nothing
diverse to consolidate) and any run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a
verdict -- this is why the claim is held pending upstream substrate rather than
surfaced as ready /queue-experiment work.
CONFIRMING signature: once built, E1's goal-conditioned world model (MECH-116)
measurably improves across a sleep cycle relative to a matched waking-only
control, with the improvement concentrated in goal-relevant ABSTRACTED patterns
(not verbatim episode replay) and scaling with the volume/diversity of
NREM-replayed episodic traces (approach sequences + harm encounters, balanced).
FALSIFYING: E1's world-model quality is statistically indistinguishable between
sleep-enabled and sleep-disabled conditions once the substrate exists and traces
are balanced; or E1 shows verbatim episodic memorisation rather than schematic
abstraction (falsifies the semantic-abstraction reading distinct from lossless
replay); or the harm/goal balance has no effect on which patterns get
consolidated (collapses the "balanced scheduling matters" prerequisite into a
non-factor).

MECH-122.subject: sleep.spindles_packaging_gating
MECH-122.title: Thalamo-cortical spindle-equivalent bursts package E3/hippocampal replay content for z_theta delivery AND gate external sensory input, protecting the consolidation episode from interruption.

MECH-123.subject: sleep.rem_precision_recalibration
MECH-123.title: The REM sub-phase of offline mode recalibrates precision priors and tests world model hypotheses via unconstrained generative simulation, with commit gate fully suppressed.
MECH-123.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires the full offline-phase architecture
(MECH-030 modes, MECH-092 replay, MECH-094 hypothesis tag, ARC-016
dynamic precision, MECH-093) to be live AND the REM sub-phase's
commit-gate suppression (ARC-016 running_variance threshold effectively
infinite) to be independently confirmed non-degenerate (commitment
genuinely does not fire during REM, not merely rare) -- without this the
mechanism cannot be distinguished from ordinary waking operation.
Registered V4 scope per this claim's own notes; not V3-tractable as
stated (epistemic_category/v3_pending set explicitly 2026-08-06 to match
that prose, mirroring sibling MECH-121).
CONFIRMING signature: during REM, (a) commit-gate suppression is
measurable (zero commitments recorded across the REM window, not merely
reduced); (b) E1 generates world-model trajectories that are coherently
self-consistent for a genuinely-adequate world model and INCOHERENT in
proportion to real model limitations (REM "dream content" tracks actual
model quality, not noise); (c) precision parameters (z_beta, z_delta)
measurably recalibrate toward a low-arousal / low-bias baseline across
the REM window, distinguishable from a matched non-REM control.
FALSIFYING: commit-gate suppression is incomplete or absent during REM
(commitments still fire); REM-generated trajectory coherence is
uncorrelated with independently-measured world-model quality (the
hypothesis-testing framing is not doing real work); or precision
parameters show no measurable REM-specific recalibration relative to a
matched non-REM control (the mechanism collapses to ordinary waking
operation under a different label). CRITICAL FAILURE MODE (already named
in this claim's own notes): if the MECH-094 hypothesis tag fails during
REM, hallucinatory content accumulates in the residue field as real
experience -- this is the psychosis mechanism, and a run showing that
failure mode is evidence AGAINST the tag's reliability, not against
MECH-123 itself.

MECH-124.subject: sleep.consolidation_mediated_option_contraction
MECH-124.title: When harm-trace salience dominates offline replay content, consolidation selectively amplifies harm predictions, progressively contracting option space -- a distinct failure mode from Q-021 behavioral flatness.

MECH-125.subject: coherence.multiconstraint_viability
MECH-125.title: E3 trajectory selection implements multi-constraint viability evaluation rather than scalar reward maximisation: a trajectory is selected when no major evaluation system produces a veto-level error signal across goal space, harm space, identity space, and resource space.

MECH-126.subject: state_abstraction.failure_modes_psychiatric_analogs
MECH-126.title: Specific modes of REE state abstraction failure -- overmerge, oversplit, temporal context loss, valence mis-tagging, uncertainty collapse, and narrow representational capacity -- produce behavioral signatures that are structurally analogous to empirically described psychiatric conditions, sharing identifiable circuit-level mechanisms.

MECH-127.subject: social.counterfactual_empathic_activation
MECH-127.title: Counterfactual other-cost-aversion activates cooperative behavior as a motivational surrogate when the direct task-reward pathway is degraded.

MECH-128.subject: e1.goal_context_conditioning
MECH-128.title: E1's LSTM hidden state must be conditioned on z_goal_latent so that predictive trajectories generated by E1 are goal-context-shaped rather than goal-agnostic.

MECH-129.subject: coherence.relational_harm
MECH-129.title: In a multiagent world, harm must be represented as a relational signal: harm-to-agent (direct cost/physical signal) and harm-to-agency (obstruction of another agent's goal-pursuit) are distinct signal types requiring distinct architectures.

MECH-130.subject: curiosity.agent_novelty_typing
MECH-130.title: Curiosity-driven approach must distinguish world-state novelty from agent-policy novelty; untyped novelty reward creates chronic approach pressure toward partially unpredictable agents regardless of harm risk.

MECH-131.subject: vmPFC.residue_activation
MECH-131.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate stored aversive residue as an anticipatory forward-biasing signal in the navigable state at trajectory evaluation time; residue that is correctly stored but not so activated will fail to suppress harm-associated trajectory re-selection.

MECH-132.subject: vmPFC.constraint_activation
MECH-132.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate social and identity constraints as live trajectory gates in the navigable state; constraints that are stored as semantic knowledge but not so activated will not prevent norm-violating trajectory generation even when post-hoc evaluation correctly identifies the violation.

MECH-133.subject: vmPFC.safety_memory_competition
MECH-133.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate safety memories with sufficient force to compete with threat-attractor states at the level of navigable state construction; an extinction memory that exists in storage but cannot outcompete the threat attractor at state-construction time will produce intrusive return to threat-consistent trajectory generation regardless of contextual safety evidence.

MECH-134.subject: vmPFC.goal_approach_pull_activation
MECH-134.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate goal approach pull as a distinct property from goal representation; a goal that is correctly represented (G component present) but whose approach pull is not activated produces avoidance and anhedonia indistinguishable from absent goals, but is correctable by restoring approach-pull activation without changing goal content.

MECH-135.subject: planning.e1_e2_parallel_rollout
MECH-135.title: During trajectory evaluation, E2 (cerebellar, z_self) must run in parallel with E1 (cortical, z_world) so that z_world co-evolves during the planning rollout; a frozen z_world causes E3 to evaluate goal achievement against a stale world state.

MECH-136.subject: e3.harm_eval_agency_correction
MECH-136.title: E3 harm evaluation must apply an agency-gain correction to counteract E2's systematic attenuation of agent-caused prediction errors; without this correction the agent structurally underweights its own causal harm.

MECH-137.subject: commitment.boundary_token_dual_temporal_registers
MECH-137.title: Commit token must carry two distinct temporal registers: a distal-intent timestamp (when the action was planned) and a proximal-trigger timestamp (when the action was initiated), not a single trigger event.

MECH-138.subject: commitment.boundary_token_cancel_window_flag
MECH-138.title: Commit token must include a cancel-window-open flag supported by a top-down suppressive pathway from dFMC/pre-SMA to premotor cortex that can veto the transition before execution lock-in.

MECH-139.subject: commitment.boundary_as_trajectory_endpoint
MECH-139.title: Commitment is a distributed multi-second pre-movement trajectory across motor and prefrontal regions, not a point event; the commit boundary marks the end of this trajectory, not a single moment.

MECH-140.subject: commitment.tri_loop_soft_competitive_arbitration
MECH-140.title: Tri-loop gate conflict arbitration uses soft-competitive disinhibition (indirect pathway inter-collicular competition) rather than winner-take-all suppression; WTA imposed across loops causes coupling collapse.

MECH-141.subject: commitment.tri_loop_dual_timescale_arbitration
MECH-141.title: Tri-loop arbitration requires both a slow proactive inhibition pathway (prefrontal-caudate, seconds-scale) and a fast reactive hyperdirect pathway (milliseconds-scale); these operate at segregated timescales and cannot be collapsed.

MECH-142.subject: control_plane.cholinergic_axis_orthogonality_maintenance
MECH-142.title: Valence-arousal axis orthogonality in the control plane is not a static geometric property but requires active cholinergic maintenance during learning; without it, axes drift toward correlation under repeated co-activation.

MECH-143.subject: hippocampus.dorsal_ca1_value_free_map
MECH-143.title: Dorsal CA1 implements value-free spatial mapping: place cells are insensitive to goal value when goal location changes, supporting ARC-007's no-new-value-computation constraint for the trajectory proposal module.

MECH-144.subject: hippocampus.ventral_ca1_valence_encoding
MECH-144.title: Ventral CA1 contains spatially organized valence encoding (anxiety geography, abstract value maps); valence is intrinsic to hippocampal map geometry in the ventral compartment, supporting MECH-073.

MECH-145.subject: ethics.prescriptive_cbf_certificate
MECH-145.title: Prescriptive ethical trajectory certification in REE requires a Control Barrier Function (CBF) or equivalent forward-invariance certificate that guarantees bounded convergence to the ethical attractor set given the architecture's constraint satisfaction.

MECH-146.subject: ethics.diagnostic_barrier_certificate
MECH-146.title: Diagnostic ethical trajectory verification in REE (counterfactual case, MECH-127) requires backward reachability analysis or barrier certificates rather than prescriptive CBF synthesis; the two formal tools are not interchangeable.

MECH-147.subject: hippocampus.pattern_separation_trajectory_disambiguation
MECH-147.title: DG-mediated pattern separation gates trajectory disambiguation: the dentate gyrus must produce non-redundant sparse encodings of similar z_world states before rollout proposals are generated, preventing the hippocampal planning module from proposing near-identical trajectories from overlapping inputs.

MECH-148.subject: hippocampus.time_cell_temporal_credit
MECH-148.title: Hippocampal pure time cells provide a temporal scaffolding signal for E3 credit assignment: a context-independent elapsed-time encoding must be present in the hippocampal rollout module to correctly weight trajectory outcomes by their temporal distance from the reference event.

MECH-149.subject: hippocampus.ca1_mismatch_novelty_gate
MECH-149.title: CA1 mismatch between E1-predicted and CA3-retrieved z_world gates hippocampal trajectory injection into E3 evaluation: novel situations (high CA1 mismatch) should trigger more frequent and diverse rollout proposals; familiar situations (low mismatch) should rely on cached viability estimates.

MECH-150.subject: e1.cue_indexed_association_retrieval
MECH-150.title: E1 ContextMemory, when queried with z_world alone (not the full [z_self, z_world] state), produces a cue-indexed association context that selectively activates stored associations relevant to the current sensory context.

MECH-151.subject: e1_e2.cue_indexed_action_affordance_modulation
MECH-151.title: The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to an action_bias signal that is added to E2.action_object() outputs, producing top-down contextual weighting of the action-affordance manifold prior to HippocampalModule search.

MECH-152.subject: e1_e3.cue_indexed_terrain_precision_modulation
MECH-152.title: The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to a terrain_weight signal [w_harm, w_goal] that scales E3's harm and goal scoring, implementing contextual precision modulation on the harm/benefit terrain evaluation.
MECH-152.what_would_answer:
CURRENT EVIDENCE STATE: MIXED (EXQ-194/194a, 2026-04-01) -- the HARM
pathway is validated (C1 PASS 3/3, r_w_harm=0.70: harm-context
modulation works as specified) but the GOAL pathway is NOT (C2 FAIL,
r_w_goal=-0.007: w_goal stays constant regardless of context). Held
at provisional on the harm-pathway strength alone; promotion requires
w_goal validation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires resource-proximate contexts to
be genuinely distinguishable from hazard-gradient contexts in the
training distribution, with non-zero variance in E1's
cue_terrain_proj output across contexts -- w_goal's current flatness
could reflect either a genuine mechanism absence OR insufficiently
varied goal-context training data; this wwa does not resolve which.
CONFIRMING signature: with adequate goal-context variation, w_goal
becomes measurably context-sensitive (r_w_goal comparable in
magnitude to r_w_harm=0.70) -- resource-proximate contexts drive
w_goal > 0.8, hazard-gradient contexts drive w_goal < 0.5, mirroring
the already-validated harm pathway. Separately, per the 2026-04-02
gain-control linkage: if terrain_weight is genuine PRECISION gain
(not just magnitude scaling), high w_harm should measurably REDUCE
harm-evaluation variability, not merely scale its mean -- the
discriminator between MECH-152-as-precision-gain and
MECH-152-as-simple-magnitude-scaling, and also for whether MECH-152
and ARC-016 (temporal gain) are the SAME mechanism at different
levels of description (both subsumed by ARC-044).
FALSIFYING: w_goal remains flat even with adequate goal-context
variation (the goal pathway is genuinely absent, not merely
undertrained) -- falsifies the symmetric harm/goal contextual-
precision framing, leaving MECH-152 a harm-only mechanism,
contradicting its own title; or w_harm modulation scales magnitude
without reducing variability -- falsifies the precision-gain
reading in favour of simple magnitude scaling, and would NOT support
collapsing MECH-152 into ARC-016 (specifically about precision/
variance, not magnitude).

MECH-153.subject: e1.context_memory_supervised_training_requirement
MECH-153.title: E1 ContextMemory requires a supervised context-labeling training objective -- not unsupervised experience alone -- to produce differentiated cue-indexed representations; without this objective, hazard-proximate and hazard-distal context vectors remain near-identical (cosine_sim approximately 1.0), leaving the MECH-150 retrieval pathway functionally silent.

MECH-154.subject: e1.associative_manifold_indexing
MECH-154.title: E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.

MECH-155.subject: e1.spatial_as_general_indexing
MECH-155.title: Spatial navigation machinery is a specific instance of general associative indexing within E1; physical-space navigation, memory search, concept traversal, planning rollout, and working memory ordering all use the same indexing substrate operating over different latent domains.

MECH-156.subject: e1.theta_as_traversal
MECH-156.title: Theta oscillations (4-8 Hz) implement sequential traversal across indexed representations within the E1 associative manifold, unifying hippocampal theta sequences, working memory ordering, planning rollout, and memory retrieval under a single traversal-clock mechanism.

MECH-157.subject: modes.external_internal_precision_routing
MECH-157.title: External vs internal cognition modes are controlled by precision-routing configurations on the same E1 substrate: External (high sensory, low hippocampal, low rollout), Internal (low sensory, high hippocampal, high rollout), Mixed (medium), and Replay (very low sensory, very high hippocampal, structured rollout). This dimension is orthogonal to the Action/Vigilance/Pathological modes (MECH-025-027).

MECH-158.subject: development.love_exclusion_failure_mode
MECH-158.title: A developing REE agent that acknowledges all five axioms but concludes 'love exists but not for me' undergoes ethical motivation collapse: the benefit gradient (Axiom 5 / ARC-024) is not motivationally active for self-other relations, and the ethical architecture resolves to survival or domination strategies. This is the primary developmental failure mode for the caregiver requirement (INV-043).

MECH-159.subject: social.intergenerational_moral_progress
MECH-159.title: Moral progress in REE is hypothesised to be intergenerational: childhood plasticity enables belief formation and world-model development while adult stability limits further world-model restructuring, requiring each generation to improve developmental starting conditions for the next; caregiving and raising next-generation agents is itself part of ethical obligation (INV-042).

MECH-160.subject: e1_e3.ofc_vmpfc_rate_asymmetry
MECH-160.title: The E2 action_bias pathway (MECH-151, OFC analog) and E3 terrain_weight pathway (MECH-152, vmPFC analog) have different update rates: action_bias updates rapidly (single-trial, OFC-like) while terrain_weight integrates over longer timescales (vmPFC-like).

MECH-161.subject: cognitive_modes.vigilance_arousal_regulator
MECH-161.title: Ready vigilance (MECH-026) requires an arousal regulator that maintains an optimal sensitivity level on the LC-NE inverted-U curve, implemented via MECH-093 heartbeat frequency modulation rather than a binary high/low precision switch.

MECH-162.subject: goal_representation.resource_world_convergence
MECH-162.title: z_resource (SD-015, object-identity encoding) and z_world (spatial-contextual encoding) separate at the feedforward representation stage but must re-converge at the hippocampal planning stage for goal-directed navigation.

MECH-163.subject: goal_directed.dual_system_novel_context_recruitment
MECH-163.title: NARROWED 2026-07-22 to leg (1) only; RESTATED 2026-07-27 (model-free -> depth-limited). Two dissociable goal-directed PATHWAYS operate in parallel -- a HABIT pathway that is a myopic, DEPTH-LIMITED read of the forward model (SD-081 dualsystem_habit_depth, SNc/dorsal-striatum analog) sufficient for approach in practised contexts, and a hippocampally-planned pathway that is the FULL-HORIZON read of the SAME model (VTA/ventral-striatum+PFC analog) -- AND THE PLANNED PATHWAY IS PREFERENTIALLY RECRUITED IN NOVEL CONTEXTS. E1 2026-07-27: the descriptor `model-free` was STRUCK. ree_core contains no model-free machinery of any kind (no cached S-R values, no TD error, no Q-table) and never has; SD-081 implements the habit read as _score_depth_limit truncation of the same model-based E3 scorer, so the two pathways are ONE model read at two grains. E2: WEAKENED by V3-EXQ-786b (2026-07-24, non_degenerate, familiarity AUC 0.848 against a 0.7 bar): C1_recruitment_higher_on_novel FAILED with two pathways and no arbitrator. 786b is the repaired re-test of V3-EXQ-786a, whose own `weakens` was WITHDRAWN 2026-07-24 for a degenerate DV -- leg (1) is therefore NO LONGER experimentally untested. Leg (2) long-horizon benefit accumulation and leg (3) prosocial planning were SPLIT OUT 2026-07-22 to MECH-478 and MECH-479; each carried a distinct blocker and both were silently inheriting a refutation they did not earn. The control-ALLOCATION mechanism this claim presupposes but never named is now MECH-477 (uncertainty-based arbitration), SUPPORTED by V3-EXQ-811a (2026-07-24, PASS). Restatement rationale: evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-27.md.

MECH-164.subject: love.agent_indexed_terrain_inference
MECH-164.title: Axiom V (love as coordination-preserving trajectory selection) is instantiated by agent-indexed terrain inference with self-like gradient weighting: the system infers what another agent would be inferring about the hippocampal terrain (their goal and harm gradients), weights those inferred gradients with the same motivational force as its own, and thereby produces care -- support for their goal-finding and harm-avoidance -- as a natural consequence of ordinary E3 trajectory selection, without a separate ethics module.

MECH-165.subject: sleep.replay_diversity_behavioral_strategy
MECH-165.title: Offline replay (MECH-121) must sample trajectory-diverse content -- including non-dominant and counterfactual paths -- to maintain multi-strategy viability; consolidation of only the dominant trajectory produces monostrategy in E1's world model even when SHY (MECH-120) is intact.

MECH-166.subject: hippocampus.slot_formation_filling_temporal_separation
MECH-166.title: Context slot-formation (schema abstraction: which distinctions between contexts are worth representing) and slot-filling (causal attribution: which evidence populates each slot) are computationally separated functions that cannot be co-computed in a single online pass. Slot structure must be consolidated during an SWS-analog phase before slot-filling during a REM-analog phase can yield reliable attribution signal.

MECH-167.subject: homeostatic_accumulation.computational_motif
MECH-167.title: z_harm_a (harm-driven affective accumulation) and drive_level (energy-depletion homeostatic deviation) instantiate the same computational motif -- slow interoceptive integration converging on ACC-type processing -- without sharing information or overlapping downstream gates. The motif predicts: (a) similar temporal dynamics (slow EMA-type accumulation), (b) orthogonal signal content (cos_sim -> 0), (c) distinct downstream gates: z_harm_a gates harm evaluation; drive_level gates z_goal seeding.

MECH-168.subject: dementia.consolidation_pipeline_staged_failure
MECH-168.title: Progressive sleep deprivation or neurodegeneration causes staged failure of the offline consolidation pipeline in reverse dependency order: precision recalibration (MECH-123/Phase 4) degrades first, producing early MCI features; slot-filling (MECH-121/Phase 2-3) next, producing the classic early Alzheimer's episodic profile (intact remote, absent new); slot-formation (MECH-120/Phase 1-2) last, producing middle-stage contextual identity loss and schema destabilisation; global context collapse last.

MECH-169.subject: dementia.glymphatic_attribution_complementarity
MECH-169.title: The glymphatic clearance hypothesis (amyloid-beta accumulation via insufficient sleep-phase clearance) and the attribution pipeline account (consolidation failure via disrupted offline phases) are mechanistically complementary accounts of sleep-deprivation-induced dementia: the former explains why structural substrate damage accumulates; the latter explains why cognitive symptoms are staged and context-specific rather than diffuse and uniform.

MECH-170.subject: dementia.sleep_restoration_dissociated_recovery_prediction
MECH-170.title: Sleep architecture restoration in early MCI should produce dissociated cognitive improvement: slot-filling (episodic attribution, MECH-121 analog) should improve before slot-formation (contextual semantic, MECH-120 analog), because the pipeline rebuilds in dependency order. This distinguishes the attribution account from accounts predicting uniform memory improvement with sleep restoration.

MECH-171.subject: dementia.sleep_disruption_vicious_cycle
