MECH-171.title: Progressive neurodegeneration creates a vicious cycle through sleep disruption: early attribution pipeline failure disrupts sleep architecture, which accelerates consolidation pipeline failure, which accelerates attribution failure. This predicts disproportionate disease-modifying effect of early sleep intervention, because it breaks the cycle before the schema scaffold collapses.
MECH-171.what_would_answer: A clinical-cohort longitudinal study showing (or failing to show) that early sleep intervention in MCI/pre-dementia has a disproportionate disease-modifying effect relative to late intervention.

MECH-172.subject: dementia.habit_system_sparing_architectural_prediction
MECH-172.title: Preservation of habit and procedural memory in early Alzheimer's disease, while episodic and contextual memory fail, is architecturally predicted by the separation of the model-free habit system (MECH-163 D1/D2, SNc) from the contextual attribution system (E3 hippocampal, requiring offline consolidation phases): the habit system does not require offline consolidation to function, so its relative preservation under early consolidation pipeline failure is not incidental but follows from the architectural separation.
MECH-172.what_would_answer: A clinical Alzheimer's cohort showing (or failing to show) that procedural/ habit memory is preserved relative to episodic/contextual memory in the early-to-middle stage, tracking consolidation-pipeline failure.

MECH-173.subject: pharmacology.rem_suppression_phase4_disruption
MECH-173.title: Medications that suppress REM sleep (anticholinergics, MAOIs, most antidepressants at therapeutic doses, benzodiazepines) selectively impair MECH-123 precision recalibration -- the most downstream pipeline phase -- and thereby accelerate the earliest dementia prodrome: overconfident contextual attributions before overt memory loss.

MECH-174.subject: pharmacology.sws_suppression_phase12_disruption
MECH-174.title: GABAergic sleep aids (benzodiazepines and Z-drugs: zolpidem, zopiclone, zaleplon) suppress SWS depth and continuity at therapeutic doses, impairing MECH-120 synaptic homeostasis and MECH-121 schema replay, producing context representations that remain globally undifferentiated -- the same failure mode as SD-017 without any SWS-analog.

MECH-175.subject: pharmacology.anticholinergic_dual_pathway_dementia_risk
MECH-175.title: Anticholinergic medications confer dementia risk via two independent and potentially additive pathways: (1) REM suppression (ACh is required for REM generation via nucleus basalis and brainstem PGO generators -- muscarinic blockade directly suppresses REM, impairing MECH-123); and (2) cholinergic deficit mimicry (AD is characterised by basal forebrain cholinergic loss; anticholinergic burden creates a pharmacological analog of this deficit during waking hours, independently degrading attention and encoding).
MECH-175.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: no REE substrate at any level settles this; V3-EXQ-698's
grid-world dual-pathway proxy was confirmed not a fair test (manipulation
checks PASS but outcome DVs at the noise floor). The decisive test is a
prospective clinical-pharmacology cohort with mediation/structural-equation
analysis. Design: enroll older adults free of dementia, score anticholinergic
burden (ACB / ARS / German ACB) at each visit, obtain an annual
polysomnography subset to quantify REM-suppression-years, follow to a
dementia-conversion endpoint, and fit a parallel-mediator SEM with (1)
cumulative REM-suppression-years (Pathway 1) and (2) cumulative diurnal
anticholinergic dose (Pathway 2) as simultaneous mediators of the
ACB->dementia path. CONFIRMS the dual independent additive account if both
mediators carry significant, partially non-overlapping indirect effects whose
sum approximates the total ACB->dementia effect, AND ACB outperforms total
medication count and total sleep-medication count as a predictor. REFUTES if
the ACB->dementia association is fully mediated by a single pathway (e.g.
daytime dose only, with REM-suppression-years adding no independent indirect
effect), or if a non-anticholinergic substitution that removes only the
nocturnal limb (oxybutynin->mirabegron natural experiment) fails to reduce
risk. Note the Grace-Vanstone-Horner 2014 caveat: REM-transition reliability /
REM-theta integrity may be the true nocturnal mediator rather than total REM
amount, so the PSG metric should include transition and spectral measures, not
just REM%.

MECH-176.subject: pharmacology.orexin_antagonist_architecture_preserving
MECH-176.title: Orexin receptor antagonists (suvorexant, lemborexant) are predicted to be architecture-preserving sleep aids: they suppress wake-promoting orexin drive without directly compressing sleep phase machinery, allowing the brain's own homeostatic sleep architecture to unfold, and should therefore preserve or improve SWS/REM ratio relative to GABAergic alternatives at equi-efficacious doses.

MECH-177.subject: pharmacology.sleep_architecture_restoration_disease_modifying
MECH-177.title: Any pharmacological intervention that durably restores the NREM-to-REM sequence and preserves phase durations in MCI or early Alzheimer's disease is predicted to be disease-modifying via pipeline protection -- upstream of irreversible neurodegeneration, breaking the MECH-171 vicious cycle before schema scaffold collapse, with predicted effect size larger in early MCI than established AD.

MECH-178.subject: neurochemistry.noradrenergic_tone_rem_suppression_rigidity
MECH-178.title: Elevated tonic noradrenergic activity (from chronic stress, stimulant exposure, or noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor antidepressants) suppresses REM sleep by maintaining locus coeruleus REM-off firing above the silence threshold required for REM generation, thereby blocking MECH-123 precision recalibration and producing progressive behavioural rigidity equivalent to partial MECH-123 deprivation -- independent of any pharmacological REM suppression.

MECH-179.subject: sleep.mel_type_phase_specificity
MECH-179.title: Prediction error type determines which sleep phase is demanded for processing: episodic, spatial, and factual errors (incorrect world-state predictions) primarily demand NREM-mediated schema replay (MECH-121) for prior correction; emotional, social, and identity-threatening errors primarily demand REM-mediated simulation and recalibration (MECH-123) for policy and salience update.

MECH-180.subject: sleep.novelty_adaptive_sleep_upregulation
MECH-180.title: Novel environments and high-MEL learning episodes adaptively upregulate the learning drive component of sleep (INV-050 third drive), producing measurable increases in slow-wave activity power, sleep spindle density, and hippocampal replay rate proportional to the novelty and prediction error load encountered during the preceding wake period.

MECH-181.subject: dementia.cognitive_reserve_as_update_loop_maintenance
MECH-181.title: Cognitive reserve (produced by education, bilingualism, complex occupation, social engagement, and enriched environments) protects against dementia primarily by maintaining sustained novelty-driven Model Error Load throughout the lifespan, keeping the SD-017 model update system exercised and preserving sleep-architecture responsiveness to learning demands; conversely, understimulating environments accelerate dementia by depriving the update system of the error signal needed to remain adaptive.

MECH-182.subject: social.vocalization_harm_signal
MECH-182.title: Vocalization timbre as learned cross-modal harm-approach signal, generalizing to other-agent vocalizations.

MECH-183.subject: social.zbeta_leakage
MECH-183.title: z_beta leakage: attributed other-model affective state activates self z_beta directly, not via inference.

MECH-184.subject: social.other_directed_harm_avoidance
MECH-184.title: Other-directed hippocampal harm avoidance: planning architecture identical to self-preservation with harm-gradient source swapped to coupled other-agent.

MECH-185.subject: social.empathic_curiosity_approach_doubling
MECH-185.title: Surprise-doubled approach gradient toward distressed other: prediction error approach and z_beta leakage approach converge simultaneously.

MECH-186.subject: serotonin.tonic_benefit_gradient_maintenance
MECH-186.title: Tonic serotonergic signal maintains VALENCE_WANTING floor under chronic harm exposure, preventing benefit terrain collapse.

MECH-187.subject: serotonin.incentive_salience_gain_regulation
MECH-187.title: Serotonin modulates the gain on dopaminergic incentive salience, converting the hard SD-012 threshold into an adaptive graded transduction function.

MECH-188.subject: serotonin.pfc_goal_persistence_under_adversity
MECH-188.title: PFC-mediated goal persistence under adversity, sustained by 5-HT projections from DRN to dlPFC, maintains z_goal through harm spikes after seeding.

MECH-189.subject: development.super_ordinal_goal_formation
MECH-189.title: During the child phase, high-salience benefit contacts under high contextual complexity are written to persistent ContextMemory as super-ordinal goal anchors that bias adult z_goal seeding across novel episodes.

MECH-190.subject: social.defense_coalition_scent
MECH-190.title: Cooperative predator defense emerges without language when defense scent pressure is additive across agents and agents can perceive each other's alarm and harm-stress states.

MECH-191.subject: social.signal_legibility
MECH-191.title: Stereotyped behavioral signals are causal externalizations of specific internal functional states, making them cross-architecturally legible without learned convention.

MECH-192.subject: social.legibility_empathy_prerequisite
MECH-192.title: Signal legibility is prerequisite for fast empathy coordination: z_beta leakage (MECH-183) requires perceivable signals that map onto observer's own functional states.

MECH-193.subject: social.reward_coupling_reinforcement
MECH-193.title: Social reward signals (affiliative touch, oxytocin-gaze loop) reinforce empathic coupling strength, creating a self-strengthening coordination loop.

MECH-194.subject: play.synthetic_signal_substitution
MECH-194.title: Play mode operates by substituting synthetic z_goal and z_harm signals while permitting full learning flow through E3/E2/E1 as if signals were real.
MECH-194.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: play mode (ARC-049 frame tag + this
substitution mechanism) is UNIMPLEMENTED in V3 (substrate_conditional).
Requires: the play-frame tag (ARC-049) authorizing synthetic z_goal/
z_harm as legitimate training targets for episode duration; z_harm_s/
z_harm_a remaining ACTIVE during play with a RAISED escalation
threshold (not suppressed -- the Panksepp 1998 opioid-mediated
threshold-elevation reading, distinct from simulation's gradient
suppression); and z_goal_synthetic encoding learning-progress
d(PE)/dt (competence-based per Oudeyer 2007), not flat/entropy-based
magnitude.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires play episodes and matched
non-play (real-signal) episodes to produce measurably different
training dynamics -- if E3/E2/E1 update identically regardless of
play-frame status, the substitution mechanism is either absent or
inert.
CONFIRMING signature: during play episodes, E3 trajectory competence,
E2 forward model, and E1 world model all update AS IF the synthetic
signals were real (weight updates proceed normally, not suppressed)
-- distinguishing play from simulation (which suppresses post-commit
learning). Separately, z_harm_s/z_harm_a remain active but with a
measurably RAISED escalation threshold during play relative to
non-play episodes (graduated harm-adjacent exposure, not harm
blindness), and z_goal_synthetic tracks learning-progress rate rather
than a flat or entropy-derived magnitude.
FALSIFYING: play episodes produce IDENTICAL learning dynamics to
simulation (gradients suppressed) -- collapses play into simulation,
contradicting "play is authorized-synthetic learning, not
simulation"; or z_harm during play shows NO threshold elevation
(full suppression or unchanged threshold) -- falsifies the
opioid-mediated-threshold-elevation reading, supporting either harm
blindness (dangerous) or no functional difference from waking harm
processing; or z_goal_synthetic tracks flat/entropy-based magnitude
rather than learning-progress rate -- falsifies the competence-based
framing.

MECH-195.subject: play.strategy_calibration_dissociation
MECH-195.title: Strategy and calibration dissociate at play episode close: policy structure transfers to real episodes; goal/harm magnitude calibration is re-anchored by real homeostatic and harm signals.

MECH-196.subject: play.episode_close_recalibration
MECH-196.title: Play episode termination triggers real-signal recalibration: homeostatic and harm signals override synthetic thresholds; the frame signal drop is the recalibration trigger.

MECH-197.subject: play.type_progression
MECH-197.title: Play types progress in dependency order (sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> rule-based -> cooperative), each training specific architectural subsystems that the next type requires.

MECH-198.subject: play.pretend_tag_intersection
MECH-198.title: Pretend play is the developmental point where the hypothesis tag (MECH-094) and play frame tag (ARC-049) first co-operate: the agent maintains counterfactual representations within a play frame, exercising the full commitment architecture in synthetic mode.

MECH-199.subject: play.caregiver_frame_maintenance
MECH-199.title: The caregiver's role during childhood is specifically play-frame maintenance (ARC-049), transitioning from unilateral frame-setting through co-participation to scaffolded withdrawal as play types progress.

MECH-200.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_derealization
MECH-200.title: Frame confusion (real->synthetic direction): the agent treats real consequences as synthetic, producing derealization, manic commitment, and dissociative states.

MECH-201.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_delusion
MECH-201.title: Frame confusion (synthetic->real direction): the agent treats simulation, replay, and imagination as real, producing delusion formation, PTSD flashbacks, and anxiety.

MECH-202.subject: psychiatric.commitment_gate_failure
MECH-202.title: Commitment gate developmental failure: undertrained gate from insufficient pretend play produces either impulsivity (gate fires without evaluation) or commitment paralysis (gate never fires).

MECH-203.subject: Tonic serotonergic (5-HT) level during waking tags benefit-relevant experiences for preferential replay during subsequent SWS, complementing harm-salience tagging by the residue field
MECH-203.title: serotonergic_replay_salience_tagging

MECH-204.subject: Serotonergic withdrawal during REM actively defines the precision recalibration zero-point by removing the benefit gradient, not merely permitting recalibration
MECH-204.title: serotonergic_rem_gate_zero_point
MECH-204.what_would_answer:
MECH-204 states a MECHANISM but has never stated its own falsification
conditions -- not the DV, not the required drift source, not the timescale at
which the correction must act. Every test to date has had to invent all three,
and each invention was wrong in a DIFFERENT way (EXQ-541 within-cycle no-op;
541a/541b under-powered timescale; V3-EXQ-596/602 scored on a cluster criterion
that is not a MECH-204 prediction; V3-EXQ-774 tautological DV; V3-EXQ-794
clamped drift source). That signature diversity is a SPECIFICATION gap, not a
granularity gap -- /claim-synthesis 2026-07-22
(claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-22.md sec 1c) REFUSED to decompose MECH-204 on
exactly this ground: classifying the cluster by the autopsies' own
four_layer_diagnosis yields ZERO non-degenerate substrate-ready FAIL signatures
and not one target carries `weakened`. This block supplies the three missing
objects so they are not re-invented a sixth time.

(a) THE DRIFT SOURCE -- now SD-076 (`use_waking_confidence_inflation`),
registered separately 2026-07-20 because it is the SOURCE while MECH-204 is the
CORRECTION, and the two must be independently ablatable. A MECH-204 test is
ADMISSIBLE ONLY WITH AN ACTIVE, DEMONSTRATED DRIFT SOURCE. "Sleep recalibrates
waking precision drift" is unfalsifiable if waking precision cannot drift, so a
null measured without live drift is a TAUTOLOGY, not evidence (V3-EXQ-774). The
drift must be shown live IN THE RUN -- a strict dose separation on the drift
variable between arms -- BEFORE the correction is scored. SD-076 currently has
NO usable headroom: V3-EXQ-794 pinned `rv_final` at exactly 0.010000 on all four
inflation arms, with `overconfidence_score` bit-identical to 15 significant
figures (-1.004111904519277) at the LO and HI asymmetry levels. MECH-204 is
therefore NOT ANSWERABLE until `sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom` lands
(separate /implement-substrate chip), followed by the V3-EXQ-794a re-run.

(b) THE PRECISION DV, AND THE NON-TAUTOLOGY BURDEN. ANY proposed DV must be
shown non-tautological BEFORE it is used. The paid lesson is V3-EXQ-774: a
SYMMETRIC precision EMA makes `running_variance` track true prediction error BY
CONSTRUCTION, pinning `overconfidence_score` near zero regardless of what is
ablated (774 measured -0.000148 and -0.000918). The DV must be a quantity whose
value can be driven materially away from the calibrated point by the drift
source ALONE, with the correction ablated. Discharge the burden in-run by
showing (i) the drift-on / correction-off arm moves the DV materially away from
calibration, and (ii) two drift doses produce DIFFERENT DV values beyond float
noise -- identical values at two nominally different doses are a SATURATION
fingerprint, not a null (V3-EXQ-794). The Phase 7 / Option B write-site in
PRECISION space (not E3-score space) is correct and must not be revisited; it is
what escapes the V3-EXQ-604c DV-invariance class.

(c) THE MINIMUM TIMESCALE IS RESOLVED, NOT OPEN: >= 16 sleep cycles per arm.
Measured -- do not re-derive it. At 4 cycles (541a/541b) cross-arm rv divergence
tops out at 1.75% against a 5% bar (inconclusive_timescale: the rv EMA damping
overwhelms the per-cycle nudge). At 16 cycles (541c; sleep_loop_K=1,
EPISODES_PER_RUN=16, precision_zero_point_ema_alpha=0.1) divergence is monotone
in step size -- 0.90% / 1.81% / 4.51% / ~10% at step 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.25 / 0.50 --
and step=0.50 clears the 5% C4 bar in 3/3 seeds, with C1-C4 PASS overall. A
MECH-204 run at fewer than 16 cycles per arm is under-powered BY MEASUREMENT and
its null carries no weight.

ANSWERS MECH-204 (5-HT withdrawal actively CALIBRATES the zero-point, not merely
permits recalibration) if, with the drift source demonstrably live and the DV
shown non-tautological, at >= 16 cycles per arm the recalibration-ON arm returns
the precision DV toward the cumulative zero-point reference relative to the
drift-only arm, with a monotone dose-response in
`rem_precision_recalibration_step` and sign consistency across seeds.

REFUTES MECH-204 if, under those same admissibility conditions, the correction
fires every cycle (C1) and adjusts with the correct sign (C2) yet leaves the
drifted DV statistically indistinguishable from the drift-only arm across the
defensible step range {0.05, 0.10, 0.25} -- i.e. 5-HT withdrawal is PERMISSIVE
only, and MECH-123 needs no zero-point term.

DOES NOT ANSWER IT EITHER WAY: any run whose overall outcome is decided by a
cluster-integration criterion that is not a MECH-204 prediction. V3-EXQ-596/602
FAILED on cluster_live_frac, a MECH-285 / GAP-3 criterion, while STRENGTHENING
MECH-204 on its own C1+C3 (recalibration fired every cycle in 3/3 seeds; 8.4-27.6%
rv divergence at 12 cycles).

NO TIMESCALE CHILD CLAIM IS WARRANTED NOW -- 541c already answered it. A
`recalibration_timescale` child becomes warranted ONLY IF, after
`sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom` lands and V3-EXQ-794a runs, the
correction fails on CYCLE COUNT again. Registering one now would mint an untested
claim from a resolved problem.

MECH-205.subject: hippocampal.surprise_gated_generative_replay
MECH-205.title: Hippocampal replay is surprise-gated and generative: episodes with high unexplained prediction error are prioritized, replayed with counterfactual variations via E2, and deprioritized only when forward models can account for the surprise.

MECH-206.subject: hippocampal.ca1_surprise_buffer_write_mechanism
MECH-206.title: CA1 acts as a PE-proportional comparator that writes episodes to the surprise buffer: mismatch between CA3 prediction and entorhinal actual input produces a graded signal that tags the episode for offline replay and suppresses retrieval of the now-erroneous prediction.

MECH-207.subject: hippocampal.cholinergic_surprise_buffer_gate
MECH-207.title: Acetylcholine acts as a permissive write-gate on the surprise buffer: prediction errors trigger hippocampal representation destabilisation and offline memory updating only when basal forebrain cholinergic activation co-occurs.

MECH-208.subject: hippocampal.valence_asymmetric_replay_approach_avoidance
MECH-208.title: Valence-asymmetric replay causally drives approach/avoidance bias: harm-path replay is weighted relative to reward-path replay by the agent's harm-salience parameter, and chronically elevated harm-weighting produces avoidance bias in safe contexts.

MECH-209.subject: sleep.semantic_consolidation_phenomenology
MECH-209.title: The simultaneous multi-instance, multi-scale, multi-time phenomenology of Type 3 dreams is the experiential signature of NREM SWR episodic-to-semantic transfer: rapid hippocampal sequential presentation of concept instances collapses to phenomenological simultaneity, with self-dissolution reflecting the stripping of episodic context during abstraction.

MECH-210.subject: sleep.rem_e1_world_model_free_running
MECH-210.title: Type 4 (detailed story, close to reality, super interesting) dreams are the phenomenological signature of REM E1 world-model free-running: with sensory input disconnected and the commit gate suppressed, E1's LSTM generates unconstrained sequential rollouts from its learned prior, producing coherent narrative arcs that are novel-but-plausible and experientially interesting.

MECH-221.subject: latent_stack.continuous_self_residualization
MECH-221.title: z_world must be continuously residualized against z_self predictions; efference-copy subtraction is not limited to SD-003 query time.

MECH-222.subject: pathology.self_attribution_overflow_psychosis
MECH-222.title: Failure of continuous z_self residualization produces self-attribution contamination psychosis: referential delusion and thought broadcasting substrate.

MECH-223.subject: attribution.animated_agency_overweighting_bias
MECH-223.title: Animated agency attribution overweighting: systematic bias toward attributing intentional causation to animated/moving entities requires active calibration in the attribution pathway.

MECH-224.subject: harm_representation.piecewise_gradient
MECH-224.title: harm_eval.piecewise_gradient_structure: E3 harm_eval learns both continuous intensity and discrete mode-transition thresholds.

MECH-225.subject: perception.oscillatory_multiplexing
MECH-225.title: Oscillatory coupling multiplexing: cross-frequency oscillatory dynamics (gamma/theta/beta/delta) implement phase-based separation of perception, simulation, and action preparation streams.

MECH-226.subject: architecture.tcl_biophysical_substrate
MECH-226.title: TCL substrate: Temporal Coherence Loop is implemented as a distributed system involving the inferior olive, cerebellum, thalamus, and cortical networks.

MECH-227.subject: pathology.anaesthesia_consciousness
MECH-227.title: Anaesthesia as D_V collapse: general anaesthesia abolishes consciousness by disrupting phase alignment, degrading V(t) globally, and collapsing D_V to zero.

MECH-228.subject: architecture.ephaptic_coupling_coherence
MECH-228.title: Field-level coherence support (ephaptic coupling): extracellular electric field interactions stabilise phase relationships across neural populations, supporting temporal coherence.

MECH-229.subject: drive.wanting_liking_behavioral_dissociation
MECH-229.title: E3 produces reliably distinct wanting and liking behavioral signals: wanting drives persistent approach toward goal-encoded locations (incentive salience); liking produces only consummatory response at resource contact.

MECH-230.subject: drive.goal_state_latent_structure
MECH-230.title: E3 maintains a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_goal sub-space, measurable as z_goal_norm > 0) distinct from harm avoidance, enabling hippocampal terrain navigation toward goal states.

MECH-231.subject: latent_stack.e2_short_horizon_efference_copy
MECH-231.title: E2 operates as a short-horizon efference-copy forward model on z_self; its prediction accuracy degrades faster than E1's across multi-step horizons, consistent with a cerebellar 1-step transition predictor.

MECH-232.subject: hippocampus.da_representational_expansion
MECH-232.title: Dopaminergic modulation of hippocampal place coding at reward-associated locations produces representational expansion (higher information density, finer spatial resolution, more stable place fields), and this expansion -- not an explicit positive valence gradient -- is the mechanism by which approach valence enters hippocampal terrain.

MECH-233.subject: hippocampus.valence_encoding_asymmetry
MECH-233.title: Threat and approach valence enter hippocampal terrain through mechanistically asymmetric pathways: BLA writes explicit negative valence via dedicated anxiety/avoidance cells (Jimenez 2018); VTA-DA enhances representational fidelity via LTP modulation and place field sharpening (Retailleau & Morris 2018). The behavioural outputs (avoidance, approach) appear similar but the encoding mechanisms are distinct.

MECH-234.subject: control_plane.habitual_deliberate_effector_domain_parallelism
MECH-234.title: DMS (goal-directed) and DLS (habitual) corticostriatal circuits can produce simultaneous parallel motor outputs only when targeting anatomically distinct motor effector pools; within the same effector pool, habitual and goal-directed outputs compete via winner-takes-all basal ganglia selection, not independent parallel expression.

MECH-235.subject: control_plane.vmpfc_arbitration_commitment_urgency
MECH-235.title: vmPFC arbitration continuously weights model-based (E3/deliberative) vs. model-free (E1/habitual) contributions to action selection on a spectrum, not a binary switch. Commitment (beta-elevated E3) shifts weighting toward model-based without silencing the habitual channel; unexpected threat (urgency signal) shifts weighting toward model-free. The MECH-091 urgency interrupt is the substrate implementation of this arbitration shift, not a bypass of the beta gate.

MECH-236.subject: hippocampus.e3_goal_conditioning
MECH-236.title: Hippocampal trajectory proposals must be conditioned on a goal signal (z_goal) injected from E3 via a dedicated input channel; without this conditioning, the hippocampal module generates only position-based trajectories and cannot produce goal-directed navigation toward target states.

MECH-237.subject: drive.goal_attractor_global_reachability
MECH-237.title: The z_goal attractor must be globally reachable across the z_goal sub-space — accessible from arbitrary latent starting states — not merely locally stable at a narrow basin; a locally-only-stable attractor fails to seed goal-directed hippocampal navigation from states far from the goal, producing approach behavior only when already near the goal.

MECH-238.subject: hippocampus.distance_metric_encoding
MECH-238.title: The hippocampal module encodes pairwise distance relations between states in the z_world latent manifold — not only positional tags — providing a metric structure that enables distance-based navigation toward goal states across the residue-field terrain.

MECH-239.subject: hippocampus.temporal_indexing_time_cells
MECH-239.title: The hippocampal indexing substrate includes a temporal dimension implemented via time cells that tile elapsed time using the same phase-precession and theta-sequence machinery as place cells, enabling correct ordering of states within multi-step planning rollouts and working-memory sequences.

MECH-240.subject: drive.goal_attractor_basin_scaling
MECH-240.title: SD-012 homeostatic drive_level dynamically scales z_goal attractor basin width — high drive widens the basin so the goal attractor is globally accessible, low drive narrows it to local stability only — enabling motivational-state-dependent modulation of goal-directedness without permanently widening the basin.

MECH-241.subject: hippocampus.goal_state_representational_compression
MECH-241.title: During active goal pursuit, hippocampal and OFC-analogue representations of goal-proximal states undergo compression -- goal locations cluster more tightly in neural state space -- improving signal-to-noise for goal-directed trajectory selection; the degree of compression predicts planning efficiency across episodes.

MECH-242.subject: hippocampus.dual_mode_trajectory_construction
MECH-242.title: Hippocampal trajectory construction operates via two dissociable mechanisms: (1) pattern completion for familiar trajectories (hippocampus-proper), and (2) vector-based construction for novel trajectories assembled from relational components (parahippocampal/parietal-analogue); pattern completion alone is sufficient for navigation within a learned residue field, but vector-based construction is required for generalisation to novel environments not represented in the existing map.

MECH-243.subject: hippocampus.approach_bias_output_pathway
MECH-243.title: A dedicated hippocampal output pathway (analogous to vCA1 to nucleus accumbens shell) specifically encodes approach bias during motivational conflict -- separately from harm avoidance -- cleanly dissociating the approach signal at the action-selection interface; inhibition of this pathway defaults action selection to avoidance without disrupting harm representation.

MECH-244.subject: psychiatric.psychosis_precision_weighting_failure
MECH-244.title: Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.

MECH-245.subject: psychiatric.hallucination_generative_dominance
MECH-245.title: Hallucination is a generative-model dominance failure where top-down predictions produce percepts without corresponding bottom-up sensory grounding.

MECH-246.subject: psychiatric.pareidolia_signal_degradation_pathway
MECH-246.title: Psychotic-like symptoms can arise from signal-degradation pareidolia: sufficiently noisy or ambiguous bottom-up perceptual signals allow correct Bayesian inference to produce false percepts, without requiring formal precision-weighting failure.

MECH-247.subject: psychiatric.trauma_prior_psychosis_pathway
MECH-247.title: Trauma-shaped hypervigilant priors can generate psychotic-like symptoms by structuring top-down predictions to respond strongly to minimal threat-relevant signals, producing perceptual errors and false beliefs without primary precision-weighting dysregulation.

MECH-248.subject: default_mode.source_monitoring_frontoparietal_implementation
MECH-248.title: Source monitoring (frontoparietal network; Johnson-Raye tradition) is a candidate biological implementation of the simulation/real distinction required by MECH-094 -- distinguishing internally generated from externally received content at the level of memory encoding and attribution.

MECH-249.subject: default_mode.neuromodulatory_encoding_mode_profile
MECH-249.title: Acetylcholine/noradrenaline balance implements action-mode-specific hippocampal write profiles as a continuous neuromodulatory state variable, providing the biological substrate of mode-dependent memory encoding differences across deliberate action, habit, simulation, SWS, and REM states.

MECH-250.subject: control_plane.respiratory_phase_gate_release
MECH-250.title: The end of exhalation (expiration phase) provides a hard, periodic release signal for committed motor programs via respiratory-motor coupling -- a breath-timed gate-release mechanism distinct from hippocampal completion (ARC-028) and urgency interrupt (MECH-091).

MECH-251.subject: attention.dan_feedback_precision_write
MECH-251.title: z_goal projects to a precision template vector that is additively written to the E1 prior via the dan_feedback channel with fast exponential decay, separable in dynamics and source from residue-geometry bias.

MECH-252.subject: sleep.sws_stored_goal_consolidation
MECH-252.title: SWS hippocampal-neocortical replay consolidates goal-value prediction error into updates of stored goal representations (content update), not into attentional-template parameters.

MECH-253.subject: sleep.rem_template_consolidation
MECH-253.title: REM sleep, with varied associative replay and attenuated noradrenergic tone, consolidates template-performance prediction error into updates of z_goal -> attentional-template projection weights (feature-specification update), not into stored-goal content.

MECH-254.subject: attention.boundary_gate_selection
MECH-254.title: At each E3 heartbeat cycle, a top-k selection over active E1/E2 latents determines which content enters E3 deliberation. Selection weights combine precision, z_goal-derived template gain, and noradrenergic bottom-up salience.

MECH-255.subject: attention.vmpfc_dlpfc_template_compiler
MECH-255.title: Template compilation is implemented by vmPFC value-content projection composed with dlPFC context-gated rule projection, integrated into a precision-space template vector that is the input to the SD-026 dan_feedback channel.

MECH-256.subject: self_attribution.forward_model_comparator_general
MECH-256.title: Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.

MECH-257.subject: forward_model.dual_function_gated_readout
MECH-257.title: E2_x is a dual-function substrate: one forward model read in two modes, retrospective comparator (attribution) and prospective rollout-scoring (evaluation), arbitrated by a controller gating signal.

MECH-258.subject: cingulate.precision_weighted_pain_PE
MECH-258.title: z_harm_a enters action selection as a precision-weighted prediction error (harm_surprise_PE, SD-020) against an internal pain forward model (E2_harm_a), not as a raw magnitude. Upgrades SD-020 from provisional to prerequisite for SD-032b (dACC-analog).

MECH-259.subject: cingulate.switch_threshold
MECH-259.title: Salience-network switch threshold: when the precision-weighted salience of any input to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) exceeds a threshold, the coordinator fires a whole-system mode switch rather than producing an incremental policy update.

MECH-260.subject: cingulate.dacc_bias_suppression
MECH-260.title: dACC-analog bias suppression against recency / monostrategy: the dACC module writes a counter-bias that resists repeating the last-rewarded trajectory when long-term value information demands exploration. Candidate explanation of the monostrategy failure observed in fishtank_viz and earlier queue-diversity results.
MECH-260.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires dACC-analog (SD-032b) bias_fraction
at E3 to be measurably non-zero and varying across ON/OFF arms --
V3-EXQ-571 already measured bias_fraction=0.000 for MECH-260's channel
specifically, which is why the claim was GOV-CEIL-1 demoted to contested
(2026-07-09, 8 confirmed substrate_ceiling autopsies:
460b/460c/460f/445h/603c/603d/603e/687). A run reproducing
bias_fraction=0.000 is NOT a fresh falsification -- it corroborates the
already-recorded finding.
CONFIRMING signature (this claim's own stated FALSIFIER): SD-032b +
MECH-260 (bias-suppression channel engaged, non-zero bias_fraction)
measurably resolves or reduces the monostrategy failure relative to
SD-032b alone -- the bias-suppression channel is doing causal work.
FALSIFYING signature (this claim's own stated FALSIFIER): implementing
SD-032b WITHOUT MECH-260 suppression already resolves the monostrategy
failure (MECH-260 unnecessary); OR SD-032b + MECH-260 still produces
monostrategy with the channel genuinely engaged (non-zero
bias_fraction) -- the bias-suppression framing is wrong and the fix
lies in exploration noise / entropy regularisation instead.
CURRENT STATUS: CONTESTED candidate since the 2026-07-09 GOV-CEIL-1
demotion -- the competing NULL reading (dACC anti-recency is inert /
does no work at E3) is carried CO-EQUALLY, not suppressed. Promotion in
either direction is re-gated on a future positive discrimination on a
richer substrate (same ARC-107/MECH-448/449 basal-ganglia-constitution
track as sibling claim MECH-439).

MECH-261.subject: cingulate.mode_conditioned_write_gating
MECH-261.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.
MECH-261.what_would_answer:
NOTE: the WRITE-GATE mechanism itself is already `stable` (33 supports / 3
weakens across 16 exp + 20 lit entries; V3-EXQ-446/455/453 validated the
landing). This what_would_answer targets the one part still genuinely
open per the claim's own 2026-04-19 notes: the SALIENCE-NETWORK-AS-
COORDINATOR overlay, which is REE-specific and has no direct rodent
validation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the EXP-0148 SD-032a-ablation arm
(forcing operating_mode to a fixed external_task vector) to exist and be
compared against the live coordinator-driven operating_mode with non-zero
cross-arm variance in post-quiescence action-selection bias -- deferred
until SD-033 substrates land; a run without that ablation contrast
self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING signature (primary): a purely local per-substrate gating
scheme (no shared operating-mode vector from SD-032a) FAILS to reproduce
the post-quiescence action-selection bias toward recently replayed
trajectories that the full coordinator-driven mechanism produces --
i.e. the shared coordinator overlay is doing real work, not decoration.
CONFIRMING signature (secondary): ablating SD-032a (forcing a fixed
external_task operating_mode) ABOLISHES the forward-propagation bias
(Tambini/Davachi 2019 signature) -- confirms coordination is genuinely
salience-network-mediated rather than locally emergent.
FALSIFYING: local per-substrate gating alone reproduces the
forward-propagation bias just as well as the full SD-032a-coordinated
mechanism (MECH-261's coordinator overlay is over-specification -- the
claim's own EXP-0148 falsifiable-primary clause); or ablating SD-032a
does NOT abolish the bias (the coordinator overlay is not load-bearing;
forward propagation is coordinated locally rather than by the salience
network).

MECH-262.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_rule_selective_persistence
MECH-262.title: Rule-selective persistence in lateral-PFC-analog: stimulus-abstracted rule representations in SD-033a persist across simulated time steps without external drive, remain selective through distractor events, and emerge through training rather than being innate.

MECH-263.subject: pfc.ofc_state_space_specific_outcome
MECH-263.title: OFC-analog state-space and specific-outcome representation: SD-033b represents both a structured cognitive map of the current task state space and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. Value signals ride on top of this structured representation rather than being stored in it directly.

MECH-264.subject: pfc.frontopolar_counterfactual_value_tracking
MECH-264.title: Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.

MECH-265.subject: pfc.frontopolar_relative_importance_monitoring
MECH-265.title: Frontopolar relative-importance monitoring across competing goals: SD-033e maintains a representation of relative importance across a set of active goals (parallel, not pairwise), enabling parallel-goal monitoring and flexible switching. Lesion analogue should reproduce the Mansouri 2015 over-focus + novel-rule-impairment phenotype.

MECH-266.subject: salience.asymmetric_mode_hysteresis
MECH-266.title: Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. Schmitt-trigger extension of the existing SD-032a enter-threshold logic (currently enter-only / symmetric).

MECH-267.subject: hippocampal.mode_conditioned_proposals
MECH-267.title: Mode-conditioned hippocampal trajectory proposals: HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories must condition on operating_mode (SD-032a) in addition to world_state. External_task mode proposes task-relevant trajectories; internal_planning mode proposes counterfactual / branching trajectories; internal_replay mode replays past-successful trajectories; offline_consolidation mode proposes stability-check trajectories. Without mode conditioning, replay content contaminates external-task selection.

MECH-268.subject: dacc.conflict_saturation
MECH-268.title: dACC conflict saturation: the dACC-analog (SD-032b) prediction-error / conflict signal caps and habituates under repeated identical outcomes; it does not grow unboundedly as conflict persists. Without saturation, a stuck governance loop can generate unbounded pe signal that never triggers a mode change, which is the control-theory signature of persistent rumination.

MECH-269.subject: hippocampal_proposer.regional_verisimilitude_anchor_selection
MECH-269.title: Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.
MECH-269.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires live per-stream V_s(t) alignment
telemetry and anchor/probe labels to actually be emitted at runtime by
HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories -- confirmed ABSENT through the
2026-04-25/05-08 diagnostics (V3-EXQ-478/480/481/476c all found the
read-side hook missing or the MECH-284+MECH-269 online coupling
wired-but-behaviourally-inert: freeze_recommit_count and
vs_commit_release_count pinned at 0 across every arm). A run without
live per-stream V_s telemetry and non-zero cross-arm anchor-invalidation
counts self-routes substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict on the hypothesis --
the instrumentation gap must close first (implement-substrate work), not
another parameter sweep against the existing dead hook.
CONFIRMING signature (primary, anchor-selection): anchored-eligible-only
rollouts show a smaller prediction-vs-outcome gap than indiscriminate
(no-anchor-selection) rollouts; probe-tagged rollouts preferentially
target high-PE regions and do NOT populate the ARC-018 viability map
until realized-experience validation; streamwise partial-anchor plans
degrade gracefully rather than catastrophically relative to a
no-anchor-selection baseline.
CONFIRMING signature (secondary): manipulating salience/harm load shifts
the observed anchor/probe mixture without retraining.
CONFIRMING signature (anchor-reset, primary): under EXQ-471 conditions
with MECH-287 trigger + MECH-284 accumulator + MECH-269 anchor-reset all
enabled, anchor invalidation (mark_inactive) fires within a bounded
number of PAG releases (target ~2-3), not the 1000/1000 freeze the
catatonic-lock failure mode (V3-EXQ-475) produces.
CONFIRMING signature (anchor-reset, dual-trace): after extinction,
re-presenting the original avoid-context cues re-activates the OLD
(inactive, not erased) anchor -- return-of-avoidance -- rather than
triggering a from-scratch re-learning trajectory, while a genuinely
different context leaves the new anchor operative (Bouton 2004).
FALSIFYING: anchor-eligible-only rollouts perform no better than
indiscriminate anchoring; probe rollouts contaminate the viability map
before validation (breaking the probe/anchor separation); anchor
invalidation never fires within bounded PAG releases once the hooks
genuinely exist (a real freeze, not an instrumentation gap); or
re-presented extinction cues trigger from-scratch relearning rather
than return-of-avoidance (falsifies the dual-trace/Bouton 2004 reading).

MECH-269b.subject: cortical_world_model.regional_verisimilitude_rollout_gating
MECH-269b.title: Regional verisimilitude V_s gates not only hippocampal proposer anchor selection but also which streams ground forward predictions in cortical world models (E1 sensory predictor, E2 transition model). Without symmetric V_s gating on E1/E2 rollouts, downstream consumers receive stale-but-confident-looking prediction errors -- the wired-but-inert failure mode.

MECH-270.subject: hippocampus.ephaptic_verisimilitude_readout
MECH-270.title: Ephaptic field coherence in CA1/CA3 pyramidal layers is the candidate physical substrate for the per-stream verisimilitude readout that MECH-269 anchor selection operates over. Streams whose predictions align with realized values produce coherent pyramidal ensembles whose extracellular fields constructively reinforce; misaligned streams produce incoherent fields. 'Anchor-eligible' reduces to 'field-coherent at read time.'

MECH-271.subject: hippocampus.hypothesis_tag_routing
MECH-271.title: MECH-094's hypothesis tag is realized as differential downstream routing of hippocampal replay, not as a source-side boolean. Anchored replay (trusted starting state, MECH-269) preferentially reaches subiculum -> entorhinal deep layers -> neocortex (E1 consolidation) and lateral PFC (SD-033a viability map); probe replay (low-verisimilitude seed, strengthened tag) preferentially reaches BLA (affective tagging without consolidation) and NAc (curiosity / novelty scaffolding). Tag loss presents as probe content reaching consolidation destinations it should not reach -- an auditable confabulatory-planning signature distinct from psychosis or hallucination.

MECH-272.subject: hippocampus.state_gated_routing
MECH-272.title: MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.

MECH-273.subject: self_model.sleep_dependent_aggregation
MECH-273.title: The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.

MECH-274.subject: other_model.sleep_dependent_aggregation
MECH-274.title: V4-reserved. The sleep-dependent aggregation pattern of MECH-273 extends to other-attribution. Fast empathy (ARC-010) produces single-episode attributions of other-agent action-outcome links; a stable model of other minds requires full-Bayesian aggregation of those attributions during sleep, architecturally parallel to MECH-273 but operating on other-agent rather than self attributions.

MECH-275.subject: sleep.general_bayesian_aggregation
MECH-275.title: Sleep-phase full-Bayesian aggregation is a general mechanism across attribution domains: given a waking-phase feedstock of counterfactual-backed attributions (produced by MECH-276), sleep phases aggregate across many episodes, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases that single-episode attribution cannot catch. MECH-273 (self-model aggregation) and MECH-274 (other-model aggregation, V4) are specialisations. Object-schema revision is a further specialisation. INV-049 (offline phases mathematically necessary for model-building agents) is operationalised here: what sleep is mathematically necessary FOR is this cross-episode Bayesian aggregation of counterfactual-backed attribution.

MECH-276.subject: agent.scientist_intervention
MECH-276.title: The scientist-agent principle: the waking-phase mechanism that feeds MECH-275 is deliberate intervention. The agent generates hypotheses (proposer-side, via MECH-269 probe channel), selects actions that will produce informative contrast under those hypotheses, executes the actions, observes the outcomes, and computes counterfactual-backed attribution. Correlational observation is insufficient -- the agent must behave like a scientist, performing experiments whose outcomes produce structured attribution signals. Applies across all three developmental stages; specialised by MECH-277 (action-space discovery), MECH-278 (object-schema formation), and a V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents).

MECH-277.subject: developmental.action_space_discovery
MECH-277.title: Stage-1 specialisation of MECH-276: the agent discovers its own action space via motor experimentation (motor babbling) before SD-003 counterfactual self-attribution is well-formed. The agent performs motor acts and observes which sensory changes covary with them; the output is the substrate SD-003 requires -- a set of actions the agent has reason to believe are self-initiated and for which it has counterfactual expectations. Without MECH-277, the counterfactual action space (a_cf) is not well-defined and SD-003 degenerates.

MECH-278.subject: developmental.object_schema_formation
MECH-278.title: Stage-2 specialisation of MECH-276: once the agent can distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change (stage 1 complete via MECH-277), it forms object-schemas via experimental action on the world. An object is the stable bundle of features that behave causally together under interventional perturbation -- push here, these features move together; occlude this, that cluster disappears. Object-schema formation is the stage-2 specialisation of the scientist-agent principle, with world-features as the target of intervention. V3's z_world (SD-005) is currently engineered pre-split; this is an architectural shortcut past stage 2.

MECH-279.subject: pag.gabaergic_freeze_gate
MECH-279.title: PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

MECH-280.subject: lh_pag.override_projection
MECH-280.title: LH-PAG override projection: a direct projection from LH (orexin and/or peri-LC GABA analog) to PAG modulates the GABAergic freeze gate (MECH-279) under metabolic demand. The projection does not silence the freeze gate; it raises its threshold (theta_freeze_effective = theta_freeze_base x (1 + alpha_override x override_signal)). This produces the behavioural transition from freeze to active foraging under sustained hunger plus threat -- the foraging-under-predation phenotype the lit-pull surveys.

MECH-281.subject: orexin.drive_arousal_coupling
MECH-281.title: Orexin-analog gain modulation of drive-coupled arousal (motor-coupling axis): an orexin-analog modulator gates the coupling between drive_level and arousal-relevant downstream targets (PFC for SD-033a deliberation, BLA/CeA for SD-035 amygdala arbitration, beta-gate for MECH-090). Loss of this coupling produces a cataplexy-analog failure where emotional/drive input fails to recruit motor activation -- z_harm and drive_level compute normally but action selection does not integrate them. This is the motor-coupling axis of orexin function; the wake-stability axis (sleep-state gating, the dominant biological role) is MECH-286. Both axes are downstream of the same SD-037 override_signal, predicting clinical co-occurrence of cataplexy with sleep-state instability under orexin loss (narcolepsy).

MECH-282.subject: lpb.interoceptive_harm_routing
MECH-282.title: LPB interoceptive routing into harm-arbitration: a lateral-parabrachial-nucleus analog (LPB) routes interoceptive distress signals (visceral malaise, taste-aversion analogs, hypoxia, hypoglycemia) into the harm-arbitration network via PBN-CGRP -> CeA -> PAG. This is the upstream broadcast arm of the threat-side architecture, parallel to VMHdm's predator-side broadcast. Both feed downstream arbiters where SD-037's override_signal reweights them. Architectural commitment: interoceptive harm has a separable input channel from external-threat z_harm, dissociable in pathology and in normal modulation.

MECH-283.subject: hippocampal.v_s_recognition_recall_gate
MECH-283.title: Verisimilitude recognition-for-recall gate: V_s computed at retrieval time (not proposal time) gates whether a stored episode is even a candidate for re-entry into the proposal stream. Recognition (does this fit my current situation?) is logically prior to anchor-eligibility (is this a good place to start a rollout from?). MECH-269's V_s is computed against the proposed anchor state; MECH-283's V_s is computed against the retrieved episode content. Loss of MECH-283 produces intrusive recall -- episodes that don't fit current context get pulled into the proposal stream (PTSD flashback / schizophrenic loose-association phenomenology).

MECH-284.subject: hippocampal.v_s_residual_schema_staleness_accumulator
MECH-284.title: V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). Distinct from generic prediction error (which operates on latent values and updates online via gradient): MECH-284 is region-indexed, accumulates across events, and exposes a dual read-out (online + offline). Refined 2026-04-22 from sleep-only formulation to dual-readout formulation after V3-EXQ-475 demonstrated that an agent trapped in a stale anchor needs an online consumer of the staleness signal -- MECH-285 sleep-only readout cannot rescue the agent during waking. Saturated map produces over-attention to schema revision (anxiety-analog); absent map produces schema rigidity (V3-EXQ-475 phenotype: 5-6 PAG releases per seed but never integrate to anchor invalidation -> 1000/1000 freeze-active steps).

MECH-285.subject: hippocampal.sleep_consolidation_priority_from_v_s_residuals
MECH-285.title: Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

MECH-286.subject: sleep.override_gated_state_transition
MECH-286.title: Override-gated sleep-state transition: SD-037 override_signal also gates entry to and exit from offline (sleep) mode. High override (sustained drive + threat under metabolic demand) suppresses sleep-mode onset; low override + accumulated MECH-284 V_s-residual staleness + permissive threat context permits onset and recruits the MECH-285 sleep-replay priority readout. Architecturally this is the recruitment authority for the offline arm of the V_s bidirectional cluster: MECH-284 accumulates the demand for offline schema repair, MECH-285 sets the priority order, and MECH-286 provides the on-switch. Without MECH-286, MECH-285 produces a priority list with no transition mechanism to consume it. This is the V3 architectural account of orexin's canonical role as wake-stability gate (Saper/Scammell flip-flop), which MECH-281 (drive-arousal coupling) understates by framing cataplexy purely as a motor-coupling failure.

MECH-287.subject: regulators.broadcast_invalidation_trigger
MECH-287.title: Dual-component online invalidation trigger: an UPSTREAM anchor-side comparator (CA1/CA3 mismatch flowing through subicular routing per Vinogradova 2001 + O'Mara 2009) coupled to a DOWNSTREAM broadcast event (LC phasic burst per Aston-Jones-Cohen 2005, with parallel signals from generalised dopaminergic prediction error per Schultz 1997 and lateral habenula negative-RPE per Matsumoto-Hikosaka 2007), wired together by the HC-VTA loop (Lisman & Grace 2005). The two components are coupled stages of one trigger event, not alternatives. Distinct from MECH-284 the accumulator: MECH-287 is the discrete trigger event (anchor-side mismatch + broadcast release) that drives accumulation. Triggered by latent-stream prediction failure (norm(z_pred(t-1) - z_obs(t)) > theta_trigger) OR strongly negative value-PE (value_PE(t) < -theta_value) OR exogenous surprise. Carries no schema-region credit on its own; downstream MECH-284 attributes the broadcast event to the active anchor set. Failure modes dissociate from MECH-284: trigger-loss produces single-event blindness (no anchor ever feels invalidated, but staleness map remains queryable); accumulator-loss produces V3-EXQ-475's phenotype directly (releases happen but never integrate). Failure modes also dissociate from MECH-285 sleep priority: trigger-loss prevents staleness from accruing, while sleep-priority loss prevents accrued staleness from being repaired. Within MECH-287 itself, anchor-side comparator failure dissociates from broadcast failure: comparator-loss = no upstream signal to broadcast (silent trigger, biologically a CA1/CA3 lesion); broadcast-loss = comparator fires but no global gain modulation downstream (silent invalidation, biologically an LC lesion).

MECH-288.subject: hippocampal.event_segmenter
MECH-288.title: Event-segment detection: a substrate-side two-level hierarchical detector that emits monotonic outer.inner segment IDs on detected event boundaries, feeding region-keyed substrates (anchor sets per MECH-269, V_s readouts per Phase 1, staleness accumulators per MECH-284) and the MECH-287 broadcast trigger at the schema/event-segment scale per Eichenbaum 2017 / Sols-DuBrow-Davachi 2017 / Baldassano 2017. Default substrate: PE-threshold detector on the fast scale (z_world+z_self) and BOCPD-Gaussian latent change-point on the slow scale (z_goal); MECH-287 broadcast fires downstream of MECH-288 boundaries (Clewett 2025) rather than via an independent comparator. The segment_id field is the region key consumed by the V_s invalidation runtime cluster; without it, MECH-269 anchor sets and per-region V_s aggregation have no substrate-native source for the region partition.

MECH-289.subject: hippocampal.cem_anti_recency_bias
MECH-289.title: The hippocampal SWR trajectory generator has anti-recency weighting: infrequently experienced trajectories are proposed more often than recently committed ones, and novel-path sequences (never behaviorally executed) are actively generated from available path segments.

MECH-290.subject: hippocampal.backward_trajectory_credit_sweep
MECH-290.title: At trajectory completion, HippocampalModule performs a backward temporal credit sweep that propagates the terminal outcome (goal contact or failure) retroactively through preceding states, consistent with the reverse replay observed at reward endpoints in awake rats (Foster & Wilson 2006).

MECH-291.subject: control_plane.online_offline_cem_mode_differentiation
MECH-291.title: Waking-online and quiescent-offline CEM modes require distinct parameter profiles: waking mode uses short rollout horizon, context-anchored start states, and low exploration weighting; quiescent mode uses longer rollout horizon, free start states drawn from the full map, and high exploration weighting (anti-recency bias per MECH-289).

MECH-292.subject: hippocampal.unresolved_goal_ghost_bank
MECH-292.title: Inactive or strained anchors whose preserved goal payload still matches the current goal form a ranked ghost-goal bank; priority scales with wanting, goal-match, staleness, and recoverability rather than with staleness alone.

MECH-293.subject: hippocampal.awake_ghost_goal_probe_search
MECH-293.title: Waking hippocampal search allocates a minority probe budget to top ghost-goal entries, seeding proposals around unresolved but still-wanted anchors instead of relying on pure current-anchor CEM or random probe noise.

MECH-294.subject: theta_gamma.multi_content_joint_packet
MECH-294.title: Theta-burst packet contains multi-content joint binding: each ~125ms theta cycle binds a {goal_latent, action_proposal, risk_estimate, state_summary} tuple within one phase-aligned window, with verisimilitude grounding the rollout step that must stay ahead of real time.

MECH-295.subject: drive_to_approach.liking_stream_bridge
MECH-295.title: The drive -> liking-stream -> approach-cue gain pathway is one of several drive->approach pathways in the REE substrate. It biases approach action scoring via a liking-specific per-candidate score_bias contribution, but is NOT the sole or necessary pathway by which drive amplification reaches approach action selection (narrowed 2026-05-31 from necessity to modulation per V3-EXQ-490j autopsy; original necessity title preserved in functional_restatement history). Parallel architecturally first-class drive->approach pathways operate in the same substrate: MECH-216 schema-readout wanting, MECH-290 backward credit sweep, MECH-307 anticipatory liking, and serotonin tonic_5ht benefit_salience.

MECH-296.subject: hippocampal.prototype_readout_via_type_keyed_attention
MECH-296.title: Prototype-readout operator computes a softmax-attention match between the current LatentState and the type-keyed anchor pool, returning a small set of best-matched type-keys plus their confidences. Runs both during waking (moment-to-moment type recognition) and during sleep (consolidation refinement of the type-anchor pool).

MECH-297.subject: hippocampal.type_vs_anchor_gating_extension_mech_269
MECH-297.title: Type-V_s gating extends MECH-269's per-stream / per-region V_s with a per-type V_s dimension keyed on the matched type-key from MECH-296. Allows the proposer / E3 to gate stream contributions by category-V_s as well as by per-stream V_s, downweighting type-confident-but-stream-degraded inputs and vice versa.

MECH-298.subject: pfc.event_gated_frontal_write_at_goal_instantiation
MECH-298.title: Event-gated frontal write at goal-instantiation moments: when GoalState transitions from inactive to active, or when z_goal changes substantially, perform a high-bandwidth one-shot transfer of LatentStack content into SD-033a rule_state and SD-033b state_code, replacing the slow-EMA update for that tick. Mirrors Spellman et al. 2015 encoding-direction HPC->PFC dependence at goal-cue encoding.

MECH-299.subject: hippocampal.theta_cycle_content_scales_with_substrate_vocabulary
MECH-299.title: Theta-cycle content scales with the agent's current substrate abstraction vocabulary: the unit packaged into a single theta cycle is the smallest reusable item available in the active substrate stack -- atomic actions when only those exist, action chunks when SD-045 lands, type-instance matches when SD-040/MECH-296 land, option invocations when SD-042 lands. Refinement of MECH-089 (theta-gamma nesting) on the content-of-packet axis.

MECH-300.subject: hippocampal.cognitive_map_traversal_at_active_abstraction_level
MECH-300.title: Cognitive map traversal via theta sequences operates at the agent's active abstraction level. Theta sequences do not have a fixed semantic content -- they simulate trajectories through whatever cognitive map the substrate vocabulary currently defines, whether spatial, conceptual, type-graph, or option-graph. Sister claim to MECH-299, on the map-being-traversed axis.

MECH-301.subject: hippocampal.waking_quiescent_replay_via_mech285_priority_sampling
MECH-301.title: Priority-weighted anchor replay (MECH-285) runs not only during sleep but also during brief waking quiescent pauses, surfacing remote / non-current stored content for goal-directed retrieval. The architectural gating is contextual (quiescent vs active behaviour, sensory input vs absence) rather than state-categorical (waking vs sleep). Refinement / generalisation of MECH-285.

MECH-302.subject: relief.completion_event_reuses_goal_achievement_pipeline
MECH-302.title: Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

MECH-303.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_passive_substrate
MECH-303.title: Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

MECH-304.subject: safety_prediction.cue_specific_conditioned_inhibition_substrate
MECH-304.title: Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).

MECH-305.subject: harm_stream.controllability_weighted_affective_load
MECH-305.title: z_harm_a requires a controllability-modulated weighting term beyond MECH-219 temporal hysteresis: perceived uncontrollability or inescapability amplifies the affective load integrator, while perceived controllability suppresses it. Biological locus is dorsal ACC, which integrates noxious stimulus input with controllability context and projects to the medial suffering pathway (ACC/insula, overlapping with salience network).

MECH-306.subject: goal_seeding.sustained_drive_trace
MECH-306.title: z_goal seeding under SD-012 requires sustained drive at contact, not instantaneous homeostatic drive alone: when the agent is well-fed, drive_level collapses at consumption and anti-correlates with benefit_exposure, so effective_benefit cannot cross the seeding threshold unless drive is floored or slow-traced.

MECH-307.subject: affect.anticipatory_conjunction_architecture
MECH-307.title: Anticipatory positive affect (excitement) and anticipatory negative affect (dread) emerge as derived states from the conjunction of (a) signed VALENCE_SURPRISE, (b) MECH-216 schema readout coupled to z_beta arousal, (c) anticipatory VALENCE_LIKING write at predicted-imminent-positive-event locations, and (d) MECH-216 writes at predicted rather than current location. Four-gap substrate amendment to MECH-216 + MECH-205 + the residue valence buffer, NOT a new VALENCE channel.

MECH-308.subject: language.acquisition_tracks_play_mode
MECH-308.title: Language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation: socially-grounded compositional language emerges as a specialised game type instantiated within play_mode (INV-058 / MECH-194 / ARC-049), not via a parallel language-acquisition substrate. The basic expression catalog (play pose, head tilt, laughter, mutual gaze, distress vocalisation, approach cue, vocal mimicry, pointing) acts as the bilateral frame-opening signal; conversational violations function as synthetic z_harm; utterance-as-goal acts as synthetic z_goal; proto-symbols accrete as conditional modifiers attached to basic-expression channels. Predicts that systems trained without play_mode-like episodes fail to acquire socially-grounded compositional language even when pattern-matching imitation succeeds.

MECH-309.subject: policy.monomodal_collapse_as_equilibrium_without_rule_apprehender
MECH-309.title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

MECH-312.subject: policy.rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session
MECH-312.title: rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session. Parent claim for the multi-variable, multi-channel, dynamic-within-session arbitration that selects between competing rules / policy modes / action sources at the policy layer. Arbitration is governed by at least four distinct sub-mechanisms (MECH-312a/b/c/d), each falsifiable independently, with a candidate fifth (controllability/agency) deferred pending V3 substrate availability. Recommended combination rule: multiplicative gate (per-channel softmax of reliability * cost * agency * V_s * practice_maturity products) per Pull 3 R4 verdict; falsified against additive-logit baseline in V3-EXQ-543b/c. Reframed 2026-05-10 from earlier dual-channel-arbitration sketch following Pull 3 SYNTHESIS R5 SUB-MECH SPLIT recommendation (conf 0.78).

MECH-312a.subject: policy.arbitration.uncertainty_reliability_weighting
MECH-312a.title: uncertainty_reliability_weighting (Daw_2005_Lee_2014_dual_systems_arbitration_analog). Arbitration weight tracks the inverse-uncertainty / reliability of each candidate rule or policy mode; high-reliability sources receive higher arbitration weight. Biological substrate: model-based / model-free dual-systems arbitration (Daw et al. 2005 Nat Neurosci; Lee et al. 2014 Neuron). LOW divergence from existing literature; direct mapping. Sub-claim of MECH-312.

MECH-312b.subject: policy.arbitration.practice_maturity_weighting
MECH-312b.title: practice_maturity_weighting (Smith_Graybiel_habit_takeover_analog). Arbitration weight tracks practice-maturity / habit-strength of each candidate rule or policy mode; well-practiced behaviour receives higher arbitration weight via a habit-takeover dynamic. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum habit consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016); successor-representation maturation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017). LOW-MEDIUM divergence; partial mapping (the maturity dimension is well-anchored; the integration into a multi-channel arbitration layer is more REE-specific). Sub-claim of MECH-312.

MECH-312c.subject: policy.arbitration.affective_stream_modulation_ree_novel
MECH-312c.title: affective_stream_modulation_of_arbitration_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated by affective stream load: when the SD-010 / SD-011 affective stream produces high load (high salience harm or affect), the arbitration layer routes more weight to rules associated with affect-laden context, suppressing arbitration weight on neutral-context rules. The REE-novel claim is the FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCE: dual-stream architecture (SD-010/SD-011) is well-anchored in Murray-Rudebeck 2018 and Pessoa-Adolphs 2010, but the modulation of rule-arbitration weights by affective-stream load is REE-specific (MEDIUM-HIGH divergence). Sub-claim of MECH-312.

MECH-312d.subject: policy.arbitration.v_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_ree_novel
MECH-312d.title: V_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated per-region by V_s freshness (the per-region staleness scalar from MECH-269 / MECH-284 / MECH-287); rules associated with stale regions receive lower arbitration trust, regardless of their reliability or practice. HIGH divergence (REE-novel per-region scope + rule-trust function): Behrens 2007 ACC volatility and Bouton 2004 contextual renewal are nearest cousins, but per-region continuous scalar + arbitration-trust routing are REE-specific. Sub-claim of MECH-312.

MECH-313.subject: policy.stochastic_noise_floor_lc_ne_tonic_analog
MECH-313.title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).
MECH-313.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the MECH-457 competence-floor
substrate to clear first -- V3-EXQ-687a (2026-07-30) already found all
4 arms of the Q-045 design failing committed_sufficiency at the
absolute floor, which is a readiness failure shared with the whole
committed-behaviour campaign (MECH-260/Q-045 co-tagged), NOT a

until MECH-457 clears. Also requires the 4-arm design (both-OFF /

CONFIRMING signature (this claim's own stated FALSIFIER, restated):

CURRENT STATUS: CONTESTED candidate since 2026-07-09 (7 confirmed

competing null reading is carried CO-EQUALLY.

MECH-314.subject: policy.structured_curiosity_bonus_parent
MECH-314.title: structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.

MECH-314a.subject: policy.curiosity.novelty_bonus_striatal_analog
MECH-314a.title: novelty_bonus_striatal_analog. A reward bonus that tracks recency-of-encounter; new or rarely-encountered states/actions receive a positive bonus independent of reward prediction error. Biological substrate: ventral striatum response to stimulus novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus.

MECH-314b.subject: policy.curiosity.uncertainty_driven_frontopolar_analog
MECH-314b.title: uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

MECH-314c.subject: policy.curiosity.learning_progress_intrinsic_motivation_analog
MECH-314c.title: learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).

MECH-316.subject: rule_discovery.cross_episode_regularity_extraction
