MECH-316.title: cross_episode_regularity_extraction (episodic_RL_successor_representation_CLS_monosynaptic_analog). A mechanism for extracting cross-episode statistical regularities from observed behaviour streams, producing a representation that supports prediction of future state-occupancy distributions. Biological substrate: hippocampal monosynaptic CA1 path (Schapiro et al. 2017 CLS bi-pathway); statistical learning in hippocampus (Davachi 2015). Computational analog: successor representation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017 Nat Neurosci). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery.

MECH-317.subject: rule_discovery.behavioural_pattern_compression
MECH-317.title: behavioural_pattern_compression (option_formation_striatal_chunking_analog). A mechanism for compressing repeated behavioural patterns into reusable options / action-chunks, producing a representation that supports temporally-extended action selection. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum sequence consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016; Martiros & Graybiel 2018). Computational analog: options framework / option-critic (Bacon, Harb & Precup 2017). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery.

MECH-318.subject: rule_discovery.rule_state_abstraction_substrate
MECH-318.title: rule_state_abstraction_substrate (meta_RL_recurrent_task_state_representation). A mechanism for abstracting the higher-level rule-state itself as a latent variable in the agent's representation, supporting policy adaptation that depends on inferred rule-context rather than only observable cue. Biological substrate: OFC cognitive map (Wilson, Takahashi, Schoenbaum & Niv 2014; Schuck et al. 2016 OFC encodes task state). Computational analog: meta-RL recurrent task-state representation (Wang et al. 2018 prefrontal-as-meta-RL; Duan et al. 2016 RL^2; Botvinick et al. 2019 review). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery. ABSORPTION CHECK 2026-05-10: VERDICT (B) PARTIALLY ABSORBED. Within-V3 functional weight is borne by SD-033a LateralPFCAnalog rule_state buffer (W1 EMA recurrence + W3 substrate-readiness + W4 downstream bias) plus ARC-062 Phase 1 gated_policy multi-stream context discriminator (W3 per-tick rule-context discrimination + W4 score-aggregation training pressure), with ARC-062 Phase 3 GAP-C planned wiring closing the loop between the two. Two residual gaps remain: W2 (multi-task training distribution -- blocked on multi-rule-context substrate, SD-054 single-context insufficient) and W5 (cross-episode hidden-state continuity -- likely V4-scope; SD-033a per-episode reset is architecturally load-bearing for the rest of the agent state machine). Empirical retire-vs-promote verdict deferred to V3-EXQ-543c-successor on multi-rule-context substrate. See REE_assembly/docs/architecture/mech_318_absorption_check.md.

MECH-319.subject: policy.arbitration.simulation_mode_write_gating_substrate_ree_novel_function
MECH-319.title: simulation_mode_rule_write_gating_categorical_replay_tag (SWR_machinery_substrate_REE_novel_function). The substrate-level instantiation of MECH-094's hypothesis-tag write gate at the rule-arbitration layer: a categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation-mode tag that suppresses arbitration-weight updates during ghost / replay / DMN passes, allowing rule-arbitration to be exercised without overwriting the active rule weights from non-realized data. Substrate-availability premise is well-anchored: SWR machinery (Joo & Frank 2018 review) + reverse-replay discriminable signature (Foster & Wilson 2006). The specific REE function (categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation tag suppressing arbitration-weight updates) is plausible biologically but unverified at cellular / synaptic level.

MECH-320.subject: action.tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias
MECH-320.title: tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias (capacity-keyed E3 score-side action drive / mesolimbic-DA-vigor-analog / average-reward-rate opportunity-cost regulator). Child mechanism for ARC-066 (tonic_vigor_coupling) AND ARC-068 (opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty -- collapse into MECH-320 per ARC-068 lit-pull R3 verdict 2026-05-16; MECH-320's w_passive term IS the ARC-068 implementation). Adds a tonic vigor scalar v_t to E3 trajectory scoring as an additive bias toward action-trajectories and an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary trajectories, where v_t is a slow EWMA over the realised E3-score-receipt stream. Target-free: bias applies regardless of whether any z_goal is currently active. Distinct from MECH-313 (LC-NE noise floor -- noise on choice, orthogonal axis), MECH-216 (target-conditioned wanting), SD-012 (deficit-keyed drive, opposite coupling), and MECH-330 (ARC-067 boredom -- valence-side z_harm_a write, different architectural layer).

MECH-321.subject: policy.decomposition_via_event_segmenter
MECH-321.title: policy_decomposition_via_event_segmenter (rollout-side consumer of MECH-288 boundary pulses; re-segments the rollout proposal stream at finer grain when a chunk's region shows low V_s / boundary fires on the imagined trajectory). First child mechanism for ARC-070. Bidirectional extension of MECH-288 substrate (R2 lit-pull verdict 2026-05-10): MECH-288 already detects boundaries on whatever latent + PE streams it consumes; MECH-321 wires the rollout / imagination input stream into MECH-288 and consumes the resulting boundary pulses at the policy-primitive layer to decompose chunked primitives into finer-grain sub-elements. PE-driven primary trigger (V_s drop on chunk's region per Zacks 2007 / Schapiro 2017); bottleneck-state framing is a separate consolidation-phase mechanism, not the primary trigger. Recursive multi-level decomposition; depth cap 3 is an ENGINEERING choice, not a literature-derived constant (provenance corrected 2026-07-27 -- see evidence_quality_note). The MULTI-LEVEL commitment is ARC-070's R3 verdict (Badre & D'Esposito 2009) and STANDS; that source never supported a level COUNT, and Badre & Nee 2018 (Badre's own re-appraisal) finds the evidence supports neither a unitary model of lateral frontal function nor a unidimensional abstraction gradient, so there is no single ordered axis along which to cap. The cap rests instead on tractability + operator symmetry (mirrors ARC-071's chunk_max_depth so the inverse operations stay symmetric; open Q-claim on hard-vs-soft). Magnitude prior only, with an explicit grain caveat: Koechlin 2003 resolves a 3-level lateral-PFC cascade (4 with Koechlin & Summerfield 2007 frontopolar branching), but at ANATOMICAL grain -- heterogeneous, anatomically fixed control levels, NOT homogeneous recursion depth of one operator re-applying to its own output. Both pre-commit and mid-execution phases supported via the same mechanism, with downstream effects gated by MECH-094 hypothesis_tag (rollout fires under hypothesis_tag=True write nothing; observation / execution fires under hypothesis_tag=False enable the existing observation-side consumer chain unchanged).

MECH-322.subject: policy.composition.sleep_replay_value_conditioned_consolidation
MECH-322.title: policy_composition.sleep_replay_value_conditioned_chunking_consolidation -- narrow exception path that permits ARC-071 chunk formation from replayed (hypothesis_tag=True) sequences during designated sleep phase, IF the replayed sequence carries a value-tag from prior real-executed episodes AND the formed chunk carries a replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution within N episodes. Resolves ARC-071 lit-pull R6 governance escalation (Option B carve-out, picked 2026-05-11).

MECH-323.subject: policy.composition.chunk_accumulator_formation
MECH-323.title: policy_composition_chunk_accumulator -- striatum/DLS-analog formation operator that builds chunk candidates from sequences of policy primitives repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes. First child mechanism for ARC-071 (the maintenance operator MECH-324 is registered separately). Encodes the lit-pull R1 verdict (repetition + outcome consistency as primary trigger, evaluative-gate upstream, V_s-positive secondary) + R2 verdict partial (striatum-analog formation substrate; vmPFC/IL maintenance substrate handled by MECH-324) + R4 verdict (chunked primitive carries initiation-set + termination-condition fields per Sutton 1999 options structure) + R5 verdict (gradual hysteresis with F_low formation < F_high dissolution -- the RELATION is literature-grounded as of 2026-07-27 (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012), the VALUES F_low=0.15 / F_high=0.45 are uncalibrated engineering defaults with NO literature support, awaiting child-MECH calibration; INITIAL chunk-size budget 2-5 elements per level, licensed by Sakai 2003 at MOTOR grain only and NOT a stable architectural constant -- Ramkumar 2016 shows chunk length grows with practice under a compute/efficiency trade-off, Bo & Seidler 2009 shows it tracks visuospatial working-memory capacity and declines with age, so the ceiling should be exposed as growable and ideally DERIVED from the agent's deliberation/rollout budget rather than configured independently; see the 2026-07-27 provenance correction in evidence_quality_note). Dissolution is SUPPRESSION WITH RETENTION, not erasure (2026-07-27 structural correction, registered on MECH-324): a previously-dissolved sequence re-forms at the REDUCED bar R_reacq = R_min * f_reacq rather than at R_min from scratch, so the MECH-323 trigger is state-dependent on the chunk library; and the initiation_set field becomes load-bearing for the renewal falsifier, which is expressible only if dissolution is scoped to the same context granularity formation uses. Two write paths: default MECH-094 strict (hypothesis_tag=False real executions only); sleep-replay carve-out under MECH-322 conditions (replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution).

MECH-324.subject: policy.composition.chunk_maintenance_dissolution
MECH-324.title: policy_composition_chunk_maintenance -- IL/vmPFC-analog maintenance operator that gates chunk crystallisation, persistence under continued corroboration, and dissolution under outcome inconsistency. Dissolution is SUPPRESSION WITH RETENTION, not erasure: a dissolved chunk persists DORMANT (unselectable but retained) and re-forms at a reduced repetition bar R_reacq = R_min * f_reacq, per the 2026-07-27 structural correction (Barnes 2005 striatal ensemble re-emergence; Bouton 2012 renewal/resurgence/rapid-reacquisition) -- f_reacq is an uncalibrated engineering default on the same footing as F_high. Yields three relapse falsifiers (rapid reacquisition, testable now; renewal and resurgence, each substrate-blocked on an open Q-claim). Second child mechanism for ARC-071 (paired with MECH-323 formation operator). Causally required for chunk crystallisation per Smith & Graybiel 2013 selective optogenetic disruption of infralimbic cortex during overtraining (which PREVENTS habit formation despite intact striatal accumulator activity). Encodes the lit-pull R2 verdict (IL/vmPFC-analog substrate component of the phase-dependent multi-substrate chunking machinery) + R5 verdict (asymmetric hysteresis with F_high dissolution threshold > F_low formation threshold and slower dissolution timescale than formation timescale -- the RELATION and the timescale asymmetry are literature-grounded as of 2026-07-27 (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012), but the VALUE F_high=0.45, and the ratio 0.45/0.15, have NO literature support and remain uncalibrated engineering defaults awaiting child-MECH calibration; see the 2026-07-27 provenance correction in evidence_quality_note) + MECH-322 verdict (accelerated dissolution for replay-origin chunks not corroborated by real waking execution within N episodes).

MECH-325.subject: hippocampus.cue_indexed_trajectory_library
MECH-325.title: hippocampal_cue_indexed_trajectory_library -- the hippocampal module should function as a content-addressable trajectory store where PFC context/goal cues pattern-complete against the stored library to retrieve trajectory templates appropriate for the current context; different PFC context states retrieve different trajectory subsets, enabling context-differentiated behavioral option selection without regenerating trajectories from scratch each tick.

MECH-326.subject: pfc.context_bias_hippocampal_retrieval_gate
MECH-326.title: pfc_context_bias_as_hippocampal_retrieval_gate -- PFC active goal/task representations send top-down bias signals that steer which hippocampal trajectory templates are retrieved or replayed; different PFC context states should produce different hippocampal retrieval subsets, enabling context-appropriate behavioral option selection; without this routing, the trajectory library is queried uniformly regardless of goal state.

MECH-327.subject: play.pe_locus_probe_action_selection
MECH-327.title: During sensorimotor play, E1 prediction-error locus upweights probe-action selection: actions targeting high-PE regions of z_world are preferentially selected, implementing curiosity-driven exploration within the play frame.

MECH-328.subject: play.goal_space_continuity
MECH-328.title: Synthetic and real z_goal vectors must lie in the same latent manifold for play-to-real policy transfer to succeed; disjoint manifolds produce a transfer failure where play-acquired competence cannot generalise to real goal-pursuit.

MECH-329.subject: development.wanting_before_liking_goal_seeding_sequence
MECH-329.title: The wanting system (mesolimbic dopamine / approach motivation) seeds z_goal anchors via accidental benefit contacts before the liking system (hedonic evaluation) is calibrated -- producing a first wave of super-ordinal goals shaped by approach drive rather than calibrated preference.

MECH-330.subject: action.idle_aversion_acute_restlessness_accumulator
MECH-330.title: idle_aversion_acute_restlessness_accumulator (engagement-rate-keyed aversive accumulator on z_harm_a / affective stream at the acute timescale ~minutes/tens-of-episodes. First child mechanism for ARC-067. Routes boredom-aversive through SD-011 affective harm stream / AIC analog per Danckert 2018 AIC-deactivation under boredom and Wilson 2014 Science self-shock exchangeability with physical pain. Three-input executive-engagement-rate estimator: commit transitions per episode, E3 deliberation depth, residue-write rate; novel-observation count dropped as primary input (van Tilburg 2017 meaning-seeking not stimulation-seeking). MAC meaning-component adds a parallel secondary channel via existing z_goal substrate (SD-012 / MECH-308). Cross-talk to MECH-331: sustained MECH-330 activation without discharge seeds the chronic frontostriatal effort-allocation substrate.)

MECH-331.subject: action.idle_aversion_chronic_anhedonic_flatness
MECH-331.title: idle_aversion_chronic_anhedonic_flatness_substrate (slow-integrating frontostriatal effort-allocation substrate at the chronic timescale ~sessions/episode-blocks. Second child mechanism for ARC-067. Seeded by sustained MECH-330 acute-restlessness activation without discharge. Implements the apathy archetype (Husain-Roiser 2018 frontostriatal effort-allocation failure) as a slow-integrating complement to MECH-330's acute restlessness pole. Preserved hedonic experience (MECH-295 liking-channel intact); impaired effort-to-act mobilisation. HPA-axis substrate context (Ulrich-Lai & Herman 2009 chronic understimulation / loss-of-control signature). Ablation predicts reduced action-density in long-horizon episodes even when MECH-330 acute restlessness is firing -- the chronic substrate damps the effort-mobilisation pathway below what the acute channel alone can drive.)

MECH-332.subject: harm_stream.nociceptive_attenuation_dual_substrate_dissociation
MECH-332.title: Nociceptive attenuation on z_harm_s is implemented by two mechanistically dissociable parallel pathways: (1) per-step efference-copy comparator (MECH-256/SD-029, spinal/cortical substrate, triggered by a_actual) and (2) commitment-gated PAG/RVM precision suppression (SD-021, PAG/RVM substrate, triggered by committed-trajectory state). Their substrates and triggers are independent; their attenuation effects are additive.

MECH-333.subject: learning.developmental_critical_period_open_phase
MECH-333.title: Critical period open phase: the dominant scoring pathway's effective update magnitude must be suppressed (or diversity circuit signal weight amplified to competitive parity) during a time-bounded plasticity-open window, preventing winner-take-all capture before diversity circuits achieve viable weight; REE analog of E/I balance shift and GABA maturation that opens biological critical periods.
MECH-333.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: only option (E) plasticity injection (the
post-window closure/plastic-channel half) is implemented
(GatedPolicy.crystallize(), 2026-05-17). The pre-window
F-ATTENUATION half (suppressing F's gradient contribution during the
open phase -- ARC-075 requirement 1) is NOT yet implemented; this is
the actual mechanism under test and it does not exist yet.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (already established by 5 consecutive
non_contributory harness failures -- 610a/b/c/d/e, all
measurement_test_design_defect or substrate_ceiling): requires (a) a
genuinely trained gated policy (610c/610d's harness never actually
trained it -- crystallize() froze never-trained heads, ewc_penalty
never entered the loss) and (b) a true negative control with noise
floor / E3 diversity / entropy bonus OFF in the D2 arm (610e's
control was confounded by MECH-313/MECH-341/entropy-bonus always-on
in BOTH arms, so D2 never showed the collapse a valid negative
control requires). A run reproducing any of these five defects is
NOT a fresh test of the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: once the pre-window F-attenuation is built and
a genuinely-trained policy is tested with a valid (collapsing) D2
negative control under Phase-3 destabilising pressure (SD-047/SD-048
multi-source dynamics + accelerated env_drift, already implemented
2026-06-01 IGW-20260601-023): the D2 control arm (no
crystallization/no open-phase gating) shows entropy COLLAPSE (delta
>= +0.10) under post-Phase-3 pressure, while the D1 arm (MECH-333
open-phase gating + MECH-334 closure) PRESERVES Phase-2 diversity.
FALSIFYING: even with a genuine training regime, a valid collapsing
negative control, and the pre-window F-attenuation actually built,
D1 (open-phase-gated) shows the SAME entropy collapse as D2
(ungated) under Phase-3 pressure -- the open-phase mechanism buys
nothing over ordinary training, falsifying the "temporary inversion
of the normal operating ratio" framing. The implementation-option
question (Q-052: which of learning-rate scheduling / magnitude
rescaling / gradient blocking / PV-analog penalty / plasticity
injection is the right computational form) is a SEPARATE open
question this wwa does not resolve.

MECH-334.subject: learning.developmental_critical_period_closure_crystallization
MECH-334.title: Critical period closure / crystallization: once diversity circuits establish competitive weight during the MECH-333 open window, a complementary closure mechanism reduces plasticity for the crystallized diversity distribution while restoring full dominant-pathway update scale; without closure, diversity representations remain equally vulnerable to gradient-driven overwriting throughout all subsequent training.

MECH-335.subject: basal_ganglia.staggered_commitment_loop_calibration_windows
MECH-335.title: Staggered ventral->dorsal commitment-loop calibration windows: the three commitment loops do not share a single critical period. Their calibration windows are staggered ventral->dorsal -- the limbic/value loop (ventral striatum / OFC) opens earliest and is the most environmentally sensitive, the associative loop next, the sensorimotor loop last -- with region-specific consolidation latencies (a calibration can be induced during a window but only expressed after it closes).

MECH-336.subject: development.maladaptive_commitment_lock_failure_mode
MECH-336.title: Maladaptive-lock failure mode (personality-pathology analog): adequate environmental input does NOT determine the locked calibration value. A stable subset of agents locks a maladaptive commitment-loop configuration despite sufficient input (lock-onto-bad-calibration), and failure to lock at all yields an unstable / diffuse commitment policy. These are the REE substrate of personality-disorder-analog failure modes: lock-too-early / lock-onto-bad-value (rigid maladaptive personality) and failure-to-lock (identity diffusion).

MECH-337.subject: rule_apprehension.caregiver_scaffolded_rule_population
MECH-337.title: Caregiver-scaffolded rule-population mechanism (the 'in' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). A caregiver / teacher agent structures the agent's exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding) and marks regularities ostensively (Csibra & Gergely natural pedagogy); the marked regularity is written into the ARC-063 CandidateRule field as a candidate the agent could not have invented alone, tagged with the scaffolding context. Population is context-bound by construction -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'context-bound rule population'. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and a caregiver-agent substrate that does not exist in V3.

MECH-338.subject: rule_apprehension.cue_driven_context_bound_rule_retrieval
MECH-338.title: Cue-driven context-bound rule retrieval (the 'cue pipeline' / 'select' face of the ARC-063 CandidateRule field). Environmental or internal cues are matched against CandidateRule context tags to gate rollout-eligibility: a rule populated in a context becomes available again when that context, or a cue associated with it, recurs (context-dependent / cued recall; Tulving & Thomson encoding-specificity; Godden & Baddeley context-dependent memory). This is the retrieval pay-off of context-bound population (MECH-337) and the access gate that decides which CandidateRules enter hippocampal rollout. Child of ARC-077. Structural slot only; hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull.

MECH-339.subject: hippocampal.composite_retrieval_cue_outshining_gate
MECH-339.title: Composite retrieval cue: the ghost-bank cue is z_goal plus a context channel composed from the already-preserved-but-match-unused SD-039 payload fields (arousal_tag, last_vs, cause), combined by an outshining gate so a strong direct z_goal match suppresses the context channel. Context-cue retrieval is the conditional fallback regime, not an always-on additive term.

MECH-340.subject: hippocampal.persistence_efficacy_gate
MECH-340.title: The persistence/efficacy gate: a control/efficacy-detection signal that maintains an unresolved-goal bank entry as an active MECH-293 re-probe target. Its ABSENCE is the default (the entry stops being re-probed and decays in MECH-292 rank; the SD-039 trace is NOT erased). It is gated ON by an unattainability-negative / control-positive appraisal, NOT by accumulated failure, repeated suppression, bare effort-cost, or staleness.

MECH-341.subject: ethics_engine_3.scoring_trajectory_class_diversity_preservation
MECH-341.title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

MECH-342.subject: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release
MECH-342.title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).

MECH-343.subject: control_plane.difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy
MECH-343.title: difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

MECH-344.subject: incentive.benefit_object_identity_binding
MECH-344.title: Benefit-to-object-identity binding (L2): at resource contact the benefit pulse is bound to the contacted object's identity (the SD-049 per-type tag) via an associative object->benefit node, rather than written as a raw scalar gate against the current world/resource latent. The amygdala/BLA-analog identity-binding node the legacy substrate lacked (cue_features was a V3 no-op stub).

MECH-345.subject: incentive.per_object_wanting_token
MECH-345.title: Per-object incentive-salience token (L3): each resource identity accrues a slowly-decaying, revaluable base incentive value plus a stored identity embedding; wanting amplitude at recall = base_value * (1 + kappa * drive), with the drive multiplier relocated from the seeding gate onto the stored per-object value and computed per-axis so wanting is drive-specific / identity-matched (specific PIT).

MECH-346.subject: incentive.z_goal_from_token_pointer
MECH-346.title: z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.

MECH-347.subject: incentive.cue_triggered_wanting
MECH-347.title: Cue-triggered wanting / cue-recall (L6): a PERCEIVED cue/object type (with no benefit pulse) retrieves its SD-057 incentive token and nudges z_goal toward that object's stored identity embedding BEFORE consumption -- identity-matched (pulls toward the perceived cue's object) and drive-specific (amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)). The downstream E3 goal_proximity + MECH-295 approach bridge then raise pre-consummatory approach toward the cued object. Distinct from the benefit-driven seed: no benefit pulse, no token revaluation, weaker (cue_recall_gain) pull.

MECH-348.subject: incentive.dacc_object_discriminative_readout
MECH-348.title: dACC object-discriminative goal readout (L7): the dACC adaptive-control consumer reads per-candidate goal_proximity to the (SD-057 object-bound) z_goal, so its effort/value computation becomes object-discriminative -- approach_commit is goal-conditioned rather than z_goal-blind. Resolves the 2026-06-04 L7 audit finding that only E3 goal_proximity read z_goal consequentially and dACC was blind.

MECH-349.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.mint
MECH-349.title: CandidateRule mint (ARC-063 CREATE face): a non-gradient structural event mints a distinct CandidateRule slot when a (context-bucket -> action-object) regularity recurs above threshold and no existing rule's context_tag already covers it. The literal MECH-309 answer -- the creator that 'invents' rules so that credit only 'weights' them. Bottom-up (ARC-064 regularity detection) primary; optional top-down ARC-062 discriminator seed.

MECH-350.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.subspace_partitioned_representation
MECH-350.title: CandidateRule field representation (ARC-063 REPRESENT face): the field holds K candidate rules as a population of distinct pinned subspace directions, so distinct minted rules occupy distinct directions and the rule_state handed to SD-033a is differentiated by construction. The architectural answer to why two shared-gradient scalar heads collapse (598b) but a minted field does not -- separability is structural, not an equilibrium gradient must find.

MECH-351.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.tolerance_gated_availability
MECH-351.title: CandidateRule tolerance gate (ARC-063 GATE face): a candidate rule becomes AVAILABLE (eligible to enter the active rule_state) only when its availability clears a threshold that RISES with the number of competing context-matched rules. The conflict-graded 'hold your horses' dynamic threshold; availability (which rules enter the active set) is distinct from selection (which action E3 picks among available rules' biases).

MECH-352.subject: policy.candidate_rule_field.eligibility_trace_credit
MECH-352.title: CandidateRule eligibility-trace credit (ARC-063 CREDIT face): each rule active when an action was taken leaves a decaying eligibility trace; the subsequent outcome/PE updates the rule's availability (raise on success, lower on exception), recency-weighted, with slow availability decay and retire-below-floor. The 'weight' half of mint-then-weight -- credit refines an existing rule's availability, it does not create rules.

MECH-353.subject: affect.blocked_agency_control_failure_stream
MECH-353.title: Blocked-agency / control-failure affect stream (z_block): an integrated readout on the SD-029 agency comparator applied to the action-outcome channel. z_block rises when an intended action repeatedly fails to produce its forward-model-predicted outcome (MECH-112 z_goal supplies the expectation), the mismatch is attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint (not own motor error), AND goal/capacity-belief is RETAINED. It is a distinct affect stream from harm (SD-011: no noxious input required), from suffering (SD-019b/Q-036: OPPOSITE controllability pole -- capacity-retained drives ASSERT, capacity-collapsed drives WITHDRAW), from residue (MECH-056: action-prevented, not action-taken-at-cost), and from licit commitment-hold (MECH-090: externally-imposed block, not self-imposed gate).

MECH-354.subject: affect.fatigue_stop_recover_homeostatic_accumulator
MECH-354.title: Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

MECH-355.subject: affect.soothing_comfort_autonomic_state_gain_modulator
MECH-355.title: Soothing/comfort autonomic state-gain modulator: a present-tense down-regulation of the ONGOING aversive/stress state (lowers the gain or speeds the recovery of the active trajectory), canonically socially gated (conspecific buffering; oxytocinergic + parasympathetic/HPA + prefrontal regulation). Proposed home is a modulator on MECH-219 (suffering accumulator) decay + SD-012 (drive) + SD-032e (pACC autonomic coupling). Distinct from relief (MECH-302: past-offset phasic reinforcer), from safety (MECH-303/304: future inhibitory predictor), and from wanting (MECH-112: appetite): soothing acts on the present stress trajectory via autonomic state-gain, not reinforcement, prediction, or appetite. V4-social (the canonical trigger is an other-agent, which V3 cannot represent); an optional V3-minimal non-social autonomic-recovery hook is noted but not built.

MECH-356.subject: affect.endogenous_parasympathetic_recovery_autonomic_rebound
MECH-356.title: Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

MECH-357.subject: prefrontal.infralimbic_freeze_suppression_avoidance_gate
MECH-357.title: Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).

MECH-358.subject: prefrontal.relief_safety_escape_affordance_bridge
MECH-358.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

MECH-359.subject: affect.candidate_differentiated_gradient
MECH-359.title: Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.

MECH-360.subject: expression.action_geometry_emergent_readout
MECH-360.title: Affective expression begins as emergent action geometry: because candidate-differentiated affect (MECH-359) selects trajectories, it also shapes the visible STYLE of behaviour -- hesitation, latency, approach angle, retreat, repeated retry, stopping, resumption, oscillation between candidates, avoidance margin, decommitment, repair-seeking. Expression is therefore initially an emergent readout of candidate-level affective arbitration, not a separately-engineered output channel; a later social agent can infer internal state from HOW an action occurred, not only what action occurred.

MECH-361.subject: memory.candidate_gradient_episode_schema
MECH-361.title: Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.

MECH-362.subject: development.subtractive_sparsification
MECH-362.title: Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

MECH-363.subject: cognifold.long_range_competition_stability
MECH-363.title: Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

MECH-364.subject: respiratory.laughter_load_release_regime_boundary
MECH-364.title: Laughter discharges accumulated E3 conflict/constraint load and thereby marks a safe inter-regime control-plane transition: beyond the per-cycle hypothesis-tag clear (MECH-110), iterated safe-confirmation produces a regime-level drop in active constraint pressure that releases the system from a threat-vigilant/high-commitment regime into an exploratory/play regime -- making laughter a boundary signal between control-plane regimes (ARC-016), not merely reward expression.

MECH-365.subject: memory.provenance_bearing_event_token
MECH-365.title: Provenance-bearing event token: every autobiographical event token carries an explicit provenance/commitment-status structure -- event_token = {time, place, self_state, other_agents, perspective, affect, residue, source_status, committed_vs_imagined} -- and a ONE-WAY gate ensures imagined / simulated future tokens can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status. The scarce resource in mental time travel is not capacity but provenance: any path that lets a simulated event accrue committed weight is a confabulation bug.

MECH-366.subject: memory.episodic_perspective_tag
MECH-366.title: Switchable episodic perspective tag: autobiographical event tokens carry a viewpoint label (participant / first-person vs observer / third-person) and can be re-experienced or re-simulated from either viewpoint at retrieval time, independent of the viewpoint at encoding. Perspective is a represented, switchable property of the episode, not a fixed encoding artefact.

MECH-367.subject: failure_modes.depressive_network_regime_vector
MECH-367.title: The depressive failure mode is carried by a multi-axis network-regime VECTOR, not a scalar low-mood/low-reward value: depressive_regime_risk = f(future_trajectory_access, goal_stream_coupling, residue_load/self_weighting, rumination_loop_gain, action_threshold/energy_budget, social_affordance_access, offline_repair_quality). The depressive state is defined by the JOINT configuration of these coupling/access axes and is self-maintaining; scalar mood/reward is an insufficient representation.

MECH-368.subject: plasticity.event_level_write_authority_gate
MECH-368.title: Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

MECH-369.subject: compulsion.slow_modulatory_loop_stickiness
MECH-369.title: Slow substrate-state modulator with authority over compulsive-loop stickiness: a slowly-varying, broadly-projecting modulatory state can bias the decommit-friction / commitment-threshold / action-release landscape so that certain action loops become sticky, urgent, or hard to release INDEPENDENTLY of represented goal value or fast prediction-error -- i.e. a compulsive loop can arise from field-state bias rather than from an endorsed reward, valued goal, or false belief. The modulator changes the release/threshold landscape, not the value estimate.

MECH-370.subject: compulsion.composite_risk_readout
MECH-370.title: Composed compulsion-risk readout: compulsive vulnerability is best modelled not as a single scalar (reward, habit strength, or belief) but as a composition compulsion_risk = f(loop_reinforcement, threat_salience, residue_persistence, decommit_friction, slow_modulatory_state) over quantities REE already represents separately -- a multi-layer state in which the substrate can make certain loops difficult to release even when any single term looks benign.

MECH-371.subject: failure_modes.global_instability_control_plane_vulnerability_axis
MECH-371.title: A global-instability / broad control-plane vulnerability axis (a p-factor / general-psychopathology-factor analogue) loads across ALL failure modes: a single broad dimension of control-plane regulatory fragility -- instability in precision/gain/threshold setpoint regulation (ARC-005) rather than any one specific comparator or stream -- raises joint susceptibility to multiple failure modes at once, distinct from and orthogonal to any single-axis failure. This is the axis with no existing REE home; it predicts that a subset of agents/patients carry elevated risk across the whole failure-mode space rather than along one axis.

MECH-372.subject: perception.modality_heterogeneity_adaptor_depth
MECH-372.title: Modality-heterogeneity / adaptor-depth gradient: senses differ in how much transformation they need before world-model entry -- smell is a near-raw gradient primitive, sight needs a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor; gradient-like (low-adaptor-depth) senses enter earliest developmentally.

MECH-373.subject: language.affect_adaptor_uncertain_hypothesis
MECH-373.title: A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

MECH-374.subject: cognifold.memristive_physical_substrate_candidate
MECH-374.title: Memristive deformation as the physical analogue of residue/cognifold curvature: spintronic-memristive media (magnetic tunnel junctions, nanomagnet ensembles, domain walls, topological spin textures, spin waves / spin-Hall nano-oscillators) are physical substrates in which past activity alters future state-transition behaviour -- making 'residue is not merely stored memory but deformation of the future action landscape' physically literal in a way von Neumann computation does not. They are a candidate post-V5 physical cognifold substrate because they combine persistent state, history-dependent deformation, oscillatory dynamics, stochastic switching, attractor-like state-space trajectories, and possible low-power embodied operation in one medium.

MECH-375.subject: relief.trainable_relief_critic
MECH-375.title: Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

MECH-376.subject: safety_prediction.trainable_safety_predictor
MECH-376.title: Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

MECH-380.subject: cognitive_control.private_speech_externalised_scaffold
MECH-380.title: Private speech is the external phase of a cognitive-control system: overt self-narration regulates attention, action, affect, and task sequence as an inspectable control surface, and the Vygotskian internalisation ladder (other-regulation -> overt self-regulation -> inner speech -> compressed control) is the developmental route by which that external control surface becomes internal.

MECH-381.subject: development.externalise_internalise_compression_ladder
MECH-381.title: Developmental compression ladder: sensorimotor exploration -> play/simulation -> self-narration -> compressed internal control -> mature arbitration. External cognitive scaffolds (play, private speech) compress into internal control over development; the externalise-then-internalise compression is the developmental mechanism, distinct from the progression of play types.

MECH-382.subject: arbitration.self_distancing_reframe_operator
MECH-382.title: Distancing operator: reframing a sticky, high-conflict, self-referential state from first-person ('I am failing') into a model-like system-state or third-person frame ('REE is encountering unresolved prediction-error pressure under current constraints') reduces self-referential collapse and increases model-based inspection during arbitration.

MECH-383.subject: perception.label_as_topdown_control_signal
MECH-383.title: Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

MECH-384.subject: observability.self_narration_trace_scaffold
MECH-384.title: Lightweight self-narration trace/debug scaffold: an optional traceable field set (state_label, goal_label, sensed_gradient, active_prediction, uncertainty_level, candidate_action, candidate_action_reason, expected_consequence, affective_pressure, conflict_flag, commitment_threshold, stop_condition, simulation_or_commitment, self_reference_frame) that surfaces REE's working state for inspection -- the V3-compatible reduced form of an externalised 'private speech' surface, before it is compressed into internal control.

MECH-385.subject: inference.belief_state_hypothesis_set
MECH-385.title: Belief-state hypothesis set: when observations are ambiguous or incomplete, REE maintains a bounded set of competing latent-state hypotheses, each carrying confidence/precision, predicted transitions, goal/antigoal relations, and uncertainty; E3 evaluates candidate trajectories over the hypothesis set rather than over a single collapsed state.

MECH-386.subject: inference.inferred_affordance_field
MECH-386.title: Inferred affordance field: REE can infer affordances not directly perceived by combining current cues, hippocampal traces, E2 action-consequence predictions, CandidateRuleField content, affective gradients, and control-plane precision; these inferred affordances bias E3 candidate trajectories without overwriting perception and remain corrigible by action outcome.

MECH-387.subject: inference.safety_route_inference
MECH-387.title: Safety-route inference: under threat, REE can infer a likely route to safety from partial map, cue, gradient, and prior-trajectory evidence rather than requiring safety to be directly visible or navigation-handed; generalises the scalar per-action-class escape credit of SD-059/MECH-358 into an inferred route.

MECH-388.subject: inference.epistemic_action_pressure
MECH-388.title: Epistemic action pressure: when goal success or harm avoidance depends on hidden state, REE can assign action pressure to information-gathering transitions that reduce uncertainty, even when those actions are not immediately reward-maximising or harm-minimising; generalises Q-044 curiosity into a survival-relevant viability function under partial observability.

MECH-389.subject: goal.interrupted_task_resumption_parked_slot
MECH-389.title: Interrupted-task resumption: a parked-goal persistence + capacity-keyed re-prioritisation mechanism that closes the event-arc interrupt->reorient->resume span. When a task is interrupted (hazard, capacity loss, higher-priority goal), its goal slot is PARKED (z_goal + progress context retained, not invalidated) rather than discarded; the parked slot carries a persistence/urgency signal (Zeigarnik-analog) that re-elevates its relative importance in the SD-033e/MECH-265 arbitrator when capacity returns, triggering reorient-and-resume rather than restart-from-scratch.

MECH-390.subject: affect.developmental_sparsification_of_affect_vector
MECH-390.title: Subtractive developmental sparsification applies to the affect vector: mature candidate-differentiated affect arbitration (MECH-359) and the candidate-gradient episode store (MECH-361) reach their mature form by pruning an initially over-connected, dense affect/channel substrate, such that mature affect-driven selection requires convergent summation of several weak affective channels rather than a single strong dominant channel.

MECH-391.subject: memory.allocation.gate_policy
MECH-391.title: Contextual memory-allocation gate policy: a control-plane decision stage (context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction, schema_fit, salience, PE, uncertainty, goal_relevance) selecting integrate / partial_overlap / separate over the hippocampal graph.

MECH-392.subject: memory.consolidation.provenance_required
MECH-392.title: Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

MECH-393.subject: memory.retrieval.scope_vs_authority
MECH-393.title: Retrieval-scope vs action-authority split: retrieval for reflection is distinct from retrieval that confers action authority; a consolidated abstraction lacking source-episode grounding may inform reflection but not unilaterally drive committed action.

MECH-394.subject: drive.multidrive_arbitration
MECH-394.title: Multidrive arbitration policy: when several drive axes are simultaneously active, behaviour is selected by a soft-competitive orchestration over context, per-axis satiation, inter-drive competition, and developmental phase -- not a fixed priority or single-axis winner.

MECH-395.subject: drive.pre_approach_orienting_mode
MECH-395.title: Pre-approach orienting/surveying mode: a cue-triggered, need-gated active-sensing control state entered when a cue/need is present but directional/affordance confidence is too low for reliable approach; it samples gradients (turn/scan, exploratory arcs) until a directional vector stabilises, then exits to approach.

MECH-396.subject: perception.cross_modal_negotiation_currency
MECH-396.title: Cross-modal negotiation currency: a common precision-weighted representation that makes structurally dissimilar sense-specific geometries (smell gradient, sight manifold, touch boundary/contact, hearing temporal-source, proprioception body-state) mutually negotiable inside one shared world model.

MECH-397.subject: developmental.adaptor_maturity_admission_gate
MECH-397.title: Adaptor-maturity curriculum gate: each sense is admitted to the shared world model when its modality-specific adaptor is mature, ordered by adaptor depth (low-adaptor gradient senses first, deep-adaptor manifold senses later), specialising the staged developmental curriculum.

MECH-398.subject: learning.ach_analog_plasticity_gain_gate
MECH-398.title: ACh-analog basal-forebrain plasticity-gain gate: a state-conditional scalar in [0,1] multiplying cortical encoder learning rates and residue write magnitudes, driven by novelty/attention/arousal, distinct from LC-NE/5-HT/orexin content signals.

MECH-399.subject: learning.pv_analog_window_closure_clock
MECH-399.title: PV-interneuron inhibitory-maturation analog: a time-since-onset accumulator that monotonically lowers the plasticity-gain ceiling, replacing the current binary critical-period phase transition.

MECH-400.subject: learning.bdnf_analog_window_duration_knob
MECH-400.title: BDNF-analog trophic window-duration scalar: a duration multiplier on top of the plasticity-gain gate and closure clock.

MECH-401.subject: memory.consolidation.gated_write_authority
MECH-401.title: Consolidation gated-write-authority: over-frequent rewriting of consolidated memory is a failure mode; the consolidation operator's authority to overwrite is gated by schema-stability / schedule-sensitivity, not run after every interaction.

MECH-402.subject: ethics.axiom_conflict_residue_comparator
MECH-402.title: Axiom conflict (self vs other) is resolved by a context-sensitive comparator plus a persisting moral-residue mechanism, not a fixed self/other priority.

MECH-403.subject: ethics.unshared_suffering_harm_channel
MECH-403.title: Unshared suffering (loneliness) is represented as a distinct architectural harm channel, derivable from Axiom 5 (love exists / INV-029) and measurable only against present-or-absent others.

MECH-404.subject: social.mirror_coupling_gain_homeostasis
MECH-404.title: Mirror-coupling gain must be homeostatically regulated inside an operating window; the three social pathologies are its boundaries (low gain = psychopathy/callousness, high gain = empathic overwhelm/paralysis, miscalibrated = burnout/moral injury).

MECH-405.subject: social.fast_empathy_stream_binding_mechanism
MECH-405.title: Fast empathy mechanism: other-bound affect is produced by routing the agent's OWN motivational-affective streams (SD-011 suffering, MECH-112 wanting, etc.) through a stable other-model slot -- e.g. other-bound suffering = suffering stream + other-model binding; MECH-183 z_beta leakage is one such attribution-gated binding.

MECH-406.subject: social.prediction_reciprocity_repair_dissociation
MECH-406.title: Other-model prediction, reciprocity reward, and residue-aware social commitment are three separable functions: an agent can predict cooperative intent without binding it into commitment-altering value, and can value reciprocity without generating repair-residue after exploitation (the A/B/C/D dissociation).

MECH-407.subject: social.residue_aware_repair_goal
MECH-407.title: Residue-aware social repair: exploiting a cooperating other leaves a persisting regret-residue that spawns a self-state repair-goal (restore commitment/relationship coherence), distinguishing genuine prosocial commitment from mere reciprocity bookkeeping.

MECH-408.subject: social.other_bound_stream_developmental_order
MECH-408.title: Developmental ordering of other-bound streams: other-bound suffering/threat (protective) come online BEFORE other-bound liking/wanting (appetitive), because early positive other-reward is destabilising and exploitable -- a safety-relevant maturational ordering on the ARC-059 social spine.

MECH-409.subject: coherence.relational_harm_qualifier
MECH-409.title: Harm-to-agency moral weighting requires a consent / incidental-vs-constitutive qualifier: a raw goal-interference signal becomes a harm signal only when the obstruction is non-consented and constitutively (not incidentally) defeats the other agent's goal.

MECH-410.subject: love.self_like_weight_calibration
MECH-410.title: Self-like gradient weighting (MECH-164) requires a developmental calibration schedule: other-terrain coupling must tighten over development scaled by inferred-terrain confidence, between the failure poles of empathic collapse (too-strong, too-early) and callousness (too-weak), and never weight a badly-inferred terrain self-like.

MECH-411.subject: e3.repair_trajectory_generation
MECH-411.title: After self-attributed harm, E3 generates repair trajectories and compares them against avoidance, concealment, and ordinary goal-continuation.

MECH-412.subject: residue.repair_completion_release
MECH-412.title: Repair completion or impossibility transforms active guilt-like residue into bounded historical memory.

MECH-413.subject: development.correction_without_self_valence_collapse
MECH-413.title: Correction without annihilation: caregiver/social correction must update rule/harm/residue models without global self-valence collapse; the agent must separate 'I erred' from 'I am unloveable / must appease / must self-erase'.

MECH-414.subject: development.love_mediated_repair
MECH-414.title: Love-mediated repair after harm: repair must be mediated by harm-recognition AND preserved loveability so it is relationship-restoration plus responsibility-integration, not punishment-avoidance, appeasement, self-erasure, control, or metric-optimisation.

MECH-415.subject: language.predicate_argument_event_rule_bridge
MECH-415.title: Predicate-argument-event rule bridge: a V6 grammar-facing layer renders ARC-063 CandidateRule structures as 'if context, then action-object, causing outcome, unless exception' -- naming, querying, and recombining pre-linguistic rules without making language the rule substrate. Predicate-argument-event structure is the same context->action-object->outcome shape ARC-063 already mints; the 'unless/except/but' exception grammar is a shadow of ARC-063 tolerance-gated availability.

MECH-416.subject: language.frame_inventory_substrate_bound
MECH-416.title: REE frame inventory: a small extensible V5/V6 inventory of scene-frames (feeding, hazard, contact, interruption, help-harm, give-receive, request-response, belief-report, error-correction) where each frame binds to REE substrates, not to words. Frame semantics (Fillmore): a word evokes a whole scene; in REE each frame is a scene-schema over rule structures, the second mining artifact after the grammar->substrate table.

MECH-417.subject: language.aspect_event_arc_closure_map
MECH-417.title: Grammatical aspect is a map of REE's event arc and post-commit closure: starting/ongoing/repeated/interrupted/resumed/completed/failed/abandoned aspect is a grammatical naming of the pre-linguistic ActionEventArc and closure machinery, not a replacement for it. Event Segmentation Theory: experience segments around prediction error and event boundaries, overlapping REE's contact/interruption/closure/transition needs.

MECH-418.subject: language.affect_prior_feeds_empathy_binding
MECH-418.title: Language-parsed other-affect feeds the empathy stream-binding layer as ONE evidence source: the affect prior recovered from language by the LanguageAffectAdaptor (MECH-373) is fused with non-linguistic evidence (behaviour, expression, context) by the existing V5 empathy stream-binding layer, NOT as a parallel or dominant affect-attribution path. The wiring/fusion commitment between the adaptor output and the empathy layer.

MECH-419.subject: reasoning.compositional_generalisation_over_named_symbols
MECH-419.title: Compositional generalisation over named symbols: the agent systematically recombines grounded, named primitives (object/action/property/relation symbols) into novel combinations never directly experienced, via the symbol/grammar layer rather than the substrate. Compositionality is mined from grounded substrate, not imported as transformer attention.

MECH-420.subject: reasoning.relational_propositional_inference_over_symbols
MECH-420.title: Relational/propositional inference over named relations: transitive inference, role-binding (giver vs receiver), and proposition chaining are realised as theta-sequence traversal (MECH-300) of a SYMBOLIC/type-graph cognitive map whose nodes are named symbols. The V6 realisation of MECH-300's cognitive-map-traversal primitive over a named symbolic map.

MECH-421.subject: reasoning.analogy_structure_mapping_across_domains
MECH-421.title: Analogy as relational structure-mapping across grounded domains (Gentner): map relational structure from source to target regardless of surface features (spatial containment <-> social inclusion; physical support <-> commitment). The capstone symbolic capacity; first tested as emergent from the compositional + relational stack before any dedicated analogy module is built.

MECH-422.subject: language.event_arc_grammatical_realisation
MECH-422.title: Event-arc grammatical realisation: grammatical tense/aspect/connectives (because, but, unless, done, again, stop, resume) are the symbolic rendering of the pre-linguistic ActionEventArc (initiate/persist/interrupt/reorient/resume/close). 'unless' = ARC-063 exception gate; 'because' = causal link; 'again/done' = aspect over closure. The action arc must EXIST (V3..V5) before grammar can name it.

MECH-423.subject: integration.cross_model_super_additivity
MECH-423.title: Cross-model super-additivity: integrating predictive models over a shared latent yields capability gains that EXCEED the sum of the isolated models, because shared features let each model's prediction-error corrections propagate to the others. Integrated (E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model [+ object spine]) beats a param/compute-matched bag of isolated modules -- the 'cross-pollination turbo-charges development' claim, made falsifiable.
MECH-423.what_would_answer: V3 ablation. ARM INTEGRATED: E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model (and, in a third arm, the object spine) trained over a SHARED L-space latent with cross-module gradient flow. ARM ISOLATED: parameter- and compute-matched modules trained with NO shared features (gradient stop between streams). PASS = joint world-model R2 + affordance accuracy of the integrated arm EXCEEDS the additive baseline (sum of each isolated module's marginal gain) by a pre-registered margin. FAIL = integrated arm at-or-below the additive baseline. READINESS PRECONDITION (the discriminating non-degeneracy gate, per Daniel 2026-06-12): the integration machinery must demonstrably be doing cross-module work before the test means anything -- (i) the shared latent must carry NON-ZERO cross-module gradient (measured), (ii) the inference loop must be running to convergence, and (iii) offline/consolidation transfer (DMN-analogue + sleep replay, MECH-121) must be active and moving traces across modules. Below any of these the integrated and isolated arms are indistinguishable by construction and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready (check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false), NOT a FAIL. The concrete readiness metric/threshold is to be set by a pending literature pull on which integration prerequisites are necessary for super-additive gain.

MECH-424.subject: language.prediction_as_corrective_instantiating_stream
MECH-424.title: Language prediction as a corrective / instantiating predictive stream: when language is modelled as an externalisation of internal cognition, predicting language inside the integrated substrate can INSTANTIATE cognitive structures not gained sensorimotorically, and can CORRECT or DEGRADE existing structures as a function of the language's quality. The bidirectional clause (good language repairs structure; bad language corrupts it) is the discriminating edge over language-as-scaffold.
MECH-424.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL -- requires a linguistic input channel REE-v3 does not have (the V6 language interface: ARC-009 realisation / MECH-373 / MECH-422). Once that channel exists: an agent with a language-prediction head trained over a corpus encoding CORRECT task structure acquires or repairs a behaviourally-measured cognitive structure that a matched no-language control does NOT (instantiate / correct leg = PASS); AND an agent trained over a corpus encoding WRONG structure has that structure DEGRADED relative to the no-language control (worsen leg = PASS). Both legs required: the bidirectional dependence on language quality is the discriminating prediction. UNMET PRECONDITION: no linguistic channel in V3, so the claim self-routes substrate_not_ready until the V6 language layer is built; the non-degeneracy gate additionally requires the measured structure to be live (non-floor) in the no-language control so 'correct' and 'worsen' are both reachable directions.

MECH-425.subject: memory.retrieval_time_accessibility_gating
MECH-425.title: Retrieval-time accessibility gating: which stored traces become reinstatable at a given moment is set by two composable READ-side policy layers, not by storage alone. Line A -- a global, slowly-fluctuating, arousal-coupled reinstatement GAIN (content-blind; sets the threshold on whether ANY stored trace crosses into accessibility; stochastic-resonance flavour). Line B -- a content-selective competitive SUPPRESSION that, given what the global gate admits, inhibits specific competitors to keep retrieval clean. The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.
MECH-425.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL -- REE-v3 has no explicit retrieval-readiness gain knob and no content-selective retrieval-suppression operator over episodic / ContextMemory read-out (the gates exist for WRITE, MECH-261; the read-time POLICY does not). Once a retrieval substrate exposes (i) a global scalar gain on trace reinstatement and (ii) a competitor-suppression operator: DISSOCIATION test -- lesioning Line A (clamp gain low) reduces reinstatement of ALL traces uniformly (apparent forgetting, content-blind), while lesioning Line B (disable competitive suppression) leaves gain intact but RAISES competitor intrusions / wrong-trace reinstatement (interference, content-selective). PASS = the two lesions produce mechanistically distinct, doubly-dissociable read-out signatures (uniform-suppression vs selective-intrusion); FAIL = a single knob reproduces both, i.e. the two layers are not separable on this substrate. NON-DEGENERACY GATE: the reinstatement-accuracy metric must be live (non-floor, non-ceiling cross-trace variance) and at least two competing traces must be co-encoded and individually scorable in the no-lesion control, else neither 'uniform forgetting' nor 'selective intrusion' is reachable and the run self-routes substrate_not_ready (check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false), NOT a verdict.

MECH-426.subject: goal.progress_velocity_maintenance
MECH-426.title: progress_velocity_maintenance
MECH-426.what_would_answer: Ablate the rate-of-progress (velocity) signal while holding the proxy-wanting landscape and the goal representation intact; long-horizon superordinate-goal maintenance degrades SPECIFICALLY in the sparse-confirmation regime (completion rate / commitment-persistence drops vs the velocity-intact arm), and the effect is absent in the dense-confirmation regime where velocity adds no information. NON-DEGENERACY: the velocity signal must have non-zero cross-condition RANGE (not magnitude-only / range-zero -- the V3-EXQ-643 "affect must be candidate- differentiated" lesson); a range-zero velocity self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. PASS/FAIL read in the effort-regulation (coasting) direction, NOT as same-goal reinforcement.

MECH-427.subject: goal.cross_level_subgoal_credit
MECH-427.title: cross_level_subgoal_credit
MECH-427.what_would_answer: A discrete subgoal-attainment event raises measured commitment to the PARENT superordinate goal (parent z_goal norm / persistence) above a matched no-subgoal-attainment control on the same trajectory; the bare distal goal alone shows no such lift. NON-DEGENERACY: subgoals must actually be attained at a NON-ZERO rate in the run (else there is nothing to credit -- the goal_pipeline GAP-2 foraging/benefit-contact-ceiling trap; a zero-attainment run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a FAIL). FAIL = subgoal attainment produces no parent commitment lift despite a non-zero attainment rate.

MECH-428.subject: goal.subgoal_bootstrapped_seeding
MECH-428.title: subgoal_bootstrapped_goal_seeding
MECH-428.what_would_answer: In a regime where DIRECT superordinate-goal seeding is sparse (unscaffolded z_goal seeding fails -- z_goal_norm stays < 0.1, the GAP-2 condition), enabling subgoal-attainment + cross-level credit (MECH-427) BOOTSTRAPS a structured z_goal attractor (z_goal_norm rises materially above the unscaffolded baseline, toward the 626b forced-seed reference) and produces goal-directed behaviour the no-subgoal control does not. NON-DEGENERACY: subgoals must be ATTAINED at a non-zero rate AND the 626b-style forced-seed positive control must itself show a structured z_goal in the SAME harness [else the substrate, not bootstrapping, is what fails -> self-routes substrate_not_ready, NOT a FAIL -- the GAP-2 foraging-ceiling trap]. FAIL = subgoal attainment produces no z_goal seeding above the unscaffolded baseline despite non-zero attainment and a working forced-seed control.

MECH-429.subject: memory.schema_congruence_consolidation_weight
MECH-429.title: Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

MECH-430.subject: memory.multidimensional_provenance_vector
MECH-430.title: Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.

MECH-431.subject: plasticity.tag_and_capture_two_factor_eligibility
MECH-431.title: Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

MECH-432.subject: pfc.dacc_fpc_reciprocal_arbitration_loop
MECH-432.title: dACC<->FPC reciprocal arbitration loop: the switch-to-alternative decision is not computed in one module but emerges from a comparison ACROSS two substrates -- the FPC-analog (SD-033e/MECH-264) carries the counterfactual value of the specific unchosen option, the dACC-analog (SD-032b) carries the environment search-value and expected-value-of-control, and slot-switching (SD-046) is gated by their relative comparison. Neither signal alone drives the switch; the loop does.

MECH-433.subject: neuromod.lc_ne_explore_exploit_gain
MECH-433.title: LC-NE-analog explore/exploit gain control: a value-INDEPENDENT, broadly-projecting tonic/phasic gain signal gates DISENGAGEMENT from the committed course. Phasic gain stabilises current-task exploitation; a tonic-mode shift -- driven by waning task utility monitored in the dACC/value system -- licenses disengagement to explore alternatives, supplying the trigger that MECH-264's value-margin switch alone does not. REE has no NE-analog substrate today; this names the missing modulator.

MECH-434.subject: inference.epistemic_commitment_timing
MECH-434.title: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

MECH-435.subject: drive.arbitration_opportunity_cost_currency
MECH-435.title: Multidrive arbitration is priced in a common opportunity-cost-of-time currency: a global, slowly-varying tonic vigour signal (the long-run average reward rate / opportunity cost of dwelling on the currently-arbitrated drive) supplies the commensurable scale over which otherwise-incommensurable drive axes compete, sitting ABOVE the per-candidate liking-stream score_bias (MECH-295). The currency sets HOW VIGOROUSLY the arbitrated drive is pursued; it does NOT by itself determine WHICH drive wins -- selection additionally requires a per-axis-differentiated benefit gradient, so the global scalar is necessary-but-insufficient for arbitration.

MECH-436.subject: drive.wanting_drive_state_modulation
MECH-436.title: Drive-state modulation of wanting (incentive salience): the homeostatic drive STATE modulates the wanting target and/or intensity dissociably from liking -- the most-wanted object tracks the currently-most-depleted drive axis (incentive-salience amplitude ~ base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)) even when the liking/consummatory target does not. Split from MECH-229 2026-06-16: MECH-229 asserts wanting and liking are dissociable SIGNALS (the object-bound dissociation, established by V3-EXQ-514o); MECH-436 is the distinct, finer claim that wanting is additionally DRIVE-STATE-MODULATED -- the incentive-salience core the 514m/514p/514q lineage kept (in different broken ways) trying to express.
