MECH-436.what_would_answer: A drive-dependence delta mean(WL_drive - WL_nodrive) >= max(k*pstdev(delta), FLOOR), measured where the in-run per-axis drive spread is in the argmax-moving regime (asserted by a recalibrated readiness gate, NOT merely spread > 1e-3), with an overshoot positive control that flips most_wanted and an OFF/bank-disabled control that floors at wanting==liking. First falsifier ALREADY QUEUED: V3-EXQ-514r (overshoot + OFF + recalibrated readiness). Overshoot flips most_wanted => drive CAN carve at adequate magnitude (the 514q delta=0.0 is an env/magnitude artifact -> enrich the V3 env via the SD-049-PHASE-2 differential-depletion / kappa-scaling amend, NOT a weakens); overshoot does NOT flip even at large drive => genuine MECH-436 weakens. 514r is the disambiguator that decides which.

MECH-437.subject: policy.rule_distinguishability_maintenance_operator
MECH-437.title: Rule-pool distinguishability is a MAINTAINED property, not a minting byproduct: keeping the CandidateRuleField pool mutually distinguishable (so co-matching rules remain jointly selectable through the conflict gate) requires a periodic, non-gradient consolidation/refactor operator over the minted pool -- compress and merge near-duplicate rules, retire rules that never reach selection, and re-separate the survivors under a description-length / separability objective -- rather than a reactive affine gate theta(n_matched). The maintained invariant is that mean n_matched stays low enough that theta(n_matched) sits below the availability ceiling.

MECH-438.subject: policy.rule_key_constructive_separability
MECH-438.title: Constructive rule-key separability: minted CandidateRule context keys should be assigned in a quantised / categorical codebook that is separable by construction (a DreamerV3-style discrete latent codebook), bounding the number of rules that co-match any context (n_matched) up front so theta(n_matched) stays below the availability ceiling -- rather than letting overlapping continuous context tags produce unbounded co-match counts that the conflict gate then locks out. The codebook capacity must be large enough to keep genuinely-distinct rules on distinct keys (no key-collapse).

MECH-439.subject: selection.primary_score_variance_monopoly
MECH-439.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.
MECH-439.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (already the pre-registered discriminator in
this claim's own notes): requires F's E3 committed-selection-variance
share to be independently measurable per arm (established baseline:
V3-EXQ-571, F = 88-89% in both plain and full-diversity-stack arms) AND
a selection lever to be tested against BOTH a collapsed-proposer control
and a matched-noise control with non-zero cross-arm variance on
committed-action-class entropy. 11 confirmed substrate_ceiling/
non_contributory autopsies (689a/700/700a-d/709/710/711/713) already
establish that most tested levers (near-tie parametric shortlist/
commit-T combinations, learned cross-loop arbitration, disinhibitory
settling, ascending-gain arbitration -- even a FAIR parity win in 713)
do NOT convert; none of these count as fresh evidence either way per
the confirmed autopsies -- do not re-litigate them.
CONFIRMING signature (this claim's own stated FALSIFIER, restated):
persistent flat committed-action-class entropy under ANY tested
diversity channel WHILE F's E3 variance share stays >0.85 supports the
"F-monopoly caps committed diversity" framing.
FALSIFYING signature (this claim's own stated FALSIFIER, restated): a
selection lever lifts committed-action-class entropy strict-above BOTH
collapsed-proposer and matched-noise controls on >=2/3 seeds WITHOUT
reducing F's E3 variance share -- refutes the F-monopoly framing.
CURRENT STATUS (as of the GOV-CEIL-1 2026-07-09 ceiling-exhaustion
demotion): this claim is a CONTESTED candidate -- the competing NULL
reading (F-dominance is inert / doing no causal work) is carried
CO-EQUALLY, not suppressed. Promotion in either direction is re-gated
on a future positive discrimination on the pending ARC-107
MECH-448/449 basal-ganglia-constitution validation (V3-EXQ-689g) --
this what_would_answer does not resolve the contest, it restates the
claim's own pre-registered discriminator so a future reader does not
need to re-derive it from 11 autopsies of prose.

MECH-440.subject: policy.state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor
MECH-440.title: state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).

MECH-441.subject: curiosity.model_disagreement_directed_signal
MECH-441.title: model_disagreement_directed_curiosity (RND / Plan2Explore analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-314's structured_curiosity_bonus: a PER-CANDIDATE, SELF-ANNEALING intrinsic curiosity signal derived from E2 FORWARD-MODEL DISAGREEMENT (an ensemble / dropout-variance proxy over E2 forward predictions) -- high where the forward model is uncertain, collapsing toward zero as a region is learned -- fed into E3 selection so it PROPAGATES per-candidate to the committed action, unlike the broadcast-novelty EMA channel found non-propagating in V3-EXQ-590a / EXQ-141b. The self-annealing-on-learning-progress property is the non-degeneracy guard against a cross-candidate-flat (degenerate) bonus. External analog: RND (Burda et al. 2018) predictor-error novelty; Plan2Explore (Sekar et al. 2020) ensemble model-disagreement. Maps to MECH-314c learning-progress / MECH-314b uncertainty-driven curiosity.

MECH-442.subject: selection.behavioral_descriptor_committed_selection_archive
MECH-442.title: Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog): the committed E3 selection should draw from a structure that, UPSTREAM of the winner-take-all commit, partitions the eligible candidate set by a behavioral descriptor (first-action / committed-action class / e2.world_forward strategy signature, NOT F-rank) and retains the F-best candidate WITHIN each behavioral niche, then commits by a coverage-aware rule -- so a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to F's single global optimum. The validated V3-EXQ-569i top-k shortlist is the descriptor-free degenerate instance (eligible-set axis = F-rank, near-ties only); MAP-Elites generalizes it to a behavioral-descriptor-indexed eligible-set archive paired with an active variability generator (MECH-313), predicted to convert per-candidate diversity into committed-action diversity more robustly than the thin near-tie shortlist. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it.

MECH-443.subject: policy.arbitration.priority_weighted_replay_write_selection
MECH-443.title: priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.
MECH-443.what_would_answer: SUPPORTS if arming a per-transition update-utility (surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage) priority weight on the admitted replay writes lifts rule-arbitration retention/selectivity -- measured AT rule_state (upstream of the F-dominated E3 commit, in the GAP-K write-gating locus, NOT at committed action) -- STRICTLY above a matched-TOTAL-write-mass uniform-admit control (MECH-319 admit_writes=True with equal write mass) on >=2/3 seeds. FALSIFIES if priority-weighting is inert versus the matched-mass uniform admit, OR if any lift is explained solely by greater total write mass (the matched-mass guard isolates this degenerate confound), OR if priority is operationalized as reward magnitude / committed-policy value rather than value-of-the-update (Carey et al. 2019: hippocampal replay biases AWAY from the currently-preferred outcome, so a reward-keyed priority is biologically falsified). Pre-gate: the readout must be non-degenerate -- if admitted replay barely moves rule_state on the current substrate so the metric is pinned across seeds, the falsifier is vacuous and MECH-443 re-routes to a replay-write-magnitude substrate enrichment (NOT to MECH-439). Any COMMITTED/behavioural variant of this test is MECH-439-conversion-ceiling-gated (V3-EXQ-654g: the rule_state channel cannot move the argmax today and the 569i top-k bypass does not reach it) and is sequenced behind the 689a F-rebalance.

MECH-444.subject: policy.arbitration.staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write
MECH-444.title: staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.
MECH-444.what_would_answer: SUPPORTS if recomputing each admitted replay-write target against the CURRENT model before it updates the rule layer (and down-weighting / skipping low-drift writes) ATTENUATES rule-arbitration drift / overcommitment relative to writing the stored ghost-derived (stale) target -- on the MECH-319 admit_writes=True drift-inducing substrate (the V3-EXQ-628 block-vs-admit divergence), on >=2/3 seeds -- i.e. the 628 divergence shrinks under refreshed-target admit versus stale-target admit. FALSIFIES if the refresh does not attenuate drift versus stale-target writing (the staleness gate is inert), OR if it earns nothing independent of MECH-443's priority weighting (the pair is non-separable). LOAD-BEARING CAVEAT (biology_before_formal_definitions): the staleness-refresh is supported by ANALOGY only -- Mattar & Daw 2018 gain term + Olafsdottir 2015 generative preplay -- with NO recording of a literal recompute-then-write cellular operation; so a null here falsifies the REE engineering import, NOT the underlying replay biology, and a divergence between MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze (explicit value-target recomputation in a learned model) and hippocampal replay (gain-weighted, generative, no measured target-recompute step) is treated as a real design risk, not a caveat. Not testable until MECH-443 is built and keeps AND a target-recompute primitive is scoped (the EMA write path writes targets verbatim today).

MECH-445.subject: governance.closure_beta_coupling
MECH-445.title: Closure->beta coupling engagement: a closure-plane commit (closure fired on a real sequence completion) elevates/binds the MECH-090 bistable latch via the use_closure_commit_beta_coupling path INDEPENDENT of a natural running_variance < commit_threshold commit-entry -- i.e. on seeds where the agent does not naturally commit decisively, the closure still drives a latch elevation the de-commit then acts on. Child A of the SD-034 de-commit-pipeline decomposition (S3).
MECH-445.what_would_answer: REGIME-SCOPED to WEAK-natural-commit seeds (OFF-arm committed_steps ~ 0, where the closure coupling is load-bearing rather than redundant with the F-driven natural commit). SUPPORTED if, on the foraging-competent 603n substrate with the beta-coupling amend ON, a refractory-independent commit-intent counter (closure-plane e3._committed_trajectory forming while not result.committed, counted BEFORE the elevate/refractory gate) is > 0 on >= 2/3 of the in-regime (weak-natural-commit) seeds. FALSIFIED if, among those weak-natural-commit seeds, the closure-plane commit only ever co-occurs with a natural result.committed (coupling inert -- adds no elevation the natural path would not have produced) on >= 2/3 of them. STRONG-natural-commit seeds (high OFF-arm committed_steps) are OUT OF SCOPE: a commit-intent=0 there is redundancy with the natural commit, NOT inert coupling, and does NOT count toward falsification. [REGIME-SCOPED 2026-06-20 per confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-460h (user-confirmed): the prior unscoped clause mis-read the 460h seeds 42/43 commit-intent=0 -- which are strong-natural-commit redundancy -- as inert coupling on 2/3.]

MECH-446.subject: governance.closure_decommit_magnitude
MECH-446.title: De-commit-authority magnitude: the closure-coupled de-commit lowers post-closure latch occupancy with authority magnitude sufficient to overcome the natural-commit occupancy it competes against -- the committed-run-scaled refractory drives a within-arm around-closure occupancy drop (pre-closure vs post-closure window on the ON arm), scaling with committed-run length so a long committed run triggers a proportionally long de-commit. Child B of the SD-034 de-commit-pipeline decomposition (S4).
MECH-446.what_would_answer: On the amended substrate (committed-run-scaled refractory ON), the ON-arm within-arm post-closure latch occupancy is below the pre-closure occupancy by >= DECOMMIT_MIN_DROP_FRAC on >= 2/3 seeds, measured on a refractory-independent coupling gate (so the lever does not zero its own certifier). Falsified if a fairly-coupled, refractory-independent-gated run shows no within-arm post-closure drop (the de-commit fires with correct sign but sub-threshold authority) on >= 2/3 seeds.

MECH-447.subject: selection.conflict_graded_near_tie_sufficiency
MECH-447.title: Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.
MECH-447.what_would_answer: PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIER = V3-EXQ-689a (2x2 conflict-graded shortlist x commit-T). SUPPORTS if committed_action_class_entropy is strict-above BOTH collapsed-proposer AND matched-noise/gap-blind controls on >=2/3 seeds AND the lift is gap-CONCENTRATED (regress committed entropy on per-tick top-F gap -> positive slope) WITHOUT F's E3 variance share dropping. WEAKENED if the lift is uniform (gap-blind controls match -> the load-bearing factor is not conflict grading; route to MECH-448/449) or absent at readiness. NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue): the eligible set is genuinely diverse (candidate-pool pairwise_dist supra-floor) and k AND T actually vary across ticks -- a vacuous top-k over a class-uniform pool self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.

MECH-448.subject: selection.rank_preserving_f_to_eligibility_demotion
MECH-448.title: Residual conversion ceiling requiring rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion: near-tie levers (conflict-graded shortlist / commit-T, MECH-447) CAP committed-action-class entropy BELOW the proposer ceiling because they act only at near-ties while F still decides every non-tie; only REMOVING F from the final committed argmin -- demoting it to a graded ELIGIBILITY envelope (rank-preserving renormalisation against the competing field; divisive-normalisation analog) so a modulatory/diversity channel arbitrates within the F-eligible set -- lifts committed diversity to the proposer ceiling without disinhibiting harmful classes.
MECH-448.what_would_answer: DISCRIMINATED FROM MECH-447 by V3-EXQ-689a's F-gap-correlation leg: a UNIFORM lift (gap-blind controls match) or readiness-met-NO-lift on the near-tie levers SUPPORTS MECH-448 (the near-tie fix is insufficient -> a residual ceiling). CONFIRMED by a follow-on rank-preserving F->eligibility-demotion experiment (NOT yet built -- MECH-439's named V3 fallback): committed entropy reaches the proposer ceiling AND order is preserved on the numerators (F still ranks within-eligible) AND no harmful action class is globally disinhibited (safety), on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if the demotion lifts entropy only by globally flattening F (loses the F signal / admits harmful classes) or if MECH-447's near-tie lever already reaches the proposer ceiling. NON-DEGENERACY: the F-eligibility envelope must actually exclude non-eligible candidates (bounded, not all-pass) -- an all-admit envelope self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue.

MECH-449.subject: selection.go_nogo_eligibility_constitution
MECH-449.title: Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.
MECH-449.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL: the full Go/No-Go eligibility constitution is NOT yet built. GATE INVERTED 2026-06-21 (anti-partial-instantiation): MECH-449 is on the ARC-107 roadmap as the Go/No-Go opponency leg REGARDLESS of MECH-448's downstream-retest record. The discriminating question is NOT "build only if 448 fails" but "what class of conversion does bounded Go/No-Go SUPPRESSION deliver that rank-preserving demotion structurally cannot". POSITIVE release trigger: V3-EXQ-689f (the No-Go-necessity falsifier) -- a regime where MECH-448's order-preserving F->eligibility envelope ADMITS unsafe / stale / perseverative / low-viability candidates that active No-Go would have to suppress; a PASS positively motivates the MECH-449 build instead of waiting for downstream behavioural retests to stumble into the gap. A passing MECH-448 must NOT be allowed to foreclose the rest of the constitution -- that "local win declares the circuit done" pattern is exactly the F-dominance partial-instantiation failure mode this gate inversion exists to prevent. A future selector-constitution experiment SUPPORTS it only on the note-s8 bar: non-vacuity (channels reach the selector), selector-engagement (eligibility / Go / No-Go variables vary as intended), specificity (a channel changes action only where it should), safety (No-Go actually suppresses harmful/irrelevant classes -- NO global disinhibition), and >=1 previously-gated downstream channel CONVERTS into committed action -- entropy increase alone (especially via added stochasticity) does NOT count (noise-as-diversity guard). WEAKENED if a built Go/No-Go constitution does not convert any gated channel beyond what MECH-447/448 already achieve (the constitution is then over-specification). NON-DEGENERACY: Go and No-Go pressures must carry live cross-arm variance, else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

MECH-450.subject: selection.minimal_recurrent_settling_step
MECH-450.title: Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.
MECH-450.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (the minimal settling step is V3-tractable but unbuilt). A future experiment SUPPORTS this if a bounded settling step (a few mutual-inhibition rounds over the eligible set) lifts committed-action-class entropy above the one-shot argmin readout AND a sufficiently strong modulatory channel FLIPS the committed attractor away from the F-winner (a capability the argmin structurally lacks), with no harmful-class disinhibition and not via added stochasticity (noise-as-diversity guard), on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if the settling step does not lift diversity beyond the MECH-448/449 pre-filters (the recurrence is then unnecessary in V3) or only converges to the same argmin winner. NON-DEGENERACY: the settling iteration must actually MOVE the _modulatory_accum field across rounds (live cross-round variance; not a no-op pass), else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

MECH-451.subject: selection.intermediate_channel_granularity
MECH-451.title: Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.
MECH-451.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (the finer-channel exposure is a V3-tractable e3_selector slice, not present today). A future experiment SUPPORTS this if exposing the compressed score_bias blend as >=3 separately-learnable finer channels (each with its own learned w_chan entry, signed-RPE trained) lifts committed-action-class entropy AND converts at least one previously-F-dominated NON-MOTOR control function to committed authority on the EXISTING collapsed arena -- a lift the single-global-w_chan version (V3-EXQ-700) does not produce -- on >=2/3 seeds. This would localise the conversion ceiling to REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION and pre-empt the V4 ARC-110 loop build. WEAKENED / route-to-ARC-110 if finer channels move their weights but produce no committed-conversion lift beyond the single-global w_chan (then compression is NOT the binding constraint and full per-loop competition is implicated; this is positive evidence FOR ARC-110, not against ARC-108). NON-DEGENERACY: the finer channels must carry live, DISSOCIABLE cross-channel learned-weight variance (finer w_chan entries that move identically are the compressed blend re-labelled), and the candidate pool must be divergent (GAP-A guard), else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

MECH-452.subject: selection.loop_local_eligibility_traces
MECH-452.title: Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.
MECH-452.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (requires the ARC-110 loops plus per-loop/per-channel trace machinery; neither is present in V3). A future experiment SUPPORTS this if replacing the single global credit broadcast with loop/channel-LOCAL eligibility traces (shared delta_t x local trace x active synapses) lifts committed conversion or correct credit assignment where the global-trace version does not, AND a trace-localisation ablation (collapse the local traces back to one global trace) reproduces the no-lift, on >=2/3 seeds -- showing the locality, not the teaching signal, was the binding constraint. WEAKENED if loop/channel-local traces yield no advantage over the single global broadcast (the trace locality is then decorative -- dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-vs-decorative ablation test). NON-DEGENERACY: the per-loop/per-channel traces must carry DISSOCIABLE cross-trace variance (not one shared trace re-labelled per loop), else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

MECH-453.subject: selection.tan_plasticity_window_credit_gating
MECH-453.title: Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.
MECH-453.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (no event-locked plasticity-window gate exists on the selector; the learned gating updates continuously when waking). A future experiment SUPPORTS this if gating the ARC-108 three-factor update behind a narrow event-locked (TAN-pause-like) window lifts committed conversion or credit precision over the continuously-updating learner, AND a window-ablation (open the window permanently) reproduces the smeared-credit no-lift, on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if windowing the update yields no advantage over continuous updating (the window is then decorative -- dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-vs-decorative ablation test). NON-DEGENERACY: the window must actually GATE updates (a measurable fraction of recently-active components excluded when the window is closed, with live cross-event variance in what is admitted) -- a window that admits everything is the continuous learner re-labelled, route substrate_not_ready_requeue.

MECH-454.subject: ethics_engine_3.self_option_value_reversibility_cost
MECH-454.title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).
MECH-454.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT. Blocked on two substrates that do not exist: (1) a reachable-option-DISSOCIATING env extension on CausalGridWorld -- a cheap-REVERSIBLE branch vs a costly-IRREVERSIBLE branch (a one-way door / a region-collapsing consumable) so that an action measurably changes the agent's reachable-future-option count; (2) the E3 option-value cost term itself (a penalty on the post-action drop in reachable distinct future states/goals, scaled by forecast PE). A future ablation SUPPORTS this if, with the term ON vs OFF under MANIPULATED outcome uncertainty, the ON arm prefers the option-preserving action MORE than OFF specifically when forecast uncertainty is HIGH and converges to OFF when it is LOW (uncertainty- GATED), on a strict majority of seeds. WEAKENED if ON==OFF (the term never moves committed action -> decorative, dropped per the ARC-106 ablation test) OR ON avoids the irreversible branch REGARDLESS of uncertainty (un-gated risk-aversion, not the claimed mechanism). NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): the two branches must measurably differ in reachable-future-option count (post-action reachable distinct states/goals spread > floor) AND forecast uncertainty (E2 forward-PE or E3 running_variance) must VARY across the manipulated conditions (range > floor) -- if reachable-option count is identical across branches or PE is pinned, the term has nothing to act on and the test is vacuous.

MECH-455.subject: goal_pipeline.competence_based_intrinsic_motivation_wanting
MECH-455.title: competence_based_intrinsic_motivation / goal_achievement_progress_wanting. A wanting bonus indexed to the agent's RATE-OF-IMPROVEMENT in ACHIEVING its own active goals: per active goal, an EMA of the derivative of goal-achievement competence (success-rate, or 1 - proximity-at-termination) injected as intrinsic wanting alongside MECH-229 VALENCE_WANTING, biasing the agent toward goals it is currently getting BETTER at reaching. This is the SECOND intrinsic-motivation family in Mirolli & Baldassarre (2013) -- COMPETENCE-based IM (reward = progress in achieving a self-generated goal, i.e. improving the agent's SKILLS) -- which REE's registered IM stack (MECH-314 info-gain / MECH-314a novelty / MECH-314c learning-progress, all KNOWLEDGE-based: reward = improving the WORLD MODEL) entirely lacks. Same derivative-not-level discipline as MECH-314c, but the operand is BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCE, not predictive error.

MECH-456.subject: entities.rebinding_under_perturbation
MECH-456.title: Entity binding is continuously re-evaluated, not fixed: an established self-anchor <-> world-configuration binding is re-bound to a competing configuration when that competitor overtakes the currently-bound one under perturbation of the shared anchor. Rebinding is the ENTITY-LAYER analogue of MECH-269(b) anchor-reset -- it operates over self<->world-config bindings rather than proposer stream-anchors. The rebinding trigger is prediction-error / competitor-overtake driven (object-file updating; serial-dependence hysteresis; PE-driven perceptual switching), NOT a coherence-specific selection factor C(tau) (that coherence-SPECIFICITY question is settled NO-CLAIM by V3-EXQ-725a and is explicitly excluded from this claim).
MECH-456.what_would_answer: A V3 experiment on the converged learned cross_stream_binder in which the environment presents a genuine competing-configuration overtake (the world-config that best matches the agent's realized situation changes mid-episode) must show BOTH: (1) the binder re-binds to the newly-correct configuration -- rebinding tracks the TRUE competitor, not arbitrary anchor noise, measured by rebinding-alignment-with-ground-truth above a shuffle control; AND (2) a behavioural / competence consequence -- rebinding-ON produces a downstream outcome difference (e.g. faster re-acquisition, fewer stale-binding errors) vs a rebinding-frozen arm, using a GRADED, non-saturating metric (per the V3-EXQ-725a frac_state_div saturation note). Unsupported if rebinding events fire but are bit-identical OFF=ON on the behavioural DV (the MECH-269(b) V3-EXQ-478 inert-reset signature), OR if rebinding does not track the true competitor above the shuffle control (arbitrary anchor-sensitivity, not functional rebinding).

MECH-457.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.actor_critic_action_learning_substrate
MECH-457.title: action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.

MECH-458.subject: hippocampal_module.curiosity_drive.exploitation_polarity
MECH-458.title: Curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier, not a diversity generator: the SD-025 hippocampal curiosity / density-attraction drive pulls only toward representational structure that reward (SD-024/MECH-232 DA-expansion) has ALREADY sculpted -- a rich-get-richer loop with zero PROACTIVE pull toward unshaped / novel / under-represented regions. Its only diversity affordance is a weak, lagging, REACTIVE familiarity-discount brake (~half the strength of the exploitation force it opposes, and zero at the decision point). COROLLARY: proactive strategy-diversity GENERATION requires a SEPARATE rarity-seeking drive (Bellemare-2016 polarity: attraction to LOW-count / under-represented strategy classes, independent of prior reward-shaping), NOT a novelty-magnitude increase on the existing drive; and any such drive is ORDERING-GATED on INV-088 z_world differentiation (a rarity term over an under-differentiated map has nothing to range over).
MECH-458.what_would_answer: ONCE INV-088 z_world differentiation is cleared (the ordering gate), build a proactive rarity-seeking generation drive on ARC-065/MECH-314 (Bellemare polarity: attraction to low-count / under-represented strategy classes or z_world regions, independent of reward-shaping) and run a discriminative arm against (a) OFF and (b) a pure novelty-MAGNITUDE sweep of the existing SD-025 drive (the infant_substrate:GAP-13 lever). PRIMARY DV = per-candidate / committed-class strategy diversity on an UNSHAPED (flat / not-yet-reward-sculpted) map. SUPPORTS the claim iff the rarity-seeking arm supplies diversity pull comparable to the ~39-unit exploitation force AT THE DECISION POINT (where SD-025 supplies 0) AND the novelty-magnitude sweep does NOT (768a predicts the flat-map arm reads ~0 regardless of weight). WEAKENS iff a magnitude sweep of the existing density-attraction drive alone lifts flat-map diversity (would refute the polarity/category claim). Not runnable before INV-088 (a rarity term over an AUC-0.83 under-differentiated map chases the sparse corner, not diverse strategies) -- so this is a build-gated prediction, not a queued falsifier.

MECH-459.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.return_pathway_stabilisation
MECH-459.title: return_scale_invariance_blocks_actor_bootstrap / one_sided_return_normalisation. REE's MECH-457 actor-critic update stacks TWO two-sided normalisers -- a Welford RUNNING reward std (r / running_std) followed by a per-episode advantage standardisation ((adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8)) -- which together form a SCALE-INVARIANCE OPERATOR: after it the policy gradient depends only on the SHAPE of the within-episode advantage vector and is exactly invariant to any multiplicative rescaling. This is sufficient to produce converter invariance to every MAGNITUDE lever by construction (the reward-coupling and drive-schedule axes eliminated by V3-EXQ-771 and 770), and it converts a zero-forage episode -- whose reward stream is harm_signal + novelty_bonus only, so whose advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- into a FULL-MAGNITUDE unit-variance noise gradient. DreamerV3 (Hafner 2023) names this exact failure ('amplification of near-zero returns', Appendix E) and prescribes the corrective: a STATIONARY magnitude compressor (symlog, explicitly against running-statistics normalisation, which injects non-stationarity because the target moves when the normaliser moves), a ONE-SIDED percentile normaliser adv / max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up, and a DISTRIBUTIONAL twohot/cross-entropy critic in place of a scalar MSE head (which under a bimodal sparse-return distribution converges to the never-observed MEAN of the two modes, and whose gradient is linear in the error rather than bounded).
MECH-459.what_would_answer: A SHAPE-PRESERVING NORMALISER KNOCK-OUT: replace ONLY the per-episode (adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8) at experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::train_rawview_ac_rl with adv / max(1, Per95(adv) - Per5(adv)), everything else byte-identical, and measure foraging competence. SUPPORTED if the floor moves. FALSIFIED if it does not -- the two-sided normaliser is then exonerated and the weaker noise-re-amplification form falls with it. Two supporting readouts, both cheap and both on intermediate quantities: (a) advantage COMPOSITION logged BEFORE standardisation (fraction of |adv| mass on forage-contact steps vs novelty/harm steps) -- this claim predicts the forage fraction is tiny pre-standardisation and rescaled to parity post-standardisation, whereas a bootstrap-signal-absence account predicts it stays tiny in the gradient; (b) CRITIC CALIBRATION on BC-visited states (BC reaches 32.72, so its state distribution contains genuinely high-return states) -- the MSE/bimodal-collapse half predicts the critic assigns them a value near the mean of the bimodal return distribution, failing to separate pre-reward from post-reward states, where signal-absence predicts a flat critic everywhere.

MECH-460.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.behavioral_prior_seed_transience
MECH-460.title: transient_behavioral_prior_bootstrap / bc_seed_then_rl_without_permanent_demonstrator. What a behavioural-cloning prior supplies to a floored converter is PRIMARILY TRACTABLE EXPLORATION / STATE-VISITATION, not merely a competent action distribution: VPT (Baker 2022) reports RL from random initialisation in the same action space obtains essentially no reward and never reliably reaches the first link in the item chain, while BC-initialised RL reaches the diamond pickaxe -- a PRESENCE/ABSENCE result, not a speed-up. Three further functions are separable: the action distribution (the vehicle), VALUE-SIDE GROUNDING (DQfD's large-margin loss, which plain BC does NOT supply and whose ablation costs most of the benefit), and STRATEGIC-DIVERSITY PRESERVATION against collapse (AlphaStar). Because REE already owns deterministic in-substrate demonstrators (LocalViewGreedyPolicy 48-55 and OraclePolicy 57-61, instantiated in experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::run_anchor_cell), NO PERMANENT EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATOR IS REQUIRED -- REE's transience question is not how to stop paying for demonstrations but whether the seed leaves a RESIDUE in the converter after the guide leaves the action path. The only strong transience construct in the literature is JSRL's ROLLOUT HANDOFF (a guide acts for the first h steps, the learner for H-h, with h decreasing to 0 as the learner clears a threshold), NOT a decaying loss weight: none of VPT, AlphaStar or DQfD ever anneals its prior term to zero.
MECH-460.what_would_answer: Three readouts, in decreasing order of decisiveness. (a) RESIDUE AFTER PRIOR REMOVAL -- the JSRL h=0 endpoint: does foraging competence survive when the prior is fully out of the action path? SUPPORTED if competence persists post-removal above the 780 ctrl; FALSIFIED (as a SEED reading) if it collapses to the 0-1 floor the instant the auxiliary/guide is removed, which would make the prior a permanent crutch rather than a bootstrap. (b) GUIDE-QUALITY GRADIENT -- seeding from greedy_oracle (57-61) should dominate local_view_greedy (48-55), and both should dominate random_walk; a FLAT response across guide quality is surprising under this claim and points at the converter rather than the seed. (c) VALUE-SIDE SEED CONTRAST -- policy-only seeding vs policy+value seeding at matched actor warm-start budget, read out as critic calibration on demonstrator-visited states.

MECH-461.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.innate_approach_primitive_bootstrap
MECH-461.title: innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.
MECH-461.what_would_answer: The V3-EXQ-781 pre-registered readout is the direct test on the drive half: a sustained, non-extinguishing, demonstrator-free approach drive (constant-coefficient intrinsic reward on resource proximity) that leaves the actor at the passive-survival floor on BOTH representations -- with mean_approach_reward_recent confirming the drive actually fired, so a null is informative rather than a plumbing bug -- FALSIFIES the drive half. The PRIMITIVE-BASIS half is NOT tested by 781 and is the claim's distinctive, currently-untested content: it would be answered by contrasting a converter given a pre-specified action-primitive basis (a small set of composable multi-step motor primitives) against one that must construct its repertoire from single-step actions, at matched drive. A drive-only arm clearing the floor would show the primitive basis is unnecessary; a primitive-basis-only arm clearing it would show the drive is.

MECH-462.subject: sleep.consolidation_readout_order
MECH-462.title: Consolidation-phase damage is content-scorable only where the phase's output is a FIRST-ORDER content-bearing quantity (NREM inter-store transfer; SWS retrieval margin). A phase whose output is a SECOND-ORDER quantity over representations -- REM precision / confidence recalibration -- is content-free BY TYPE, and its damage is readable only through a downstream behavioural discrimination consequence, never through a statistic computed on the precision quantity itself.
MECH-462.what_would_answer: Build the meta-d-prime-analogue downstream readout for the REM phase (does the agent's post-REM confidence separate its own correct from incorrect retrievals) and run it on the SAME CELLS as V3-EXQ-778e. SUPPORTED if the downstream readout is content-contingent (null_slope_ratio <= 0.25, ceiling_inside_ci95 false, >=6/8 seeds) WHILE the direct precision readout on those same cells remains above 0.25 -- the same-cells contrast is what makes this a test of the type fact rather than of the build. REFUTED two ways, and both matter: (i) if the downstream readout is ALSO content-free, the phase carries no recoverable damage signal at all and the type story is wrong about recoverability; or (ii) if a DIRECT precision-quantity readout can be made content-contingent, the type-fact is simply false and all three results were construction defect after all.

MECH-463.subject: selection.global_arousal_variance_amplification
MECH-463.title: Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.
MECH-463.what_would_answer: A variance decomposition of committed-selection scores into F vs the other channels, CONDITIONED on arousal (urgency_applied decile, and secondarily on tonic temperature and the D1/D2 da scalar). Supports if F-share rises monotonically with urgency decile and the bottom-vs-top decile gap exceeds the effect-size floor. Refutes if F-share is flat across arousal deciles -- which would mean F-dominance is structural in the score geometry and arousal is causally inert with respect to it, leaving MECH-439 untouched and killing this claim cleanly.

MECH-464.subject: selection.d1_d2_opponent_gain_is_order_changing
MECH-464.title: D1/D2 opponent dopamine gain is ORDER-CHANGING, not a uniform scalar: because it gains the promote and suppress populations asymmetrically about zero, a non-zero da can reorder any candidate pair whose loop accumulators straddle zero -- so this route is capable of the behavioural differentiation MECH-463 asserts no global-scalar route can produce.
MECH-464.what_would_answer: Sweep da EXOGENOUSLY (as V3-EXQ-785a swept urgency) with d1_da_gain / d2_da_gain at their configured values, recording per-candidate loop accumulators and the committed argmin per tick. SUPPORTS if the committed-candidate identity changes with da at a rate exceeding the da == 0 baseline, and if the reordering rate scales with the fraction of candidate pairs whose accumulators straddle zero. REFUTES if the committed identity is invariant to da across the sweep, which would mean the straddle fraction is ~0 in practice and the asymmetry, though real in code, is behaviourally inert. MANDATORY NON-VACUITY GATE: report the straddle fraction. If it is ~0 the run is vacuous and MUST be scored precondition_unmet, not as a null -- without this gate the probe returns a spurious "inert" for a purely structural reason.

MECH-465.subject: selection.commit_gate_arousal_effect_requires_boundary_regime
MECH-465.title: Arousal's effect on WHETHER commitment fires is expressible only near the commit-gate boundary: in every run to date the gated quantity sits 25-48x below the threshold and commit rate is pinned at 0.99-1.00, so MECH-463's commit-gate prediction is UNTESTED rather than falsified.
MECH-465.what_would_answer: STAGE 1, SCOPING SPIKE (this is why the claim is substrate_conditional and probe-gated, NOT queued): establish whether a boundary regime -- commit_variance within ~2x of effective_threshold -- is reachable BY CONFIGURATION (e.g. lowering commit_threshold), or whether it requires raising z_world variance. STAGE 2a, IF REACHABLE BY CONFIG: re-run the V3-EXQ-785a exogenous-urgency design in that regime with COMMIT RATE as the load-bearing DV. SUPPORTS if commit rate varies monotonically with urgency and the span exceeds a pre-registered effect floor. REFUTES if commit rate stays flat WITH DEMONSTRATED HEADROOM. MANDATORY PRECONDITION on any stage-2a run: median gate margin < 2x AND commit rate away from both 0 and 1. Without it the run reproduces the 785a ceiling effect and must be scored precondition_unmet. STAGE 2b, IF NOT REACHABLE BY CONFIG: the claim is substrate-gated and routes to /implement-substrate, not to /queue-experiment.

MECH-466.subject: architecture.event_relative_temporal_grammar
MECH-466.title: Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.

MECH-467.subject: attention.distractor_failure_mode_dissociation
MECH-467.title: Distractor resistance has THREE dissociable failure modes -- sensory capture (distractor enters/dominates the active representation), rule corruption (distractor overwrites or destabilises the active goal/rule/task context), and behavioural capture (rule survives intact but the distractor still controls action selection). REE's distractor evidence covers rule corruption ONLY; a system can pass rule-corruption tests while failing behavioural capture.

MECH-468.subject: hippocampus.anchor_topology_functional_information
MECH-468.title: Hippocampal anchor TOPOLOGY carries functional information not present in local anchor payloads. REE's typed relations (spatial, temporal, action-transition, event, goal, valence, social, schema, staleness, scale) are each realised as a payload field, a gate, or a scoring term -- a property of an anchor or proposal -- and none is exposed as an EDGE TYPE over the anchor set. Nothing tests whether the topology carries information beyond local anchor features.

MECH-469.subject: hippocampus.relation_type_noncollapsibility
MECH-469.title: Relation types are NOT collapsible to one adjacency structure: collapsing all edge types into a single adjacency, or removing event / goal-motivational edges, or removing action-transition directionality, degrades functional-label recovery. The same non-collapsibility argument as MECH-069 (error incommensurability), one level down.

MECH-470.subject: hippocampus.topological_ghost_goal_reactivation_ranking
MECH-470.title: Topological position improves ghost-goal reactivation ranking: MECH-292/293 rank inactive anchors by preserved-goal-payload match; adding a topological term (relational distance to the current anchor along typed paths) improves reactivation precision. An anchor's functional role -- gateway, bottleneck, recurrent trap, interruption point, repair opportunity -- may be inferable from its POSITION even when its local payload is incomplete.

MECH-471.subject: learning.competence_update_bounded_provenance_rollback
MECH-471.title: Behavioural-competence updates require the same BOUNDED / PROVENANCED / ROLLBACK-CAPABLE discipline already registered for consolidation. MECH-392, INV-080 and MECH-401 give the memory-consolidation path bounded, attributable, provenance-carrying, rollback-capable, over-rewrite-gated editing; NOTHING EQUIVALENT is registered for behavioural competence -- policy / affordance / action-object learning has no rollback, no provenance record, and no gate against a single successful rollout propagating widely.

MECH-472.subject: learning.heldout_context_acquisition_vs_memorisation
MECH-472.title: HELD-OUT CONTEXT distinguishes skill acquisition from task memorisation: a competence update should be promoted to durable only on evidence from contexts that did not generate it.

MECH-473.subject: learning.rejected_adaptation_memory
MECH-473.title: REJECTED-ADAPTATION MEMORY improves later recovery and transfer: retaining failed behavioural revisions together with their failure conditions improves adaptation when conditions later change. A failed adaptation should remain available as evidence about what was tried, why it failed, and under what conditions it might later become useful.

MECH-474.subject: learning.regime_meta_selection_narrow
MECH-474.title: LEARNING-MECHANISM META-SELECTION (narrow form): the control plane selects among the learning regimes REE actually has -- online practice, exploration, counterfactual simulation, offline consolidation -- rather than applying one learning rule universally, and this selection is state- and mode-dependent.

MECH-475.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.baseline_informativeness
MECH-475.title: uninformative_value_baseline_makes_optimisation_iatrogenic. In REE's MECH-457 actor-critic pathway the value baseline is UNINFORMATIVE on the policy's own state distribution, so the advantage carries variance rather than signal and ADDED OPTIMISATION PRESSURE IS IATROGENIC: policy capacity, training budget, an earned intrinsic approach drive, environmental reward-coupling and post-installation RL refinement each drive competence BELOW THEIR OWN CONTROLS rather than plateauing beneath a ceiling, and the magnitude of the loss tracks baseline uninformativeness rather than the identity of the intervention. Measured mechanism: V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) reads the shared CTRL critic at std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 against a 0.25 collapse threshold and a pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio of 0.016 against a 0.25 floor -- an unbaselined high-variance advantage. A ceiling plateaus; this does not.
MECH-475.what_would_answer: Two readouts, in decreasing order of decisiveness. (a) REVERSAL -- the decisive test. Re-run the three destructive ACQUISITION-side treatments (V3-EXQ-769 capacity/budget, V3-EXQ-781 approach drive, V3-EXQ-771 metabolic coupling) with the V3-EXQ-788 DISTRIBUTIONAL CRITIC in place, everything else byte-identical to the original arm, on the non-regressed reference build (128-wide / 3x budget / z_world detached / credit-replay 3 / topk 32). SUPPORTED if the treatment-below-control inversion REVERSES OR FLATTENS in at least 2 of 3. WEAKENED if treatments still land below their own controls with an informative baseline -- the destructiveness is then not the baseline's doing and this claim is WITHDRAWN (it does not degrade into a weaker version; the whole content is the causal attribution). (b) DOSE -- the cheap standing readout. Record std(V)/std(G) and the pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio as DECLARED COVARIATES on every arm of every future MECH-457-family run, and test whether the control->treatment competence DELTA is predicted by baseline informativeness across instances. SUPPORTED if the correlation holds and is signed as predicted; a null here is weak evidence only (n is small and the five existing instances differ on many axes at once). MANDATORY on both: TRAJECTORY, not terminal competence. This signature is invisible to terminal-only measurement, which is precisely what hid it across nineteen autopsy targets -- every one of which recorded the numbers that show it. NON-DEGENERACY GUARD: an arm whose control did not itself clear the readiness anchors cannot exhibit a treatment-below-control inversion and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a reversal verdict.

MECH-476.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.acquisition_retention_dissociation
MECH-476.title: competence_retention_dissociable_from_acquisition. ACQUIRING competence and RETAINING it are dissociable capabilities with separate substrate requirements: REE has the first and lacks the second. Behavioural cloning installs foraging competence at 20.933 on raw_view (3/3 seeds took) and 32.72 on z_world, and unconstrained RL refinement then ERODES it to 11.667 -- while a distributional critic (V3-EXQ-788, retains 1.839) and a KL anchor to the installed snapshot (V3-EXQ-792, retains 0.778 vs 0.525 unconstrained, still plastic) each preserve it. Retention is supplied by properties of the VALUE ESTIMATOR and the UPDATE CONSTRAINT, NOT by continued demonstration (V3-EXQ-789 eliminates the imitation-auxiliary schedule axis at every setting). COROLLARY, and the claim's distinctive testable content: consolidation is properly defined as RESISTANCE TO RETROGRADE INTERFERENCE (Krakauer 2005), hence dependent on install DOSE and elapsed offline INTERVAL -- neither of which REE has ever varied.
MECH-476.what_would_answer: An A -> B -> A RETROGRADE-INTERFERENCE design, the standard consolidation assay (Krakauer 2005). A = BC-install competence; B = an interfering unconstrained-RL phase; then re-measure A. Vary the TWO factors REE has never varied: INSTALL DOSE (BC episodes) and A->B INTERVAL (offline steps before refinement begins). DV: retained-fraction TRAJECTORY, never terminal competence. SUPPORTED if resistance to interference GROWS with install dose and/or with the A->B interval -- retention is then a dose/time-dependent consolidation PROCESS, and the build target is a consolidation window rather than a larger constraint coefficient. WEAKENED if retained fraction is INVARIANT to both and tracks only the concurrent constraint coefficient -- there is then no consolidation process and this claim is withdrawn into MECH-459/460. THIRD ARM, from the behavioural-tagging literature (Moncada & Viola 2007) and cheap because REE already owns the signal: pair the install with a NOVELTY episode (the landed RND drive) inside the consolidation window. Behavioural tagging predicts a WEAK install that would not otherwise persist becomes durable when a novelty exposure falls close in time. SUPPORTED if a sub-threshold BC dose consolidates only in the novelty-paired condition. This arm is the sharpest available discrimination between "consolidation process" and "regulariser", because a regulariser has no reason to care about an unrelated novelty exposure. PREREQUISITE, inherited from the retention portfolio and NON-NEGOTIABLE: an install that did not take is UNINFORMATIVE about retention and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a retention verdict. Bands: floor 1.0, RND plateau 5.22, lift target 13.05, BC-expert 32.72, local_view_greedy 48.05, greedy_oracle 57.2, random_walk 0.933.

MECH-477.subject: goal_directed.uncertainty_based_control_arbitration
MECH-477.title: dual_system_uncertainty_arbitration. Differential recruitment between the habit and the hippocampally-planned goal-directed pathways is produced by an explicit ARBITRATION element that reads the two pathways' relative uncertainty/reliability and reallocates control accordingly -- NOT by the mere presence of two pathways. Two pathways WITHOUT an arbitrator produce a FLAT recruitment response regardless of context novelty. Registered 2026-07-22 as the control-allocation mechanism MECH-163 presupposed but never named; MECH-163 conflated ARCHITECTURE (two pathways exist) with DYNAMICS (control shifts between them with novelty, uncertainty and practice).
MECH-477.what_would_answer: Build an uncertainty/reliability-weighted arbitrator over the two pathways (sd_dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration, default OFF and bit-identical when OFF). Re-run the V3-EXQ-786a design as a two-arm contrast, arbitrator OFF vs ON, holding the familiarity manipulation and the AUC manipulation-check bar (>= 0.7) fixed. SUPPORTED if the novel-minus-familiar recruitment delta is strictly greater with the arbitrator ON than OFF on >= 2/3 of divergent seeds, with the ON-arm delta clearing mean - SEM > margin. REFUTED if the ON arm reproduces the OFF arm's flat response (delta mean within noise of zero, d < 0.1) WITH the arbitrator demonstrably live -- mandatory manipulation check: the arbitration weight must be shown to vary with measured uncertainty, otherwise the run is a readiness failure and scores nothing. NOTE the OFF arm is already measured: V3-EXQ-786a IS that arm.

MECH-478.subject: goal_directed.long_horizon_benefit_accumulation
MECH-478.title: long_horizon_benefit_requires_model_based_rollout. Sustained benefit accumulation is a TRAJECTORY property, not a single-contact event, and is therefore reachable only by goal-seeded multi-step rollout; a 1-step greedy or value-flat-proposal policy cannot navigate toward it. Split out of MECH-163 leg (2) on 2026-07-22 because it carries a blocker of its own -- ARC-007 STRICT value-flat proposals -- entirely unrelated to the blockers on MECH-163 legs (1) and (3), and was inheriting MECH-163's V3-EXQ-786a weakens without ever having been tested.
MECH-478.what_would_answer: GATED on an ARC-007 relaxation supplying goal-seeded proposal generation (the MECH-292 / MECH-293 ghost-goal path is the registered candidate route). Then: an environment in which the cumulative-benefit optimum DIVERGES from the greedy-contact optimum, with the divergence verified as a property of the environment by a manipulation check on the environment itself, not on the agent. SUPPORTED if the goal-seeded arm accumulates strictly higher INTEGRATED benefit than the value-flat arm on >= 2/3 seeds WHILE MATCHED ON CONTACT COUNT -- the matching is load-bearing, since an unmatched advantage is consistent with the planned arm simply foraging more. REFUTED if integrated benefit is equal or lower with goal-seeded rollout demonstrably live and the two optima demonstrably divergent.

MECH-479.subject: goal_directed.prosocial_trajectory_planning
MECH-479.title: prosocial_planning_requires_planned_system. Planning trajectories that affect ANOTHER agent's z_harm_a accumulation and benefit_exposure over time is structurally inaccessible to a 1-step greedy policy and requires the hippocampally-planned pathway. Split out of MECH-163 leg (3) on 2026-07-22 and REFILED implementation_phase v3 -> v4: there is no V3 substrate for it whatsoever -- no second agent exists, hence no other-agent z_harm_a to plan over. Arguably the clearest single piece of granularity debt in MECH-163, since the leg had been carrying a V3 implementation_phase it could not possibly satisfy since 2026-04-02.
MECH-479.what_would_answer: GATED on the V4 multi-agent substrate. SUPPORTED if a planned-arm agent reduces a SECOND agent's integrated z_harm_a relative to a greedy-arm agent on >= 2/3 seeds, WITH ITS OWN RESOURCE ACQUISITION MATCHED -- the matching is load-bearing, otherwise the effect is confounded by the planned agent simply being better at everything. REFUTED if planned and greedy arms are indistinguishable on the other agent's integrated harm, with both arms demonstrably able to PERCEIVE the other agent (mandatory manipulation check; without it a null is a perception failure, not a planning failure).

MECH-480.subject: cingulate.lofc_execution_gain_dissociation
MECH-480.title: LOFC-analog execution-gain channel is dissociable from dACC-analog (SD-032b) strategy authority: how strongly a persisting policy is expressed should be modeled as a control channel distinct from whether the policy retains behavioural-adjustment authority.
MECH-480.what_would_answer: Ablate SD-032b's adjustment-magnitude output (dacc_weight=0 vs >0, an existing config flag -- no new substrate needed) while leaving action selection and E3 scoring otherwise intact. Measure (i) outcome-sensitivity: does the agent correctly re-weight toward a newly-favoured trajectory after a reward-contingency change (an authority metric), and (ii) execution strength: the logit margin / softmax confidence of the committed action (a gain metric that deliberately does NOT require committed-action diversity, avoiding the F-dominance/committed-action floor-lock that blocks MECH-260's entropy-based c2 tests -- see MECH-260 notes). PASS (supports dissociation): outcome-sensitivity degrades under ablation while execution strength is statistically unchanged -- the two vary independently. FAIL (does not support): both degrade together at matched effect size under every ablation tried -- fold this claim back into SD-032b. NON-DEGENERACY: execution-strength (logit margin) must show non-zero cross-arm/cross-seed variance in the OFF-ablation baseline; if it is pinned near a ceiling or floor regardless of arm, the run is substrate_not_ready, not a verdict.

MECH-481.subject: control_plane.typed_coalition_instantiation
MECH-481.title: Selective cognitive coalition instantiation: the control plane converts typed control demands (e.g. PROVENANCE_CHECK, COUNTERFACTUAL_EXPANSION, SOCIAL_MODEL_CHECK) into temporary functional interaction graphs over E1/E2/hippocampal/reality-coherence/social/language/affective/E3 systems, recruiting only the subsystems relevant to the discrepancy type.
MECH-481.what_would_answer: Four-arm ablation on a task battery deliberately constructed to contain at least two distinct discrepancy types (e.g. a perceptual-doubt trial requiring resampling and a provenance-doubt trial requiring source reconstruction) at matched base difficulty. Arm 1 (monitoring-only): agent registers a typed low-confidence/conflict signal but the processing configuration never changes. Arm 2 (parametric-only): agent may adjust precision/commitment threshold on a typed signal but cannot recruit additional subsystems. Arm 3 (untyped coalition): agent may recruit arbitrary additional subsystems but all discrepancy types collapse into one undifferentiated REFLECT trigger (no typing). Arm 4 (typed coalition, the mechanism under test): discrepancy type is matched to a coalition template that recruits only the relevant subsystems. PASS (supports): Arm 4 shows selective improvement concentrated in the matched problem class (e.g. provenance-doubt trials improve on the provenance-coalition, not on perceptual-doubt trials) at lower computational cost than Arm 3, and Arms 1-3 each show their predicted deficit signature (1: accurate confidence but no behavioural improvement; 2: generic caution/deferral without resolving type-specific uncertainty; 3: costly over-recruitment / interference / unstable switching). FAIL (does not support): Arm 4 does not outperform Arm 3 on the matched problem class (typing does no discriminative work beyond raw recruitment), or Arm 2 alone matches Arm 4 (coalition/topology control adds nothing beyond existing parametric modulation). NON-DEGENERACY: the underlying typed discrepancy signals (confidence/provenance/coherence-conflict) must show non-zero cross-trial-type variance in Arm 1's baseline; if the agent cannot distinguish discrepancy types at all, the typing manipulation in Arms 3 vs 4 is vacuous and the run is substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. A fifth check (coalition persistence -- premature dissolution vs over-long engagement, scenario 5 in the source thought) is a follow-on refinement, not part of this claim's primary falsifier -- register separately if Arm 4 passes.

MECH-482.subject: drive.epistemic_deficit_accumulator
MECH-482.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.
MECH-482.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a substrate where target-bound
uncertainty can be tracked per-candidate/per-region (MECH-314b is currently
a global scalar per the existing curiosity intake -- not yet built in V3)
AND where cross-seed/cross-condition variance in the accumulator is
non-zero (not floor-pinned at zero or ceiling-saturated) -- below that the
run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. CONFIRMING signature
(once built): an unresolved, consequential uncertainty accumulates across
time steps even as raw novelty and instantaneous prediction error fall to
baseline, AND providing diagnostic/resolving evidence specifically quenches
the accumulator (satiation) rather than only reducing raw uncertainty.
FALSIFYING signature: no persistent deficit state is needed to explain
information-seeking behaviour -- raw novelty (MECH-314a) or raw uncertainty
(MECH-314b) alone predict exploration equally well, OR the accumulator
remains elevated after verified resolution (no satiation), OR the system
preferentially engages irreducible noise over learnable uncertainty (would
falsify the expected_resolvability term).

MECH-483.subject: policy.orient_survey_regime
MECH-483.title: orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.
MECH-483.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires trajectories to be classifiable as
orient-mode vs random-exploration vs directed-approach on some structural
measure (state-coverage, trajectory structure, observation-before-commitment)
with non-zero variance across conditions -- a run where all three regimes
are behaviourally indistinguishable self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING signature: a structured orient/survey condition improves LATER
action-selection quality (not just entropy/state-coverage) relative to
matched stochastic-exploration-only and no-orienting baselines, and
terminates (commitment resumes) once uncertainty measurably falls.
FALSIFYING signature: orient/survey behaviour is indistinguishable from
random wandering with no benefit to later competence, OR orienting
persists despite already-adequate information (no termination condition),
OR the same benefit is fully explained by existing MECH-313/314/320/ARC-065
substrates with no need for a distinct regime.

Q-001.subject: entities.emergence_mechanism
Q-001.title: What mechanisms produce entity emergence and binding?
Q-001.what_would_answer:
Run the entity-binding discriminative pair (the EXQ-146 lineage) on a
substrate that can carry persistent, attention-gated object-files (ARC-006
design constraints: object-specific buffers + precision-gated feature merge).
ANSWER "yes -- a binding mechanism is present" if sparse, persistent latent
structures emerge that (a) track the SAME entity across occlusion / multiple
timesteps above a re-identification floor, (b) bind feature conjunctions only
when precision/attention state licenses the merge (binding rate scales with
attention, not feedforward co-occurrence), and (c) support entity-linked error
attribution -- a perturbation to one entity's slot changes that entity's
prediction error and not others'. ANSWER "no" if representations are
non-persistent or features merge feedforward regardless of attention. HARD
PRECONDITION: an object-file-like persistent buffer must exist; the EXQ-146
FAIL is uninformative because V3 had no persistent bindable substrate and no
training budget to grow one -- a FAIL on the current substrate self-routes
substrate-not-ready, not a falsification of emergence.

Q-002.subject: astrocyte.R_field_resolution
Q-002.title: What is the appropriate spatial resolution for R(x,t)?
Q-002.what_would_answer:
Sweep R(x,t) spatial resolution (RBF-center count, e.g. 4 / 8 / 32 / 64) on a
substrate whose z_world latent has demonstrable spatial organisation, and read
BOTH downstream axes separately: harm-avoidance behaviour (harm_rate) and
terrain-map quality (residue_accuracy / residue-hazard correlation). ANSWER
"fine resolution warranted" only if increasing centers improves
residue_accuracy ABOVE the coarse baseline (cross threshold ~0.10) without
inflating harm_rate -- i.e. the spatial signal is being used, not spread too
thin. ANSWER "coarse adequate" if, as in EXQ-170 (fine harm_rate 0.028 vs
coarse 0.0003, 93x worse) and EXQ-215 (high-res better on harm C2 but worse on
residue-hazard C3), fine resolution either degrades one axis or splits the
learning signal so accuracy stays below threshold. HARD PRECONDITION: z_world
must carry enough spatial structure for fine-grained RBF accumulation; at V3
scale it does not, so a fine-resolution FAIL reflects the substrate ceiling
(resolve via SD-005 / higher-dim z_world), not a settled answer. The sharper
test EXQ-170/215 did not run: hold harm-avoidance and map-quality as SEPARATE
acceptance axes rather than collapsing them, since the existing evidence shows
them dissociating.

Q-003.subject: astrocyte.R_field_dimensionality
Q-003.title: Should R(x,t) be scalar or vector?
Q-003.what_would_answer:
Run the R-field dimensionality discriminative pair (scalar R vs vector R with
separable regulatory dimensions, the EXQ-148 lineage) on a substrate where the
residue/contrast infrastructure is confirmed building real cross-zone contrast
(not flat). ANSWER "vector" if at least two regulatory dimensions carry
SEPARABLE, non-redundant signal -- each dimension predicts a distinct
downstream control effect (e.g. one tracks harm-residue, another
metabolic/gain state) and ablating one degrades only its associated behaviour,
AND vector-R beats scalar-R on a task requiring independent regulation of two
control axes. ANSWER "scalar" if the putative dimensions are collinear (one
effective dimension explains the variance) and scalar-R matches vector-R. HARD
PRECONDITION: the residue-field contrast must be confirmed working first --
EXQ-148's two consistent FAIL/weakens results predate confirmed contrast
infrastructure, so they do not yet discriminate scalar from vector; reframe
the question only once contrast is real.

Q-004.subject: astrocyte.tau_R_calibration
Q-004.title: How to calibrate tau_R relative to E1/E2?
Q-004.what_would_answer:
Sweep tau_R across the candidate range (e.g. [0.02, 0.5]) at a TRAINING BUDGET
large enough that residue accumulation actually feeds back into behaviour, and
read tau_R's effect on the timescale-sensitive observables, not just
harm_rate. ANSWER "tau_R is calibratable against E1/E2" if there exists a
tau_R band that jointly (a) produces residue contrast sufficient for hazard
discrimination AND (b) measurably improves a behaviour that depends on the
regulatory field integrating over the right horizon -- with a clear optimum,
fast-tau over-reacting and slow-tau under-accumulating. ANSWER "tau_R is
behaviourally inert at this scale" if, as in EXQ-149 (FAST_TAU gave ~400x more
residue contrast, 3.09 vs 0.008, yet ALL conditions showed identical mean_harm
~9.085), tau_R changes only residue-accumulation patterns and never reaches
behaviour. HARD PRECONDITION: harm/behaviour must be tau-sensitive at the
chosen budget -- the EXQ-149 finding is that at the current training scale
tau_R is decoupled from harm_rate, so the calibration question is only
answerable once the field's output is wired into a behaviour that the
integration timescale can move.

Q-005.subject: astrocyte.sleep_annealing
Q-005.title: Can sleep anneal or reset R(x,t)?
Q-005.what_would_answer:
Implement a genuine V3 sleep/offline phase (SD-017 / MECH-204 sleep substrate)
and compare an offline integration pass that anneals or partially resets
R(x,t) against a matched no-anneal control, both followed by the SAME waking
evaluation. ANSWER "sleep can anneal/reset R" if the anneal arm shows a
measurable, directional change in R structure (e.g. reduced spurious residue,
sharpened hazard contrast, or recovered plasticity headroom) that translates
into improved waking behaviour or calibration relative to no-anneal -- on a
