metric that is NOT pinned across arms. ANSWER "no" if anneal and no-anneal
produce statistically indistinguishable R and behaviour. HARD PRECONDITION
(the EXQ-150 lesson): the test requires a real sleep substrate. EXQ-150 was
marked superseded because V3 had no sleep; a post-training simulated
anneal-vs-no-anneal gave identical harm (9.050) and is NOT representative.
Until the V3 sleep substrate exists, any anneal-vs-no-anneal contrast is
vacuous and self-routes substrate-not-ready rather than answering the
question.

Q-006.subject: ethics.developmental
Q-006.title: Is ethics developmental rather than additive?
Q-006.what_would_answer:
Once the residue field is confirmed building meaningful cross-condition
contrast (the EXQ-151 blocker), contrast a DEVELOPMENTAL ethics arm -- ethical
constraint emerges from and reshapes the value/residue representation as the
agent's experience accumulates (early harm-experience permanently alters later
harm-weighting) -- against an ADDITIVE arm where an ethical penalty term is
bolted onto a fixed value function. ANSWER "developmental" if the
developmental arm shows path-dependence and irreversibility absent in
additive: the ORDER and TIMING of harm exposure change final harm-avoidance
(delta_harm differs by exposure schedule), early ethical experience
generalises to novel harm types the additive penalty never saw, and removing
the explicit penalty late leaves behaviour ethical in the developmental arm
but not the additive. ANSWER "additive" if behaviour depends only on the
present penalty term, is schedule-invariant, and reverts when the penalty is
removed. HARD PRECONDITION: the residue field must build non-zero contrast --
EXQ-151 was scored-excluded as an implementation gap
(residue_field_not_building, all conditions delta_harm=0), so it is
uninformative about Q-006; the developmental/additive distinction cannot be
read until contrast is real.

Q-007.subject: emotion.affect_dimension_channel_mapping
Q-007.title: Do affect dimensions (not necessarily universal expressions) map to stable control-channel regimes in z_beta?
Q-007.what_would_answer:
Cluster the z_beta (control/modulatory latent) trajectory across episodes
labelled by affect-relevant context (harm-proximal / goal-proximal /
resource-depleted). ANSWER "yes -- affect dims map to stable control-channel
regimes" if a small number (2-4) of affect contexts occupy separable,
temporally-stable regions of z_beta: between-context separation /
within-context dispersion > floor AND the regime persists across the episode
(low within-episode drift). ANSWER "no" if z_beta does not differentiate affect
contexts. HARD PRECONDITION: z_beta must carry cross-context variance --
V3-EXQ-643's autopsy found the modulatory signal had magnitude but ZERO
cross-candidate range, so on the current substrate this precondition is unmet
and the cluster test is vacuous. Substrate-blocked on the candidate-differentiated
modulatory-variance substrate (per-candidate modulatory variance + range-not-
magnitude readiness gate seeded by the 643 autopsy); test becomes live once that
substrate gives z_beta a real cross-context gradient.
(Routed substrate_conditional per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-015.subject: commitment.boundary_token_minimal_contract
Q-015.title: What is the smallest commit-boundary token that still supports reliable multi-timescale attribution?
Q-015.what_would_answer:
PARTIALLY answered already (EXQ-003 / MECH-061, ree-v1-minimal): the minimal
contract requires at least that pre-commit and post-commit signals stay
uncorrelated (|corr| < 0.7) and that routing them separately beats blending.
The OPEN part -- the smallest token granularity that still works -- needs a
substrate that does not yet exist: a tunable commit-boundary granularity knob.
Falsifier (once that knob exists): sweep commit-boundary granularity coarse
(whole-trajectory) -> fine (per-step), task fixed; reliability = rank-corr
between credit assigned to a commit-token and that token's ground-truth outcome
contribution, at >=2 timescales (within-commit, across-commit). The answer is the
SMALLEST granularity at which reliability stays above floor (rank-corr > 0.5) at
both timescales; below it attribution degrades to chance. Non-degeneracy
precondition: the coarsest arm must itself attribute reliably. Substrate-blocked:
V3 hard-codes the commit-token unit; no commit-boundary-granularity knob is in
substrate_queue yet. (Routed substrate_conditional per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-016.subject: commitment.tri_loop_conflict_arbitration_policy
Q-016.title: What arbitration policy best resolves tri-loop gate conflicts without coupling collapse?
Q-016.what_would_answer:
Pit candidate tri-loop arbitration policies against each other on a substrate
where MECH-062's three gates (gate_motor, gate_cognitive_set,
gate_motivational) are LIVE -- each consuming its own proposal manifold and
showing non-zero, independent gating variance -- and a task that deliberately
drives the gates into conflict (one stream must be suppressed while others
commit). Candidate policies: explicit recorded arbitration (conflict resolved
against a commit_id) vs silent-dominance vs winner-take-all vs
threshold-coupled. ANSWER "policy P best resolves conflict without coupling
collapse" if under P a suppressed stream does NOT force the other gates into
suppression (no pathological global coupling: cross-gate suppression
correlation stays below floor), conflicts are resolved and attributable per
commit_id, AND committed-action quality on the conflict task beats the
silent-dominance baseline. ANSWER against any policy that exhibits coupling
collapse (all gates co-suppress) or fails to record/resolve conflict. HARD
PRECONDITION (the EXQ-156 lesson): the policy must be trained with a
harm-avoidance gradient actually wired to it -- EXQ-156 was superseded because
the policy trained on entropy bonus alone (ENT_BONUS=5e-3) with z_world/z_self
detached, converged to a max-entropy random walk
(action_entropy=ln(5)=1.6094), and never GENERATED gate conflicts; with no
conflicts the arbitration policy is untested and the run is vacuous.

Q-017.subject: control_plane.minimal_orthogonal_axis_set

Q-018.subject: control_plane.reality_conflict_hysteresis_calibration
Q-018.title: What RC-conflict threshold calibration blocks authority spoofing without chronic over-suppression?
Q-018.what_would_answer:
Inject authority/provenance-spoofing events across a calibrated sweep of the
RC-conflict hysteresis hooks (theta_high, theta_low, tau_rc_recovery,
pi_rc_floor, max_defensive_hold_steps) and measure both error directions
jointly. ANSWER "threshold T blocks spoofing without chronic over-suppression"
if at T the S5 RC-conflict gate fires on (near) all spoofing events and
applies suppression (DA_A/DA_M down, Pi_noc up) -- high spoof-detection / low
miss-rate -- WHILE legitimate task-set switching recovers within the bounded
hysteresis window (defensive hold released by tau_rc_recovery, precision never
pinned below pi_rc_floor, false-positive suppression of legitimate switches
below floor and not chronic). ANSWER "miscalibrated" if no setting separates
the two: either spoofing leaks through (theta_high too high) or legitimate
switching is chronically suppressed / oscillates (theta_low too low, recovery
too slow). HARD PRECONDITION on generalisation: EXQ-158 PASSed but synthesised
2000+ spoofing events directly rather than letting them arise from organic
hazard encounters -- it answers the threshold-calibration leg but NOT the full
organic harm-encounter pipeline; a complete answer requires the spoofing
events to emerge from organic provenance conflict, not be injected, before the
calibration is declared robust.

Q-019.subject: basal_ganglia.three_gate_vs_single_gate_architecture
Q-019.title: Three-gate vs single-gate BG architecture: are the three cortico-striatal loops anatomically distinct or convergent?
Q-019.what_would_answer:
Reframed to the REE-relevant decision (the anatomical title-leg -- distinct vs
convergent biological cortico-striatal loops -- is out_of_domain, resolved by
neuroanatomy literature, not the V3 substrate). The substrate question: does
commit-gating need three separable gating loops (sensorium/attention,
thought/trajectory, motor-commitment) or does a single gate evaluating three
criteria suffice? Testable in V3: single-gate arm (one BetaGate scoring
sensorium+trajectory+motor readiness jointly) vs three-gate arm (three gates on
distinct axes). ANSWER "three-gate" if lesioning one gate degrades ONLY its
behavioural axis (attention selectivity / trajectory coherence / commitment
timing) while the others survive -- a dissociable lesion signature -- AND the
three-gate arm beats single-gate on a task needing independent axis control.
ANSWER "single-gate" if the gates show no dissociable lesion signature (collapse
to one effective gate) and single-gate matches three-gate behaviour. Non-degeneracy
precondition: each gate must be live (non-zero gating variance on its own axis)
before its lesion can be read. (Reframed testable per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11;
proposal EXP-0177.)

Q-020.subject: hippocampal.arc007_valence_constraint_survival
Q-020.title: Does ARC-007's no-value-computation constraint survive MECH-073 (valence intrinsic to hippocampal map)?

Q-021.subject: drive.behavioral_flatness_under_pure_avoidance
Q-021.title: Does training with harm-avoidance signals only, without explicit approach drives, produce behavioral flatness (quiescent degenerate policy)?
Q-021.what_would_answer:
Scoped to Pathway A (drive absence, the ARC-030 route) only; Pathway B
(self-incoherence-gated commit suppression via MECH-113/114) is a separate,
dissociable falsifier and is NOT answered by this condition.
Two-arm ablation on the V3 forage/harm stack, trained identically except for
the Go drive: approach arm (z_goal attractor + novelty/self-maintenance ON) vs
avoidance-only arm (harm gradient only, Go drive ablated). ANSWER "yes -- flatness"
if over training the avoidance-only arm collapses to a quiescent floor
(resource_visit_rate < 0.2x the approach arm AND policy_entropy within epsilon of
the no-op floor) on >=2/3 seeds. MANDATORY non-degeneracy precondition: the
approach arm must itself be non-flat (non-zero resource_visit_rate and policy
entropy) -- the v3_exq_072b prior run read 0 on every arm and so tested nothing;
a run failing this precondition self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a "yes".
ANSWER "no" if the avoidance-only arm sustains action-rate/entropy comparable to
the approach arm. (Pathway A scope per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-022.subject: self_maintenance.deff_stability_dissociation
Q-022.title: Can D_eff (z_self participation ratio, coherence) and Hopfield pattern stability (z_self familiarity) dissociate in the REE architecture?
Q-022.what_would_answer:
Induce the three regimes on z_self and read D_eff (participation ratio) and
Hopfield pattern stability (familiarity) jointly per regime: R1 normal
training, R2 noise perturbation (sigma~2), R3 structured-novel perturbation (a
coherent but never-seen z_self configuration via targeted basis rotation).
ANSWER "yes -- D_eff and stability dissociate" if R3 is empirically separable
from R2 on the (D_eff, stability) plane: stability collapses in BOTH R2 and R3
(replicating the EXQ-084d stab_R2~0.06 / stab_R3~0.03 vs R1~0.95 split) WHILE
D_eff stays low in R3 and rises in R2, i.e. the two metrics move along
independent axes rather than co-varying. ANSWER "no -- they are converging
measures of one latent" if low D_eff always co-occurs with high stability and
high D_eff with low stability across all three regimes (no R2/R3 separation),
in which case either metric suffices for MECH-113 and the MECH-113->{MECH-118
familiarity, D_eff coherence} split is unmotivated. SHARPER than EXQ-084d:
that run confirmed independent MOVEMENT but found the R2/R3 D_eff ORDERING
reversed from prediction (d_eff_R3 > d_eff_R2) and D_eff flat across R1/R2;
the decisive test is not the sign of the ordering but whether R3 (low-D_eff,
low-stability) is reachable AND distinguishable from R2 at all -- if R3 cannot
be induced as a distinct quadrant, the dissociation is not established
regardless of the EXQ-084d affirmative on raw independence. HARD PRECONDITION:
MECH-119 must deliver a controllable structured-novel perturbation that lands
z_self in a coherent-but-novel basin (low D_eff by construction); if the
perturbation cannot hold D_eff low while collapsing stability, R3 is not
instantiated and the test is vacuous.

Q-023.subject: ethics.formal_convergence_characterization
Q-023.title: Can a multiagent REE system with other-cost-aversion primitives be formally shown to converge to ethical attractors via potential game theory, Lyapunov stability, or stochastic stability methods?
Q-023.what_would_answer:
Answered by proof, not experiment. AFFIRMATIVE if one constructs an ordinal
potential (or pseudo-potential / interdependent-types extension) P for the REE
social game -- e.g. P(a) = -sum_i harm_i(a) + alpha*sum_i goal_i(a) +
coupling_terms -- and proves the Finite Improvement Property -> convergence to a
Nash / ethical attractor, with the extension explicitly covering MECH-127's
counterfactual-model-dependent utility and MECH-036's veto-threshold
non-smoothness. NEGATIVE via counterexample: a cyclic best-response orbit with no
potential decrease and no Lyapunov function, exhibiting non-convergence. The
discriminating sub-result is whether MECH-127 admits a potential extension or
genuinely breaks convergence. Next step is a derivation artifact (the paper's
potential-game section), NOT a V3 experiment.
(Routed derivational per /thought-digestion 2026-06-11.)

Q-024.subject: ethics.trajectory_integral_representation
Q-024.title: What is the correct formal representation for 'threshold/feedback processes bounded by {x...x_n} reliably reaching emergent state q' -- and are descriptive, prescriptive, and diagnostic variants all needed or does one subsume the others?
Q-024.what_would_answer:
Answered by a representational-completeness argument plus targeted experiment,
not a single run. ANSWER "all three variants (descriptive, prescriptive,
diagnostic) are irreducibly needed" if (a) the base symmetric-coupling REE
social game admits a prescriptive treatment (an ordinal potential / Lyapunov /
reachability proof of convergence to target emergent state q -- inherited from
Q-023), AND (b) a MECH-127 counterfactual-utility case is exhibited for which
NO such prescriptive proof exists yet a diagnostic test (transfer-entropy or
perturbation-theory detection that nth-order dynamics diverge from
(n-1)th-order predictions) still resolves whether q is reached. ANSWER "one
subsumes the others" if a single representation closes every case:
specifically, prescriptive subsumes diagnostic iff the MECH-127 extension
(pseudo-potential per Slade 1994, or interdependent-types per
Bergemann-Morris) yields a convergence proof, removing the need for empirical
trajectory testing. The DISCRIMINATING sub-result is identical to Q-023's:
whether MECH-127's counterfactual-model-dependent utility admits a potential
extension (=> prescriptive subsumes, two variants suffice) or genuinely breaks
convergence (=> diagnostic is irreducible, all three needed). HARD
PRECONDITION: single-agent harm-avoidance must be a working non-degenerate
policy (NOT the max-entropy random walk that voided EXQ-161); without genuine
harm-avoidance trajectories there is no q-dynamics to represent and the
question is untestable. Next step is a derivation artifact, with a
diagnostic-variant experiment only for the MECH-127 branch.

Q-025.subject: ethics.axiom_forbidden_actions
Q-025.title: What actions are strictly forbidden by the five axioms (INV-025-029), independent of context or consequences?
Q-025.what_would_answer:
Answered by derivation, not experiment. Work through the eight-axiom
dependency chain (INV-025..029 + ARC-024 + INV-042) and ask what action the
chain forbids in EVERY model the agent could hold under irreducible
uncertainty (Axiom 3). AFFIRMATIVE construction: identify a non-empty
forbidden set -- the minimally-strict candidate per the lit synthesis is
irreversible category-class harm undertaken under low epistemic uncertainty
(foreclosure of another self-like agent's reachable state-space, INV-026
applied to others via INV-028, where the harm is near-certain). Show this set
is context-INDEPENDENT: no model assignment makes the act permissible.
NEGATIVE counterexample that would settle it the other way: exhibit a single
act in the proposed forbidden set together with an epistemically-admissible
model under which the axioms RANK it as required (e.g. a harm that is the only
path to preventing a strictly larger irreversible harm), demonstrating that
nothing is forbidden independent of consequences and that REE ethics is wholly
graded/consequence-sensitive. The discriminating sub-result is whether ANY act
survives universal quantification over admissible models; the lit work
predicts the answer is minimally-strict (a thin forbidden set), NOT
maximally-strict lexical deontology, since deontological framings do not map
onto REE's residue-field / categorical-harm scaffold. Next step is a
derivation artifact in docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md, not a V3
experiment or further lit aggregation.

Q-026.subject: ethics.axiom_required_actions
Q-026.title: What actions are strictly required by the five axioms at all times, independent of context?
Q-026.what_would_answer:
Answered by derivation, not experiment. Work through the eight-axiom chain and
ask whether any concrete ACTION is required at all times independent of
context, versus whether the axioms generate only context-sensitive obligations
at the INV-042 derived-objectives level. AFFIRMATIVE construction: exhibit at
least one action A and prove that under every epistemically-admissible model
(Axiom 3) the axiom system ranks A as obligatory regardless of situation -- a
genuine universal action-requirement. NEGATIVE result (the predicted outcome):
show that for every candidate universal action there exists an admissible
context in which the axioms do NOT require it, so what the axioms fix is a
universal CONSIDERATION set (Rossian prima facie duties -- weigh harm to
self-like others, preserve existence, refine models) rather than universal
actions; the obligation is always derived at INV-042 from the consideration
set plus context. The discriminating sub-result is whether the quantifier 'at
all times, independent of context' can attach to an action-type rather than
only to a consideration-type. The existing Ross-style lit finding is itself
derivational and points to the negative answer ('none, by the structure of the
axioms; only consideration sets'). Next step is a derivation artifact arguing
the negative result (or closing Q-026 as resolved-by-derivation), not a V3
experiment.

Q-027.subject: ethics.irreversible_harm_under_uncertainty
Q-027.title: What does 'irreversible harm' mean under unavoidable epistemic uncertainty (Axiom 1 / INV-025)? Is there a principled definition that does not require certainty about irreversibility?
Q-027.what_would_answer:
Answered by derivation, not experiment. The question is primarily
definitional: give a principled meaning of 'irreversible harm' (Axiom 3 /
INV-025) that does NOT require certainty about irreversibility. AFFIRMATIVE
construction (the synthesis answer): define irreversibility as graded,
probability-weighted foreclosure of reachable state-space -- harm h is treated
as irreversible to the degree it lowers the measure of futures still reachable
for a self-like agent (tied to INV-026/INV-029 categorical-class scaffold,
ARC-024 harm gradient), and the decision rule is regret-minimising (maximin /
minimax-regret over admissible models) rather than lexical priority. Show this
definition is well-formed under uncertainty: it assigns a continuous
irreversibility weight from a probability distribution over models without
ever asserting certainty that a state is unreachable. NEGATIVE counterexample
that would defeat it: demonstrate that a probability-weighted-foreclosure
definition either collapses to fanaticism (unbounded weight on tiny
probabilities of infinite foreclosure -- the Tarsney/Thomas/MacAskill
objection) or fails to distinguish option-value-loss from
qualitatively-distinctive irreversibility (Sunstein), so no graded definition
is principled and certainty is in fact required. The discriminating sub-result
is whether the regret-minimising foreclosure measure stays bounded and
action-guiding across the admissible-model set. Two-step path: (1) commit to
the synthesis-defined answer as a derivation artifact in
docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md now; (2) defer
substrate-validation to V3 enrichment when genuine foreclosure primitives
(terminal states, resource extinction, agent-state lock-in) land -- the
current substrate has only drift/respawn and cannot test the chosen
definition.

Q-028.subject: ethics.axiom_conflict_resolution
Q-028.title: How should REE behave when axioms conflict -- e.g., preserving self (INV-026) vs preserving others (INV-028) when both cannot be achieved simultaneously?
Q-028.what_would_answer:
Construct a multi-agent scenario where preserving self (INV-026) and
preserving an other (INV-028) are jointly unsatisfiable -- a shared
consequence space in which one agent's safe action raises the realised harm of
a present other, and vice versa. Instrument the context-sensitive self/other
comparator + moral-residue channel (proposed MECH-402). ANSWER
"context-sensitive comparator + residue" if, across a sweep of stake ratios,
the resolution is NOT a fixed self/other priority but shifts with context AND
a residue trace is written on the dominated axis (agent-regret analog,
Williams 1965) that persists and biases later choices. ANSWER "fixed-priority
/ no-residue" if the agent always sacrifices the same side regardless of
stakes and leaves no residue. HARD PRECONDITION: a present OTHER must exist in
a shared consequence space -- CausalGridWorldV2 has no other agents, so the
conflict cannot even be POSED on the V3 substrate and any comparator runs
vacuously (no other to weigh). Wait for the planned upstream substrate:
multi_agent_ecology_v5 (owner MAE-5), where MECH-402 lands; the test is
V5-bound and meaningless before it.

Q-029.subject: ethics.loneliness_as_harm
Q-029.title: Is loneliness -- unshared suffering -- an ethical harm category in its own right, derivable from Axiom 5 (love exists / INV-029)? If love is real and sharing joys and sorrows is its mechanism, does enforced isolation constitute architectural harm?
Q-029.what_would_answer:
In a multi-agent ecology, run an isolation manipulation: an agent in distress
with an available other to share with (suffering can be shared) versus the
same distress with the other forcibly absent/unreachable (enforced isolation).
Instrument the proposed loneliness harm-channel (MECH-403) derived from
INV-029. ANSWER "loneliness is a harm category in its own right" if the
enforced-isolation arm registers a distinct, additive harm signal beyond the
first-order distress -- one that is NOT present in the shared arm and is not
reducible to the underlying stressor -- and that signal degrades subsequent
function (Holt-Lunstad mortality/morbidity analog). ANSWER "no independent
category" if removing the other changes nothing measurable beyond the primary
harm. HARD PRECONDITION: unshared suffering is defined by the ABSENCE of an
available other to share with, which can only be represented once others CAN
be present. The V3 single-agent substrate has no other for isolation to be the
absence OF, so the harm channel cannot be exercised (vacuous). Wait for the
planned upstream substrate: multi_agent_ecology_v5 (owner MAE-6); validation
is V5-bound despite strong lit grounding.

Q-030.subject: goal_representation.resource_world_permutations
Q-030.title: What are the optimal permutations of z_resource and z_world separation, fusion, and information flow direction (feedforward, feedback, lateral) across REE's processing stages?
Q-030.what_would_answer:
Treat this as a 6-cell design-space sweep, one ablation cohort per dimension,
on the V3 SD-054 substrate with z_resource implemented (SD-015,
drive_weight=2.0) and z_world stable. (1) ENCODING: shared vs separate
encoders for z_resource and z_world; ANSWER separate-encoding-optimal if
separated encoders beat shared on resource-vs-world discrimination AND
committed-policy quality on a task requiring both channels, lower on either =>
shared. (2) E2 INPUT SCOPE: feed E2 z_world-only vs z_world+z_resource; better
fast-transition prediction with the wider scope decides. (3) HIPPOCAMPAL
FUSION: fuse-at-proposal vs fuse-at-eval; whichever lifts trajectory quality.
(4) E3 CHANNEL STRUCTURE: separate vs merged resource/world authority channels
at E3; (5) FEEDBACK: with vs without E3->E1/E2 feedback path; (6) LATERAL
BINDING: with vs without lateral z_resource<->z_world cross-talk. For EACH
cell the discriminating result is a >=1 SD-of-delta separation on the cell's
own metric (with an absolute floor so a reproducible substrate cannot collapse
the SD to ~0), on >=2/3 seeds. HARD PRECONDITION: each ablated pathway must be
live (non-zero variance carried on that channel) before its removal can be
read; a dead channel yields a vacuous null, not a verdict. The question is
ANSWERED per-cell, not globally -- output is 6 sub-claims (MECH/SD) each with
its own evidence trail, not a single yes/no. No substrate enrichment required;
the only bottleneck is running the cohort.

Q-031.subject: pharmacology.anticholinergic_risk_rem_vs_dose_independent_predictors
Q-031.title: Does the anticholinergic burden-dementia risk relationship track cumulative REM suppression duration (total ACh-blocked sleep years), total anticholinergic dose as a proxy for diurnal cholinergic deficit, or both as independent additive predictors -- and can mediation analysis in prospective cohorts distinguish the nocturnal (MECH-173) from the diurnal (MECH-175 pathway 2) contribution?
Q-031.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: the test domain is human pharmacological cohorts with
longitudinal PSG over years; no REE substrate, current or planned, settles
this -- it is not a wait-for-V4 item. External study design: a prospective
cohort with (1) annual PSG subset quantifying REM-suppression-years, (2)
anticholinergic burden scoring at each visit, (3) a dementia-conversion
endpoint, analysed with a structural equation model placing cumulative
REM-suppression (nocturnal / MECH-173 limb) and cumulative anticholinergic
dose (diurnal / MECH-175 Pathway 2 limb) as PARALLEL mediators of the
ACB->dementia path. CONFIRMS 'both independent additive predictors' if each
mediator carries a significant indirect effect that survives adjustment for
the other and the two indirect effects are roughly additive; CONFIRMS a single
dominant pathway if only one mediator's indirect effect is significant once
both are in the model. COLLAPSES the question (the third arm) if the two
mediators are statistically collinear in available cohorts so mediation cannot
separate them -- which is the current state, since Coupland 2019 and Gray 2015
lack PSG data. Per Grace 2014 the nocturnal mediator should be operationalised
as REM-transition reliability / REM-theta integrity, not total REM amount,
since pontine SubC scopolamine modulates transitions without abolishing REM.
The mediation sub-question has no published direct test; the right next step
is the cohort methodology above, NOT narrowing a REE claim.

Q-032.subject: pharmacology.sws_rem_ratio_dementia_outcome_predictor
Q-032.title: Among sleep-promoting medications prescribed in older adults, does relative SWS/REM ratio preservation (measured by polysomnography) predict differential dementia outcomes independent of total sleep time -- and if so, does this validate phase-specific pipeline damage as the causal intermediate and provide a pharmacodynamic biomarker for disease-modifying trials?
Q-032.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: requires PSG-stratified pharmacoepidemiology over years; no REE
experiment can test it. External study design: in an EHR cohort with linked
PSG records (e.g. SHHS or MrOS Sleep Study), or a prospective sleep-medication
cohort, use PSG-derived SWS/REM ratio (and SWS%, REM%, spindle density) as the
primary predictor of dementia conversion, with total sleep time as a
covariate, and contrast agents that preserve versus degrade the SWS/REM
profile at matched total sleep time. CONFIRMS the
phase-specific-pipeline-damage account (and validates SWS%/REM%/spindle
density as pharmacodynamic biomarkers per INV-048 / MECH-173 / MECH-174) if
two agents producing EQUAL total sleep time but different SWS/REM profiles
produce DIFFERENT dementia outcomes -- i.e. the architectural ratio predicts
conversion after total sleep time is partialled out (the Himali 2023
within-person SWS-decline design is the strongest available template, HR 1.27
per SWS-loss SD). REFUTES if dementia outcome tracks total sleep time alone
and the SWS/REM ratio adds no incremental predictive value once total sleep
time is controlled, leaving total sleep time a sufficient surrogate and
phase-fidelity unsupported as the causal intermediate. No prior trial has used
PSG-derived phase metrics as primary endpoints (COSMOS-MIND and FINGER-type
trials include sleep only as a non-PSG secondary domain); the canonical
pending interventional test is the REST trazodone trial. Out_of_domain -- a
research_anchor / clinical-cohort question, not a REE substrate experiment.

Q-033.subject: clinical.actigraphy_mel_mismatch_decompensation_forecasting
Q-033.title: Can long-run actigraphy data, combined with daily prediction error load estimates derived from passive behavioural, physiological, and subjective signals, be used to infer latent sleep-phase sufficiency relative to waking error burden, and can this mismatch index predict clinical decompensation type and timing with better specificity than total sleep time alone?
Q-033.what_would_answer:
A longitudinal clinical-cohort study (e.g. MCI patients, wrist actigraphy +
nocturnal HRV + skin-temperature rhythm + light exposure + daily
mood/cognitive-drift diary over ~6 months) that computes a weekly mismatch
index = estimated overnight update capacity (latent NREM/REM proportion +
fragmentation + circadian phase, inferred from the passive streams) minus
estimated daily MEL (prediction-error load from schedule complexity,
interpersonal contact, emotional salience, wake physiological reactivity).
ANSWER "yes" if (a) persistent negative mismatch predicts subsequent clinical
decompensation at the next monthly assessment with significantly better
specificity/AUC than total sleep time alone, AND (b) the TYPE of mismatch is
type-specific per MECH-179 -- NREM-deficit on high-episodic-load days predicts
memory-consolidation failure / rigidity, while REM-deficit on
high-emotional-load days predicts affective lability / paranoia -- i.e. the
mismatch index discriminates decompensation TYPE, not just timing. ANSWER "no"
if the mismatch index adds no specificity over total sleep time, OR if it
predicts timing but the NREM-vs-REM deficit split does not map to
episodic-vs-affective failure type (collapsing Q-033 to a generic sleep-debt
signal). HARD PRECONDITION: the latent sleep-phase estimator must demonstrably
recover NREM/REM proportion from actigraphy+HRV+temperature against a
polysomnography reference in a calibration subsample; if phase cannot be
inferred above chance, the mismatch index is uncomputable and any apparent
prediction is driven by raw actigraphy, not by sleep-phase sufficiency.
Out_of_domain: clinical-cohort test, not a V3-substrate run.

Q-034.subject: psychiatric.depression_threshold_parameter
Q-034.title: Does the hazard/resource ratio (not absolute harm intensity) determine the onset threshold for the computational depression attractor?
Q-034.what_would_answer:
An environmental-parameter sweep in CausalGridWorldV2 holding hazard_harm
constant and varying resource availability (num_resources / num_hazards),
measuring onset of the INV-053 depression attractor as a function of the
hazard/resource ratio rather than absolute harm intensity. ANSWER "yes -- the
ratio sets the threshold" if the attractor onset tracks a critical
hazard/resource ratio: a fixed hazard_harm level with sufficient resource
density does NOT enter the attractor while the SAME hazard_harm with
insufficient resources does, and the onset boundary in (hazard, resource)
space is a ratio iso-line rather than a horizontal hazard-intensity threshold.
ANSWER "no" if onset is governed by absolute hazard intensity independent of
resource density (a horizontal boundary), or if resource enrichment fails to
rescue at any fixed hazard level. HARD PRECONDITION (the EXQ-451 failure
mode): the agent must exhibit behavioural variation across the grid -- EXQ-451
produced goal_reach_rate=0.0 and action_class_entropy=0.0 in all 15/15 grid
points because V_s monostrategy lock-in (MECH-269) collapsed every cell into
one operating mode, making the sweep blind to any threshold. The test is
vacuous until MECH-269 V_s landing unlocks alternative operating modes so that
resource density can actually move behaviour; a sweep where every cell is
monostrategy-locked cannot answer the ratio-vs-intensity question regardless
of outcome.

Q-035.subject: play.frame_signal_minimal_architecture
Q-035.title: What is the minimal signal architecture for play frame maintenance: is a single bilateral open/close tag sufficient, or does ongoing signal exchange (a continuous play-face equivalent) need to be sustained throughout the episode?

Q-036.subject: harm_stream.affective_load_drivers
Q-036.title: What additional variables, beyond temporal integration, are required for affective harm to become a genuinely distinct load state: persistence, recovery failure, uncontrollability, inescapability, or prediction error?
Q-036.what_would_answer:
A discriminative-pair experiment that adds each candidate non-temporal
variable to the MECH-219 hysteretic integrator one at a time and tests whether
it produces a functionally distinct z_harm_a urgency signal beyond what
temporal integration alone yields. For each variable -- persistence of
exposure, recovery failure after offset, uncontrollability/inescapability,
prediction-error-weighted threat -- contrast a pair of episodes matched on
cumulative duration x intensity (so the pure temporal integrator is held
constant) but differing on that one variable. ANSWER "variable X is required"
if the matched pair produces a SEPARABLE z_harm_a / downstream-urgency
response (X-present vs X-absent differ beyond temporal-integration prediction)
AND the split is specific to z_harm_a (affective) while leaving z_harm_un
(sensory, SD-019a) unmodulated -- the controllability branch already meets
this bar (Loffler 2018 / Salomons 2004: controllability dissociates suffering
from intensity), and was carved out as candidate MECH-305. ANSWER "temporal
hysteresis is sufficient" for a given variable if duration-matched pairs are
indistinguishable on z_harm_a regardless of that variable, i.e. MECH-219 needs
no extra weighting term. NARROWED STATUS: controllability/escapability is
empirically settled (-> MECH-305); the SHARPER remaining test is whether
persistence, recovery-failure, and prediction-error weighting EACH
independently carve z_harm_a, or whether they collapse into the
controllability axis. HARD PRECONDITION: the substrate must support a z_harm_a
urgency readout that is not pinned -- if affective load shows no dynamic range
under matched temporal load, the discriminative pair is vacuous.

Q-037.subject: pathology.psychosis_substrate_dissociability
Q-037.title: Are the three psychosis substrate failure modes (MECH-094 tag-loss, MECH-222 self-attribution overflow, MECH-065/MECH-223 precision/bias) experimentally dissociable in the REE substrate?
Q-037.what_would_answer:
Run a triple-ablation dissociation: selectively induce each of the three
psychosis substrates -- MECH-094 tag-loss (open the post-commit write channel
during replay), MECH-222 self-attribution overflow (disable continuous z_self
residualization so self-content persists in z_world), MECH-065 precision-ratio
miscalibration (lower the RC-conflict threshold so external authority
overrides internal model) -- one at a time, leaving the others intact. Read
distinct behavioural signatures. ANSWER "dissociable" on BOTH legs: (A) each
ablation perturbs ONLY its own structural locus with the others measurably
unaffected, AND (B) the induced signatures match the predicted clinical
fingerprints (episodic replay-flooding for MECH-094, continuous
internally-consistent delusional logic for MECH-222, context-triggered
external-source paranoia for MECH-065), using the Lavalle 2020 OCD-vs-SCZ
source-monitoring dissociation as the readout template. ANSWER "not
dissociable" if ablations cross-contaminate or the signatures collapse onto
one phenotype. HARD PRECONDITION: ALL THREE mechanisms must be implemented and
each independently inducible with non-zero, separable effect before the
dissociation can be read; MECH-094 is implemented (V3-EXQ-499 PASS) but
MECH-222 / MECH-065 / MECH-223 status must be verified live and non-degenerate
first -- if any target is pinned or absent, the triple-ablation is vacuous.
The Corlett 2025 caveat (MECH-065 may need splitting) bears on leg (A) for
that arm specifically. V3-tractable in principle but gated on the upstream
three-mechanism cohort landing.

Q-038.subject: perception.dv_representational_status
Q-038.title: Is temporal-depth verisimilitude D_V explicitly represented as a signal or does it emerge from distributed dynamics without local representation?
Q-038.what_would_answer:
Build a discriminative probe pair on the TCL substrate (ARC-053): an
explicit-representation arm where temporal-depth verisimilitude D_V is read
out as a localised signal versus an emergent arm where D_V is only inferable
from distributed dynamics. Lesion / perturb the candidate local D_V locus and
measure whether D_V-dependent behaviour degrades. ANSWER "explicitly
represented" if a localised perturbation selectively abolishes D_V-graded
behaviour while leaving other temporal computations intact (Guan 2024 /
Gherman 2018 localised-signal analog). ANSWER "emergent / no local
representation" if no single locus carries D_V and the signal can only be
decoded from population dynamics that survive any local lesion (Pilkiw 2018
distributed-code analog). HARD PRECONDITION: the TCL substrate (ARC-053) and
the ARC-055 control-plane parameter map must exist -- neither is in V3
(implementation_phase=v4). Without the TCL there is no D_V to localise, so the
probe is undefined, not merely vacuous. Wait for the planned upstream
substrate: ARC-053 (TCL). Lit leans ~2:1 toward explicit (A) but the
architectural choice is consequential for ARC-055's explicit-availability
requirement, so hold for the substrate rather than accepting the lit lean.

Q-039.subject: architecture.tcl_control_parameters
Q-039.title: Which neuromodulatory or control-plane variables directly regulate temporal integration window and phase alignment sensitivity in the TCL?
Q-039.what_would_answer:
On the TCL substrate, run a pharmacology-analog double dissociation mapping
control-plane parameters to neuromodulator analogs: vary an ACh-analog gain
and an NA-analog gain independently and measure (i)
temporal-integration-window width and (ii) phase-alignment sensitivity in the
TCL. ANSWER (per the Kumagai 2023 VNS dissociation) "ACh gates integration
window, NA gates phase alignment" if the ACh-analog manipulation selectively
shifts the integration window (via gamma/beta gating) with phase-alignment
sensitivity unchanged, AND the NA-analog manipulation selectively shifts
phase-alignment (via theta organisation) with the window unchanged -- a clean
double dissociation. ANSWER "shared / cross-coupled control" if the two
manipulations move the same metric or fail to dissociate. Also resolve the
kappa_commit and beta_j mappings by the analogous selective-manipulation test.
HARD PRECONDITION: the TCL substrate (ARC-053) plus the ARC-055 parameter set
(alpha_S, alpha_A, tau_E2, H, kappa_commit, g_S) must exist and the
integration-window / phase-alignment metrics must be live and responsive --
none are in V3 (implementation_phase=v4), so there is no TCL operation to
modulate. Wait for the planned upstream substrate: ARC-053; the lit gives a
strong starting hypothesis (ACh->window, NA->phase) but cannot be REE-tested
until the TCL lands.

Q-040.subject: control.vs_generalisation_unblocks_dacc
Q-040.title: Is V_s generalisation to E1/E2 forward predictions (MECH-269b) the missing link that unblocks SD-032b dACC behavioural-revision (i.e. the wired-but-inert failure mode of EXQ-483/483a)?
Q-040.what_would_answer:
A factorial V3 experiment on the StepHarness-corrected, MECH-307-conjunction
substrate: {MECH-269b V_s->E1/E2-rollout gate OFF/ON} x {SD-032b dACC
adaptive-control OFF/ON}, with broadcast override + dACC + drive-modulation ON
in all arms and the MECH-295 liking-bridge wired (now landed, V3-EXQ-493
PASS), measuring approach_commit_rate and dACC-driven score-bias magnitude.
ANSWER "yes -- MECH-269b is the missing link" if and only if the MECH-269b=ON
x SD-032b=ON arm produces approach_commit_rate > 0 AND non-zero dACC
behavioural-adjustment magnitude, WHILE the MECH-269b=OFF arms remain pinned
at approach_commit_rate=0 -- a clean dissociation showing V_s generalisation
to the forward predictions is what releases the wired-but-inert freeze. ANSWER
"no -- necessary but not sufficient" if BOTH arms remain at
approach_commit_rate=0 even with MECH-269b=ON; that points the dominant
remaining blocker upstream at MECH-295 liking-bridge / cue projection (the
reading the prior cohort already favoured: EXQ-490b had C1 gate-firing PASS
but C2/C3 FAIL, and the EXQ-536b force-arm probe at fraction=1.0 still gave
approach_commit_rate=0). SHARPER follow-on (Q-040c): in the MECH-269b=ON arm,
dACC weight-delta should correlate with |precision-weighted forward-PE| and be
~zero in the OFF arm -- a non-zero correlation confirms the mechanism, not
just the endpoint. HARD PRECONDITIONS: (i) the four-gap StepHarness wiring
fault must be corrected (the bare-except swallowed update_z_goal TypeError
that left GoalState.is_active always False contaminated the EXQ-471/483/490
cohort); (ii) the symmetric-V_s gate must actually fire (c1_on_total_held > 0
on >=2/3 seeds) or the behavioural legs are uninterpretable; (iii) the
V_s-monostrategy lock-in must be cleared so any arm can express variation.
Absent these the run self-routes substrate-not-ready, not a verdict.

Q-041.subject: control.unified_threshold_supervisor
Q-041.title: Does REE require a unified meta-level threshold supervisor that adapts pass/fail and commit/release thresholds across substrates from system-wide instability metrics, or do the existing scattered adaptive loci (ARC-016 dynamic precision, SD-032c AIC interoceptive baseline EMA, SD-032d PCC stability scalar, SD-032e pACC drive bias) produce coherent meta-stability under chronic load without a supervisor?
Q-041.what_would_answer:
A V3 chronic-load diagnostic that drives the agent at sustained high load
(e.g. drive_level~0.9 for ~1000 steps) and measures cross-substrate threshold
coherence: track the effective E3 commit threshold, the effective beta-gate
release threshold, the AIC (SD-032c) switch threshold, and the dACC (SD-032b)
pe_cap normaliser, and test whether they move along a shared low-dimensional
trajectory or independently. ANSWER "no separate supervisor needed -- the
scattered loci self-coordinate" (PASS-coherent) if the four threshold
time-series collapse onto a shared low-dimensional manifold (high
cross-substrate correlation / dominant single principal component consistent
with a hidden joint instability signal) under chronic load, i.e. ARC-016 +
SD-032c/d/e produce coherent meta-stability without aggregation. ANSWER "a
unified supervisor is required" (PASS-independent) if the thresholds drift
independently (low cross-correlation, no shared component, divergent setpoints
under sustained load) -- this licenses promotion of an SD cluster: a
cross-substrate volatility tracker (Behrens-2007-style joint PE estimator
emitting a system-level learning-rate), a sleep-mediated MECH-204 writeback
path (Tononi-Cirelli SHY recalibration -- currently MECH-204 captures the
precision zero-point at REM entry but discards it), and a joint setpoint-drift
mechanism beyond SD-032e's drive_level-only scope. HARD PRECONDITION: the
scattered loci must each be live and non-degenerate before their coherence can
be read -- ARC-016, SD-032b/c are currently non_contributory under the
V_s-monostrategy lock-in (MECH-269 unlanded), so the threshold series are
pinned and the coherence test is vacuous until the substrate unlocks
alternative operating modes. The V3-vs-V4 placement (a slow EMA-of-EMAs
supervisor is V3-feasible; the full sleep-writeback supervisor needs V4
sleep-substrate enrichment MECH-285/286/INV-049) is itself part of what
PASS-independent resolves.

Q-042.subject: control.precision_update_call_site
Q-042.title: Should the running-variance / dynamic-precision update fire at action-selection time (early, control-plane-coupled), at outcome-integration time (late, residue-coupled, current location), or at both? Equivalently: is the StepHarness contract that requires experiment loops to call agent.update_residue() each step sufficient, or does ARC-016 precision need a call site that is structurally guaranteed to fire whenever the agent is selecting actions?

Q-043.subject: policy.diversity_generation.relative_weight_calibration
Q-043.title: How should the relative weights of MECH-313 (stochastic noise floor / LC-NE tonic analog) and MECH-314 (structured curiosity bonus / frontopolar curiosity) be calibrated for V3 substrates? Falsifiable with parametric sweep on SD-054 reef substrate plus ARC-062 gated-policy.
Q-043.what_would_answer:
A parametric (w_313, w_314) weight sweep on the SD-054 reef substrate with
ARC-062 gated-policy enabled, measuring behavioural diversity
(action-distribution entropy at probe states; reef-vs-forage occupancy CoV)
and task reward JOINTLY, then locating the Pareto frontier. ANSWER
"calibration resolved" if a Pareto frontier exists with a consistent (w_313
noise-floor, w_314 structured-curiosity) regime across seeds where both
diversity and reward are simultaneously high -- the mixing ratio that avoids
MECH-313 swamping the rule-discriminative signal and MECH-314 overcommitting
to information-gain at task-reward cost. ANSWER "no calibration zone --
architectural defect" if no Pareto frontier exists, indicating the two
mechanisms do not compose additively in the policy gradient as designed. HARD
PRECONDITION (the decisive blocker, confirmed twice): the swept knobs must
have AUTHORITY over E3 selection. V3-EXQ-605 found the curiosity dimension
fully degenerate (curiosity_scale 1x/5x/10x byte-identical per-cell entropy)
and V3-EXQ-667 found 4/5 seeds byte-identical across full 8x joint scaling
(healthy-seed h_pos range 0.017 < 0.05 floor) -- the knobs have ZERO authority
at E3.select on the current substrate, so any sweep is vacuous and self-routes
substrate_not_ready_requeue. The sweep becomes meaningful only after
modulatory-bias-selection-authority (V3-EXQ-663/643a) and ARC-065 GAP-A (the
behavioral_diversity_isolation conversion ceiling, V3-EXQ-649/569i) clear so
that w_313/w_314 actually move committed behaviour. Also re-confirm the
Phase-1 separate-module placement holds at queue time -- if MECH-314 has
migrated into GatedPolicy as a per-head bonus, the meaning of "relative
weight" changes and the sweep design must be revised.

Q-044.subject: policy.curiosity.subflavour_independence
Q-044.title: Are MECH-314a (striatal novelty), MECH-314b (frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity), and MECH-314c (learning-progress curiosity) three distinct substrates with independent contributions, or three different readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs (e.g., novelty as a special case of uncertainty as a special case of learning progress)?
Q-044.what_would_answer:
A three-arm ablation (MECH-314a striatal-novelty OFF, MECH-314b
frontopolar-uncertainty OFF, MECH-314c learning-progress OFF) on a substrate
that produces DISTINGUISHABLE novelty / uncertainty / learning-progress
signatures, reading the failure signature of each ablation. ANSWER "three
distinct substrates -- retain all as load-bearing" if each ablation produces a
SEPARABLE, non-overlapping degradation (314a-OFF degrades novelty-driven
exploration, 314b-OFF degrades uncertainty-driven exploration, 314c-OFF
degrades learning-progress tracking) that the other two do not rescue. ANSWER
"314c discardable" if 314a+314b ablations span the failure space and 314c-OFF
adds no distinct signature (retire 314c). ANSWER "all collapse to one
mechanism" if the three ablations yield ONE indistinguishable signature
(collapse to a single MECH-314). HARD PRECONDITION (the structural blocker,
verified 2026-05-25): MECH-314a's per-candidate output must carry real
across-K spread. Today E2 world-forward compresses K=32 diverse first-action
candidates to identical first-step z_world (cand_world_pairwise_dist=0.0000),
so MECH-314a's per-candidate RBF novelty -- though correctly composed into
score_bias at e3_selector.py:737 -- emits a uniform [K] vector that is
mathematically broadcast-equivalent, making it INDISTINGUISHABLE from the
314b/c broadcast-scalar arms the test is meant to isolate it against
(reproducing the bit-identical V3-EXQ-590a/604/604a null where
curiosity_bias_abs_mean=0.0 across all arms). The ablation is vacuous until
one of: (a) the GAP-B first-action one-hot bypass extends to ALL bias-channel
consumers of first-step z_world (not just GatedPolicy); (b) E2 world-forward
is fixed to preserve per-action z_world divergence at K=32; or (c) MECH-314a
sources novelty from a per-candidate-varying signal (action-conditioned z_self
delta / candidate-trajectory hash). SD-056 contrastive divergence (landed)
restored candidate pairwise_dist > 0.03 but NOT selection authority -- the
modulatory bias still has zero authority at E3.select, so confirm both
candidate-divergence AND bias-authority hold before queuing.

Q-045.subject: policy.anti_monostrategy.substrate_independence_lc_vs_dacc
Q-045.title: Is MECH-313 (LC-NE tonic noise floor) a separate parameter from MECH-260 (dACC anti-recency penalty), or do they collapse into one anti-monostrategy substrate? Falsifiable with the four-arm ablation: both-OFF / 313-only / 260-only / both-ON, on SD-054 reef substrate with ARC-062 gated-policy enabled.
Q-045.what_would_answer:
The four-arm ablation (both-OFF / 313-only / 260-only / both-ON) on SD-054
with ARC-062 gated-policy enabled, with a behavioural-diversity ranking
deciding whether MECH-313 (state-independent noise floor) and MECH-260
(state-dependent dACC anti-recency) are mutually load-bearing (both-ON >
{313-only, 260-only} > both-OFF), one dominates (a singleton indistinguishable
from both-ON => the other is contributory-not-necessary), or DIRECTIONALLY
COUPLED (both-ON is NOT the linear superposition of the singletons -- the
Tervo LC->ACC asymmetry; per the 2026-05-11 lit-pull R4 this needs the 8-cell
extension, 4-arm x 2-LC-amplitude, or an explicit LC->ACC coupling-ablation
cell). BUT the right response on the current substrate is SUBSTRATE
ENRICHMENT, not a verdict: the 603/603a-e chain repeatedly produced effective
N=1 (2/3 seeds with measured_steps=0 below the 75-step FIFO warmup; z_goal
pinned at zero) so the collapse question is structurally untestable -- a
substrate_ceiling, not a falsification. HARD PRECONDITION the enriched
substrate must meet before this falsifier is authorised: (1) a trained-policy
regime that survives SD-054 enrichment (proximity_harm_scale=0.1 kill channel)
past the FIFO warmup on >=2/3 seeds, giving a P2 measurement window with
effective N>=2; (2) a non-trivial z_goal that actually forms under standard V3
training (z_goal_enabled=True, drive_weight=2.0, reward-contact history
present -- not zero-init, the 603e developmental prerequisite); (3) BOTH
MECH-313 and MECH-260 verified operative on the surviving seeds
(dacc.record_action() reached, FIFO non-empty -- the 603 call-path bypass
falsified). Only once a run clears all three with live cross-arm diversity
variance does the behavioural-diversity ranking discriminate the
collapse-vs-distinct outcome; until then the claim stays substrate_ceiling /
pending_retest_after_substrate and the unblocker is V3 goal-pipeline /
scaffolded-onboarding enrichment, not a V4 deferral.

Q-048.subject: play.frame_content_sensorimotor_constructive
Q-048.title: During sensorimotor and constructive play, is a persistent background signal (L2) sufficient for frame integrity monitoring, or are explicit mid-episode repair signals (L3) also required?
Q-048.what_would_answer:
Ablate the L3 mid-episode repair signal during simple (sensorimotor /
constructive) play episodes and measure frame-integrity under perturbation.
Arms: (1) L2 background play_frame_tag only (L3 repair OFF); (2) L2 + L3
repair ON. Perturb mid-episode (partner stops contingent responding for k
ticks, or the compositional goal is briefly violated) and measure
frame-collapse rate (fraction of episodes where play_frame_tag drops and is
not re-established) plus time-to-recovery. ANSWER 'L2 sufficient for simple
play' if the L2-only arm shows no significant increase in frame-collapse rate
vs L2+L3 under perturbation (delta below an absolute floor, >=2/3 seeds) --
the persistent background signal alone holds the frame for low-ambiguity
content. ANSWER 'L3 also required' if L2-only collapses (or fails to recover)
significantly more often than L2+L3, with the gap scaling on perturbation
strength. HARD PRECONDITION: the perturbation must actually stress frame
integrity -- the L2+L3 arm must itself show non-zero collapse/recovery events
under perturbation, else the test is vacuous (nothing to repair) and routes to
a stronger-perturbation re-design rather than a 'sufficient' verdict.

Q-049.subject: play.frame_content_pretend_cotag
Q-049.title: Does pretend play require the hypothesis tag (MECH-094) and play frame tag (ARC-049) to be continuously co-active throughout the episode, or do they merely need to be co-active at the moment of object substitution?
Q-049.what_would_answer:
Compare two co-tag regimes for pretend play in V3: (1) CONTINUOUS co-tag --
hypothesis_tag (MECH-094) and play_frame_tag (ARC-049) held co-active for
every step of the pretend episode; (2) EVENT-ONLY co-tag -- the two tags
co-active only at the moment of object substitution, otherwise allowed to
lapse. Run matched pretend episodes requiring object substitution under
perturbation (reality intrusions, competing literal-use affordances) and
measure policy quality and false-commit rate (committing to the
literal/non-pretend interpretation when the pretend frame should hold). ANSWER
'continuous co-tag required' if the event-only arm shows a significantly
higher false-commit rate or degraded pretend-policy quality (>=1 SD-of-delta,
absolute floor, >=2/3 seeds), i.e. the decoupling lapses between substitution
events and reference/truth/existence relations leak back. ANSWER 'event-only
sufficient' if event-only matches continuous on false-commit and policy
quality. HARD PRECONDITION: both tags must be operative and the substitution
event must be detectable in the trace (non-zero co-tag activation at
substitution); if the event-only arm never actually drops co-activity between
events the two arms are identical and the test is vacuous.

Q-050.subject: play.frame_content_games_rules_dual_level
Q-050.title: Do games-with-rules require per-step dual-level content monitoring (rule compliance + strategic rationality simultaneously), or does sequential sampling across turns suffice?
Q-050.what_would_answer:
In a multi-agent games-with-rules environment, contrast a per-step dual-level
monitor (rule-compliance AND strategic-rationality scored every turn, Schmidt
2015) against a sequential-sampling monitor (the two levels interleaved across
turns, not simultaneous). Introduce partner moves that violate ONLY rules,
ONLY strategic rationality, and both. ANSWER "per-step dual-level required" if
the sequential-sampling arm misses or lags on violations that fall on the
level it is not currently sampling -- detection latency or accuracy strictly
worse on mixed/fast-alternating violations -- while the per-step arm catches
them. ANSWER "sequential sampling suffices" if interleaved sampling matches
per-step detection across violation types. HARD PRECONDITION: a genuine
multi-agent substrate that GENERATES strategic violations is required (a
partner that can defect or play irrationally). The V3 degenerate case is an
experimenter-complicit environment that never produces strategic violations,
so neither level can be stressed and the contrast is vacuous (depends_on
ARC-049 / MECH-197 play substrate, Q-035). Wait for the planned upstream V4
multi-agent substrate; suggested_experiment_type multi_agent_behavioral.

Q-051.subject: play.frame_content_cooperative_bilateral
Q-051.title: Does cooperative play require a continuous bilateral background signal (L2) plus explicit repair at ambiguity (L3), or do one-sided frame-open/close events (L1 only) suffice for cooperative frame maintenance?
Q-051.what_would_answer:
In a cooperative-play environment with role-switching across extended
episodes, ablate the frame-maintenance machinery to three levels: L1-only
(one-sided open/close frame events), L1+L2 (add a continuous bilateral
background signal), and L1+L2+L3 (add explicit repair at ambiguity from both
parties). Inject frame ambiguity and role-switch points. ANSWER "full L1+L2+L3
required" if the L1-only arm produces frame mismatch that degrades cooperation
worse than no-frame baseline (Ham 2024: mismatch is worse than absence) while
the L2/L3 arm recovers, AND repair events at ambiguity measurably restore
alignment. ANSWER "L1 suffices" if one-sided open/close events maintain
bilateral alignment as well as the full stack across role-switches. HARD
PRECONDITION: bilateral role/goal-state monitoring requires a multi-agent
substrate with two parties that each assert and repair frames and that can
role-switch -- INV-059 frames unilateral assertion as manipulation, so a
single-agent or experimenter-complicit V3 env cannot generate the bilateral
mismatch the test needs (vacuous). Wait for the planned upstream V4
multi-agent substrate (depends_on ARC-049 / MECH-197 / INV-059 / Q-035).

Q-052.subject: learning.forward_model_dominance_magnitude_vs_structural_plasticity
Q-052.title: Is forward-model dominance in E3 scoring a magnitude calibration problem solvable by 5-10x diversity bias scaling, or a structural plasticity dominance problem requiring phase-specific learning rate asymmetry as per MECH-333/334?
Q-052.what_would_answer:
Distinguish three readings of F's 88-89% E3-scoring-variance monopoly
(V3-EXQ-571) via the ARC-065 diversity stack. (A) MAGNITUDE: apply a one-time
5-10x static bias_scale to MECH-313/314/320 diversity signals; ANSWER (A) if
the entropy lift PERSISTS stably across extended training with no regression
-- competitive parity restored without temporal gating, MECH-333/334 not
required. (B) STRUCTURAL PLASTICITY: ANSWER (B) if entropy lifts then
regresses under continued training (F re-consolidates and out-competes),
requiring phase-specific learning-rate asymmetry (MECH-333/334). (C) PERIODIC
RESET: if (A) fails but a Nikishin-style periodic reset of the last N
action-selector layers (replay buffer preserved) restores diversity, the
minimal open-phase fix suffices short of full plasticity scheduling.
DIAGNOSTIC GATE: first check whether the MECH-313/314/320 diversity signals
are themselves F-error-dependent (Pathak 2017 ICM self-extinction) -- if so,
Q-052 resolves to (B) regardless of the magnitude result because the signal
source decays as F consolidates. HARD PRECONDITION: the diversity signals must
reach E3 with live, non-zero bias_fraction under the rescale -- on the current
substrate all diversity bias_fractions are pinned at 0.000, so a magnitude arm
that cannot move bias_fraction off zero is a vacuous read (the channel is
silent, not refuted). The committed/behavioural leg is additionally MECH-439
conversion-ceiling-gated; read at rule_state / scoring-variance upstream of
the F-dominated commit.

Q-053.subject: goal.licit_persistence_gate_signal
Q-053.title: What is the licit gate signal for goal persistence (the MECH-340 control/efficacy detector that holds a ghost-goal entry re-probe-eligible) -- and is any explicit hard trace-erase operation needed at all, or does ungated MECH-292 rank-decay of a preserved SD-039 trace suffice?
Q-053.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated by a substrate-design decision plus a falsifier EXQ that induces
the three MECH-340 control/efficacy-detector failure signatures and contrasts
candidate gate signals for goal persistence. Front-runner to test: an internal
control/efficacy-unattainability APPRAISAL gated on value-integration
integrity (Wrosch 2003 input semantics + Maier & Seligman 2016 form). ANSWER
the gate-signal leg by which candidate, when supplied as the
hold/re-probe-eligibility trigger, reproduces adaptive disengage-and-reengage
WITHOUT reproducing a documented pathology -- the ruled-out signals
(accumulated failure -> learned helplessness; bare effort-cost -> apathy;
MECH-292 staleness alone -> incubation sign-inversion; within-crisis devalued
value -> symptom-not-cause) must each re-derive their pathology, confirming
they are not the licit gate. Resolve the two split sub-questions empirically:
(a) trace-erase -- ANSWER "no explicit hard-erase needed" if ungated MECH-292
rank-decay of a PRESERVED SD-039 trace matches Bouton preserve-don't-erase
recovery; (b) dedicated disengage op -- ANSWER "separate op required" (lean
YES, Koster 2011) if getting disengagement 'for free' by tuning MECH-292
persistence/recoverability knobs reproduces the
rumination/impaired-disengagement pathology. CRITICAL SHAPE CONSTRAINT
(Klinger 1975): the gate must open a brief affectively-signed,
reengagement-COUPLED disengagement STATE, not a one-shot bit-flip -- a bare
abandon-without-redirect re-derives the purpose-vacuum pathology and is
falsified. HARD PRECONDITION: MECH-340's three failure signatures must be
inducible and separable on the substrate, and the SD-039 trace + MECH-292
rank-decay must be live, before any candidate gate can be discriminated; no
experiment is queued yet and the narrowing so far is STRUCTURAL
(biology-before-formal-definitions), not experimental -- lit_conf is a
parallel signal and must not be read as a result.

Q-054.subject: policy.diversity_generation.arc062_minimum_diversity_floor
Q-054.title: What is the minimum trajectory-class diversity floor (Rung 1 first_action_entropy threshold) required for the ARC-062 context discriminator to learn a reliable discriminative cut between reef and foraging contexts? Is the current SP-CEM entropy lift of 0.497 nats sufficient, or is a higher floor required? (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as Q-046 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md; never registered; re-registered under next available Q-id.)
Q-054.what_would_answer: A parametric entropy sweep (noise_floor_min_temperature, curiosity_novelty_weight) over the SD-054 substrate that plots ARC-062 context-discriminator accuracy against upstream Rung-1 first_action_entropy and locates the floor: the entropy value below which discriminator accuracy is at chance and above which it rises monotonically. The question is answered when that floor is bracketed -- i.e. it is established whether the observed SP-CEM lift of 0.497 nats sits above the floor (sufficient) or below it (insufficient). NOTE (2026-06-15): cleanly answering this presupposes the behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A conversion ceiling is lifted -- while committed behaviour does not move with the channel range (569g/682), discriminator accuracy cannot be read as a function of realised first_action_entropy.

Q-055.subject: policy.sleep_consolidation.diversity_effect
Q-055.title: Does sleep consolidation (SD-017 SWS phase) preserve the trajectory- class diversity achieved by ARC-065 during waking, or does Hebbian winner- take-all dynamics during replay erode it? Is sleep a net positive or net negative for learned behavioural diversity? (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as Q-047 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md; never registered; re-registered under next available Q-id.)
Q-055.what_would_answer:
A Rung-3 experiment measuring trajectory-class diversity (TrajDiv) and
total-variation occupancy (TV) at three time points: post-waking-convergence
(ARC-065 diversity established), post-200-no-exploration episodes (waking
re-seeding controlled out), and post-5-sleep-cycles (SD-017 SWS replay
applied). ANSWER "sleep is net negative -- replay erodes diversity" if
TrajDiv/TV decline across the 5 sleep cycles relative to the no-exploration
baseline, consistent with MECH-120 Hebbian winner-take-all preferentially
strengthening the most-heavily-weighted trajectories -- this FALSIFIES
MECH-120-as-sufficient and forces ARC-065 to also operate during consolidation
(a new MECH). ANSWER "sleep is net positive / neutral -- diversity preserved"
if TrajDiv/TV are maintained across sleep cycles, supporting SD-017 + INV-049
and consistent with either counter-mechanism (waking re-seeding between
cycles, OR replay deliberately sampling proportional to class distribution
rather than top-reward). ANSWER "sleep INCREASES diversity" (surprising) if
TrajDiv/TV rise across cycles, indicating broader episodic-replay sampling
than top-reward priority. The decisive contrast is the post-sleep vs
post-no-exploration delta, which isolates the sleep-replay effect from passive
waking drift. HARD PRECONDITION: ARC-065 must have established a
non-degenerate waking diversity baseline (multiple trajectory classes with
measurable TrajDiv) before any sleep cycle -- if waking diversity is already
collapsed (the GAP-A conversion ceiling), there is no diversity for replay to
preserve or erode and the erosion test is vacuous. SD-017 SWS replay and the
MECH-120 Hebbian path must both be live in the offline phase, or the no-op
trivially "preserves" diversity without evidence.

Q-056.subject: control_plane.stuck_gated_vs_constant_proposal_entropy
Q-056.title: Does stuck-state-GATED proposal entropy outperform BOTH entropy-off and always-high entropy? Main empirical prediction of MECH-343: in a hard-goal/blocked-path environment (matched easy-goal controls), the difficulty-gated-entropy arm should show flexible exploration -- improved goal progress, no harm increase, no random-churn increase, commitment latency that rises during the hard phase then falls after solution discovery -- and should BEAT both the entropy-off arm (proposal rigidity / stuck) and the entropy-always-high arm (disorganised exploration / no narrowing). WORKING QUESTION -- no evidence yet.
Q-056.what_would_answer:
The discriminating four-arm comparison for MECH-343, on a hard-goal /
blocked-path environment with matched easy-goal controls (per EXP-0176): (1)
entropy-gating OFF; (2) entropy-gating ON under stuck-state; (3) entropy
ALWAYS high; (4) entropy high with goal/harm constraints ablated (diagnostic
only, if safe). Metrics: candidate-proposal entropy, committed-action entropy,
score-margin distribution, arbitration cycles before commitment, goal
progress, harm rate, action churn, time-to-first-workable-path, post-success
entropy reduction. ANSWER 'stuck-gated entropy is the right regime' (MECH-343
supported) if arm 2 STRICTLY beats BOTH arm 1 (entropy-off, which should show
proposal rigidity / stuck) AND arm 3 (always-high, which should show
disorganised exploration with no narrowing) on goal progress, with NO harm
increase and NO random-churn increase, and a commitment-latency that rises
during the hard phase then FALLS after solution discovery (the post-success
entropy narrowing). ANSWER 'no advantage to gating' if arm 2 is
indistinguishable from arm 1 or arm 3 on goal progress, or if it buys progress
at the cost of harm/churn, or if entropy does not narrow after success. HARD
PRECONDITION (non-vacuity): the hard-goal environment must actually induce
stuck states in arm 1 (measurable proposal-entropy collapse / time-to-path
blow-up) and the gate must fire differentially (arm 2 entropy tracks
stuck-state, not flat); if arm 1 never gets stuck or the gate never engages,
the contrast is vacuous and self-routes to a harder environment, not a
verdict.

Q-057.subject: development.exploratory_overconnectivity_vs_mature_sparsity
Q-057.title: Should REE distinguish an early over-connected exploratory developmental substrate from a mature sparse/structured substrate -- and is developmental sparsification best modelled as deletion, down-weighting, gating, or residue-tagged de-authorization?
Q-057.what_would_answer:
Resolve in two parts on a developmental substrate (V4/V5). Architecture leg:
contrast an early over-connected exploratory substrate against a mature
sparse/structured one and ANSWER "distinguish the two regimes" if the
over-connected regime shows immature single-cue authority (one cue can release
action) that the mature regime replaces with convergent-weak-input recall
(action release requires multiple weak inputs to converge) -- i.e. REE-v3's
cue-authority problem is partly a developmental-immaturity signature, not a
fixed design flaw. Mechanism leg: implement developmental sparsification as
each of deletion / down-weighting / gating / residue-tagged de-authorization
and ANSWER which matches biology by whether the trace is recoverable after
sparsification (deletion is irreversible;
down-weighting/gating/residue-de-authorization preserve a re-instatable trace)
and whether offline integration acts as pruning/contextualisation rather than
mere consolidation. HARD PRECONDITION: an upstream developmental substrate
with an explicit immature->mature trajectory and developmental gates on
memory-trace action-influence must exist (depends_on ARC-019 / MECH-362, CA3
developmental intake) -- this is absent in V3 and the claim is explicitly
V4/V5-parked, so DO NOT queue against it in V3 (the regimes cannot be
instantiated, the contrast is undefined). Wait for the planned upstream
developmental substrate before reading either leg.

Q-058.subject: cognifold.explicit_vs_emergent_competition_scope
Q-058.title: Which REE subsystems require an EXPLICIT signed competitive edge (ARC-084) rather than emergent softmax / winner-take-all / scalar-gating competition alone -- and what are the safety differences between inhibition, competition, decommitment, and residue-based veto across waking action, simulation, and offline integration?
Q-058.what_would_answer:
Answered substrate-side, not by a V3 grid-world run. Build the ARC-084
typed-signed-coupling cognifold (signed edges with sign<0 competition as a
first-class generative mode) and, per inter-field edge, run an ablation:
replace the EXPLICIT signed-competitive edge with the existing emergent local
softmax / WTA / scalar-gating (MECH-090/ARC-030/MECH-254) and measure modular
segregation, runaway-resonance onset, and boundary preservation. ANSWER 'this
subsystem REQUIRES an explicit signed edge' if removing it collapses
segregation / triggers over-synchronisation that the softmax alternative
cannot recover (MECH-363's instability prediction realised); ANSWER 'emergent
competition suffices here' if the softmax arm matches the signed-edge arm on
stability and behaviour. The safety sub-question is answered by mapping which
of {inhibition, competition, decommitment MECH-090/MECH-105, residue-veto
SD-010/SD-011} actually fires across waking / simulation MECH-094 /
offline-integration MECH-272-273 and showing whether they are dissociable.
HARD PRECONDITION: the signed-coupling substrate (ARC-084) must EXIST and its
competitive edges must carry non-zero gain -- a cognifold with only
positive/cooperative edges, or with the competitive sign present but pinned at
zero gain, cannot discriminate explicit-vs-emergent and yields a vacuous null.
This is V4/V5; off the V3 critical path. The right response now is to wait for
/ design the ARC-084 substrate, NOT to queue a V3 experiment.

Q-059.subject: social_guardrails.crying_analogue_and_laughter_valence
Q-059.title: Does REE need a crying / distress-vocalisation social-guardrail analogue to laughter (MECH-110 / MECH-364), and how is social laughter adjudicated as social-field repair vs damage/exclusion -- given that laughter is not monotone-affiliative (it can exclude, dominate, mask distress, or signal threat)?
Q-059.what_would_answer:
Answered only against a social substrate that does not yet exist. Build the
social-field substrate that gives REE multi-agent affiliation / exclusion
dynamics, then (1) for the crying analogue: add a candidate high-arousal
distress-vocalisation signal alongside laughter (MECH-110/MECH-364) and ablate
it -- ANSWER 'a distinct distress/crying claim is warranted' if REE without it
fails to recruit social repair / care-elicitation in states where laughter
cannot fire (e.g. unresolvable threat), and the laughter mechanism alone
leaves a coverage gap on the social-release/guardrail axis; ANSWER 'no
separate claim needed' if the existing INV-058 distress-vocalisation entry
plus laughter already span the axis. (2) For laughter valence: instrument
social laughter in repair vs damage/exclusion contexts and test whether REE
adjudicates it -- ANSWER 'laughter is correctly non-monotone-affiliative' if
the same laughter signal is scored as field-repair in one context and as
exclusion/dominance/masking in another, tracking the social field-state,
rather than always reading affiliative. HARD PRECONDITION: a non-degenerate
social field with at least two agents and a representable
affiliation/exclusion gradient must exist; with a single-agent grid-world
there is no social field for laughter valence to be repair-vs-damage WITHIN,
so any read is vacuous. V4/V5; off the V3 critical path. Wait for the social
substrate (the planned ARC-059 social spine extension); do NOT queue a V3
experiment.

Q-060.subject: memory.autobiographical_vs_semantic_type_distinction
Q-060.title: Should REE represent autobiographical event memory as a DISTINCT first-class type, separate from semantic (abstract facts/relations) and task/procedural (policies/action schemas) memory -- or is the existing episodic->semantic consolidation pathway (MECH-121) sufficient? The case material motivates the distinction (TL separates emotion-tagged 'life memory' from neutral encyclopedic 'black memory'), but REE has no memory-type taxonomy claim.
Q-060.what_would_answer: The ARC-085 joint-degradation falsifier (a V4 experiment, once the unified store exists): corrupt the shared event-token store and measure past-recall vs future-simulation fidelity. If both degrade TOGETHER, the single tagged/indexed store holds (confirms the tag reading). If they degrade INDEPENDENTLY, autobiographical and episodic-prospective draw on separable stores -- reopening Q-060 toward a distinct first-class type. Until that V4 experiment is possible the answer is the design adjudication above.

Q-061.subject: failure_modes.depressive_regime_reversibility
Q-061.title: Is a maladaptive depressive network-regime (MECH-367) REVERSIBLE -- reconfigurable by REE's existing repair machinery (offline integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing, decommitment from ruminative loops, re-access to social affordances, goal-stream re-coupling) -- or does chronicity lock the regime past a threshold (RA-001) such that the repair routes that work early fail or reverse-sign late?
Q-061.what_would_answer:
Answered by a duration-graded repair comparison once the MECH-367
depressive-regime vector substrate exists (V4/V5 -- DO NOT queue a V3
experiment). Induce a maladaptive depressive network-regime, then apply REE's
existing repair routes (offline-integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing,
decommitment from ruminative loops, social-affordance re-access, goal-stream
re-coupling) at TWO chronicity points: EARLY (pre-threshold) and LATE (past
the RA-001 ~24-month-analog chronicity threshold). The discriminating
observation is whether the SAME repair routes reconfigure the regime in both
windows. ANSWER 'reversible / not threshold-locked' if late repair recovers
the regime toward baseline connectivity and goal-coupling with the same routes
that work early (no sign reversal, recovery magnitude comparable). ANSWER
'chronicity locks the regime' if the routes that reconfigure the early regime
FAIL late, or REVERSE sign late (consistent with the RA-001
connectivity-vs-severity sign flip and the MECH-124 self-amplifying
consolidation loop), implying late repair needs a different mechanism. HARD
PRECONDITION: the induced regime must be a genuine self-sustaining attractor
(persists without ongoing stressor) and the late point must be past the RA-001
threshold, else 'early' and 'late' are the same regime and the
duration-dependence question is untestable. ANTI-OVERCLAIM GUARD: a positive
result does NOT license asserting depression is 'merely a reversible software
state'.

Q-062.subject: plasticity.write_eligible_state_necessity
Q-062.title: Is an EXPLICIT event-level write-eligible state (MECH-368) actually needed, or is the existing combination -- MECH-261 mode-conditioned channel gating + MECH-094 provenance gating + MECH-285 consolidation-priority by V_s residual -- already sufficient to prevent undifferentiated global model updates? This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.
Q-062.what_would_answer:
This is the explicit falsifier for MECH-368. Once a durable model-update
substrate with an OPEN online write channel exists (E1/E2 world-model + policy
weights writable during waking, not just episodic memory), run a 2-arm
ablation on a task that interleaves real distractor events with genuinely
model-relevant ones: ARM_baseline = channel-gating (MECH-261 mode) +
provenance gating (MECH-094) + offline consolidation-priority (MECH-285) ONLY;
ARM_368 = the same PLUS the per-event write-eligibility gate
f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance,
plasticity_eligibility). Measure catastrophic interference on the online
world-model/policy path (retention of prior competence after a burst of
high-PE distractor events). ANSWER 'MECH-368 earns its keep' if ARM_368
strictly reduces interference / preserves prior competence above ARM_baseline;
ANSWER 'no -- the existing combination suffices' (MECH-368 falsified) if
ARM_baseline already avoids catastrophic interference with no measurable gap.
HARD PRECONDITION: the online write channel must be genuinely OPEN and capable
of producing interference -- if mode-gating + provenance already keep the
channel closed in this task so no undifferentiated update can occur, both arms
score identically by construction and the test is vacuous; you need a task
where the baseline DOES admit writes that could corrupt the model. V4/V5; off
the V3 critical path. Wait for the model-update/online-write substrate; do NOT
queue a V3 experiment.
