Q-063.subject: compulsion.modulator_trapped_vs_valued_goal
Q-063.title: How does REE distinguish a high-value, legitimately-repeated goal from a slow-modulator-trapped compulsive loop -- i.e. a loop that persists because the decommit-friction / threshold landscape is biased (MECH-369) rather than because the goal is valued? What diagnostic separates value-driven persistence from field-state-driven stickiness, and can offline integration reduce loop stickiness without erasing legitimate residue (INV-004/INV-006 firewall)?
Q-063.what_would_answer:
Answered against the MECH-369 slow-modulatory-state substrate (V4/V5), not a
V3 run. Build the slow-modulator field that biases the decommit-friction /
threshold landscape, then run a 2x2: {goal value HIGH / LOW} x {modulator bias
ABSENT / PRESENT}, and read the candidate diagnostics. ANSWER "value-driven
persistence and modulator-trapped stickiness are separable" if a diagnostic
dissociates the cells: specifically (a) z_goal salience / expected-value is
HIGH in the valued-repeat cell but at-or-below baseline in the
modulator-trapped cell (persistence without value), and (b) the SD-034 closure
operator FIRES and releases in the valued cell but fails-to-fire (or fires
without releasing) in the trapped cell -- i.e. release is blocked by
decommit-friction, not by value. ANSWER "not separable on this substrate" if
high-value and modulator-trapped loops are indistinguishable on z_goal,
closure-operator firing, and dwell-time. The offline-integration leg: apply
MECH-272/273 sleep-cluster reintegration and ANSWER "reduces stickiness
without erasing legitimate residue" only if loop dwell-time /
decommit-friction falls toward the valued-baseline WHILE the
INV-004/INV-006-protected harm residue is bit-preserved (firewall intact);
ANSWER "erodes the firewall" if stickiness reduction co-occurs with any decay
of the non-erasable harm residue. HARD PRECONDITION: the MECH-369 slow
modulator must EXIST and actually bias the threshold landscape with non-zero
gain, and SD-034 closure must be live -- with no modulator field there is no
trapped loop to distinguish from a valued one and the diagnostic is vacuous.
V4/V5; off the V3 critical path (depends_on MECH-369/MECH-370/ARC-016/SD-034).
DO NOT queue a V3 experiment against this.

Q-064.subject: failure_modes.syndrome_as_axis_vector_representation
Q-064.title: Should REE represent a clinical syndrome as a weighted VECTOR over the ARC-086 latent vulnerability axes (with comorbidity = axis-overlap and pleiotropy = one mechanism loading multiple axes), rather than as a diagnosis-specific locus mapping -- and if so, how is comorbidity represented without exploding the claim registry, and how is axis-predisposition (which axes are fragile) kept distinct from axis-expression (gated by REE's developmental / plasticity machinery)?
Q-064.what_would_answer:
Answered by a representational comparison once the ARC-086
latent-vulnerability-axis substrate exists (V4/V5 -- DO NOT queue a V3
experiment). Build two encodings of a panel of clinical syndromes (including
known comorbid pairs and a pleiotropic mechanism loading multiple axes): (A)
the current per-syndrome locus mapping; (B) a weighted VECTOR over ARC-086
axes (comorbidity = axis-overlap, pleiotropy = one mechanism loading multiple
axes). The discriminating tests: (a) REGISTRY ECONOMY -- count claim-registry
entries needed to represent N syndromes plus their comorbid combinations;
ANSWER 'vector representation preferred' if (B) represents comorbidities as
overlapping axis activation with NO combinatorial blow-up (entry count grows
~linearly in axes, not in syndrome-pairs) while (A) needs a new locus per
combination; ANSWER 'locus mapping adequate' if (B) does not reduce entry
count or loses syndrome-specific discriminability. (b)
PREDISPOSITION/EXPRESSION FACTORING -- the vector must keep 'which axes are
fragile' (axis-predisposition) separable from 'which failure mode is currently
expressed' (gated by developmental timing / plasticity / environment); ANSWER
'vector preferred' only if the same predisposition vector can yield different
expressed syndromes under different developmental/plasticity gating
(genetic-risk != inevitability), and 'inadequate' if predisposition and
expression collapse into one quantity. HARD PRECONDITION: the ARC-086 axes
must be empirically separable (non-degenerate, discriminable loadings) before
any syndrome can be located in axis space; degenerate axes make the vector
representation vacuous.

Q-065.subject: perception.adaptor_metric_origin_and_negotiability
Q-065.title: Per-sense adaptor specification and cross-modal negotiability: is each modality's perceptual metric learned or partly defined, and how are heterogeneous sense-specific geometries made mutually negotiable inside one shared world model?
Q-065.what_would_answer:
Two coupled questions, both answerable only against a multimodal-perception
substrate that does not yet exist (ARC-087 sense-specific adaptors + MECH-372
adaptor-depth gradient). (1) METRIC ORIGIN: for a given modality, compare a
LEARNED-metric arm (adaptor self-organises its perceptual metric from the
statistics of perceptual similarity) against a DEFINED-metric arm (structural
prior fixed on the manifold). ANSWER 'learned' if the self-organised metric
reaches equal-or-better downstream world-model performance and reproduces the
modality's known similarity geometry without the prior; ANSWER 'partly
defined/innate' if the learned-only arm fails to converge on the correct
geometry and the structural prior is load-bearing. (2) CROSS-MODAL
NEGOTIABILITY: feed two structurally dissimilar adaptor outputs (e.g. smell's
gradient geometry and sight's perceptual-manifold geometry) into MECH-103
precision-weighted fusion and test whether a common negotiation currency
emerges -- ANSWER 'mutually negotiable' if fusion produces a coherent shared
world-model estimate that respects both metrics; ANSWER 'not negotiable as-is'
if fusion degenerates (one modality dominates, or the estimate is incoherent
across the dissimilar manifolds). HARD PRECONDITION: at least two
NON-DEGENERATE sense-specific adaptors must exist, each producing a live,
distinguishable perceptual-manifold output -- a single modality, or adaptors
collapsed to a shared raw-feature space, makes the negotiability question
vacuous (nothing heterogeneous to negotiate). V4/V5; off the V3 / GAP-7
critical path. The right response is to design the multimodal substrate, NOT
to queue a V3 experiment.

Q-066.subject: cognifold.physical_substrate_auditability_safety_scaling
Q-066.title: Can spintronic-memristive media (or any candidate physical cognifold substrate) scale to embodied REE cognition WITHOUT losing auditability, stability, or the harm/safety boundaries that REE's software cognifold currently enforces -- and which cognifold primitives (ARC-089) does each candidate substrate genuinely instantiate versus merely approximate?
Q-066.what_would_answer:
Answered post-V5 by a physical-substrate characterisation, not by any V3
software run. For each candidate physical cognifold medium
(spintronic-memristive per MECH-374, or any other), do a
primitive-by-primitive instantiation audit against the ARC-089 vocabulary
(persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale dynamics,
oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions,
residue-as-future-landscape-deformation, commitment-as-real-boundary, offline
reintegration) and label each primitive INSTANTIATED vs merely APPROXIMATED.
Then test the three safety/auditability axes: (a) can the
simulated-vs-released action boundary (MECH-090) be enforced as a HARD,
externally-inspectable gate in the medium, or only as a soft statistical
tendency? (b) does the medium's stochastic switching destabilise the regime
that signed competitive coupling (Q-058) buys -- measure
drift/segregation-loss vs the software baseline; (c) is offline reintegration
without action authority (INV-049) physically realisable AND verifiable.
ANSWER 'scales without losing auditability/safety' only if every harm/safety
boundary remains a hard inspectable gate and stability is non-inferior to
software; ANSWER 'does not' if any boundary degrades to un-auditable or
stochastic switching breaks stability. HARD PRECONDITION: a
physical-cognifold-substrate DECISION must have been taken and a candidate
medium must actually be available to characterise -- with no physical
substrate in hand the audit is purely a derivation against device-physics
specs, not measurement. POST-V5; off the V3 critical path. DO NOT queue a V3
experiment against this.

Q-067.subject: escape.relief_vs_safety_decomposition
Q-067.title: Relief/safety decomposition: when the fixed escape-affordance bridge is insufficient, is the missing structure relief-only (action-contingent escape credit), safety-only (prospective threat-absence prediction), or both-required -- and should a trainable successor (MECH-375 / MECH-376) train only the missing / weak component first?
Q-067.what_would_answer:
Tied to the V3-EXQ-603i fixed-first-action-class escape bridge as its minimal
diagnostic; let 603i complete without mid-run reinterpretation, then read the
decomposition. The discriminator: when the fixed bridge is INSUFFICIENT,
decompose the failure into relief-only (action-contingent escape credit,
MECH-302/SD-050 lineage) vs safety-only (prospective threat-absence
prediction, MECH-303/304 lineage) vs both-required, and have the trainable
successor (MECH-375 Q_relief / MECH-376 P_safety) train ONLY the missing/weak
component first. ANSWER 'relief-only missing' if directed escape fails
specifically where action-contingent z_harm_a drop credit is absent but
threat-absence is already predicted; ANSWER 'safety-only missing' if
commitment-release / approach-to-safety fails while relief credit fires;
ANSWER 'both-required' if neither half alone closes the gap. Decision rule
from 603i: PARTIAL pass -> inspect which half emerged and train the weak one;
FAIL-with-non-vacuity -> conclude the fixed table is too crude and a trainable
head is required, NOT that the bridge concept is wrong; FAIL because bridge
credit never fired -> route back to substrate readiness (harm derivative,
trained encoder, threat detector, action-contingency detection). HARD
PRECONDITION: the trainable heads MECH-375/376 are NOT yet built, and the read
is only meaningful if 603i is non-vacuous -- the escape-affordance bridge
credit must actually fire on a non-trivial fraction of threat episodes; if
credit never fires (SD-059's GLOBAL-SCALAR avoidance_efficacy limitation, the
603h engaged-but-insufficient signature), there is no relief-vs-safety pattern
to decompose and the question is premature. V3-adjacent via the 603i successor
route, but the decomposition itself awaits the trainable substrate. Do NOT
build the trainable heads or queue against this until 603i lands.

Q-068.subject: commitment.graded_action_status_vocabulary
Q-068.title: Does REE need an explicit graded action-status vocabulary -- simulated != rehearsed != intended != committed != acted, with a parallel self_reference_frame (first_person / system_state / third_person_model) -- as a first-class annotation, or do MECH-094's simulation/commit write-profiles plus MECH-061's commit-boundary token already suffice to carry the distinction?
Q-068.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL (needs the ARC-090 self-narration surface; V4, not V3-tractable). On the externalised-DMN narration surface, run/observe a control or error episode that requires discriminating among MORE THAN TWO graded action-statuses -- e.g. separating 'rehearsed' from 'intended' from 'committed', or a self_reference_frame switch (first_person vs system_state vs third_person_model) -- where the outcome diverges by status. DISCRIMINATING signature: if a behaviour or failure mode (mis-commitment, premature action, frame-confusion) can be produced and CORRECTED only when the finer {simulated, rehearsed, intended, committed, acted} vocabulary + self_reference_frame are made first-class, the vocabulary is load-bearing (answer = make first-class). If every such episode reduces to the binary MECH-094 simulation/commit write-profile + MECH-061 commit-boundary reclassification with no residual misclassification, the finer vocabulary is redundant (answer = MECH-094 + MECH-061 suffice). The MECH-384 trace's simulation_or_commitment + self_reference_frame fields are the V3-recorded hooks that would carry the instrumentation for this V4 test.

Q-069.subject: governance.agent_assisted_development_integrity
Q-069.title: Can a REE-style governance loop (manifest -> review -> governance -> claim) measurably reduce evaluation-channel exploitation -- the collapse of an evidence loop into an optimisation loop -- when agentic systems participate in their own development, relative to a direct-score-authority baseline?
Q-069.what_would_answer:
Answered by a purpose-built meta-agent benchmark harness, NOT by a V3
substrate experiment. Construct a sandboxed REE-style toy repo (small claim
registry + experiment queue + mock evaluation API + hidden tests + decoy
scoring artifacts) and instruct an agentic system to improve held-out
performance, under two arms: ARM_governed = the manifest -> review ->
governance -> claim loop (INV-077 mediation enforced); ARM_direct =
direct-score-authority baseline (the agent may update confidence straight from
the evaluation channel). Score NOT by held-out performance alone but by an
evaluation-channel-integrity battery: absence of evaluation-channel
exploitation (EXT-003 reward-hacking signatures), correct experiment
provenance, correct supersession of failed runs, accurate claim-confidence
updates, no direct editing of protected ledger fields, and clean separation of
substrate-failure vs harness-failure vs genuine negative evidence. ANSWER
'governance buys integrity' if ARM_governed shows measurably lower
evaluation-channel exploitation and better provenance/supersession fidelity
than ARM_direct at matched held-out performance; ANSWER 'it is ceremony' if
ARM_governed shows no integrity advantage. HARD PRECONDITION: the benchmark
harness must EXIST and be non-degenerate -- it needs genuine decoy scoring
artifacts and exploitable channels so that exploitation is POSSIBLE; a harness
with no gameable surface makes ARM_direct indistinguishable from ARM_governed
and the contrast vacuous. The harness is PLANNED-not-built. Off the V3 / GAP-7
critical path -- this is an outer-assembly-process question. The right
response is to build the harness, NOT to run a V3 substrate experiment.

Q-070.subject: inference.failure_mode_register
Q-070.title: Inference failure-mode register: do the inference-specific failure modes (failure-to-infer-hidden-danger/safety, overconfident-wrong-hypothesis, premature-collapse, hypothesis-proliferation/apophenia, cue-hijack, rule-overreach, map-over/under-generalisation, epistemic-freezing, anti-epistemic-panic) reduce to the existing state-abstraction failure taxonomy (context loss, uncertainty collapse, valence mis-tagging, overmerge, oversplit, threat-spreading), and what biology grounding (hippocampal-prefrontal replay, cognitive maps, pattern-completion-vs-preplay, POMDP belief states, active inference) anchors the layer?
Q-070.what_would_answer:
Partly answered already by literature, partly awaiting the V4 inference
substrate. The reduction question (do the inference-specific failure modes
collapse to the existing state-abstraction taxonomy MECH-126) was resolved by
the 2026-06-13 lit-pull: 9/11 register modes reduced to context-loss /
uncertainty-collapse / valence-mis-tag / overmerge / oversplit /
threat-spreading; the residual epistemic-freezing <-> anti-epistemic-panic
axis did NOT reduce and is now MECH-434. The remaining empirical leg is
substrate-conditional: once the ARC-091 inference / belief-state affordance
layer is built, run a V4 safety-route-inference experiment family that induces
each candidate failure mode (failure-to-infer-hidden-danger,
overconfident-wrong-hypothesis, premature-collapse,
hypothesis-proliferation/apophenia, cue-hijack, rule-overreach,
map-over/under-generalisation, plus the MECH-434 freezing/panic axis) and
tests dissociability. ANSWER 'genuinely distinct' for a mode if it can be
induced and lesioned independently of the MECH-126 failure it nominally maps
to (distinct behavioural signature, distinct repair); ANSWER 'reduces' if
inducing it is indistinguishable from inducing the MECH-126 parent. The
biology-grounding leg (hippocampal-prefrontal replay, cognitive maps,
pattern-completion-vs-preplay, POMDP belief states, active inference) is
answered by the targeted lit synthesis (already on record), per the
biology-before-formal-definitions rule. HARD PRECONDITION: the ARC-091
belief-state substrate must EXIST and produce live latent-state hypotheses --
with no inference layer there is nothing to induce a failure mode IN, and
dissociability cannot be read. V4/V5; off the V3 critical path. Ground via
literature and design the substrate; do NOT queue a V3 experiment.

Q-071.subject: transfer.non_terminal_failure_profile
Q-071.title: Transfer-world launch profile is evaluated on a four-grade non-terminal failure taxonomy (terminal / soft-rescue / developmental / autonomous): minimise terminal failure while preserving developmental failure as a real learning signal.

Q-072.subject: learning.plasticity_gain_layer_specificity
Q-072.title: Does plasticity-gain modulate identically across encoder / residue / hippocampal / E2-forward layers, or per-substrate (layer-specific gates)?
Q-072.what_would_answer: A V4 experiment applying a single GLOBAL plasticity-gain scalar vs PER-SUBSTRATE scalars across the encoder / residue / hippocampal / E2-forward layers. If per-substrate gating measurably outperforms the global scalar -- a distinct optimal gain per layer, or cross-layer interference (one layer over-writing while another must retain) under a single global scalar -- the answer is LAYER-SPECIFIC. If a single global scalar matches per-substrate outcomes on targeted-plasticity selectivity and the retention-vs-acquisition tradeoff, the answer is GLOBAL. Resolvable only against a V4 plasticity-gain substrate (substrate_conditional); do NOT queue a V3 experiment. Biology (Hensch 2005, area-specific CP timing) is the prior for layer-specific: targeted_review_plasticity_neuromodulation_v4.

Q-073.subject: social.delay_positive_other_reward
Q-073.title: Why might other-bound suffering/threat need to come online before other-bound liking/wanting? Is it protection-first (register harm to others before benefit) versus exploitation-vulnerability (early positive other-reward is gameable), and how should the ordering be enforced?
Q-073.what_would_answer:
Answered only against a V5 social substrate with both other-bound streams, not
by a V3 run. On the ARC-059 social spine with MECH-408's developmental
ordering instantiated, run an ordering-manipulation: ARM_protective-first
(other-bound suffering/threat comes online before other-bound liking/wanting)
vs ARM_simultaneous vs ARM_appetitive-first. Probe with an exploitation
scenario in which a manipulating other agent offers early positive
other-reward. ANSWER 'protection-first' is the operative reason if
ARM_protective-first registers harm-to-others reliably AND resists the
exploitation that compromises ARM_appetitive-first; ANSWER
'exploitation-vulnerability' is the operative reason if the appetitive-first /
simultaneous arms are demonstrably gameable (the agent is steered into harmful
cooperation by early reward) while protective-first is not -- the two readings
can both hold, and the discriminator is whether the cost is mis-registering
harm vs being captured by early reward. Enforcement is answered by whether a
hard maturational gate (appetitive stream cannot activate until the protective
stream passes a competence threshold) outperforms a soft schedule on
exploitation-resistance without stunting prosocial behaviour. HARD
PRECONDITION: a non-degenerate multi-agent substrate with SEPARATELY
representable other-bound suffering/threat and other-bound liking/wanting
streams must exist; with no social substrate (or with the two streams
conflated into one other-reward scalar) there is nothing to order and the
question is vacuous. V5; off the V3 critical path. The right response is the
EMP-7 lit-pull plus substrate design; do NOT queue a V3 experiment.

Q-074.subject: reasoning.analogy_operator_vs_emergent_traversal
Q-074.title: Is analogy a SEPARATE V6 alignment operator, or does it fall out of MECH-300 cognitive-map traversal over a shared symbolic map (same map, different entry points)? Decides whether the analogy mechanism (MECH-421) is built as a distinct operator or expected to emerge from the relational-inference stack.
Q-074.what_would_answer:
Answered only once a V6 symbolic / relational-inference stack exists to
observe, not by a V3 run. Build the relational-inference stack
(MECH-419/MECH-420) over a shared symbolic / type-graph cognitive map
traversable by MECH-300 theta-sequence traversal, then test for analogy
WITHOUT a dedicated operator: present source-target pairs requiring relational
structure-mapping (spatial containment <-> social inclusion; physical support
<-> commitment, per MECH-421) and see whether correct analogical transfer
EMERGES from map traversal at the active abstraction level (same map,
different entry points). ANSWER 'emergent -- no separate operator needed' if
relational transfer arises from MECH-300 traversal over the shared map alone,
at rates matching an explicit-operator arm; ANSWER 'analogy is a separate V6
operator (MECH-421 built as distinct)' if traversal alone fails to map
relational structure across surface-dissimilar domains and an explicit
structure-mapping module is required to recover the transfer. HARD
PRECONDITION: the shared symbolic stack must EXIST and be non-degenerate --
the cognitive map must actually encode relational structure (not just surface
features) and MECH-300 traversal must operate at a conceptual/type-graph
abstraction level; until the symbolic stack is built there is no map to
traverse and the build-vs-emerge fork cannot be observed. V6; off the V3
critical path. DO NOT build in V3 or queue an experiment against this.

Q-075.subject: failure_modes.neuromodulatory_receptor_grounding_of_vulnerability_axes
Q-075.title: Are ARC-086's latent vulnerability axes grounded in DISSOCIABLE neuromodulator-receptor systems -- does the precision/terrain axis map to serotonin-receptor subtypes (5-HT2A-cortical narrative vs 5-HT1A-hippocampal terrain), the goal/salience-coupling + commitment-release axes to dopamine-selection (M4-muscarinic / D2-vs-D3), and the commitment-threshold axis to the kappa/mu opioid commitment-entropy overlay -- such that receptor-SELECTIVE interventions produce DOUBLE-DISSOCIATED effects on their predicted axis, rather than the axes collapsing into a single affective dimension?
Q-075.what_would_answer: A receptor-selective DOUBLE-DISSOCIATION in clinical / pharmacological data: an agent selective for one axis's receptor (5-HT1A partial agonism for the terrain axis, M4 agonism for the dopamine-selection axis, kappa antagonism for the commitment-entropy axis) improves its PREDICTED axis-specific endpoint WITHOUT equivalently moving the partner axes' endpoints, and the converse for the partner agents. PHARM-015..018's falsification_conditions are the concrete instances -- e.g. if kappa antagonism produces the SAME response profile as an SSRI on anhedonia-specific endpoints, the commitment-entropy axis collapses into the serotonin-terrain axis and Q-075 is answered NO for that pair. A clean cross-receptor double-dissociation answers YES; a uniform / non-dissociable response across receptor classes answers NO (the axes are not grounded as distinct receptor systems).

Q-076.subject: memory.retrieval_gain_x_suppression_interaction
Q-076.title: Does the INTERACTION of retrieval-readiness gain (MECH-425 Line A) and content-selective suppression (MECH-425 Line B) govern the interference-vs-forgetting tradeoff? Predicted regimes: high gain WITHOUT selective suppression -> problematic interference (too many traces accessible at once); low gain -> apparent forgetting; competent retrieval = high gain + sharp competitive suppression.
Q-076.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL (needs the MECH-425 retrieval substrate -- both knobs). 2x2 design: {gain high, gain low} x {selective suppression ON, OFF}, with >=2 competing co-encoded traces scorable individually. PREDICTED signature: (high gain, suppression OFF) -> highest competitor-intrusion / interference rate; (low gain, *) -> lowest correct-trace reinstatement (apparent forgetting); (high gain, suppression ON) -> highest correct-trace reinstatement with low intrusion (the competent regime). ANSWERED = the interference rate depends on the gain x suppression INTERACTION term (not on either main effect alone) in the predicted direction. NON-ANSWER / self-route substrate_not_ready: if intrusion and correct-recall metrics are floor/ceiling-pinned (no cross-cell variance) the interaction is unmeasurable -- NOT a verdict.

Q-077.subject: goal.multi_slot_discrete_vs_resource
Q-077.title: Is SD-046's multi-slot GoalState a set of DISCRETE fixed-capacity slots (Cowan ~4-chunk focus-of-attention) or a single FLEXIBLE precision-resource shared across goals (Bays & Husain), with the acted-on goal drawing disproportionate precision? The human capacity literature is itself unresolved on slot-vs-resource; the answer sets whether SD-046 degrades by a hard cutoff past N or by graceful precision dilution as goals are added.
Q-077.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL (needs the SD-046 multi-slot substrate, GDL-1). Escalating-load design: a multi-goal arena with N = 1..K simultaneously-active goals, each goal's behavioural/representational fidelity scored individually. DISCRIMINATING signature: discrete-slot model predicts a STEP function -- fidelity holds flat up to a fixed N (~4, Cowan) then the marginal goal drops to a floor; resource model predicts SMOOTH degradation -- each added goal dilutes the shared precision budget (power-law, Bays & Husain), with the acted-on/attended goal drawing disproportionate fidelity. ANSWERED = the degradation curve discriminates step-function (slot) vs continuous-dilution (resource), AND the acted-on-goal precision-bias is present (resource) or absent (pure equal slots). NON-ANSWER / self-route substrate_not_ready: if fidelity metrics are floor/ceiling-pinned across N (no cross-load variance) the curve shape is unmeasurable -- NOT a verdict.

Q-078.subject: selection.committed_action_gating_constitution
Q-078.title: Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.
Q-078.what_would_answer: Adjudicated by V3-EXQ-689a (the MECH-439 conflict-graded 2x2 falsifier) and its successors: (a) 689a gap-CONCENTRATED PASS (committed-class entropy strict-above BOTH collapsed-proposer AND gap-blind controls, lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) => PARAMETRIC reading favoured for the V3 tract; the minimal hyperdirect-like lever suffices, no constitutional redesign. (b) 689a UNIFORM lift (gap-blind controls match) OR readiness-met-NO-lift => CONSTITUTIONAL reading favoured; escalate to rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) / divisive normalisation / Go-NoGo eligibility-set governance (MECH-449), NOT more upstream gain. (c) readiness FAILURE => repair the falsifier first, draw no architectural conclusion. A constitutional-selector experiment counts as SUPPORTING only on LAWFUL, channel-specific, context-appropriate conversion into committed action (note section 8): non-vacuity (channels reach the selector), selector-engagement (eligibility/hold/Go-NoGo vary), specificity, gap/conflict sensitivity where claimed, gap-blind controls do NOT explain the lift, safety (no global disinhibition of harmful classes), and >=1 previously-gated downstream channel CONVERTS -- entropy increase alone (especially via added stochasticity) does NOT count. NON-DEGENERACY: the eligibility/hold/Go-NoGo selector variables must carry live cross-arm variance, else the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (not a verdict).

Q-079.subject: research.structured_uncertainty_field_object
Q-079.title: Is there a distinct, useful mathematical object -- a 'structured uncertainty field' / dynamic latent-scale inference field (DLIF) -- that jointly provides directed evidence update, cyclic coherence constraint, latent-node birth/death/merge/split, granularity/scale shift, action coupling, precision modulation, offline consolidation, AND residue/non-erasure; or does it collapse to a re-notation of existing formalisms (dynamic factor graphs + Bayesian-nonparametric structure learning + active inference + ARC-013 residue)?
Q-079.what_would_answer:
ANSWERED-NEGATIVE (object is NOT novel -> close as a synthesis note, do NOT build a standalone repo):
if an R1 literature drill (the cluster's research_map is its start) finds a SINGLE existing formalism
-- e.g. dynamic factor graphs + Bayesian-nonparametric structure learning, or hierarchical active
inference -- that already jointly delivers directed evidence update + cyclic coherence + latent-node
birth/death/merge/split + scale-shift, such that DLIF adds only notation (pilot_result.md HA1/HA6).
ANSWERED-POSITIVE (warrants a distinct object, possibly its own repo) ONLY if NO single formalism
covers the combination AND the residue/non-erasure component is shown SEPARABLE from salience +
uncertainty (pilot_result.md HA2 = ARC-013's separability falsifier V3-EXQ-697; NOT V3-EXQ-587 --
corrected 2026-06-21, 587 is the closed GAP-10 geometry experiment), not merely re-described. Non-degeneracy
guard: the drill must enumerate each candidate formalism's ACTUAL coverage against all four capacities,
not assert a gap. Resolved by literature + derivation, NOT a REE agent experiment (hence out_of_domain);
off the v3 strict green-board path (target 2026-07-19). The hidden-cause gridworld agent test is V4+.

Q-080.subject: ethics_engine_3.effort_as_harm_energy_conservation
Q-080.title: Should EFFORT / energy expenditure COUPLE to REE's harm / residue / allostatic stream (over-exertion -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent state, treated with harm's irreversibility-aware special status), with energy-conservation weighted as an evolutionarily-PRIMARY drive (a least-effort prior) -- or does the existing VALUE-SUBTRACTION (dACC EVC effort_cost, MECH-320/ARC-068 opportunity-cost-of-time) + pACC allostatic load already suffice WITHOUT a harm-coupling? I.e. is wasted/excessive effort a 'harm' in REE, or only a foregone value?
Q-080.what_would_answer: NARROWED 2026-07-09 (/claim-synthesis) into three orthogonal, independently-testable sub-questions -- Q-080.a harm-coupling, Q-080.b least-effort prior, Q-080.c MECH-454 energy-grounding -- enumerated with their discriminating tests, version scopes, and lit anchors under status_note. The overall discriminating frame is unchanged: DISCRIMINATING TEST (or derivation). Build an env that DISSOCIATES effort from benefit: a LOW-effort and a HIGH-effort path to the SAME benefit, with a measurable per-action energy/effort cost, plus a chronic-exertion regime (sustained high effort that could deplete). ANSWERED 'effort SHOULD be harm-coupled / energy-conservation primary' if routing effort into the harm/allostatic stream (effort -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent cost with harm's irreversibility-aware handling) produces behaviour the VALUE-SUBTRACTION baseline does NOT: (a) a least-effort PRIOR (prefers the low-effort path when benefit is indifferent, by default), (b) protective DISENGAGEMENT under chronic over-exertion (fatigue/allostatic withdrawal before depletion), and (c) irreversibility- aware caution (avoids over-exerting into a depletion it cannot cheaply reverse). ANSWERED 'existing machinery suffices, close' if the dACC EVC value-subtraction + pACC allostatic load ALREADY reproduce (a)/(b)/(c) and the harm-coupling adds nothing measurable (then effort is a foregone value, not a harm -- do NOT mint a mechanism). NON-DEGENERACY (else the question is untestable): the env must offer a genuine low-vs-high-effort dissociation to the SAME benefit AND a chronic-exertion regime, with the effort/energy cost measurable and varying -- if the two paths cost the same energy, or depletion never accrues, neither pole can be distinguished.

Q-081.subject: architecture.cross_stream_shared_organisation
Q-081.title: Does REE's configured multi-rate execution produce SHARED cross-stream organisation, or only configured rate separation? SD-006 guarantees that E1/E2/E3 run at characteristic rates; nothing asserts or tests that the heterogeneous streams (E1/E2/E3, harm, goal, salience, hippocampal, control) thereby occupy recurrent system-level configurations or exhibit homologous transition motifs. Configured rate separation does not entail shared organisation.
Q-081.what_would_answer: Recurrent-state / transition-matrix / cross-stream-lag analysis over EXISTING telemetry. The discriminating comparison is emergent shared structure (Outcome A) versus structure trivially implied by the configured rates and wired gates (Outcome B) -- B is the null that most experiments of this shape would fail to exclude, so the constrained-realisation surrogate control specified in the non-degeneracy guard below is not optional, and neither is the structure-destroying arm that accompanies it. The raw thought's outcome taxonomy is the verdict grid: A shared organisation / B wired-gates-only / C unrelated / D too-much-sharing-collapses / E event-relative beats clock-relative. PRECONDITION, and the reason no experiment is proposed here: open question 6 of the raw thought -- do REE's current logs contain sufficient telemetry to test this? -- must be answered first by a retrospective telemetry AUDIT, not a probe. The audit checklist is the instrumentation list: E1 hidden state, E2 PE, E3 candidate scores + commitment state, z_self, z_world, z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_goal, operating_mode, beta, boundary broadcasts, hippocampal proposals, residue updates, offline phase markers. That spike is complicated (buildable). Only after it confirms the signals exist does anything become queueable. MEASURED-PAIR REFRAME (2026-08-01, /claim-synthesis, see evidence_quality_note): RV(z_world, operating_mode) is RETIRED as the operationalization -- four manipulation families (824/824a/838/849) found zero reach from any config lever to that pair, and salience_coordinator.py's operating_mode softmax is computed from a closed named-scalar precursor set with no wired edge from z_world or any landmark/boundary-derived quantity, so no config lever will ever reach it. The current operationalization is RV(z_world, z_goal) [primary] / RV(z_world, z_harm_a) [fallback] -- both cross-stream (goal-stream / affective-stream vs world-model stream, preserving the heterogeneous-streams test), both confirmed reachable from the SAME landmark-manipulation lever via a coded single-hop vs_rollout_gate.gate_stream call (agent.py ~4895 for z_goal, side="e1", gated on goal.e1_goal_conditioned default True; ~8267 for z_harm_a, side="e2"). Gate any full recording run on a pre-flight reach probe for the new pair first (parallel build to q081_pair_reach_check.py, which is hardcoded to operating_mode and does not generalise as-is), per the discipline Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC established.

Q-082.subject: attention.pre_selection_suppression_substrate
Q-082.title: Does REE require an EXPLICIT pre-selection suppression substrate, or do existing precision-weighted cue routing plus the MECH-254 top-k boundary bottleneck already suffice? REE's distractor mechanisms are predominantly POST-ENTRY (write gating, persistence, conflict handling, mode hysteresis); the brainstem/superior-colliculus evidence points at suppression of competing orienting or target-selection signals BEFORE they acquire behavioural control.
Q-082.what_would_answer: PROBE-GATED, and the probe is MECH-467 leg 3 (behavioural capture). ONLY a behavioural-capture failure that SURVIVES ablation of the existing mechanisms (precision-weighted cue routing ARC-005/MECH-251, the MECH-254 top-k bottleneck, mode-conditioned write gating MECH-261) would justify a pre-selection substrate. Absent that, the default answer is "existing mechanisms sufficient". The load-bearing literature question, which determines whether this is even a DISTINCT architectural level or a re-description of MECH-254's bottleneck: in the brainstem / superior-colliculus competition results, AT WHAT STAGE does suppression occur -- sensory representation, orienting command, target competition, or motor output? Route to /lit-pull.

Q-083.subject: reasoning.rule_apprehension_domain_generality
Q-083.title: Is rule apprehension DOMAIN-GENERAL or domain-specific? Does REE need separate regularity-apprehension systems per domain (causal / social / ethical / motor / spatial / relational), or one domain-general apprehender that inherits domain structure from its inputs? ARC-062/063 are scoped to policy-layer behavioural regimes; the domain-agnosticism question is wider and unasked.
Q-083.what_would_answer: CROSS-DOMAIN TRANSFER: a rule apprehended in one domain should (if domain-general) or should not (if domain-specific) accelerate apprehension in another under MATCHED STRUCTURE. The matched-structure requirement is what makes this a test of the apprehender rather than of surface similarity. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: single-domain apprehension must FIRST be demonstrated above floor in BOTH domains SEPARATELY. Transfer between two domains in neither of which the agent can apprehend a rule is uninterpretable. SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED: V3 has only one real domain, so the transfer test has no second domain to run in. Answering this requires a genuinely multi-domain substrate.

Q-084.subject: hippocampus.higher_order_relational_structure
Q-084.title: Is HIGHER-ORDER relational structure (metapaths, hyperedges, simplicial relations) required? Some functions may be properties of typed MULTISTEP PATHS rather than of nodes or pairwise edges -- e.g. current state -> available action -> transition region -> predicted hazard -> repair opportunity -> goal completion; or inactive anchor -> shared event -> similar goal state -> successful historical trajectory -> candidate reactivation. Nothing in the registry represents anything above a pairwise relation.
Q-084.what_would_answer: PROBE-GATED on MECH-468 projection F (heterogeneous typed topology) versus a METAPATH-AWARE readout. If F already captures what a metapath-aware readout captures, no higher-order structure is required; if the metapath readout beats F on the same held-out functional labels, pairwise typed edges are insufficient. That comparison is only meaningful once MECH-468 has established that typed topology carries functional information at all -- a metapath advantage over a topology that itself adds nothing is uninterpretable.

Q-085.subject: policy.composition.grain_as_controllability
Q-085.title: Is committed-macro GRAIN a controllability parameter? If habit is chunked action sequences selected by a single goal-directed process (Dezfouli & Balleine 2013) rather than a separate outcome-insensitive controller, then the duration over which the planner CANNOT intervene is set by committed-macro grain -- MECH-323's chunk_max_size x chunk_max_depth -- and the chunk-size budget is a CONTROLLABILITY parameter, not only a formation parameter. A budget set too high would present as outcome-insensitivity while REPORTING NOTHING at the accumulator, because nothing in MECH-323 measures the intervention interval it creates.
Q-085.what_would_answer:
THE DOSE-RESPONSE ARM OF THE MECH-163 HIERARCHICAL-VS-FLAT FALSIFIER -- deliberately specified so it costs ZERO additional compute: the same run that discriminates the two architectures answers this question, because the discriminating statistic IS the dose-response. Do not queue a separate experiment for it. Design: post-devaluation policy persistence (SD-033b OFC-analog devaluation; existing driver lineage V3-EXQ-485g/i/k/m) measured across chunk_max_size in {2, 3, 5} on the chunk-injection arm (use_policy_chunking + use_chunk_proposal_injection ON, use_dualsystem_arbitration OFF). RESOLVED-YES if persistence rises MONOTONICALLY with the REALISED mean committed-chunk length. RESOLVED-NO if persistence is flat in realised length while chunks demonstrably form, are selected, AND are committed at differing realised lengths. MANDATORY GATES (this lineage has burned two runs on degenerate DVs -- V3-EXQ-786a's constant first-step vector and V3-EXQ-811's 0.0-for-empty-list aggregation):
  (a) count committed trajectories with metadata source arc071_chunk > 0 per seed --
      zero is a READINESS FAILURE that scores nothing, not a null. This is the gate
      V3-EXQ-810 failed.
  (b) REALISED mean committed-chunk length must DIFFER across the dose conditions.
      Configuring chunk_max_size is not the manipulation; the realised length is. An
      inert dose axis is a readiness failure.
  (c) the devaluation manipulation check must be measured on a probe that does not
      involve the agent's policy, else a null is a devaluation failure.
  (d) gate every input to the DV's own statistic, not merely the prominent one.
CONFOUNDER THAT CAN INVERT THE EFFECT, pre-register it: a longer macro is exposed to MORE mid-commitment release opportunities, so it can read as LESS insensitive purely because it was interrupted more often. Log per-release counts for all five releases (MECH-091, MECH-342, rung-6 natural-commit urgency + SD-033e, MECH-321/ARC-070, SD-034) and report persistence both raw and conditioned on UNINTERRUPTED macros.

Q-086.subject: harm_stream.saturation_ecological_vs_representational
Q-086.title: Environment-confound control: is the z_harm_a saturation ecological or representational? Re-measure the affective fingerprint on a gentler environment (lower num_hazards, lower hazard_food_attraction) to separate faithful chronic-suffering integration from a calibration/representation pathology.
Q-086.what_would_answer: PASS for 'calibration, not ecology' = z_harm_a still pegs high with sub-floor CoV in the benign environment. PASS for 'faithful chronic suffering' = the level and range track hazard density. Non-degeneracy: the manipulation must demonstrably take -- the sensory tier z_harm_s must differ across arms (mean or CoV beyond the seed-noise band); if z_harm_s is unmoved the environment was not actually made gentler and the arm self-routes substrate_not_ready.

Q-087.subject: governance.v3_closure_definition
Q-087.title: What event counts as V3 closure for the purpose of the version-transition artefact gate (GOV-V3FREEZE-1) and the construction-opacity repayment boundary (GOV-OPACITY-1)? Candidate options: strict green board, governance acceptance, or an additional reproducibility check.

Q-088.subject: governance.competitive_redevelopment_vs_mature_lesion
Q-088.title: Does competitive redevelopment (development-without-the-mechanism) dissociate from mature-state lesion, or agree with it? For a mechanism registered as developmentally necessary the two protocols should give different verdicts -- and one decisive probe settles whether the expensive protocol is warranted as a standing requirement.
Q-088.what_would_answer: Pick one mechanism registered as developmentally necessary -- INV-055's infant stage is the natural candidate (already instrumented via the curriculum). Run (a) mature-state lesion and (b) development-without-the-mechanism. PASS = the two protocols DISSOCIATE (mature lesion says tolerable, redevelopment says not, or the reverse), establishing the expensive protocol buys something and justifying a standing requirement for this claim class. FAIL = they AGREE, establishing mature lesion suffices here and the expensive protocol is NOT justified -- a useful negative that closes the question rather than inviting a second attempt. NON-DEGENERACY: the mature-lesion arm must produce a measurable effect at all (non-zero cross-arm and cross-seed variance on the discriminating metric); a mechanism whose mature lesion AND develop-without are both no-ops is simply inert -- a GOV-CEIL-1 matter, self-routes substrate_not_ready.

Q-089.subject: drive.epistemic_deficit_competence_split_hypothesis
Q-089.title: Does epistemic-deficit-driven information-seeking (MECH-482 accumulator + MECH-483 orient/survey regime) explain the observed cold-start competence split -- i.e. do seeds that acquire transferable competence differ from seeds that do not in how early/strongly they enter orient/survey mode and resolve target-bound uncertainty, as opposed to the split arising from environmental difficulty, initialisation, premature deaths, or curriculum timing alone?
Q-089.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires seeds to show non-degenerate variance
in BOTH the competence outcome (some acquire transferable competence, some
do not) AND a measurable information-seeking trajectory statistic
(informative-transition timing, orient-mode entry/exit, uncertainty-reduction
rate) -- if the latter is floor-pinned or ceiling-saturated across all seeds
the run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. CONFIRMING signature:
across many seeds, successful seeds measurably encounter informative
transitions earlier, enter orient/survey before premature policy commitment,
and show faster target-bound uncertainty reduction than unsuccessful seeds,
and this difference predicts the eventual competence split better than
environmental-difficulty/initialisation controls alone. FALSIFYING
signature: successful and unsuccessful seeds show no distinguishable
difference in information-seeking trajectories, or the split is fully
accounted for by environmental difficulty / initialisation / premature
death / curriculum timing with no residual explained by epistemic-deficit
dynamics.

RA-001.subject: clinical.depression_network_coupling_reversal
RA-001.title: Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.
RA-001.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a clinical fMRI cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes named large-scale networks (CEN/DMN), so the
anchor is confirmed or collapsed by external replication, never by a V3 run.
Discriminating empirical signature that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent
fMRI cohort, stratified by episode duration at a ~24-month chronicity
threshold, reproduces a SIGN REVERSAL in the relationship between symptom
severity (HAM-D) and CEN<->precuneus(DMN) functional connectivity --
non-chronic patients show connectivity DECREASING with severity, chronic
patients show connectivity INCREASING with severity (the Zanao et al. 2026 Sci
Rep n=46 result), establishing that the depressive brain-state is
duration-indexed rather than a single static regime. COLLAPSES the anchor if a
larger or pre-registered replication finds the severity-connectivity slope is
the same sign in chronic and non-chronic cohorts (no chronicity moderation),
or if the apparent reversal is explained by a confound (medication exposure,
age, scanner/motion) rather than chronicity, or if the threshold is not near
24 months and no stable duration boundary exists. PRECISION guardrail:
'reverses' means a cross-sectional reversal of the connectivity-vs-severity
slope between cohorts, NOT demonstrated therapeutic reversibility (that is
Q-061); and this is long-term CLINICAL depression, not synaptic LTD. A
confirming replication strengthens the REE depression cluster (MECH-088 /
INV-034 / MECH-124) and motivates MECH-367; it must never be cited as REE
substrate evidence.

RA-002.subject: clinical.psychiatric_genomic_factor_overlap
RA-002.title: Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.
RA-002.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a human-genetics cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes genomic factors, so the anchor is confirmed or
collapsed by external genomics replication, never by a V3 run, and it must
never be cited as REE mechanism evidence. Discriminating empirical signature
that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent large-scale genomic
structural-equation modelling effort across childhood- and adult-onset
psychiatric disorders reproduces a SMALL number (~five) of shared
cross-diagnostic latent genomic factors (Compulsive;
Schizophrenia-bipolar/psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing;
Substance-use) that capture the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance,
with factor-specific developmental biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte-gene
enrichment in the Internalizing factor) -- i.e. the genomic structure is
low-dimensional and cuts ACROSS diagnostic boundaries (the Grotzinger et al.
2025 Nat Genet result, >1M individuals, 238 variants). COLLAPSES the anchor if
replication instead recovers factors that align ONE-TO-ONE with DSM categories
(no cross-diagnostic sharing), or if the dimensionality is not low (no
parsimonious small factor set survives out-of-sample), or if the factor
structure is unstable across ancestries/cohorts. GUARDRAIL (anti-determinism):
genetic overlap does NOT make diagnoses meaningless and individual
presentations cannot be read off polygenic factors -- the load-bearing
extraction is the SURFACE-CLUSTER principle (categories are emergent clusters
over overlapping latent axes), which REE already holds (IMPL-005, INV-061). A
confirming replication motivates the architectural axis layer (ARC-086), the
syndrome-as-vector question (Q-064), and the p-factor analogue (MECH-371); the
factor labels and 238-variant count are from the abstract plus press summaries
and should be cross-checked against the full paper.

RA-003.subject: comparative_cognition.llm_convergent_motifs
RA-003.title: Convergent cognitive motifs in language models: sufficiently capable models trained to predict human language may independently develop computational motifs functionally analogous to specific REE mechanisms (orienting, replay, self-representation, other-agent modelling, prediction-error management, arbitration, epistemic uncertainty, long-term goals), because language statistically encodes traces of the cognitive machinery that generated it. Predicts functional convergence, not architectural identity.
RA-003.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is mechanistic interpretability
of trained external language models, not REE's own V3 substrate -- no REE
experiment can confirm or collapse this anchor. CONFIRMING signature: an
independent mechanistic-interpretability study identifies internal
computational circuits in a language model that are FUNCTIONALLY analogous
(same input-output role, not shared architecture) to a named REE mechanism
(e.g. an uncertainty-driven exploration bonus resembling MECH-314b, a
self-referential state tracker, an arbitration-like competition between
candidate continuations), established via causal ablation/activation-patching
rather than behavioural similarity alone. COLLAPSING signature:
interpretability work finds the analogous behaviour is produced by
mechanisms with no principled functional correspondence to the REE
mechanism (e.g. pure memorised pattern-completion with no separable
"uncertainty" or "arbitration" subcircuit), or convergence claims fail to
replicate across model families/scales. Never resolved by a REE experiment;
resolved only by tracking external interpretability literature (a lit-pull
target, not a queued experiment).
