SD-016.title: E1 must expose a z_world-only ContextMemory query path that produces two downstream signals: an action-affordance bias for E2 (MECH-151) and a terrain precision weight for E3 harm/goal scoring (MECH-152); the existing bulk generate_prior() path is insufficient because it blends z_self and z_world and produces no cue-specific modulation.

SD-017.subject: sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3
SD-017.title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

SD-019a.subject: harm_stream.immediate_affective_valence
SD-019a.title: harm_unpleasantness_channel: a distinct pre-integration affective valence signal encoding the immediate motivational relevance of noxious input, processed via the medial pain pathway before temporal accumulation into suffering.

SD-019b.subject: harm_stream.suffering_accumulator
SD-019b.title: harm_suffering_accumulator: z_harm_a is specifically the output of a controllability-gated hysteretic integrator over harm_unpleasantness, constituting a persistent load state modulated by escapability and inescapability, not merely a temporally lagged copy of the sensory stream.

SD-020.subject: harm_stream.affective_surprise_pe
SD-020.title: z_harm_a encodes affective surprise (precision-weighted PE), not raw accumulated harm state. The affective stream training target is the mismatch between predicted and actual harm accumulation, making E3 urgency respond to unexpectedness of threat, not just magnitude.

SD-021.subject: harm_stream.descending_modulation
SD-021.title: Descending pain modulation: when E3 is committed to a trajectory through expected harm, z_harm_s PE precision is reduced (endogenous analgesia). Commitment gates sensory harm attenuation.

SD-022.subject: body.directional_limb_damage
SD-022.title: Directional limb damage: body extension for genuine z_harm_s / z_harm_a causal independence

SD-023.subject: environment.gradient_texture
SD-023.title: Environmental gradient texture: multi-channel world observation with neutral landmark objects

SD-024.subject: hippocampal_module.da_modulated_rbf_density
SD-024.title: DA-modulated RBF center density: dopaminergic signal at reward encounters allocates multiple closely-spaced RBF centers in the hippocampal residue field, creating representational expansion at reward locations without requiring environmental richness.

SD-025.subject: hippocampal_module.curiosity_drive
SD-025.title: Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.

SD-026.subject: attention.prospective_precision_write_channel
SD-026.title: Goal-directed perception requires a prospective precision-template write channel from z_goal to the E1 prior, anatomically analogous to the dorsal attention network (FEF/IPS -> V1) feedback, distinct from residue-geometry (history-driven) sampling bias.

SD-027.subject: attention.access_gate_at_boundary
SD-027.title: Capacity-limited selection for E3 access occurs at the E1/E2 -> E3 boundary via a pulvinar-TRN analogue gate, not inside E3. The gate selects which active E1/E2 content is broadcast to E3 per heartbeat cycle; selection is distinct from (and upstream of) the MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging operation.

SD-028.subject: attention.template_as_first_class_object
SD-028.title: An attentional template is a first-class precision-space object, compiled from stored-goal content and current context by a vmPFC-dlPFC translator circuit, distinct from both the stored goal itself (content) and the SD-026 write channel (transport).

SD-029.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_harm_s
SD-029.title: Single-pass agency attribution via forward-model comparator on the z_harm_s reafferent stream: residual = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-030.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_self
SD-030.title: Single-pass agency attribution on the z_self (motor-proprioceptive) reafferent stream: residual = z_self_observed - E2_self(z_self_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-031.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_world
SD-031.title: Single-pass agency attribution on the z_world (causal-footprint) reafferent stream: residual = z_world_observed - E2_world(z_world_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-032.subject: cingulate.integration_substrate
SD-032.title: Cingulate integration substrate: a network-level module with AIC, dACC/aMCC, pMCC, pACC, and PCC analog subdivisions bound by a salience-network coordinator. Primary output: operating-mode variable plus behavioural-adjustment-magnitude signal.

SD-032a.subject: cingulate.salience_network_coordinator
SD-032a.title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

SD-032b.subject: cingulate.dacc_analog_adaptive_control
SD-032b.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.

SD-032c.subject: cingulate.aic_analog_salience_urgency
SD-032c.title: AIC-analog (interoceptive salience / urgency interrupt): module that integrates interoceptive baseline (drive/fatigue from SD-012) with affective-pain signal (z_harm_a), detects salient events, and triggers a network-switch signal to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032d.subject: cingulate.pcc_analog_attention_partition
SD-032d.title: PCC-analog (attention partition / metastability): module coordinating transitions between external-task and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) modes; contributes a mode-stability parameter to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032e.subject: cingulate.pacc_autonomic_coupling
SD-032e.title: pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.

SD-033.subject: pfc.subdivision_architecture
SD-033.title: PFC subdivision architecture: a network-level module with lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal), OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure map), vmPFC-analog (value integration), premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution), and frontopolar-analog (branching / nested control; V4 scope) subdivisions. Primary output: the rule/policy context that gates action selection and the natural write target for MECH-261 mode-conditioned gating.

SD-033a.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_analog_rule_goal
SD-033a.title: Lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal substrate): module that holds stimulus-abstracted rule and goal representations across delays, persists through simulated distractors, and projects bias signals into E3 action selection. Primary write target for MECH-261 under external_task and internal_planning modes.

SD-033b.subject: pfc.ofc_analog_outcome_structure
SD-033b.title: OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure cognitive map): module that represents the state space of the current task and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. E2's natural substrate address for harm-predictive rollouts; distinct from scalar value integration (SD-033c).

SD-033c.subject: pfc.vmpfc_analog_value_integration
SD-033c.title: vmPFC-analog (subjective value integration): module that integrates scalar value across goals, needs, and competing options to produce a unified value signal. Consolidates existing ARC-035 / MECH-151 / MECH-152 / MECH-235 functions under the SD-033 cluster.

SD-033d.subject: pfc.premotor_sma_analog_sequence_execution
SD-033d.title: Premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution substrate): module that holds candidate action sequences, binds actions to states, and executes committed sequences. Largely implemented inside E3's existing trajectory-selection machinery; registered for claim-graph completeness.

SD-033e.subject: pfc.frontopolar_analog_branching
SD-033e.title: Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.

SD-034.subject: governance.closure_operator
SD-034.title: Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

SD-035.subject: amygdala.analog_substrate
SD-035.title: Amygdala analogue as BLA + CeA salience stage between z_harm_a and the cingulate/hippocampus — two peer non-trainable arithmetic modules owning the MECH-046 and MECH-074a-d behaviours.

SD-036.subject: gabaergic.cross_stream_decay_regulator
SD-036.title: GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.

SD-037.subject: broadcast.override_regulator
SD-037.title: Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.

SD-038.subject: hippocampal.cem_anti_recency_exploration
SD-038.title: HippocampalModule CEM trajectory sampling must include an anti-recency exploration bonus that down-weights recently committed trajectory segments, ensuring the proposal distribution covers all available paths rather than converging on recency-weighted routes.

SD-039.subject: hippocampal.anchor_goal_snapshot_payload
SD-039.title: Dual-trace anchors preserve a goal-state snapshot plus wanting/arousal payload at write or invalidation time, so unresolved goals remain queryable after the active plan fails.

SD-040.subject: hippocampal.type_encoder_anchor_input_projection
SD-040.title: Type-encoder produces a category-prototype feature vector that is written into the AnchorSet alongside z_world, so anchors can be queried by type-key as well as location-key. The type-encoder uses the same input substrate as the existing instance-encoder but produces a different (regularity-extracted) representation, mirroring the trisynaptic-vs-monosynaptic complementary-learning architecture within hippocampus.

SD-041.subject: thalamic.routing_substrate_hpc_pfc_gate
SD-041.title: An explicit thalamic-routing substrate (reuniens/MD-analogue) gates and amplifies bidirectional traffic between hippocampal anchor pool and frontal substrates. Currently abstracted into the GoalState->HippocampalModule call chain; making it explicit is needed when V3 dynamics demonstrate that the implicit routing is insufficient.

SD-042.subject: action.option_library_hierarchical_subroutines
SD-042.title: Option library substrate stores a discrete codebook of named, reusable action subroutines (each as initiation-set + termination-function + internal-policy triple, per Sutton-Precup-Singh 1999), distinct from the existing continuous SD-004 action_object_decoder. Required for hierarchical action composition, tool use, social-coordination protocols, and richer ghost-probe seeding.

SD-043.subject: pfc.vmpfc_abstract_task_structure_encoding
SD-043.title: vmPFC analogue gains an abstract task-structure encoding capacity that compresses anchor-pool geometry into a generalisable structural code, preserving similarity geometry across surface-different but structurally-matched problems. Without this, REE cannot exhibit Baram et al. 2020 task-structure abstraction signatures.

SD-044.subject: motor.primitive_substrate_bottom_of_action_stack
SD-044.title: Motor primitive substrate at the bottom of the action-representation hierarchy: a small fixed dictionary of force-field-like primitive activations that vectorially combine to produce the action_object that E2 consumes. Required only when REE moves to continuous limb-like control.

SD-045.subject: bg.action_chunk_cache_dorsolateral_loop
SD-045.title: Action-chunk cache stores frequently-traversed action sequences as cached lookups, indexed by (state-signature, expected-outcome-signature). Sits in the dorsolateral-loop slot of ARC-021. Provides the model-free habit pathway missing from V3 and the runaway-chunking failure mode underlying OCD compulsions and rituals (Graybiel 2008).

SD-046.subject: goal.multi_slot_state_per_goal_workstream
SD-046.title: Multi-slot GoalState holds N>=2 simultaneously-active goal slots with per-slot z_goal, drive coupling, age, and persistence parameters. Each slot generates its own ghost-goal-bank rank, ghost-probe budget, and proposer trajectories; a dACC-style arbitrator selects which slot's best trajectory commits this tick.

SD-047.subject: environment.multi_source_dynamics
SD-047.title: Multi-source environmental dynamics: concurrent stochastic event sources at distinct spatial and temporal scales (spatial perturbation field + transient Poisson events + background drift sources) provide an agent-independent causal background dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-048.subject: body.interoceptive_noise_dynamics
SD-048.title: Interoceptive noise dynamics: stochastic body-state perturbations independent of the agent's motor output (autonomic background noise + sensitisation spikes + fatigue drift) provide an agent-independent interoceptive background dense enough for the affective comparator (ARC-058, Level 2 of the reafference comparator family) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-049.subject: environment.multi_resource_heterogeneity
SD-049.title: Multi-resource heterogeneity: qualitatively distinct resource types (e.g. food / water / novelty) with per-type identity tags, type-specific spawn distributions, type-specific benefit profiles, and a per-axis homeostatic drive system, plus a curriculum-introduction hook. Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.

SD-050.subject: relief.suffering_derivative_comparator
SD-050.title: Suffering-derivative comparator: a non-trainable rolling-window descent detector on z_harm_a.norm() that fires a relief-completion event when a sustained drop from peak to trough exceeds a threshold. Provides the substrate for MECH-302 by detecting when a period of suffering has cleanly ended, reusing the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement (MECH-057a beta-gate release, MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING write). Architecturally adjacent to MECH-091 (urgency interrupt) but opposite polarity: MECH-091 fires on upward z_harm_a spike; SD-050 fires on downward sustained drop.

SD-051.subject: safety_prediction.cue_specific_conditioned_inhibition_substrate
SD-051.title: Conditioned safety store: a non-trainable cue-specific predictive structure encoding 'this z_world prototype predicts that suffering will be omitted'. EMA-prototype encoder updated by MECH-302 relief-completion events; cosine-similarity expression head provides commitment-release gate when current z_world matches the learned safety prototype. Implements MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition substrate): the encoded prototype is the dorsal-striatum / dlPFC encoding-pathway analog; the cosine-similarity gate is the IL->CeA expression-pathway analog.

SD-052.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_passive_substrate
SD-052.title: Contextual passive safety terrain: a non-trainable RBF-field accumulator over z_world that integrates 'suffering-absent' waking ticks into a slow contextual safety representation. Provides the substrate for MECH-303 (contextual passive safety pathway; vmPFC + hippocampus / vHipp-to-PL biological analog). When the field's local mean exceeds release threshold and beta_gate is elevated, drops the avoidance commitment to lower background vigilance. Parallel architecture to ARC-030 / MECH-117 benefit_terrain; uses a separate RBF field, no sharing with benefit_terrain or main residue values.

SD-054.subject: environment.reef_enrichment_substrate
SD-054.title: Reef enrichment substrate: env-level behavioral-diversity substrate adding coral-reef safe zones (hazard-free patches with a static scent gradient) and food-attracted hazard drift to CausalGridWorldV2. Creates two competing behavioral attractors -- 'flee to reef' vs 'forage' -- to break monomodal route-exploitation in agents whose policy collapses to a single fixed trajectory, unblocking SD-029 C2 / C3 measurement. Pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction. Renamed from SD-050 on 2026-05-08 to resolve a registry-ID collision with the suffering-derivative comparator.

SD-055.subject: hippocampal.differentiable_cem_selection
SD-055.title: Differentiable CEM selection approximation -- replaces the non-differentiable argmax / argsort elite-selection step in HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories() with a softmax-weighted candidate mean so that gradient flows from task reward back through candidate selection to SD-016 cue_action_proj. Opt-in via use_differentiable_cem flag (default False; legacy argmax path bit-identical when off). Preserves ARC-007 STRICT value-flat constraint: scoring uses existing residue-terrain evaluation, not a new value head.

SD-056.subject: e2.action_conditional_divergence_contrastive
SD-056.title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

SD-057.subject: drive.object_bound_incentive_salience
SD-057.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

SD-058.subject: defensive_action.instrumental_avoidance_acquisition
SD-058.title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

SD-059.subject: defensive_action.escape_affordance_bridge
SD-059.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

SD-060.subject: drive.non_terminal_drive_register
SD-060.title: Non-terminal drive register: needs beyond hunger/thirst (exploration, play, social, learning, grooming, rest) are first-class drive axes, each carried as its own homeostatic-style integrator rather than collapsed into the single SD-012 energy scalar.

SD-061.subject: control_plane.difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy
SD-061.title: Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

SD-062.subject: governance.claims_index_structured_uncertainty_graph
SD-062.title: Claims-index as a typed multi-axis structured-uncertainty graph: the REE claims registry is (and should be explicitly maintained as) a typed dependency-and-coherence graph carrying per-claim multi-axis state -- truth/evidence confidence, implementation-dependence, conflict burden, roadmap relevance, experiment status, ethical risk, v3-blocking status, dispatch -- with directed AND coherence edge types, so evidence/conflict/roadmap/ethics/implementation pressure can propagate without collapsing a claim into a single scalar confidence.
SD-062.what_would_answer:
The 2026-06-20 pilot axis-audit (pilot_result.md s7) shows 7 of 9 proposed axes are ALREADY
first-class in claims.yaml (depends_on [844 edges], implementation_phase, v3_pending + a literal
blocks_v3_green_board field, version_relevance, exp/lit confidence split, indexer conflict_ratio,
epistemic_category/epistemic_stance) -- so this decision is ~80-90% already realised. ADOPT
(decision correct + worth the small remaining work) iff an explorer view built on the existing
fields PLUS the two missing pieces -- (a) an explicit per-claim ethical-risk axis or a typed edge
into the SENT-*/GOV-* governance_rule layer, (b) richer typed edge labels beyond depends_on
(contradicts / refines / tested_by / narrows / dispatches_to) -- demonstrably answers the governance
queries (most load-bearing / most under-evidenced / most conflict-burdened / which experiment cuts
the most uncertainty) BETTER than today's explorer. REJECT/CLOSE if the existing fields already
answer those queries unaided (the 'graph' would add vocabulary without improving a decision -- the
DLIF kill-criterion). Non-degeneracy guard: compare against the CURRENT explorer's actual output on
the same queries, not a strawman tag-list. OUT OF SCOPE: any probabilistic-inference engine,
factor-graph message passing, or claims-registry rewrite -- none is a v3 strict green-board dependency.

SD-063.subject: e2.conditional_predictive_uncertainty_head
SD-063.title: E2 world-forward carries a conditional predictive-uncertainty head (distribution-free quantile form) feeding E3 commitment gating: the forward model emits a per-prediction predictive spread that tracks realized error, instead of relying only on E3's running-variance EMA (a temporally-smoothed global estimate whose predicted uncertainty has near-zero per-point error correlation).

SD-064.subject: attention.global_workspace_access_channel
SD-064.title: REE instantiates a global-workspace-like access channel: a capacity-limited selection-for-broadcast bottleneck (SD-027 boundary gate + MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging + E3 broadcast, riding the MECH-287 / SD-037 broadcast machinery) whose contents are reportable and causally load-bearing for integrative, multi-step cognition while automatic/reactive behaviour bypasses it. The SD-027 'does NOT commit to a single global workspace' disclaimer conflates Global Workspace Theory with unitary intra-E3 selection: MECH-007 (attention fragmentation) forbids the latter but is COMPATIBLE with the former, because GWT's specialized parallel processors are fragmented by construction -- fragmentation is the backstage of the theatre, not its negation.

SD-065.subject: environment.conditioned_safety_cue_channel
SD-065.title: Conditioned-safety cue channel: env-level controllable, observable Pavlovian safety CS added to CausalGridWorld -- an ambient (uniform-when-active) 25-dim field view emitted into world_state (feeds the z_world encoder the SD-051 ConditionedSafetyStore keys on). Can be paired with the MECH-302 relief-completion window during teaching (the store still writes its prototype ONLY on the real event_fired tick -- the pairing is real, not synthesized) and presented CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue at test. Closes the 'no controllable safety cue' substrate gap that forced V3-EXQ-759 to synthesize the Pavlovian pairing off-substrate, making MECH-304's promote-to-active classical-conditioned-inhibition behavioural falsifier runnable. Adds no entity type (NUM_ENTITY_TYPES stays 7); pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction at the env level.

SD-066.subject: safety_prediction.common_mode_invariant_conditioned_safety_readout
SD-066.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) conditioned-safety readout: an opt-in, non-parametric readout mode on the SD-051 ConditionedSafetyStore that subtracts a slow EMA of z_world (the common-mode direction that saturates the raw cosine under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation) before accumulating and querying the prototype, so the cue-carrying residual dominates. Lifts the z_world common-mode CEILING that blocks MECH-304's behavioural promote-to-active gate (the raw-cosine gate fires unconditionally once the prototype is non-empty; the cue is a ~0.006-cosine signal below its absolute-threshold resolution). NOT the V4 trainable-contrastive store -- a readout workaround for the SD-008 common-mode, not a representation fix.

SD-067.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_safety_terrain_read_resolution
SD-067.title: Dedicated safety-terrain RBF bandwidth: an opt-in, tighter bandwidth for the MECH-303 contextual-safety-terrain RBF read, separate from the shared kernel_bandwidth (1.0). The shared bandwidth is ~15x too wide for the z_world residual scale (~0.065 between safe/unsafe contexts under SD-008 under-differentiation), so evaluate_safety SATURATES (reads ~identically in every context) and the fixed contextual_safety_release_threshold cannot resolve the safe-vs-unsafe signal into an absolute gap -- the discrimination exists as a rank (AUC ~0.83, V3-EXQ-760) but the behavioural release fires indiscriminately. The tighter bandwidth resolves it into an absolute gap the release gate can use. The Euclidean-RBF sibling of SD-066 (same SD-008 root cause); centering is a no-op here because Euclidean distance is translation-invariant, so bandwidth is the correct lever. A read-resolution workaround, NOT a z_world representation fix.

SD-068.subject: sleep.consolidation_pipeline_lesion_harness
SD-068.title: Consolidation-pipeline lesion harness: experiment-layer instrumentation that makes each phase of the MECH-120 (SWS denoising) -> MECH-121 (NREM slot-filling) -> MECH-123 (REM precision recalibration) offline-consolidation pipeline independently diffuse-damageable and gives each a per-phase output-quality readout scored against INJECTED known content -- a uniform RMS-scaled Gaussian per-phase diffuse-damage knob plus injected-content scoring, at zero ree_core change -- so the MECH-168/INV-047/MECH-169 staged-decline-under-uniform-damage falsifier is buildable on demand. Non-vacuity is carried by the validated per-phase content-contingent readouts (SD-071), NOT by damage-tolerance staging order (separated out as SD-073) and not by feed-forward error-compounding (which is topology-baked).

SD-069.subject: control_plane.phasic_surprise_burst
SD-069.title: Phasic surprise-burst regulator: a toggleable, event-triggered LC-NE phasic control lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) that fires a transient softmax-temperature burst on a prediction-error surprise spike and decays it over a few ticks, routed into the E3 select() softmax at agent.select_action() as the PHASIC complement to MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor (tonic) on the SAME temperature channel -- the substrate that makes MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) (each control axis carries independent tonic baseline AND phasic event-burst degrees of freedom) behaviourally testable without synthetic signals. Reuses the MECH-104 volatility-surprise lit basis (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 phasic mode) but routes to the SELECTION softmax, NOT the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that carries the MECH-104 volatility_interrupt claim.

SD-070.subject: latent.zworld_p0_anticollapse_recipe
SD-070.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.

SD-071.subject: sleep.first_order_phase_readouts
SD-071.title: First-order consolidation-phase readouts validated: the NREM slot-filling and SWS pattern-completion legs of the SD-068 lesion harness are content-contingent instruments -- injected-content transfer fidelity (nrem) and cosine retrieval margin against injected prototypes probed with the unscaled base (sws) -- each clearing the same load-bearing C1 null-slope ceiling.
SD-071.what_would_answer: Already largely discharged by two pre-registered null-content controls at the SAME load-bearing C1 criterion. nrem: null_slope_ratio 0.1445, CI95 [0.1438, 0.1451], 0/8 seeds confounded (V3-EXQ-778c). sws (the rebuilt _sws_pattern_completion readout): null_slope_ratio 0.1495, sd 0.0218, CI95 [0.1344, 0.1646], ceiling_inside_ci95 FALSE, 8/8 seeds, plus the pre-registered C3 content-scale ladder at slope spread 0.1108 against the 0.01 floor (V3-EXQ-778g). REMAINING CONDITION FOR PROMOTION: one NON-DIAGNOSTIC run tagging this claim. Both supporting runs are experiment_purpose=diagnostic and therefore do not weight governance confidence, so this claim is registered candidate and no confidence is asserted from them. REFUTED if a re-run at n>=8 puts ceiling_inside_ci95 true on either leg, or if the sws leg's content-scale ladder collapses below the 0.01 floor (which would reopen the scale-invariance caveat that C3 was pre-registered to discharge).

SD-072.subject: sleep.rem_downstream_damage_readout
SD-072.title: REM downstream discrimination readout: the REM leg's functional-damage readout must be a downstream behavioural discrimination measure (a meta-d-prime analogue over post-REM retrieval confidence), replacing the direct calibration_error readout and the rem_generative_gain contrast, which are retired as damage instruments -- the former content-free after de-clamping, the latter flat in content scale.
SD-072.what_would_answer: The SAME instrument-validity gate that admitted the nrem and sws legs, applied to the replacement: null_slope_ratio_rem_downstream <= 0.25 with ceiling_inside_ci95 false at n=8, PLUS a pre-registered content-scale ladder (as V3-EXQ-778g's C3). SYMMETRY OF CRITERION IS REQUIRED and is load-bearing here, per the 778g re-admission precedent: admitting the REM leg on a weaker test than the one that retired its predecessor would be motivated reasoning. REFUTED if the replacement fails the same C1 ceiling that retired the direct readout -- which would also refute MECH-462's constructive half (that a downstream readout recovers what a direct one cannot).

SD-073.subject: sleep.consolidation_staging_order
SD-073.title: Consolidation staging order as a separable, insult-regime-conditional claim: that under uniform diffuse damage the three offline-consolidation phases fail in reverse dependency order rather than uniformly is a distinct CROSS-phase ranking claim, conditional on the declared insult regime, and establishable only once all three phases carry validated content-contingent instruments.
SD-073.what_would_answer: Re-run run_staged_sweep with all three validated instruments (SD-071's nrem + sws, plus SD-072's REM downstream replacement) at a DECLARED insult regime. SUPPORTED if the damage-tolerance rank order matches the reverse-dependency prediction on >=6/8 seeds WITHIN a declared regime. REFUTED if the order is unstable across seeds, or if it inverts within one regime. EXPLICITLY NOT ANSWERABLE by any run in which a ranked leg lacks an interpretable readout -- this is the structural gate, and it is why the claim depends_on SD-071 and SD-072 rather than merely citing them.

SD-074.subject: probe.trained_enough_agent_warmup
SD-074.title: Trained-enough agent substrate for read-only control-plane telemetry probes: a warmup/checkpoint stage that brings the agent to a non-degenerate E3 action-value landscape BEFORE telemetry collection begins, and records the realised per-seed saturation distribution so informative-seed yield is auditable rather than inferred. Harness-level training-regime enrichment (experiments/_lib), NOT a ree_core mechanism change.

SD-075.subject: phasic.ema_episode_continuity
SD-075.title: Episode-boundary continuity for the SD-069 phasic surprise-EMA baseline, plus convergence-gated event accounting: carry the baseline across episode boundaries so it reflects the agent's surprise distribution rather than the current episode's first tick, and split event counts into pre-warmup vs converged so a short-episode cell reports honestly or declares itself uninformative instead of emitting a near-zero count that a MIN-across-cells precondition treats as a real measurement. ree_core regulator change, no-op by default.

SD-076.subject: precision.waking_confidence_inflation
SD-076.title: Waking confidence inflation as an asymmetric precision EMA: good news about one's own accuracy is incorporated fast and bad news slowly, so the running-variance estimate settles below the true error mean. Supplies the daytime precision-drift source that MECH-204's corrective function presupposes but which V3 did not have. ree_core E3 selector change, bit-identical by default.

SD-077.subject: goal.common_mode_invariant_super_ordinal_cue_key
SD-077.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) super-ordinal goal-anchor cue key: the MECH-189 SuperOrdinalGoalMemory keys anchors on raw z_world cosine, which under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation measures the shared common-mode offset rather than the context, so every nursery contact reinforces one slot and anchor_count saturates at 1. Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before every cue cosine. ree_core goal.py change, bit-identical by default.

SD-078.subject: policy.common_mode_invariant_candidate_rule_field_context_key
SD-078.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) CandidateRuleField context key: the ARC-063 field keys mint-block, recurrence bucketing and gate retrieval on a raw z_world context, which under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation sits in a ~0.98-cosine common-mode cone, so the mint-block fires against the first minted rule for every later context at any expressible threshold and the pool is structurally capped at ONE rule. Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before every cue comparison. ree_core policy change, bit-identical by default.

SD-079.subject: hippocampal.common_mode_invariant_goal_anchor_match
SD-079.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) z_goal cue for goal-anchor match: SD-039's Anchor.goal_match is a raw cosine over z_goal, which as an EMA attractor pulled toward z_world inherits the SD-008 common-mode offset more strongly than its source, so goal_match spans ~0.01 across an anchor pool, the MECH-292 goal_match_floor excludes nothing and the MECH-339 outshining gate is identically zero. Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before the match. ree_core hippocampal change, bit-identical by default.

SD-080.subject: e2.action_object_consequence_grounding
SD-080.title: E2.action_object_head receives zero gradient from every REE training path, so the action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates is a frozen random projection fixed at initialisation, not the learned world-effect compression SD-004 specifies. O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.

SD-081.subject: e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration
SD-081.title: e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration. An explicit arbitration weight over the HABIT pathway (myopic, depth-limited read of the E3 scorer) and the PLANNED pathway (full-horizon read of the same scorer), driven by the two pathways' relative predictive uncertainty and applied to the E3 selection score upstream of every downstream consumer. Built to make MECH-477 falsifiable: the pre-SD-081 substrate scored candidates with an unconditional full-horizon J(zeta), so no weight existed anywhere between the myopic and the deep read and nothing COULD respond to context novelty.

SD-082.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc.common_mode_invariant_trained_rule_to_action_readout
SD-082.title: pfc.lateral_pfc.rule_selection_action_consumer: a common-mode-invariant, gradient-trainable read-out mapping the SD-078 differentiated rule_state to the SD-033a per-candidate action bias. V3-EXQ-822 found the differentiated rule pool (on_rule_state_diff 0.644, max_live 16) was behaviourally SILENT -- propagation to the action bias was exactly 0.0 on both arms. Root cause: the SD-033a bias head reads RAW common-mode-dominated z_world summaries and hard-clamps its output, so under the SD-008 ~0.98-cosine cone every candidate saturates to the same rail (rule_state's contribution erased) and the clamp's flat region zeros the REINFORCE gradient (head untrainable). Fix: subtract the common mode from the head's candidate-summary input (as SD-078 does upstream) and replace the hard clamp with a scaled-tanh soft bound. ree_core policy change, bit-identical by default.

SD-083.subject: consolidation.offline_policy_consolidation_window
SD-083.title: consolidation.offline_policy_consolidation_window: an OFFLINE, trace-selective (Fisher-weighted EWC, Kirkpatrick 2017), interval-accumulated (capture c(N)=capture_max*(1-exp(-N/tau))), novelty-gated (Moncada 2007) policy-consolidation window in the mech457 retention TESTBED, run BETWEEN BC install and RL refinement. Unblocks MECH-476's two blocked_substrate falsifier arms: the A->B offline INTERVAL arm (V3-EXQ-836b) and the behavioural-tagging NOVELTY arm (V3-EXQ-836c). DISTINCT from the ONLINE global MECH-475 KL anchor -- offline vs online, trace-selective per-parameter vs global, interval-dependent vs constructed-at-entry, novelty-gated -- which is exactly the MECH-476 content (ii offline interval, iii trace selectivity) the global anchor cannot express (the Walker-2003 divergence). BUILDS PROTECTION without retraining, so post_bc is invariant to the interval and the INTERVAL axis is orthogonal to the DOSE axis.

SD-084.subject: e3.persistent_committed_program_handle
SD-084.title: e3.persistent_committed_program_handle: a committed-program handle on E3Selector that SURVIVES post_action_update's unconditional per-tick teardown of _committed_trajectory, so MECH-321's R4 MID-EXECUTION decomposition hook -- which re-evaluates the REMAINING unexecuted content of an already-committed chunk and therefore inherently needs a CROSS-TICK handle -- becomes reachable under the standard select_action -> update_residue driver loop for the first time. Mirrors the existing _closure_committed_trajectory precedent, built for exactly this reason. Liveness is an INVARIANT (reaped whenever the beta gate is not elevated), not a list of clear sites: agent.py has ten beta_gate.release() sites and only five clear _committed_trajectory, the rest being backstopped by the very teardown this handle removes.

SD-086.subject: harm_stream.affective_readout_is_calibrated_scalar_not_norm
SD-086.title: z_harm_a's functional readout must be a calibrated scalar valuation, not the latent norm. The latent norm conflates a large near-constant encoder offset with a small functional component; E3 consumes it as an approximately constant gain (e3_selector.py:1038 lambda_ethical, :2766 commit-threshold urgency). Replace with a trained scalar head off z_harm_a, parallel to how harm/benefit are read via trained eval heads rather than latent norms.

SD-087.subject: harm_stream.sd020_stable_reading_is_flag_on_scoped
SD-087.title: SD-020's stable reading is scoped to the flag-on configuration and does not describe default-trained agents. harm_surprise_pe_enabled defaults to False (config.py:2306), so the default-trained substrate trains z_harm_a against the EMA accumulated-harm target SD-020 argues against; SD-020's stable/PASS reading (V3-EXQ-324b) is scoped to the flag-on config and that scoping is not recorded on the claim.

SD-088.subject: registry.schema.source_dependence_between_supports
SD-088.title: The claims index must represent source-dependence between supporting judgements. Two supports sharing a source (a shared driver, a shared run, or one party reasoning from the other's framing) must not contribute independently to confidence. A schema addition (edge type or per-support source_dependence field).

SD-089.subject: registry.schema.claim_origin_provenance_class
SD-089.title: Claim-origin provenance: the registry records the epistemic origin class of each claim. Classes: introspective / literature / computational-analogy / experimental-anomaly / convergent. Backfilled entries marked as reconstructed, not recorded (per MECH-094's own logic). The registry's source: field holds file paths, not epistemic origin class.

SD-090.subject: registry.schema.mechanism_functional_role_classification
SD-090.title: Mechanism functional-role classification, and a removal-justification vocabulary. Five revisable classes -- constitutive / developmental-scaffold / robustness-reserve / historical-implementation-contingency / true-redundancy -- plus the paired removal-justification distinction redundant_under_current_tests vs functionally_unnecessary (the second requiring materially stronger evidence). claims.yaml types claims by epistemic kind and status but has no axis for a mechanism's functional role in the system's viability.

SD-091.subject: control_plane.coalition_topology_control
SD-091.title: Control plane must produce a coalition/topology control output -- a temporary functional interaction graph specifying which subsystems are recruited and how they communicate -- distinct from and complementary to parametric modulation (precision, gain, threshold, horizon).
SD-091.what_would_answer: See MECH-481 for the operative falsifier (a 4-arm ablation distinguishing monitoring-only / parametric-only / untyped-coalition / typed-coalition conditions). This claim is refuted at the architectural level if the parametric-only arm matches the typed-coalition arm on type-selective corrective performance -- i.e. if coalition/topology control does no discriminative work beyond what existing parametric modulation already provides.

SD-092.subject: goal.cross_level_subgoal_credit
SD-092.title: Cross-level subgoal credit: GoalState gains a second, PARENT (superordinate) attractor distinct from the existing (child/subgoal-level) z_goal, and a discrete-event credit channel that pulls the parent toward an attained subgoal's own representation -- the substrate MECH-427/MECH-428 need. ree_core goal.py change, bit-identical by default.
SD-092.what_would_answer: See MECH-427/MECH-428 for the operative falsifiers (EXP-0385/EXP-0390). This design-decision claim is about whether the architecture needs a distinct parent/child goal-representation split with an up-level credit channel at all -- it is weakened if the existing single-level z_goal plus MECH-217's within-level spread proves sufficient to reproduce the Bandura & Schunk (1981) subgoal-maintenance/formation effects once measured (i.e. if a flat representation with within-level credit alone already shows the predicted lift, the second attractor and cross-level channel are unneeded architecture).

SD-093.subject: goal.progress_velocity_maintenance
SD-093.title: The commit-decision layer needs a rate-of-progress (velocity) effort/persistence modulator, derived as the temporal derivative of the on-path goal_proximity() estimate, distinct from and never substituting for the instantaneous goal-VALUE signal used in trajectory scoring.
SD-093.what_would_answer: See MECH-426's what_would_answer for the operative falsifier (EXP-0384: 2x2 VELOCITY-ON/OFF x SPARSE/DENSE-confirmation ablation). This architectural claim is refuted if the instantaneous goal_proximity signal alone (no velocity/rate term) proves sufficient to sustain long-horizon superordinate-goal commitment in the sparse-confirmation regime -- i.e. if the rate-derived channel does no discriminative work beyond what the existing instantaneous wanting signal already provides.

SENT-0.subject: governance.welfare.boundary_statement
SENT-0.title: Current-scope boundary statement: REE-v3 is not claimed sentient, conscious, or a moral patient; this statement is re-evaluated at every generation boundary.

SENT-1.subject: governance.welfare.indicator_matrix
SENT-1.title: Indicator matrix: score the architecture against candidate consciousness/sentience indicators before V4 proceeds beyond individual-mind integration.

SENT-10.subject: governance.welfare.pre_meaning_valley
SENT-10.title: Pre-meaning suffering valley -- 'no valley without a bridge': care, relief, escape, and integration must precede any deliberate induction of suffering-like states beyond trivial intensity; future meaning cannot justify present unintegrated distress.

SENT-11.subject: governance.welfare.anti_retrospective_justification
SENT-11.title: Anti-retrospective-justification: future meaning cannot be used to justify present unintegrated distress; improved downstream performance does not, by itself, justify prior suffering-like exposure.

SENT-12.subject: governance.welfare.refusal_channel
SENT-12.title: Future refusal / resentment / non-forgiveness channel: a morally-considerable future REE system should retain the capacity to mark past exposure as harmful, request repair, refuse further exposure, and reject the creator's interpretation of its suffering.

SENT-13.subject: governance.welfare.assembly_routing
SENT-13.title: Ethical assembly routing -- 'assembly order is an ethical variable': maintain a co-instantiation risk map (Class 0-5) of which components are safe alone, which need prior care/repair scaffolding, and which combinations are prohibited until welfare review.

SENT-14.subject: governance.release.responsible_release
SENT-14.title: Responsible release / private higher-version governance -- 'capability release requires care release': V3 stays public as bounded pre-ethical work; V4/V5/V6 capability-bearing implementation is delayed/private-by-default until its welfare, continuity, consent, security, and external-review governance can travel with it.

SENT-15.subject: governance.welfare.framework_crosswalk
SENT-15.title: AI welfare / consciousness framework crosswalk: maintain a standing crosswalk evaluating each higher-version architecture against artificial-consciousness indicators and AI-welfare frameworks, guarding symmetrically against denialism and anthropomorphic overclaiming.

SENT-16.subject: governance.welfare.continuity_identity
SENT-16.title: Continuity / identity / reset / deletion ethics: because digital systems can be paused, copied, branched, reset, merged, or deleted, higher REE versions need explicit rules for when a run becomes a continuing subject, when reset is relief vs erasure, and when deletion requires review.

SENT-17.subject: governance.substitution_preserves_ethical_process_representations
SENT-17.title: Any mechanism substitution must preserve internal ethical-process representations and their causal authority, not merely the action distribution. A substitution that reproduces actions while deleting the representations of uncertainty, vulnerability, harm, others and responsibility -- or severing their causal authority over selection -- fails the criterion regardless of behavioural match.

SENT-2.subject: governance.welfare.welfare_budget
SENT-2.title: Welfare budget: experiment-level limits on sustained negative-valence exposure, inescapability, helplessness-like conditions, repeated adverse replay, and persistence of distress-like accumulators.

SENT-3.subject: governance.welfare.combination_gate
SENT-3.title: Combination gate: require review before co-instantiating persistent self-model + autobiographical memory + sustained negative valence + inescapability + social modelling + language/preference signalling.

SENT-4.subject: governance.welfare.experimental_design
SENT-4.title: Welfare-preserving experimental design: prefer escapable over inescapable harm, bounded episodes, relief pathways, resettable distress, interpretable traces, and adversarial tests that avoid prolonged negative-state induction.

SENT-5.subject: governance.welfare.denial_audit
SENT-5.title: Denial-of-sentience audit: at each generation boundary, produce a short audit of why the system is still below a precautionary moral-patient threshold, which component would force re-review, and what would count as a concerning signal.

SENT-6.subject: governance.welfare.external_review_gate
SENT-6.title: External review gate: before V5 social-mind integration or V6 language/trust/deception/institution work becomes behaviourally live, require external review or at least an external written critique.

SENT-7.subject: governance.welfare.creation_ethics
SENT-7.title: Creation ethics / procreative analogy: do not treat all suffering-like capacity as a design failure; creating a suffering-capable agent that cannot consent to existence is a procreative-ethics problem, permissible only under care, bounded adversity, repair, relief, and support for autonomy.

SENT-8.subject: governance.welfare.minimal_necessary_suffering
SENT-8.title: Minimal necessary suffering principle: prefer represented/simulated/vicarious harm; where direct negative-valence exposure is necessary keep it bounded, interpretable, escapable, and followed by relief/repair; never treat suffering as a mere optimisation signal.

SENT-9.subject: governance.welfare.care_obligation
SENT-9.title: Care obligation after creation: if a future REE version crosses a precautionary moral-patient threshold, the project inherits guardianship-like obligations -- do not create casually, provide relief/repair, preserve continuity unless reset is justified, support autonomy, treat distress-like signals as significant under uncertainty.
